title: Energy dissipation in linear viscoelasticity
summary: We compare the specific dissipation $Q^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ for the Becker, Lomnitz, and Lambert models in linear viscoelasticity. Graphically, the specific dissipation of these models behaves similarly as $ω\rightarrow 0^{+}$ and $ω\rightarrow +\infty$. Furthermore, we obtain analytic formulas for the asymptotic behavior of $Q^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ in the Becker and Lomnitz models as $ω\rightarrow 0^{+}$ and $ω\rightarrow +\infty$, where the latter limit coincides with the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model. We also derive a novel closed-form expression for the specific dissipation in the generalized Becker model, $Q_{ν}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $, when the parameter $ν\in \left( 0,1\right] $ is rational. When $ν\rightarrow 0$, we recover the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model, whereas when $ν=1$, we recover that of the original Becker model. In addition, we derive two new closed-form expressions for the specific dissipation for the extended Jeffreys--Lomnitz model $Q_{α}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $, the first being valid for $α\in \left( 0,1\right] $, and the second for $α\in \left( -\infty ,1\right] $. When $α\rightarrow 0$, we recover the specific dissipation of the Lomnitz model, whereas when $α=1$, we recover that of the Maxwell model. Finally, we conclude that the asymptotic behavior of $Q_{α}^{-1}\left( ω\right) $ as $ω\rightarrow +\infty $ coincides with the specific dissipation of the Maxwell model. Keywords:

AI.tldr: 本文在线性粘弹性力学框架下，对Becker、Lomnitz和Lambert三种模型的比耗散函数Q^{-1}(ω)进行了系统比较，并推导出Becker、Lomnitz以及广义Becker、扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型在特定参数条件下的闭式解析表达式及其渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 比耗散函数是刻画粘弹性材料能量耗散特性的关键物理量，不同粘弹性模型（如Becker、Lomnitz、Lambert等）的Q^{-1}(ω)行为差异对材料建模与参数识别具有重要影响，但现有文献缺乏对这些模型比耗散函数系统性的解析比较与闭式表达式推导。
AI.method: 通过图析对比三种经典模型（Becker、Lomnitz、Lambert）的比耗散函数，并利用解析方法推导Becker和Lomnitz模型在ω→0^+和ω→+∞时的渐近公式；进一步对广义Becker模型（参数ν为有理数时）和扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型（分别针对α∈(0,1]与α∈(-∞,1]两种参数区间）推导出新型闭式解析表达式。
AI.result: 发现三种经典模型在ω→0^+和ω→+∞极限下比耗散函数图像行为相似；Becker与Lomnitz模型的无穷大极限与Maxwell模型的比耗散一致；广义Becker模型的闭式表达式在ν→0时还原为Maxwell模型、ν=1时还原为标准Becker模型；扩展Jeffreys–Lomnitz模型的两个闭式表达式在α→0时还原为Lomnitz模型、α=1时还原为Maxwell模型，且该模型在ω→+∞时的渐近行为与Maxwell模型的比耗散一致。
AI.conclusion: 各模型之间的极限关系揭示了这些粘弹性模型在能量耗散特性上的内在联系，所获得的闭式表达式为工程应用中的比耗散计算提供了更便捷的解析工具，并为后续扩展模型的渐近分析奠定了基础。

title: Information Loss under Gauge Reduction of Discrete Electromagnetic Fields
summary: We study relative entropy under gauge reduction in Whitney-discretized electromagnetism. The discrete Hodge decomposition separates exact gauge directions from harmonic and coexact physical degrees of freedom. For Gaussian distributions on the auxiliary potential space, relative entropy splits exactly into the relative entropy of the physical marginals and a nonnegative conditional gauge contribution. We express this contribution through Schur complements, conditional means, and physical--gauge correlations, and characterize equality between auxiliary and physical relative entropies. The physical divergence is also shown to be the minimum over all Gaussian auxiliary extensions. At the infinitesimal level, Fisher information admits an analogous decomposition. A two-variable model illustrates how statistically distinct auxiliary potentials may represent identical physical statistics. The construction provides an information-geometric interpretation of discrete gauge reduction without assigning physical significance to the eliminated gauge variables.

AI.tldr: 本文研究惠特尼离散化电磁学中规范约化下的相对熵。通过离散Hodge分解分离精确规范方向与调和及共精确物理自由度，证明了高斯分布下辅助势空间中的相对熵可精确分解为物理边缘分布的相对熵与非负条件规范贡献之和，并给出了Fisher信息分解及双变量模型演示。
AI.motivation: 在离散电磁学中引入规范自由度会产生冗余参数，使得辅助势空间中的统计量（如相对熵、Fisher信息）可能蕴含非物理信息。作者旨在厘清规范约化前后统计量之间的关系，为离散规范体系的统计推断和几何解释提供理论基础，不赋予被消除的规范变量以物理意义。
AI.method: 利用离散Hodge分解将辅助势空间分解为精确（规范）、调和与共精确（物理）三个子空间。对高斯分布，通过Schur补、条件均值与物理-规范相关性，推导相对熵在约化前后的精确分解公式，并刻画两者相等（零规范贡献）的条件。类似结构推广至无穷小层面的Fisher信息，并以双变量模型构造示例验证统计上不同的辅助势可对应相同物理统计。
AI.result: 证明了辅助势空间中的相对熵等于物理边缘相对熵加上非负的条件规范贡献项；物理分布的散度等于所有高斯辅助扩展中相对熵的最小值；Fisher信息具有类似分解；双变量模型展示了不同辅助势分布可对应完全相同的物理统计，说明规范变量确实不含物理信息。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为离散规范约化提供了信息几何层面的精确解释：物理统计量不受规范选择影响，而被约化的规范变量仅贡献非负的"不可约"信息项。这为在网格/多面体离散框架下进行无规范依赖的统计推断与不确定性量化奠定了基础。

title: Distance Energies and Negative Type of Flat Tori
summary: Let \(T_Λ=\mathbb R^d/Λ\), \(d\geq2\), be a flat torus with quotient metric \(ρ_Λ\), and consider the distance energies \(I_α(μ)=\iint ρ_Λ(x,y)^α\,dμ(x)\,dμ(y)\) of Borel probability measures \(μ\). We prove a quantitative Fourier signature of the cut locus: for every Voronoi facet and every \(α>0\), there is a sequence of dual-lattice frequencies approaching the facet normal along which the Fourier coefficients of \(ρ_Λ^α\) are positive, with an explicit leading asymptotic determined by the facet. As direct consequences, Haar measure is not a local maximizer for any positive distance power, even among smooth densities, and every flat torus of dimension at least two has supremal negative type and generalized roundness zero. We then solve the global maximization problem for two classes of flat tori. On an orthogonal rectangular torus, the maximizers undergo a transition at \(α=2\): for \(1\leqα<2\) they are the translated uniform measures on the two-torsion subgroup; at \(α=2\) all balanced couplings on translates of that subgroup are extremal; and for \(α>2\) only equally weighted diametral pairs remain. On the regular hexagonal torus, the maximizers are precisely the uniform measures on translates of a distinguished cyclic subgroup of order three for every \(α\geq1\).

AI.tldr: 本文研究平坦环面上Borel概率测度的距离能量I_α(μ)，证明了割迹的定量Fourier特征：对每个Voronoi面和α>0，存在趋于面法线的对偶格点频率序列，使ρ_Λ^α的Fourier系数为正并有显式主导渐近。由此推出Haar测度对任何正距离幂都不是局部极大值，且维数≥2的平坦环面具有上确界负型和广义圆度零。对正交矩形环面，极大值在α=2处发生转变；对正六边形环面，极大值恰为某三阶循环子群的平移上的均匀测度。
AI.motivation: 将经典的负型（negative type）与距离能量最大化理论推广到更一般的平坦环面几何，探索割迹（cut locus）结构与Fourier分析之间的深层联系，并希望获得距离能量全局极大值的显式刻画。
AI.method: 利用平坦环面的对偶格点结构与Voronoi胞腔分解，对距离能量ρ_Λ^α的Fourier展开进行精细定量分析，推导沿特定晶格频率序列上Fourier系数的显式正号渐近；结合优化的变分方法与对称性论证求解两类特殊环面上的全局最大化问题。
AI.result: (1)建立了割迹诱导Fourier系数正的定量定理；(2)证明Haar测度非任何α>0距离能量的局部极大值，以及平坦环面的supremal negative type与generalized roundness为零；(3)正交矩形环面上极大值在α=2发生相变：1≤α<2为二挠子群平移上的均匀测度，α=2为平衡耦合，α>2仅为等权重直径对；(4)正六边形环面上极大值恰好是x三阶循环子群的平移均匀测度。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了平坦环面距离能量的极大熵型结构与割迹Fourier特征之间的深刻联系，完整解决了正交矩形与正六边形两类环面的全局最大化问题，为负型理论与最优测度配置提供了新的定量工具。

title: An Algebraic Proof of Gauge-Fixing Independence
summary: This paper provides an algebraic proof of the gauge-fixing independence of perturbative asymptotic expansions in a finite-dimensional model of non-Abelian gauge theory. We develop an algebraic framework using the BRST formalism and perturbation theory. Our main theorem shows that under appropriate transversality conditions, normalized expectation values of observables remain unchanged under smooth deformations of the gauge-fixing conditions that preserve these assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过代数方法证明了有限维非阿贝尔规范理论模型中，微扰渐近展开的规范固定无关性。利用BRST形式主义和微扰理论构建代数框架，证明了在适当横截性条件下，保持这些假设的规范固定条件的光滑形变不会改变可观测量归一化期望值。
AI.motivation: 在非阿贝尔规范理论中，物理可观测量的计算结果应不依赖于人为选择的规范固定条件。虽然在物理上普遍预期这一性质成立，但缺乏严格的代数证明。本文旨在为这一核心物理原理提供严格的数学基础。
AI.method: 采用BRST（Becchi-Rouet-Stora-Tyutin）形式主义构建代数框架，结合微扰理论分析有限维模型。通过设定适当的横截性条件（transversality conditions），研究规范固定条件在保持这些假设前提下的光滑形变，并证明可观测量归一化期望值在此类形变下的不变性。
AI.result: 建立了主定理：在适当的横截性条件下，对满足这些假设的规范固定条件进行光滑形变时，可观测量的归一化期望值保持不变，从而从代数层面严格证明了规范固定无关性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非阿贝尔规范理论的规范固定无关性提供了严格的代数证明，尽管是在有限维模型的设定下，但为将该性质推广到更一般的量子场论情形奠定了数学基础。

title: A new O(n log n) approach for the Euclidean maximum weight matching problem
summary:
In a weighted graph $G = (V, E)$, the maximum weight matching problem (MWM) asks for a matching (i.e. pairing) of its vertices, such that each vertex is paired with at most one other vertex and the total sum of weights of all edges connecting paired vertices is maximised. If the vertices of the graph correspond to points in the Euclidean plane and the weights to their pairwise Euclidean distances, we get the Euclidean maximum weight matching problem (Euclidean MWM). The best optimum-solution algorithm for this problem runs in $O(n^{2.5})$. Furthermore, there exists an FPTAS guaranteeing a $(1 - ε)$-approximation ratio, which runs in $O(m ε^{-1} \log ε^{-1})$ time. Heuristics with a subquadratic running time (with respect to the number of vertices $|V|$) are known, but often yield solutions of a modest quality.
  In this paper, we present a novel algorithm for solving the Euclidean MWM running in $O(n \log n)$ time and providing excellent solution quality, especially for larger instances. In particular, in our computational tests, the algorithm yielded optimum or near-optimum solutions for all test instances; the worst observed optimality gap was less than $1.38\%$. This makes the algorithm highly attractive for practical applications, especially when exact methods become computationally prohibitive due to the size of the instance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于欧几里得最大权重匹配（Euclidean MWM）问题的新算法，运行时间为O(n log n)，在计算测试中对所有实例均获得最优或近最优解，最差最优性间隙小于1.38%。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得最大权重匹配问题的最优算法复杂度为O(n^2.5)，FPTAS的时间为O(m ε^-1 log ε^-1)，虽然存在次二次时间的启发式算法但解质量往往有限。实际应用中需要一种既高效又能保证良好解质量的算法。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的欧几里得最大权重匹配求解算法，其时间复杂度为O(n log n)，通过利用欧几里得空间的几何特性来加速匹配过程。
AI.result: 在计算测试中，算法对所有测试实例均获得最优或近最优解，最差观测到的最优性间隙小于1.38%，尤其在大规模实例上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在实际应用中具有高度吸引力，特别是在实例规模使得精确方法计算代价过高时。

title: Measurement of CP Asymmetry Parameters and Polarization Correlations in $Ω^{-}\barΩ^{+}$ Pairs
summary: Using $(2.71 \pm 0.01) \times 10^9$ $ψ(3686)$ events collected with the BESIII detector, a joint full angular distribution analysis is carried out for the process $ψ(3686) \to Ω^-(\toΛK^-) \, \barΩ^{+}(\to \barΛK^+)$. The first simultaneous measurement of the weak decay parameters $φ_{Ω^{-}}$ and $φ_{\barΩ^{+}}$ for $Ω^- \to K^-Λ$ and $\barΩ^+ \to K^+\barΛ$ is performed, yielding the first result for the CP-sensitive observable, $φ_{\rm CP} = (-0.004 \pm 0.055 \pm 0.017)~\text{rad}$, where the first and second uncertainties are statistical and systematic, respectively. This further enables the extraction of the weak and strong phase differences between the $P$- and $D$-wave amplitudes: $(ξ_D - ξ_P) = (-0.15 \pm 2.25 \pm 0.69)~\text{rad}$ and $(δ_D - δ_P) = (-0.97 \pm 0.88 \pm 0.34)~\text{rad}$. Additionally, the polarization correlations between $Ω^{-}$ and $\barΩ^{+}$ are measured.

AI.tldr: 基于BESIII探测器采集的约27.1亿ψ(3686)事例，对ψ(3686)→Ω⁻(→ΛK⁻)Ω̄⁺(→Λ̄K⁺)过程进行了联合全角分布分析，首次同时测量了Ω⁻→K⁻Λ和Ω̄⁺→K⁺Λ̄的弱衰变参数φ，得到CP敏感可观测量φ_CP = (-0.004 ± 0.055 ± 0.017) rad，并与标准模型预测一致。
AI.motivation: 通过测量Ω超子及其反粒子的弱衰变参数，检验CP对称性是否在重子衰变中被破坏，为寻找超出标准模型的新物理提供线索。此前尚未对Ω⁻及其反粒子实现弱衰变参数的联合测量。
AI.method: 利用BESIII探测器采集的(2.71±0.01)×10⁹个ψ(3686)事例，对ψ(3686)→Ω⁻(→ΛK⁻)Ω̄⁺(→Λ̄K⁺)全过程进行联合全角分布分析，同时测量Ω⁻和Ω̄⁺的弱衰变参数φ，进而提取CP敏感可观测量φ_CP以及P波与D波振幅之间的弱相位差和强相位差，并测量极化关联。
AI.result: 首次测得φ_CP = (-0.004 ± 0.055 ± 0.017) rad，弱相位差(ξ_D-ξ_P) = (-0.15 ± 2.25 ± 0.69) rad，强相位差(δ_D-δ_P) = (-0.97 ± 0.88 ± 0.34) rad；同时获得了Ω⁻与Ω̄⁺之间的极化关联测量结果。
AI.conclusion: φ_CP的测量结果与零一致（在误差范围内），表明在当前统计精度下未观测到CP破缺信号，与标准模型预言相符。该工作为检验重子衰变中的CP对称性提供了新的实验数据约束。

title: Thick subcategories over weakly symmetric algebras with radical cube zero
summary: In this paper, we study thick subcategories of the (stable) module categories of finite-dimensional weakly symmetric algebras with radical cube zero. When the spectral radius of the Ext matrix is two, thick subcategories containing the algebra, equivalently thick subcategories of the stable category, are classified by Serre subcategories of a certain abelian category; when it is not two, only the trivial thick subcategories occur. As an application, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the first examples of commutative Noetherian Gorenstein dominant local rings that are not complete intersections.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有三次根为零的有限维弱对称代数的（稳定）模范畴中的厚子范畴。当Ext矩阵的谱半径为2时，包含代数的厚子范畴（等价于稳定范畴的厚子范畴）可通过某个阿贝尔范畴的Serre子范畴来分类；当谱半径不为2时，仅存在平凡厚子范畴。作为应用，本文首次给出了非完全交的交换诺特Gorenstein优势局部环的例子。
AI.motivation: 理解弱对称代数（尤其是三次根为零的有限维代数）的稳定模范畴中的厚子范畴结构，建立其分类框架，并探索此类分类结果在交换环论中的深远应用。
AI.method: 利用Ext矩阵的谱半径作为关键不变量进行区分：当谱半径为2时，构建厚子范畴与Serre子范畴之间的等价分类对应；当谱半径不为2时，证明仅存在平凡厚子范畴。
AI.result: 完成了对三次根为零的弱对称代数稳定模范畴中厚子范畴的完整分类，分类结果由Ext矩阵的谱半径（是否为2）二分决定。
AI.conclusion: 该分类结果为构造非完全交的交换诺特Gorenstein优势局部环提供了全新途径，填补了该方向的空白。

title: Optimal long-run control of endemic infections: bang-bang threshold policies in a stochastic SIS model
summary: We study long-run optimal intervention strategies for endemic infections in a stochastic susceptible-infected-susceptible (SIS) model. The proportion of infected individuals evolves as a diffusion process with random fluctuations, while a control variable $ζ_t\in[0,\tildeζ_{max}]$ represents the intensity of public health interventions that reduce transmission for some intervention threshold $\tildeζ_{max}\in (0,1]$. The objective is to minimize the long-run average societal cost, balancing the burden of infection against the costs of interventions. Under a concave intervention cost structure the problem can be formulated as an ergodic stochastic control problem, whose structure implies (under certain additional conditions) that optimal interventions are of bang-bang type, switching between no intervention and the maximal admissible intervention at a single switching threshold in the infection level. We construct candidate value functions, rigorously verify optimality in this single-threshold case, and relate the results to extinction and persistence properties of the underlying SIS dynamics in the absence of control. In our framework, the analysis provides a rigorous justification for the threshold-based intervention rules commonly used in epidemic management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机SIS流行病模型中的长期最优干预策略，在凹性干预成本结构下将问题构造成遍历随机控制问题，证明最优干预为单阈值的bang-bang型策略，并提供了严格的数学验证。
AI.motivation: 为流行病管理中常用的阈值干预策略提供严格的数学理论依据，在随机SIS模型中从长期平均成本最小化的角度推导出最优干预的结构。
AI.method: 将随机SIS模型中的感染比例建模为扩散过程，引入代表公共卫生干预强度的控制变量ζ_t∈[0,ζ_max]，在凹性干预成本结构下将问题形式化为遍历随机控制问题，构造候选值函数并严格验证单阈值bang-bang最优性，同时与无控制下SIS动力学的灭绝与持久性性质相联系。
AI.result: 在某些附加条件下证明最优干预为bang-bang类型，即在单一感染水平阈值处进行无干预与最大许可干预之间的切换；构建了候选值函数并严格验证了单阈值情形下的最优性。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为流行病管理中常用的基于阈值的干预规则提供了严格的数学论证，将感染负担与干预成本权衡下的随机最优控制问题归结为清晰的单阈值切换策略。

title: Lower bounds for some value sets over finite fields: incidence geometry and Bourgain's group expansion theorem
comment: 20 pages, no figures. Comments are welcome. A partial Lean 4 formalization is available at https://github.com/hxypqr/finite-field-value-sets
summary: We develop two transition principles for lower-bounding value sets generated by structured sequences over prime fields. A reciprocal-affine family with $M$ internal transitions and bounded quotient multiplicity has image size $\gg \min{M,p}^{8/15}$. This recovers the factorial-residue bound and yields the same exponent for arithmetic Pochhammer products, Gaussian $q$-factorials, derangement numbers, and the numbers of ordered subsets. A second theorem treats nonzero sequences whose consecutive ratios evolve under a nondegenerate M"obius transformation: their value sets have size $\gg \min{M,p}^{1/2+η}$ for an absolute constant $η>0$. As consequences, fixed rows of Pascal's triangle and the initial half-blocks of the Catalan and central binomial sequences exceed the square-root scale. The proofs combine transition quotients with, respectively, Cartesian-product point-line incidence geometry and Bourgain's expansion-based incidence theorem in $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了两个转换原理，用于下界估计质数域上结构化序列生成的值集大小。第一个原理针对具有M次内部转换且商重数有界的互反仿射族，得到值集大小 ≫ min{M,p}^{8/15}；第二个定理处理连续比率在非退化Möbius变换下演化的非零序列，得到值集大小 ≫ min{M,p}^{1/2+η}。后者推论表明Pascal三角形固定行、Catalan数与中心二项式序列的初始半块超过平方根尺度。
AI.motivation: 研究质数域上结构化序列（如阶乘、Pochhammer乘积、组合数序列）生成的值集的大小，这在数论和加性组合学中具有基础性意义。已有结果（如阶乘余数和相关界）往往局限于特定序列，缺乏统一的转换原理框架来系统地获得更优或适用于更广泛序列的下界。
AI.method: 论文提出两个转换原理：(1) 对互反仿射族（具有M次内部转换和有界商重数），将其与笛卡尔积点-线关联几何相结合，导出值集大小 ≫ min{M,p}^{8/15}；(2) 对连续比率由非退化Möbius变换演化的非零序列，利用Bourgain在SL_2(F_p)中的基于展开的关联定理，得到指数突破平方根的下界 ≫ min{M,p}^{1/2+η}。
AI.result: 第一个原理恢复了阶乘余数界，并为算术Pochhammer乘积、高斯q-阶乘、错排数和有序子集数给出了相同的指数8/15。第二定理表明存在绝对常数η>0，使此类序列的值集大小至少为 min{M,p}^{1/2+η}；作为推论，Pascal三角形固定行以及Catalan数、中心二项式序列的初始半块的值集都超过平方根尺度。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将转换商与不同的加法组合学工具（笛卡尔积点-线关联几何与Bourgain展开型关联定理）配对，建立了两个普适的转换原理，统一并改进了此前已知的阶乘类序列下界，并为多类经典组合序列的值集大小提供了突破平方根障碍的新下界。

title: Kibble-Zurek Dynamics in Two-dimensional Frustrated Systems with a Neural Foundation-state Subspace Method
summary: Universal scaling generated when a strongly interacting quantum many-body system is driven across a continuous phase transition provides a dynamical probe of equilibrium criticality. Accessing this regime numerically in two dimensions is challenging because it requires accurate real-time evolution of correlated many-body states over many system sizes and driving rates. We introduce a Neural Foundation-state Subspace (NFS) method for near-adiabatic dynamics. A foundation neural-network quantum state represents the ground-state manifold along the driving path, and a small fidelity-selected subset defines a fixed variational subspace. The many-body Schrödinger equation then reduces to the evolution of a few linear coefficients, with projected operators reusable across ramp times. We validate the method on the two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, recovering the expected Kibble-Zurek scaling and critical exponents in quantitative agreement with ground-state quantum Monte Carlo estimates. Applied to the frustrated square-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model up to $16 \times 16$ clusters, our approach provides strong numerical evidence of Kibble-Zurek mechanism across the Néel-to-spin-liquid transition at $J_2/J_1=0.49$, yielding ${ν=1.23(15)}$ and ${η=0.409(19)}$ at fixed $z=1$, consistent with static estimates and supporting the proposed continuous critical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经基态子空间（NFS）方法，用于高效模拟强关联量子多体系统的近绝热动力学，并在二维横场Ising模型和阻挫J1-J2海森堡模型中验证了Kibble-Zurek标度行为。
AI.motivation: 在二维强关联量子多体系统中，驱动系统跨越连续相变时产生的普适标度为平衡临界性提供了动力学探测手段，但精确的实时演化数值模拟在二维下极具挑战性，需要对多个系统尺寸和驱动速率进行精确的关联多体态实时演化。需要开发新的数值方法来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出神经基态子空间（Neural Foundation-state Subspace, NFS）方法：利用基础神经网络量子态表示沿驱动路径的基态流形，通过保真度选择的子集构建固定的变分子空间，从而将多体薛定谔方程简化为少数线性系数的演化，投影算子可在不同斜坡时间之间重复使用。
AI.result: 在二维横场Ising模型中验证了该方法，恢复的Kibble-Zurek标度和临界指数与基态量子蒙特卡洛估计定量一致。应用于16×16的阻挫方格子J1-J2海森堡模型，在J2/J1=0.49处提供了跨越Néel到自旋液体转变的Kibble-Zurek机制的有力数值证据，固定z=1时得到ν=1.23(15)和η=0.409(19)，与静态估计一致，支持所提出的连续临界行为。
AI.conclusion: NFS方法成功实现了二维强关联系统的大规模近绝热动力学模拟，为验证临界动力学普适性提供了有效工具，并有力支持了J1-J2模型中Néel到自旋液体转变具有连续临界行为的结论。

title: Decomposition of Sparse Integer Programs via Nonlinear Edge Encodings and Column-and-Row Generation
summary: A wide range of sparse integer programs admit a block structure in which subproblems interact through a small set of shared variables. Dualizing the linking equalities yields a decomposable Lagrangian relaxation, but generally introduces a duality gap. Recent work shows that this gap can be closed while preserving decomposability by dualizing exponentially large families of redundant nonlinear consistency constraints on the shared variables. We develop a computational framework for exploiting this idea without explicitly constructing the resulting exponentially large relaxation. Our framework combines nonlinear edge encodings of shared-variable consistency with a column-and-row generation (CRG) algorithm that generates local integer solutions by pricing and encoding constraints by separation. With complete encodings and exact separation, the framework recovers the exact relaxation while retaining independent optimization over the blocks. We introduce several encoding families and establish exponential separations among them: the Generalized family can require exponentially fewer constraints than the Vertex, Monomial, or Reflected families, yet can itself require exponentially many constraints on instances for which a single problem-specific encoding suffices. Computational experiments on decomposed stable-set and dominating-set instances show that CRG substantially outperforms a monolithic formulation across a range of tree topologies and coupling strengths. The results also show that richer encoding families need not perform better computationally, highlighting the choice of encoding as a central issue in effective decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个计算框架，利用非线性边界编码和列与行生成（CRG）算法，在不显式构造指数大规模松弛的情况下，通过对偶化共享变量的冗余非线性一致性约束来闭合分解式Lagrangian松弛的对偶间隙。实验表明CRG在分解的稳定集和支配集问题上显著优于单体模型，且更丰富的编码族不一定计算性能更好。
AI.motivation: 稀疏整数规划常具有块结构，子问题通过少量共享变量交互。对偶化链接等式可得到可分解的Lagrangian松弛，但通常存在对偶间隙。近年理论研究表明，通过对偶化共享变量上指数级大的冗余非线性一致性约束族可以闭合该间隙，但如何在大规模计算中有效利用这一理论结果尚未解决。
AI.method: 提出一个计算框架，将共享变量一致性的非线性边界编码与列与行生成（CRG）算法相结合。CRG通过定价生成局部整数解，通过分离添加编码约束。框架支持多种编码族（Vertex、Monomial、Reflected、Generalized），在完全编码和精确分离下可以恢复精确松弛，同时保持各块独立优化。论文还建立了编码族之间的指数级分离关系。
AI.result: 理论结果表明Generalized族可能比Vertex、Monomial或Reflected族需要指数级更少的约束，但在某些实例上单一定制编码仅需少量约束而Generalized族仍需指数级约束。计算实验在分解的稳定集和支配集实例上表明，CRG显著优于单体（monolithic）公式，覆盖多种树拓扑和耦合强度；同时也发现更丰富的编码族不一定带来更好的计算性能。
AI.conclusion: 编码族的选择是有效分解的中心问题：并非编码表达能力越强计算性能越好。该CRG框架为在不显式构造指数规模松弛的情况下利用冗余非线性一致性约束闭合对偶间隙提供了切实可行的路径，为大规模块结构整数规划求解提供了新的工具。

title: Observability Analysis of Joint Steering and Extrinsic Calibration
summary: This technical report studies the local weak observability of a planar bicycle-model vehicle when vehicle pose, planar LiDAR extrinsic calibration, and steering-angle bias are estimated jointly. A Lie-derivative-based nonlinear observability analysis is used to examine stationary, straight-line, constant-curvature, and combined straight-plus-arc motion. The resulting observability matrices and nullspaces describe how pose, LiDAR translation and yaw offsets, and steering bias become coupled under different motion primitives. Stationary motion and individual motion primitives retain unobservable directions, whereas the combination of straight and curved motion removes the identified degeneracies and yields full local weak observability of the seven-state system. The analysis provides a theoretical basis for selecting calibration trajectories that sufficiently excite both steering and sensor-extrinsic parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文针对平面自行车模型的车辆，研究当车辆位姿、平面LiDAR外参标定和转向角偏差联合估计时的局部弱可观测性。通过李导数非线性可观测性分析，考察静止、直线、恒曲率和直线加圆弧组合运动，证明静止和单一运动基元保留不可观测方向，而直线与曲线运动组合可消除退化并实现七状态系统的完全局部弱可观测性。
AI.motivation: 在同时估计车辆位姿、LiDAR外参和转向角偏差时，不同运动模式会影响系统的可观测性。缺乏理论分析将导致标定轨迹选择不当，无法充分激励转向和传感器外参参数，从而影响估计的收敛性和精度。
AI.method: 采用基于李导数的非线性可观测性分析方法，对七状态系统（车辆位姿、LiDAR平移与航向偏移、转向角偏差）在四种运动模式（静止、直线、恒曲率、直线加圆弧组合）下进行分析，推导可观测性矩阵和零空间。
AI.result: 静止运动和单一运动基元（直线或恒曲率）仍然存在不可观测方向；只有直线运动与曲线运动组合时才能消除识别出的退化方向，实现七状态系统的完全局部弱可观测性。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为选择能够充分激励转向参数和传感器外参参数的标定运动轨迹提供了理论基础，结论是标定轨迹应包含直线和弧线组合运动以确保系统完全可观测。

title: Geometry Parameterisation via a Structural Modal Basis for Aerodynamic Shape Optimisation
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures. Accepted for presentation at ICAS 2026. Conference presentation scheduled for 17 September 2026
summary: Aircraft outer mould lines are often heavily constrained early by payload requirements, manufacturability limits, and low-observability considerations. The remaining aerodynamic design space is typically small, highly constrained, and difficult to represent using a concise and physically meaningful set of design variables. A structural modal parameterisation method (MPM) is introduced for such problems. The method constructs a tunable pseudo-structure and solves its eigenvalue problem to obtain a modal basis, from which a selected subset of modes parameterises the geometry. Boundary conditions, stiffness distribution, density, thickness, and added masses are treated as intentional basis-design variables that shape the admissible deformation space prior to optimisation. The resulting design coordinates are independent of any specific flow solver, making the approach broadly applicable. For tightly constrained aerodynamic shape optimisation problems, it provides a practical balance of parameter conciseness, robust constraint awareness, and geometric flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结构模态参数化方法（MPM），用于解决飞机外模线在强约束下的气动外形优化问题。该方法通过构建可调伪结构并求解其特征值问题获得模态基，用其中选定的模态子集对几何进行参数化，提供了一种简洁、约束感知且具有几何灵活性的参数化框架。
AI.motivation: 飞机外模线常受载荷需求、可制造性和低可观测性等早期约束的重限制，剩余的气动设计空间通常很小、约束强，难以用简洁且物理意义明确的设计变量表示。现有参数化方法难以在此类紧约束问题中兼顾参数的简洁性、约束感知性和几何灵活性。
AI.method: 该方法构建一个可调的伪结构（pseudo-structure），通过求解其特征值问题获得模态基，从模态基中选取一个子集来参数化几何。边界条件、刚度分布、密度、厚度和附加质量被有意地作为基设计变量（basis-design variables），在优化之前塑造允许的变形空间。设计坐标与特定流场求解器无关，因此具有广泛的适用性。
AI.result: 该方法应用于紧约束的气动外形优化问题时，在参数简洁性、稳健的约束感知性和几何灵活性之间提供了实用的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结构模态参数化方法（MPM）为解决高约束下的气动外形优化问题提供了可行的参数化途径，其设计变量独立于流场求解器，通用性强，适用于紧约束条件下的气动外形优化。

title: Central Limit Theorems for Persistent Betti Numbers
summary: Various persistent invariants have been developed in recent years. In this paper, we develop a method based on homological algebra for deriving central limit theorems for persistent Betti numbers associated with $\mathbb{R}$-indexed chain complexes constructed from a homogeneous Poisson point process of unit intensity on $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our method also applies to Gibbs point processes. This algebraic method reduces the verification of the required conditions to checking properties of the kernels and cokernels of add one maps between chain complexes. As an application, we recover the known central limit theorem for persistent Betti numbers arising from simplicial complex filtrations. In addition, we prove a central limit theorem for persistent Betti numbers of $\ell_p$-Vietoris-Rips simplicial homology, including blurred magnitude homology of random geometric graphs. We also establish central limit theorems for relative $\ell_p$-Vietoris-Rips homology and, in particular, for magnitude Betti numbers of random geometric graphs. These results suggest that our algebraic method can be applied more broadly to derive central limit theorems for persistent Betti numbers.

AI.tldr: 本文基于同调代数方法，为从齐次Poisson点过程和Gibbs点过程构造的R-指标链复形中的持久Betti数推导中心极限定理，并将其应用于多种同调理论，包括l_p-Vietoris-Rips同调、模糊magnitude同调和相对同调。
AI.motivation: 近年来发展了多种持久不变量，但缺乏一个统一的代数框架来为持久Betti数建立中心极限定理。作者希望开发一种通用方法，能够简化条件的验证过程，并广泛应用于不同类型的同调理论。
AI.method: 提出一种基于同调代数的方法：将验证CLT所需条件简化为检查add-one映射在链复形之间的核（kernels）和余核（cokernels）的性质。该方法适用于R-指标链复形，覆盖齐次Poisson点过程和Gibbs点过程。
AI.result: 恢复了已知的单纯复形过滤的持久Betti数CLT；证明了l_p-Vietoris-Rips单纯同调（包括随机几何图的模糊magnitude同调）的持久Betti数CLT；建立了相对l_p-Vietoris-Rips同调以及随机几何图magnitude Betti数的中心极限定理。
AI.conclusion: 该代数方法展示了广泛的适用性，可进一步推广用于推导更广泛持久Betti数的中心极限定理。

title: Estimating water levels in the High Plains Aquifer by synthesizing satellite data with groundwater well observations
summary: The High Plains Aquifer (HPA) is a critical water resource in the Central United States, yet its depletion remains a major concern. While the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment (GRACE) satellite mission provides large-scale estimates of liquid water equivalent thickness (LWET), its coarse spatial resolution (approx. 24 km) limits local inference. In contrast, well observations from the National Ground-Water Monitoring Network (NGWMN) offer valuable but spatially sparse measurements of depth-to-groundwater. In this paper, we develop a downscaling framework for the satellite data that integrates the two sources and covariates using a Bayesian hierarchical framework. Our model uses a latent Gaussian Markov Random Field (GMRF) that describes the groundwater storage at a high spatial resolution. To address computational issues, we use a basis representation approach specified via the Moran basis. We find that fine-scale covariates like irrigation intensity and precipitation help refine spatial predictions. We thus provide, to our knowledge, the first statistically-rigorous approach for downscaling groundwater information based on GRACE satellite data and NGWMN groundwater measurements. Our approach yields high-resolution estimates of groundwater variations across the HPA from 2002--2022. The resulting fine-scale inference provides valuable insights into groundwater dynamics, highlighting the effects of land use and local extraction patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯层次框架的降尺度方法，将GRACE卫星的粗分辨率地下水数据与NGWMN钻孔观测数据及协变量集成，利用潜在高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）和Moran基表示，生成2002-2022年高平原含水层（HPA）的高分辨率地下水储量估计。
AI.motivation: 高平原含水层（HPA）是美国中部关键的水资源，但其枯竭问题令人担忧。GRACE卫星提供大尺度地下水储量估计但空间分辨率粗（约24 km），而NGWMN井观测数据虽然空间稀疏但提供了有用的深度-地下水测量。现有方法难以整合这两种异质数据源进行精细尺度的地下水推断。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个集成了卫星数据、井观测和协变量的降尺度框架，采用贝叶斯层次模型。模型使用描述高分辨率地下水储量的潜在GMRF，并通过Moran基的基表示方法来解决计算问题。细尺度协变量（如灌溉强度和降水）用于优化空间预测。
AI.result: 细尺度协变量（灌溉强度和降水）有助于细化空间预测。该方法是首个基于GRACE和NGWMN数据对地下水信息进行降尺度的统计学严谨方法，生成了2002-2022年HPA的高分辨率地下水变化估计，揭示了土地利用和局部开采模式对地下水动态的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为地下水精细尺度推断提供了有价值的见解，突出了土地利用和局部开采模式对地下水动态的影响，为HPA的地下水管理和决策提供了高分辨率的科学依据。

title: Rapid radio variability in the $z\sim7$ blazar VLASS J0410$-$0139: Indication of a hidden population of weak radio jets at Cosmic Dawn
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, Accepted for publication in ApJ
summary: Doppler boosting allows blazars to be detected out to high-$z$, making them promising probes of the intergalactic medium through the 21 cm forest. We report 0.144$-$11 GHz observations of the most distant known blazar, VLASS J041009.05$-$013919.88 at z$\sim$7, obtained with the upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (uGMRT), the LOw Frequency ARray (LOFAR) and the Very Large Array (VLA). The first uGMRT epoch (300$-$820 MHz, April 2023) revealed an inverted radio spectrum which, combined with earlier (2021$-$2022) VLA data (1.5$-$11 GHz), unveiled a double-peaked spectrum potentially indicative of multi-epoch jet activity. A second uGMRT campaign (August 2023), simultaneous with new VLA observations (1.5$-$11 GHz), instead revealed a flat low-frequency and a peaked high-frequency spectrum, ruling out this interpretation. While limited by the two uGMRT epochs, variability analysis favors intrinsic jet processes, indicating a highly relativistic, closely aligned jet ($θ<3$ deg, $δ>19.3$, $Γ>9.7$). The equipartition magnetic field ($> 1$ mG) exceeds the equivalent Cosmic Microwave Background field at $z\sim7$ (0.2 mG), indicating synchrotron losses dominate. The inferred Doppler boosting ($δ>19.3$) implies that J0410$-$0139 is intrinsically radio-weak. As a blazar, it traces a much larger parent population of radio quasars at $z\sim7$, detectable only with deep ($\leq μ$Jy) next-generation radio observations. LOFAR 144 MHz observations (April and July 2024) yielded $\sim$2 mJy, well below the $\sim$8 mJy predicted from uGMRT epochs, confirming strong variability at rest-frame $\sim$1 GHz. Low-frequency monitoring will be crucial for identifying high radio intensity states suitable for future 21 cm forest studies.

AI.tldr: 该研究对已知最遥远耀变体VLASS J041009.05-013919.88（z~7）进行了0.144-11 GHz的多波段观测（uGMRT、LOFAR、VLA），揭示其射电频谱随时间剧烈变化，排除双峰频谱对应多期喷流活动的解释，确认其源自高度相对论性、紧密对准的喷流（θ<3°, δ>19.3, Γ>9.7），并表明该天体本质上射电弱、依赖于强的多普勒增亮效应，凸显低频监测对21 cm森林研究的重要性。
AI.motivation: 耀变体因多普勒增亮效应可被探测到高红移，是研究星际介质的重要手段（通过21 cm森林）。该工作旨在通过多波段、多历元观测，深入表征z~7处最遥远耀变体J0410-0139的射电性质、活动机制及其作为高红移射电类星体种群的示踪潜力。
AI.method: 利用升级版GMRT（uGMRT，300-820 MHz）两个历元（2023年4月与8月）、LOFAR（144 MHz，2024年4月与7月）以及VLA（1.5-11 GHz）进行0.144-11 GHz的多波段射电观测。通过对比不同历元得到的光谱形态，结合变异性分析，推导喷流几何参数（视角θ、多普勒因子δ、洛伦兹因子Γ），并估算等分磁场强度以判断主导辐射机制。
AI.result: 第一个uGMRT历元显示倒转谱，结合早期VLA数据呈现双峰谱（曾被解释为多期喷流活动）；第二个uGMRT历元及同步VLA数据显示低频平坦、高频峰化的谱形，排除了该解释。变异性分析支持喷流内部过程，得出θ<3°、δ>19.3、Γ>9.7。等分磁场（>1 mG）超过z~7处等效宇宙微波背景场（0.2 mG），表明同步辐射损耗主导。LOFAR 144 MHz观测得到~2 mJy，远低于uGMRT预测的~8 mJy，证实在静止系~1 GHz处存在剧烈变异性。
AI.conclusion: J0410-0139作为z~7的耀变体，尽管射电本征较弱，但其强多普勒增亮使其可被观测，代表了更大的高红移射电类星体母体群。低频射电监测（如LOFAR/uGMRT）对识别高强度射电状态至关重要，为未来21 cm森林研究挑选最优观测时机提供关键支持。

title: Renormalization Group on Wiener Space: Spectral Theory and Universality
summary: We develop a rigorous renormalization group (RG) formalism on Wiener space. We introduce an RG operator $\mathcal R$ acting on probability measures over continuous paths, whose fixed point is the Wiener measure. We linearize $\mathcal{R}$ around the Brownian fixed point and analyze the spectral structure of the resulting operator $\mathscr{L}$. Its eigenvectors are too singular to be realized as honest measures on path space, and we therefore develop a generalized spectral theory within the framework of white noise analysis (Hida calculus). The eigenvectors of $\mathscr{L}$ are realized as Hida distributions, satisfying $\mathscr{L} U=λU$ in the weak sense. This analysis yields structural results such as a spectral gap and a diagonal-concentration property of the eigenvectors. Moreover, we identify a family $\{\mathfrak{U}_n\}_{n \geq 0}$ of eigenvectors with eigenvalues $λ_n = 2^{1-n/2}$, consisting of Wick polynomials of white noise formally expressed as $\mathfrak{U}_n = \int_0^1 {:}\dot W(t)^n{:}\, dt$, and rigorously constructed as Hida distributions. We then use this spectral structure to uncover a finer, second layer of universality in the Donsker invariance principle: not only is the convergence of random walks towards the Brownian scaling limit universal, but the entire hierarchy of leading corrections to the Brownian limit is universal as well, governed by the eigenpairs $(λ_n, \mathfrak{U}_n)$. We also show, at a formal level, that the framework developed here extends to Gibbs-type perturbations of the Brownian fixed point, in the spirit of self-interacting quantum field theories. In particular, we recover the standard irrelevant/marginal/relevant classification, usually obtained in the physics literature by power-counting, solely from the spectral analysis of $\mathscr{L}$.

AI.tldr: 本文在Wiener空间上建立了严格的RG形式化方法，通过引入作用在连续路径概率测度上的RG算子R（其不动点为Wiener测度），并在白噪声分析（Hida分布）框架下发展广义谱理论来分析其在Brownian不动点附近的线性化算子L。该分析不仅揭示了谱隙和特征向量的对角集中性质，还发现了一族具有显式特征值λ_n = 2^{1-n/2}的Wick多项式特征向量，从而揭示了Donsker不变原理中第二层精细普适性——不仅随机漫步收敛于Brownian标度极限是普适的，其整个高阶修正层级也是普适的。此外，该框架在形式层面可推广至Gibbs型微扰（如自相互作用量子场论），其relevant/marginal/irrelevant分类可完全由L的谱分析获得。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在为Wiener空间上的重正化群理论建立严格的数学基础。传统上RG方法在物理和概率论中广泛使用，但其在连续路径空间上的严格处理尚缺乏系统框架。此外，Donsker不变原理只描述了随机游走收敛到Brownian运动的"第零阶"普适性，而高阶修正是否普适、如何系统地表征，是悬而未决的问题。本文试图通过谱分析提供一个统一的、严格的回答。
AI.method: 本文方法分为三层：(1) 在Wiener空间上构造RG算子R，其不动点为Wiener测度；(2) 将R在Brownian不动点处线性化得到算子L，由于L的特征向量过于奇异而无法作为路径空间上的普通测度实现，作者引入白噪声分析（Hida微积分）框架，将特征向量实现为Hida分布，在弱意义下满足L U = λU；(3) 通过谱分析识别出特征对(λ_n, U_n)，其中U_n为白噪声的Wick幂的积分，并在形式上推广到Gibbs型微扰场景。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：获得了关于L的谱间隙（spectral gap）和特征向量对角集中性质的结论；明确构造了一族特征向量{U_n}，对应特征值λ_n = 2^{1-n/2}；揭示了Donsker不变原理的第二层普适性——Brownian极限的所有前导修正由特征对(λ_n, U_n)普适地控制；在形式层面恢复了对自相互作用量子场论中相关/边缘/无关算子的标准分类，且这种分类完全来自L的谱分析而非传统的幂次计数（power-counting）方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文为Wiener空间上的RG理论提供了一个严格且系统的框架，通过Hida分布实现广义谱理论，不仅深化了对Brownian不动点附近普适性结构的理解，还为连接概率论中的不变原理与量子场论中的RG分类提供了新的数学桥梁。

title: A Sub-4 Approximation for Fair $k$-Means
summary: Fairness in clustering has attracted sustained research interest, motivated by the need to ensure equitable representation of protected groups in machine learning applications. We study fair $k$-means clustering in Euclidean space, where the proportion of each protected group in every cluster must lie within specified lower and upper bounds. These constraints make it challenging to determine both cluster centers and point assignments. We propose an approximation algorithm that combines a linear programming relaxation with geometric transformations of the input to construct candidate center sets. Given a $ρ$-approximate algorithm for weighted $k$-means and any $ε>0$, our algorithm returns a fractional solution whose cost is at most $1+(3-1/Γ)ρ+O(ε)$ times the optimal integral fair cost, where $Γ\approx6.357$ is an upper bound on the integrality gap of the standard Euclidean $k$-means LP. With a PTAS as the subroutine, the approximation ratio becomes $3.8427+O(ε)$, improving the previous factor of $5+O(ε)$ to below $4$. The solution satisfies all fairness constraints exactly and can be rounded to an integral assignment with a bounded additive violation of fairness and no increase in cost. The same approximation guarantee extends to the $k$-sparse Wasserstein barycenter problem.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧几里得空间中公平k-means聚类问题，提出一种结合线性规划松弛与几何变换的近似算法，将近似比从5+O(ε)改进至3.8427+O(ε)。
AI.motivation: 公平聚类问题在实际机器学习应用中至关重要，需要保证每个簇中受保护群体的比例满足上下界约束。这类约束使得聚类中心和点分配决策变得困难，现有方法的近似比仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 将线性规划松弛与输入数据的几何变换相结合来构造候选中心集合。给定一个ρ-近似的加权k-means算法作为子程序，该算法返回一个分数解，其代价至多为目标最优整数公平代价的1+(3-1/Γ)ρ+O(ε)倍，其中Γ≈6.357是标准欧几里得k-means LP的积分性间隙上界。若采用PTAS作为子程序，近似比可达到3.8427+O(ε)。所得解精确满足所有公平约束，并可舍入为整数分配，仅产生有界的公平性加性违反且不增加代价。
AI.result: 近似比从5+O(ε)改进至3.8427+O(ε)（首次跌破4），该结果同样适用于k-稀疏Wasserstein重心问题。
AI.conclusion: 该算法通过巧妙结合LP松弛的积分性间隙界与几何变换，在保证公平约束精确满足的同时实现了更优的近似保证，并拓展至相关聚类与最优传输问题。

title: Prospective study of light dark matter search in positron beam mode with DarkSHINE experiment initiative
summary: We perform the prospective study on searching for invisibly decayed dark photons ($A^{\prime}$) in positron-on-fixed-target (POT) scheme with the DarkSHINE experiment simulation setup. In the positron-on-fixed-target scheme, two additional production channels of dark photons via annihilation with extranuclear electrons are present: non-resonant t-channel ($e^+e^-N \to γA^{\prime}N$) and resonant s-channel ($e^+e^-N \to A^{\prime}N$), alongside bremsstrahlung emission similar to electron-on-fixed-target scheme. Based on a Geant4 full detector simulation of an 8 GeV positron beam with $3 \times 10^{14}$ POT events, we developed an analysis strategy using missing energy and momentum signatures across three orthogonal signal regions optimized for these channels. Our results indicate that the additional annihilation channels of dark photon production improve the dark photon invisible decay search sensitivity, improving the exclusion limits by approximately two orders of magnitude compared to existing constraints in the electron-on-fixed target (EOT) scheme, particularly near the center-of-mass energy threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了DarkSHINE实验中正电子轰击固定靶方案下不可见衰变暗光子（A'）的前瞻性搜索研究，发现由于正电子与核外电子的湮灭过程（非共振t通道和共振s通道）的存在，相比电子轰击固定靶方案，暗光子不可见衰变的排除限提高了约两个数量级，尤其是在质心能量阈值附近。
AI.motivation: 探索暗光子（一种暗物质候选媒介粒子）的存在，通过正电子固定靶方案利用额外的湮灭产生通道来增强信号产生截面，从而提升不可见衰变暗光子的搜索灵敏度，超越现有电子固定靶方案的约束。
AI.method: 基于Geant4全探测器模拟，使用8 GeV正电子束流和3×10^14个正电子打靶事件（POT），构建了基于丢失能量和动量特征的分析策略，针对三种不同产生通道（轫致辐射、非共振t通道、共振s通道）优化了三个正交的信号区域。
AI.result: 正电子固定靶方案中额外的湮灭产生通道改善了暗光子不可见衰变的搜索灵敏度，相比现有电子固定靶方案的排除限提高了约两个数量级，尤其是在质心能量阈值附近效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 正电子打靶方案因其独特的湮灭产生通道，能够显著提升暗光子不可见衰变的搜索能力，为暗光子探测提供了比电子打靶方案更优的实验路径。

title: A Note on Additive Diameter
summary: We record two results on additive diameters of group representations. First we give a corrected version of Proposition 5.3 from the first arXiv version of arXiv:2504.07573. Let $0<\varepsilon<1/3$, let $n>9/\varepsilon^2$, and let $U\leq\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C})$ with $\dim U>\varepsilon n^2$. Then $\operatorname{diam}^{\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})}_{+}(\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C}),U)\leq 32/\varepsilon+8$. The proof uses an averaging argument for the action of the symmetric group on the off-diagonal matrix positions. This argument was subsequently developed further in arXiv:2609.03882. We also prove the right-hand inequality in Question 6.7 of arXiv:2504.07573. If $G$ is a complex algebraic group, $V$ is a finite-dimensional $G$-module, $U\leq V$, and $\mathfrak g=\operatorname{Lie}(G)$, then $\operatorname{diam}^{G}_{+}(V,U)\leq\operatorname{diam}^{\mathfrak g}_{+}(V,U)$. No irreducibility or connectedness assumption is needed.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了关于群表示加性直径的两个结果。第一，修正了arXiv:2504.07573第一版中命题5.3的表述，证明了在特定维度条件下$\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C})$子空间$U$的加性直径上界为$32/\varepsilon+8$，证明使用了对称群在非对角矩阵位置作用上的平均论证。第二，证明了arXiv:2504.07573中问题6.7的右端不等式：对任意复代数群$G$及其有限维模$V$的子空间$U$，加性直径$\operatorname{diam}^{G}_{+}(V,U)\leq\operatorname{diam}^{\mathfrak g}_{+}(V,U)$成立，且无需不可约性或连通性假设。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是对群表示中的加性直径（additive diameter）这一几何组合不变量进行更深入的刻画。作者一方面需要修正此前预印本中命题5.3的证明缺陷，另一方面希望建立群作用与其李代数作用之间加性直径的一般性不等式关系，从而将该理论推广到更一般的代数群情形，消除此前结果中对不可约性或连通性等额外假设的限制。
AI.method: 论文采用两种主要技术手段。其一，对于$\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C})$情形，利用对称群在非对角矩阵位置上的作用进行平均化论证（averaging argument），通过对称化手段压缩维度条件并推导出加性直径的线性上界$32/\varepsilon+8$。其二，对于一般代数群情形，通过比较群轨道与李代数轨道之间的加性直径关系来证明不等式$\operatorname{diam}^{G}_{+}(V,U)\leq\operatorname{diam}^{\mathfrak g}_{+}(V,U)$，该方法不依赖于$G$的不可约性或连通性。
AI.result: 成功给出$\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C})$中满足维度条件$\dim U>\varepsilon n^2$的子空间$U$的加性直径上界$\operatorname{diam}^{\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})}_{+}(\mathfrak{sl}_n(\mathbb{C}),U)\leq 32/\varepsilon+8$，其中$0<\varepsilon<1/3$，$n>9/\varepsilon^2$。同时证明了对于任意复代数群$G$及其有限维模$V$的子空间$U$，群作用的加性直径不超过其李代数作用的加性直径，且无需额外假设。
AI.conclusion: 本文纠正了此前文献中命题5.3的缺陷并给出严格的证明路径，同时建立了群与李代数之间加性直径的一般性上界关系，拓展了该理论的适用范畴，为后续研究（如arXiv:2609.03882中的进一步推广）奠定了基础。

title: Spread of Chronic Wasting Disease under Stochastic Environmental Conditions and its Control using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Chronic wasting disease (CWD) is a fatal prion disease affecting deer, elk, moose, reindeer, muntjac, and other cervids. Because free-ranging cervid populations face environmental variability and randomness, deterministic models may miss important dynamics like stochastic fade-out. We develop a stochastic Susceptible-Infectious-Environmental model using differential equations with reflection to ensure the susceptible class remains non-negative. We examine how environmental variability influences cervid populations as CWD pressure and control measures increase. For the deterministic model, we derive the basic reproduction number as the sum of direct and environmental contributions, showing the endemic phase arises at R0=1. For the stochastic system, we establish local well-posedness, positivity, and the disease-free law. The top Lyapunov exponent for invasion remains unaffected by reflection. We evaluate CWD mitigation using a deep reinforcement learning agent trained with Proximal Policy Optimization in a hybrid action space, comparing hunting, decontamination, and combined strategies. In the deterministic case, hunting alone can control the disease but reduces the population by about 58%, while decontamination requires sustained effort. The combined policy more than doubles the cervid population and nearly eliminates infection and contamination. In the stochastic case, the policy contains the disease in about 80% of runs, with 10% experiencing large outbreaks; effectiveness decreases as noise increases. Across all scenarios, the agent consistently emphasizes environmental decontamination, the key control method.

AI.tldr: 本文针对慢性消耗性疾病（CWD）在鹿科种群中的传播，构建了带反射的随机微分方程S-E模型，结合深度强化学习（PPO）在混合动作空间中评估狩猎、去污染及组合策略的疾病缓解效果。
AI.motivation: CWD是对鹿、麋鹿、驼鹿、驯鹿等反刍动物致命的朊病毒病。由于自由放养鹿科种群面临环境变异性和随机性，确定性模型可能遗漏随机灭绝等重要动态。因此需要引入随机性以更真实地刻画疾病传播和种群动态。
AI.method: 开发了一个带反射的随机易感-感染-环境（Susceptible-Infectious-Environmental）模型，以确保易感类为非负。对确定性模型推导基本再生数（R0为直接与环境污染贡献之和）；对随机系统建立局部适定性、正性和无病律。使用基于近端策略优化（PPO）的深度强化学习智能体在混合动作空间中评估三种控制策略：狩猎、去污染和组合策略。
AI.result: 确定性模型中，狩猎单独可控制疾病但种群减少约58%，去污染需持续投入；组合策略使鹿科种群数量翻倍以上且几乎消除感染和污染。随机情形下，组合策略在约80%的运行中控制住疾病，10%经历大规模暴发；有效性随噪声增大而降低。在所有场景中，智能体始终偏向环境去污染策略。入侵的顶层Lyapunov指数不受反射影响。
AI.conclusion: 环境去污染是最关键的CWD控制手段，组合策略（狩猎+去污染）在确定性和随机环境中均显著优于单一策略，但随机噪声会削弱控制效果。研究为CWD管理提供了定量依据和最优控制框架。

title: On the Diophantine Equations Arising from Three-Term $b$-Concatenations in Pell-Type Sequences
summary: We study the Diophantine problem of representing a Pell or Pell--Lucas number as the base-$b$ concatenation of three other Pell or Pell--Lucas numbers. Under the condition that the index of the middle block does not exceed that of the leading block, we obtain an explicit upper bound for the sequence indices in terms of $b$. For $2\leq b\leq15$, we determine exactly $51$ solutions up to the identification $Q_0=Q_1=2$, while there are $74$ solutions when distinct index choices are counted separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Pell数与Pell-Lucas数在基数b进制下作为其他两个/三个Pell或Pell-Lucas数的拼接（concatenation）的丢番图表示问题。
AI.motivation: 探讨Pell数列和Pell-Lucas数列在基数b进制拼接下的丢番图表示问题，此为经典丢番图方程与数列理论交叉的研究方向，类似于此前对Fibonacci数列拼接问题的工作。
AI.method: 在中间块索引不超过前导块索引的条件下，利用丢番图逼近、线性型下界（如Baker理论）等方法推导出序列索引关于基数b的显式上界；随后对2≤b≤15进行穷举/计算验证，枚举所有解。
AI.result: 对于2≤b≤15，确定了51个本质不同的解（基于Q_0=Q_1=2的等价关系），若将不同的索引选择分别计数，则共有74个解。
AI.conclusion: 在给定条件下获得了Pell/Pell-Lucas数拼接表示问题中索引的显式上界，并完整枚举了b在2到15范围内的所有解，给出了解的精确计数。

title: Deviation from Fermi-liquid $T^2$ resistivity caused by collective transport
summary: `Fermi-liquid behavior' is nowadays used as a shorthand for quadratic temperature dependence of the electrical resistivity. In a metal, for this to occur, electrons must be cooled well below the Fermi degeneracy temperature, $T_{\mathrm{F}}$. A departure from this behavior is observed at finite temperature. Here, we note that this departure has opposite signs in two distinct types of Fermi liquids. In weakly correlated ones, the upward departure implies a higher exponent of the inelastic resistivity, attributable to \textit{additional scattering} by phonons. In contrast, there is a downward deviation in strongly correlated metals, which implies either \textit{reduced scattering} or \textit{additional conduction}, as in the case of normal liquid $^3$He, in which a distinct contribution to heat transport by a sound mode has been recently identified. Such a channel of conduction smoothly transforms across $T_{\mathrm{F}}$ to the one captured by the Bridgman formula for thermal conductivity of classical liquids. In three metals (UPt$_3$, Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, and heavily overdoped LSCO), according to the available experimental data, the normalized amplitude of excess conductivity at $T/T_{\mathrm{F}}\simeq0.02$ is comparable to what has been seen in $^3$He, suggesting, without establishing, a common origin.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，费米液体行为（电阻率随温度的二次方变化）在弱关联和强关联金属中偏离标准行为的符号方向相反：弱关联金属呈向上偏离（归因于声子的额外散射），强关联金属呈向下偏离（暗示减少散射或额外导电通道）。作者将强关联金属中的向下偏离与液态³He中声学模式对热输运的额外贡献相关联，并指出包括UPt₃、Sr₂RuO₄和重掺杂LSCO在内的三种金属在T/T_F≈0.02处展现了与³He相当的过量电导幅度，提示可能存在共同的物理起源。
AI.motivation: 标准费米液体理论预测电阻率在T²区间内遵循严格的二次方温度依赖，但实验上在有限温度观察到偏离。作者旨在揭示这种偏离在不同类型费米液体中具有系统性但方向相反的规律，并探索其与液态³He中已识别的声学模式输运的潜在联系，从而为强关联费米液体中的"异常"向下偏离提供统一的物理解释。
AI.method: 本文属于理论/现象学分析论文，作者系统梳理并比较了两类费米液体的电阻率偏离行为：(1)弱关联金属中的向上偏离，归因于声子引起的额外非弹性散射；(2)强关联金属中的向下偏离，将其解释为结构熵减少散射或额外传导通道。论文将后者的物理图像与正常液态³He中声学模式对热输运的贡献进行类比，并通过对UPt₃、Sr₂RuO₄和重掺杂LSCO的实验数据进行定量比较，检验该机制的普适性。
AI.result: 研究发现在弱关联费米液体中电阻率的向上偏离源于声子散射，而在强关联费米液体（包括正常液态³He）中观察到向下偏离，提示存在超出准粒子散射框架的额外导电/导热通道。声学模式的输运贡献可在T_F附近连续过渡到经典流体的Bridgman公式描述的导热机制。实验比较显示三种强关联金属在T/T_F≈0.02处的过量电导归一化幅度与³He具有可比性（但不构成确定性的证据）。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出强关联费米液体中电阻率的向下偏离可能反映了一种超越朗道费米液体框架的内在性质——声学模式（可能为集体零声模式或类似通道）参与了电荷/热输运，且这一机制在低温极限与准粒子输运共存、在高温端自然衔接至经典流体描述。三种金属中的实验观测为这一观点提供了初步但不充分的量化支持，揭示了一个值得进一步验证的普适物理图景。

title: Sparse plus low-rank matrix embedding with applications in cancer radiotherapy optimization
summary:
Decomposing a matrix into sparse and low-rank components is central to robust principal component analysis and has broad applications in machine learning, signal processing, and computer vision. Classical formulations seek to recover the underlying sparse and low-rank structure. We instead introduce \emph{sparse-plus-low-rank matrix embedding} (SLME), whose goal is to construct a computationally efficient surrogate for a large dense matrix, without requiring its components to be interpretable. Given $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, SLME approximates $A \approx S+HW$, where $S$ is sparse, $H\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times r}$, $W\in\mathbb{R}^{r\times n}$, and $r\ll \min\{m,n\}$. The resulting matrix-vector product can be evaluated as $Sx+H(Wx)$ in $\mathrm{nnz}(S)+r(m+n)$ operations, rather than the $mn$ operations required by $Ax$. Our primary motivation arises from optimization problems in cancer radiotherapy treatment planning, where a large dense \emph{dose-influence matrix} is a major computational bottleneck.
  We formulate SLME as a bi-objective nonconvex optimization problem that balances approximation error against the computational cost of the downstream tasks. We then develop \emph{R3-Trust}, an efficient trust-region algorithm that approximates the Pareto frontier in a single parameter-free run. Each point on the resulting frontier provides a sparse-plus-low-rank representation with a different balance between accuracy and downstream computational cost. Experiments on clinical radiotherapy matrices show that decompositions obtained from existing recovery-oriented formulations can be suboptimal for the embedding objective. Conversely, experiments on synthetic instances demonstrate that SLME and R3-Trust can also be applied to sparse-plus-low-rank recovery, where they compare favorably with state-of-the-art recovery methods in both reconstruction accuracy and computational time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出稀疏加低秩矩阵嵌入（SLME）问题,旨在为大型稠密矩阵构建计算高效的替代品（A≈S+HW）,而无需组件可解释。作者提出R3-Trust信任域算法,通过单次无参数运行近似Pareto前沿,在精度与下游计算成本之间取得平衡。实验表明在临床放疗矩阵上,现有面向恢复的分解方法对嵌入目标可能次优,而在合成实例上SLME也在稀疏加低秩恢复任务中与最先进方法相当。
AI.motivation: 传统的稀疏加低秩分解（如鲁棒主成分分析）旨在恢复可解释的稀疏与低秩结构,但对某些应用（如放疗计划中的剂量影响矩阵）而言,核心需求是构造计算高效的矩阵替代品以加速矩阵-向量乘法,而非恢复结构。大型稠密剂量影响矩阵是放疗优化中的主要计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 将SLME形式化为双目标非凸优化问题,同时平衡逼近误差与下游计算成本；开发R3-Trust信任域算法,在单次无参数运行中逼近Pareto前沿,前沿上的每个点对应不同精度与计算成本权衡的稀疏加低秩表示。
AI.result: 临床放疗矩阵实验表明面向恢复的现有分解方法在嵌入目标上可能次优；合成实例实验表明SLME与R3-Trust同样适用于稀疏加低秩恢复任务,在重建精度与计算时间上均优于或媲美最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SLME提供了一种面向嵌入/代理目标而非恢复目标的矩阵分解新范式,R3-Trust作为参数无关的单次算法能有效探索Pareto前沿,同时该方法在恢复任务中也展现出竞争力,具备广泛适用性。

title: Multi-robot Learning-based Informative Path Planning Using Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Process Kalman Filter
summary: Multi-robot informative path planning (IPP) for persistent target monitoring requires robots to reason about spatial uncertainty, temporal evolution, and practical sensing and communication constraints. Recent learning-based multi-robot IPP methods use Gaussian Processes (GPs) for target uncertainty, but often rely on simplified sensing models and centralized belief updates. We propose a grid-based spatio-temporal GP-Kalman filtering framework for learning-based multi-robot IPP. Instead of maintaining one GP per target, we represent anonymous target presence as a single latent field over a discrete workspace grid. The proposed recursive update considers all visible cells inside a camera footprint and supports arbitrary fields of view and range-dependent noise. A GP-consistent temporal process update accounts for moving targets and stale information by inflating uncertainty over time. For decentralized deployment, each robot maintains its own mapper and exchanges compact belief summaries rather than raw measurements. Received beliefs are fused using diagonal covariance intersection to remain conservative under unknown inter-robot correlations. We integrate the mapper with a reinforcement-learning policy for graph-based neighbor selection. Simulation benchmarks show about 20% lower average target uncertainty and improved target visitation compared with learning-based and classical auction/coverage baselines. Real-world two-UAV experiments demonstrate transfer to outdoor multi-robot search over a large field of more than 7000 square meters.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于网格时空高斯过程-卡尔曼滤波的多机器人信息路径规划框架，用于持续目标监控，支持去中心化部署和异构传感器模型，在仿真和真实无人机实验中分别实现约20%的不确定性降低和超过7000平方米的户外搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的多机器人IPP方法依赖简化的传感模型和集中式信念更新，难以应对实际场景中的非均匀视场、随距离变化的噪声以及多机器人间的通信约束，缺乏可扩展且可部署的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出网格化时空GP-卡尔曼滤波映射器：将匿名目标存在性表示为离散工作空间网格上的单一潜在场；递归更新考虑相机视场内的所有可见单元，支持任意视场和距离相关噪声；GP一致的时间更新通过随时间膨胀不确定性来应对移动目标和陈旧信息；去中心化部署中每个机器人维护自身映射器并通过对角线协方差交集融合紧凑信念摘要。
AI.result: 在仿真基准中平均目标不确定性降低约20%，目标访问率优于基于学习的和经典的拍卖/覆盖基线方法；真实世界双无人机实验在超过7000平方米的大规模户外多机器人搜索场景中验证了方法的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化的网格时空GP-卡尔曼滤波框架能够有效结合学习策略实现多机器人IPP，在保持保守估计的同时实现高效的分布式信念融合，并可从仿真成功迁移至大规模真实环境。

title: Efficient $C^1$ Bernstein Quasi-Trefftz Discretization for Heterogeneous High-Frequency Helmholtz Problems
summary: We develop an efficient $C^1$ Bernstein quasi-Trefftz discretization for heterogeneous high-frequency Helmholtz problems on unstructured triangular meshes. The method first imposes strong $C^1$ continuity through Bernstein--Bézier smoothness relations on local macro-patches and then reduces the resulting conforming polynomial space by enforcing projected Helmholtz residual constraints. On two-triangle patches, this compresses the local dimension from quadratic growth in the polynomial degree to a trace-sized space of dimension $2p+1$ under the natural rank condition. Variable matrix-valued coefficients are handled through local polynomial projection, allowing coefficient-approximation effects to be separated from discretization error. A graph-residual formulation couples the reduced patch spaces and produces a sparse global system in compressed coordinates. The implementation combines explicit $C^1$ continuation, batched coefficient projection, batched residual construction, and stable local kernel extraction by QR factorization. Numerical experiments on heterogeneous unstructured meshes demonstrate high-order accuracy, roundoff-level $C^1$ conformity, robust high-frequency resolution, and substantial reductions in local and global computational cost. Turning-point and penetrable-scattering examples further illustrate the flexibility of the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的C1 Bernstein拟Trefftz离散化方法，用于异构非结构化三角网格上的高频Helmholtz问题。该方法通过Bernstein-Bézier光滑性关系施加强C1连续性，再通过投影Helmholtz残差约束压缩多项式空间，在双三角形patch上将局部维数从多项式次数的二次增长压缩到维数为2p+1的迹空间。数值实验展示了高阶精度、舍入级C1一致性、鲁棒的高频分辨率以及显著的计算成本降低。
AI.motivation: 高频Helmholtz问题在异构介质和非结构化网格上的高效数值求解具有挑战性，传统方法需要大量自由度来分辨波场。需要一种既能保证高阶精度、又能有效处理多次散射和异构系数且计算开销可控的离散化方法。
AI.method: 方法分三步：(1)通过Bernstein-Bézier光滑性关系在局部macro-patches上施加强C1连续性；(2)通过施加投影Helmholtz残差约束，将一致多项式空间压缩为维度2p+1的迹空间；(3)采用图残差公式将缩减后的patch空间耦合，生成压缩坐标下的稀疏全局系统。实现包括显式C1延拓、批量系数投影、批量残差构造以及基于QR分解的稳定局部核提取。变矩阵值系数通过局部多项式投影处理，将系数逼近误差与离散化误差分离。
AI.result: 在异构非结构化网格上的数值实验表明：该方法具有高阶精度、舍入级C1一致性、鲁棒的高频分辨率，并且在局部和全局计算成本上均有显著降低。转折点和可穿透散射算例进一步验证了方法的灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的C1 Bernstein拟Trefftz方法在高频Helmholtz问题求解上兼顾了精度、连续性和效率，通过将局部维度从二次增长压缩到线性(2p+1)，并在非结构化异构网格上保持了高阶和鲁棒性能，为高频散射与传播问题提供了一种有竞争力的数值方案。

title: Homotopical Nilpotency and Homology Nilpotency: A Dimension--Connectivity Bound
summary: Let $X$ be a $(q-1)$-connected rational space of finite type, where $q\ge2$, with homotopical nilpotency $nil_h(X)=n\ge1$. If $H^{>N}(X;Q)=0$ and $N\le q(n+3)-3$, we prove that $Hnil(X)=n$. More precisely, the sufficient bound is $N\le a_n(M_X)+2q-3$, where $a_n(M_X)$ is the first nonzero internal cohomology degree of $(M_X^+)^{n+1}$ in the minimal model. A family of examples proves that the constant $-3$ in this refined bound is optimal; optimality of the uniform bound is not asserted. The proof uses two stages of adjoining primitives to an ideal of the fixed minimal model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连通有理空间的同伦幂零性Hnil(X)与上同调维数之间的定量关系。在空间X是(q-1)-连通、有限型有理空间，且同伦幂零性nil_h(X)=n的条件下，证明了当上同调维数N≤q(n+3)-3时，Hnil(X)=n成立。更精确的界为N≤a_n(M_X)+2q-3，其中a_n(M_X)是极小模型中(M_X^+)^{n+1}的第一个非零内部上同调次数。通过构造一族例子证明了精化界中常数-3是最优的。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机在于建立有理同伦理论中同伦幂零性（homotopical nilpotency）与空间上同调维数之间的精确量化关系，为通过有限维上同调信息来判定或估计空间同伦幂零性提供定量判据。
AI.method: 证明方法基于对固定极小模型中的某个理想进行两阶段添加原语（adjoining primitives）操作，构造出合适的上同调信息来刻画同伦幂零性。同时提供一族例子来验证精化界中常数-3的最优性。
AI.result: 证明了在N≤a_n(M_X)+2q-3的精化条件下Hnil(X)=n；作为推论得到统一界N≤q(n+3)-3也足以保证Hnil(X)=n。通过具体例子族证明了精化界中常数-3是不可改进的最优常数。
AI.conclusion: 文章建立了同伦幂零性Hnil(X)等于n的充分上同调维数界，精化界中的常数-3被证明是最优的；而统一界的最优性未作断言，留作开放问题。

title: A Network-Structured Bayesian Hierarchical Model for Sparse Mutation-Drug Response Associations: Application to Cancer Pharmacogenomics
comment: The manuscript is under review with Biostatistics (Oxford Academic)
summary: We develop a network-structured Bayesian hierarchical model for sparse association mapping between genomic alterations and quantitative treatment-response phenotypes. The framework combines a Gaussian Markov random field prior that borrows strength across pathway-connected genes, a global-local horseshoe prior inducing sparsity, and a conjugate Gibbs sampler requiring no Metropolis-Hastings steps. Though broadly applicable to high-dimensional settings with known predictor networks, we validate it using cancer cell-line drug-sensitivity data. Applied to GDSC2 ($N=951$ cell lines, $G=219$ driver genes, $D=295$ drugs), the model identifies 126 gene-drug associations (0.195\% of 64{,}605 pairs), concentrated in EZH2 (45 drugs, all sensitivity-direction, mean effect $-0.911$ $\ln$IC50) and KMT2D (36 drugs, all sensitivity-direction, mean effect $-0.496$ $\ln$IC50). These markers show external support in an independent PRISM screen (1{,}518 compounds), with KMT2D achieving complete directional replication (36/36) and EZH2 partial replication (8/12). Five-fold cross-validated predictive log-likelihood confirms each prior layer's value: the full model outperforms the no-network ablation by $+3{,}109$ log-units per fold and the no-horseshoe ablation by $+14{,}039$ log-units, consistently across folds. Simulations under three scenarios show the full model achieves the highest precision and lowest false-discovery rate throughout, while the network prior improves sensitivity recovery under network-structured signal. A tissue-stratified extension identifies coherent subgroup refinements, including lung-specific EGFR-inhibitor sensitivity and skin-specific BRAF-Dabrafenib sensitivity. These results show the framework identifies sparse, interpretable, externally supported drug-sensitivity markers while enabling principled investigation of tissue-specific departures from shared effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种网络结构的贝叶斯分层模型，将高斯马尔可夫随机场先验与马蹄铁稀疏先验相结合，用于基因组变异与定量治疗反应表型之间的稀疏关联映射。在GDSC2癌症细胞系药物敏感性数据上验证，识别出126个基因-药物关联，其中EZH2和KMT2D在外部PRISM筛选中得到验证，五折交叉验证和模拟实验均证实模型优越性，并扩展了组织分层变体。
AI.motivation: 高维基因组数据中关联映射面临稀疏性和网络结构噪声的挑战，现有方法难以同时利用基因通路之间的先验结构信息并保持稀疏性和计算可扩展性。需要一种能够跨通路基因借用统计强度、无需MCMC后验采样（Metropolis-Hastings）的贝叶斯框架，以实现稀疏且可解释的基因-药物关联图谱。
AI.method: 构建网络结构化贝叶斯分层模型：1) 高斯马尔可夫随机场先验，在通路相连基因之间借用统计强度；2) 全局-局部马蹄铁先验诱导稀疏性；3) 共轭Gibbs采样器避免Metropolis-Hastings步骤，保证计算效率。另提出组织分层扩展以研究组织特异的效应偏差。
AI.result: 在GDSC2数据（951种细胞系，219个驱动基因，295种药物）上识别出126个基因-药物关联（占64,605对的0.195%），集中在EZH2（45种药物，平均效应-0.911 lnIC50）和KMT2D（36种药物，平均效应-0.496 lnIC50）。KMT2D在独立PRISM筛选中实现完全方向复制（36/36），EZH2部分复制（8/12）。五折交叉验证显示完整模型优于无网络消融（+3,109 log单位/折）和无马蹄铁消融（+14,039 log单位/折）。模拟实验证实完整模型具有最高精度和最低假发现率。组织分层扩展识别出肺特异EGFR抑制剂敏感性和皮肤特异BRAF-Dabrafenib敏感性等一致的亚组细化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够识别稀疏、可解释且有外部支持的药物敏感性标记，同时允许对组织特异性的共享效应偏离进行原则性研究。模型每一层先验（网络结构与马蹄铁稀疏）均被证明确实贡献价值，且在高维设置下具有广泛适用性。

title: A Possible X-ray and Gamma-ray Quasi-Periodic Oscillation in GRB 241030A
summary: Quasiperiodic oscillations (QPOs) in gamma-ray intensity have been reported from a few gamma-ray bursts. These QPOs could be related to fundamental frequencies in the sources, which would lead to new insights about these systems. Here we report on our analysis of GRB~241030A, a several-minute-long burst with $\sim 10$ gamma-ray flares that have approximate periodicities at f ~ 0.04 Hz and f ~ 0.08 Hz. This quasi-periodicity is seen in X-rays with the Swift X-Ray Telescope (XRT) as well as in gamma-rays with the Swift Burst Alert Telescope (BAT) and the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM). Compared with a power spectral model that has only red noise, the Bayes factor in favor of a Lorentzian-shaped QPO is more than $10^{200}$, even when the red noise is described by segments with up to four different slopes. However, the interpretation of this power spectral feature as a QPO rather than as a fluctuation in red noise is complicated by the low frequency of the feature as well as the extremely large number of counts, which amplifies differences from smooth power spectral distributions. After discussing the properties of the apparent QPO, we discuss a few processes that could plausibly modulate the flux at this frequency. Among the mechanisms considered, we find the most plausible explanation to be a GRB jet passing through regularly spaced shells of circumburst material, possibly produced by binary interactions near periastron in an eccentric progenitor system.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了GRB 241030A（一个持续数分钟、包含约10个伽马射线耀斑的伽马射线暴）中的准周期振荡（QPO）现象。在X射线和伽马射线波段均检测到约0.04 Hz和0.08 Hz的准周期信号，贝叶斯因子超过10^200支持QPO存在，但作者对将其唯一定性为QPO而非红噪声波动持谨慎态度，并认为最可能的物理解释是喷流穿过由双星近日点相互作用产生的周期性外部介质壳层。
AI.motivation: 伽马射线暴中罕见的准周期振荡可能揭示源的基本频率，为理解这类高能天体物理系统提供新的物理见解。虽然此前已有少数GRB报告QPO现象，但每一个新案例都是验证和拓展这一研究方向的重要机会。
AI.method: 作者对GRB 241030A的多波段观测数据（Swift XRT、Swift BAT和Fermi GBM）进行功率谱分析，采用分段（最多四段不同斜率）红噪声模型进行贝叶斯拟合，并用Lorentzian形状分量检验QPO特征，计算贝叶斯因子评估统计显著性。
AI.result: 在约0.04 Hz和0.08 Hz频率处检测到准周期信号，X射线和伽马射线各探测器均显示该特征。即使红噪声模型分段复杂化，支持QPO的贝叶斯因子仍超过10^200。然而作者指出该特征的极低频率及极大光子计数使其与红噪声波动的区分变得复杂。
AI.conclusion: GRB 241030A表现出显著的准周期调制特征。作者在考虑了多种可能机制后，认为最可能的情景是GRB喷流穿过由偏心双星系统近星点相互作用产生的周期性排列的环周介质壳层，从而导致通量产生周期性的调制。

title: Condensation and Collapse in the Mean-Field Limit of Rotating 2D Bose Gases with Two-Body and Three-Body Interactions
summary: We consider a system of $N$ interacting bosons in a rotating harmonic trap in $\mathbb{R}^2$, where the two-body interaction is attractive and scaled as $N^{2α}U(N^αx)$ with $0<α<1/12$, and the three-body interaction is repulsive and scaled as $N^{4β}W(N^βx,N^βy)$ with $0<β<1/24$. In the mean-field limit, the ground state energy is effectively described by a rotating cubic-quintic nonlinear Schrödinger functional. We analyze the collapse regime where the two-body coupling $a$ approaches the critical value $a_*$ and the three-body coupling $b$ tends to zero. The NLS ground states blow up with a universal profile given by the optimizer of the Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality, and the energy satisfies $E^{\mathrm{NLS}} = (1-ζ/4+o(1))\mathcal{Q}{\rm{pot}}\ell_n^2$ with $ζ\geqslant0$ determined by the relative rates of $a_n\to a_*$ and $b_n\searrow0$. From the many-body theory, we rigorously justify this effective description: the quantum ground state energy converges to the NLS energy with the same asymptotic expansion in the collapse regime, and the many-body ground states exhibit complete Bose-Einstein condensation onto the universal blow-up profile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维旋转谐波阱中吸引玻色气体的塌缩行为，证明在平均场极限下，当两体耦合趋近临界值且三体耦合趋零时，NLS基态能具有由Gagliardo-Nirenberg不等式优化子给出的普适blow-up剖面，且多体基态能量收敛到NLS能量并展现完全玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。
AI.motivation: 理解旋转阱中吸引玻色气体的塌缩（collapse）机制是冷原子物理中的重要问题，尤其是两体吸引与三体排斥相互作用竞争下的基态行为。已有工作多限于纯两体情形，尚缺乏同时包含两类相互作用、刻画临界塌缩极限下能量渐近展开与凝聚性质的多体严格分析。
AI.method: 采用平均场极限与塌缩分析相结合的方法。两体势缩放为N^{2α}U(N^α x)（0<α<1/12），三体势缩放为N^{4β}W(N^βx,N^βy)（0<β<1/24）。将问题约化为旋转三次-五次非线性薛定谔（NLS）泛函，分析a→a_*、b→0的临界极限，利用Gagliardo-Nirenberg不等式优化子刻画blow-up普适剖面，并从多体理论严格推导基态能量收敛与凝聚性质。
AI.result: NLS基态在塌缩区以普适profile blow up（由GN不等式优化子给出），能量满足E^{NLS}=(1-ζ/4+o(1))Q^{pot}ℓ_n²，其中ζ≥0由a_n→a_*与b_n↘0的相对速率决定。多体基态能量收敛到NLS能量且具有相同的渐近展开，多体基态展现出完全玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚到该普适blow-up剖面上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作严格证明了二维旋转吸引玻色气体在临界塌缩区（两体临界吸引–三体小排斥耦合）的有效平均场描述，得到了NLS与多体层面一致的基态能量渐近公式，并验证了完全凝聚性质，为吸引玻色气体的塌缩理论提供了严格的数学基础。

title: The Stretch Factor of Planar Delaunay Triangulations Is Less Than 1.65
summary:
Delaunay triangulations are a fundamental class of plane spanners, and determining their worst-case stretch factor has been a longstanding problem in computational geometry. We prove an upper bound of 1.65, improving the previous bound of 1.998 and reducing the gap to the known lower bound of 1.5932 by a factor of more than seven. The result holds for every planar Delaunay triangulation, including configurations with collinear or cocircular sites.
  Our main contribution is a Bellman formulation of the disk-chain bound underlying the proof. By comparing shortest-path length with additive progress along the query segment, we obtain an exact recursion whose state records only the current disk, the incoming chord, and the difference between two prefix distances. We show that a bound for this chain class holds if and only if a potential satisfies three local inequalities for initialization, transitions, and termination. The associated Bellman value function is the pointwise smallest feasible potential, giving a precise target for constructing an upper bound.
  We construct such a potential using a function of one variable. Geometric monotonicity reduces its feasibility to inequalities that are affine in this function and its derivative. A spline construction, certified by exact arithmetic and rigorous interval bounds, yields the stretch bound of 1.65. We also give a dual certificate showing that every feasible quadratic profile under the same conditions requires a certified constant greater than 1.67.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了所有平面Delaunay三角剖分的伸展因子（stretch factor）上界为1.65，改进了此前1.998的上界，将对下界1.5932的差距缩小了七倍以上。其核心方法是将盘链（disk-chain）界转化为Bellman方程，通过构造满足局部不等式的单变量势函数并结合样条与精确计算给出证明。
AI.motivation: Delaunay三角剖分是计算几何中最基本的平面稀疏子图类之一，其最坏情况伸展因子的确定是数十年来的公开难题。此前上界1.998与下界1.5932之间的差距过大，需要更精细的分析工具来逼近真实值。
AI.method: 本文提出一种Bellman形式的盘链界公式化方法。通过比较最短路径长度与沿查询线段的加性进展，得到状态仅包含当前盘、入弦及两个前缀距离差值的精确递推。作者证明该链类界成立当且仅当存在一个势函数满足初始化、转移和终止三类局部不等式。进一步的几何单调性将可行性化约为关于单变量函数及其导数的仿射不等式，借助样条构造并采用精确算术与严格区间界验证，得到1.65的伸展界限。
AI.result: 证明所有平面Delaunay三角剖分（包括共线和共圆配置）的伸展因子上界为1.65，显著改进了此前1.998的结果。同时给出了对偶证书，表明在相同条件下任何可行的二次型势函数所需认证常数都大于1.67，这说明了新构造中的样条结构对于获得紧的上界是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Delaunay三角剖分伸展因子的上界压缩至距下界仅约0.056的范围内，确立了Bellman/势函数方法在几何分支因子分析中的有效性，为最终确定精确伸展因子提供了重要的理论工具。

title: Likelihood-Based Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in CMS Dijet Events
summary:
We present an unsupervised search for anomalous dijet events in proton--proton collision data using neural spline flow density estimation. A normalizing flow model is trained on a high-dimensional feature space comprising jet, dijet, and event-level observables to learn the dominant Standard Model background directly from data, without assuming a specific signal hypothesis. Events assigned low likelihood under the learned density are identified as potential anomalous events.
  Using this approach on a CMS Open Data dijet sample, we investigate extreme events in the tail of the anomaly-score distribution and perform an extensive validation and robustness study. This study includes feature-level statistical comparisons, mass decorrelation tests, permutation-based null tests, and evaluations of training stability. The selected anomalous events exhibit notable departures from the background-only expectation, primarily in jet-substructure observables, while remaining stable under several known sources of bias in unsupervised learning.
  The identified anomalies are distributed across the kinematic phase space and do not exhibit a narrow structure in the dijet invariant-mass spectrum. Instead, they show correlated deviations across multiple observables, consistent with a multivariate difference in jet substructure and event topology rather than a localized resonance. While no claim of new physics is made, this study demonstrates that neural spline flow-based density estimation can be sensitive to rare, structured deviations in collider data and may provide a model-independent exploratory tool for searches for physics beyond the Standard Model at the LHC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经样条流密度估计的无监督异常检测方法，用于搜索质子-质子对撞数据中的异常双喷注事件。通过在CMS开放数据上训练归一化流模型学习标准模型背景分布，识别低似然事件作为潜在异常，并进行全面验证与稳健性研究。结果发现异常事件在喷注子结构观测量上显示出多变量相关偏差，而非局部共振结构。
AI.motivation: 传统的超标准模型搜索依赖于具体的信号假设模型，这可能导致对非预期新物理模式的盲区。作者旨在开发一种模型无关的探索性工具，无需先验信号假设即可从不平衡的对撞机数据中识别稀有、结构化的异常事件，弥补现有搜索策略的不足。
AI.method: 采用神经样条流归一化流模型，在高维特征空间（包含喷注、双喷注及事件级观测量）中直接从数据学习标准模型背景密度。以训练得到的密度函数赋予低似然的事件为潜在异常候选。在CMS开放数据双喷注样本上进行训练与筛选，随后开展特征级统计比较、质量解相关测试、基于排列的零假设检验及训练稳定性评估等多项验证。
AI.result: 选出的异常事件与仅含背景的预期存在显著偏离，偏差主要集中在喷注子结构观测量上，且对多种无监督学习已知偏差源保持稳健。异常事件分布于整个运动学相空间，在双喷注不变质量谱上不呈现窄峰结构，而是表现出跨多个观测量的相关偏差，符合多变量意义上喷注子结构和事件拓扑的差异模式。
AI.conclusion: 尽管未宣称发现新物理，该研究证明了神经样条流密度估计对稀有、结构化对撞机数据异常具有敏感性，可为LHC上的超标准模型物理搜索提供一种模型无关的探索性工具。

title: PAGR: Proof-Carrying Algebraic-Geometric Retrieval: A Quiver-, Provenance-, and Sheaf-Theoretic Framework for Grounded LLM Retrieval
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation is usually formulated as a statistical information-retrieval problem. Graph-based variants add relational structure, but the mathematical status of that structure is often left underspecified. Three distinct questions tend to be conflated: which statements are certified as knowledge, which latent representations are useful for retrieval, and which multi-hop compositions are semantically admissible.
  We propose Proof-Carrying Algebraic-Geometric Retrieval (PAGR), a framework that separates these questions mathematically. Its symbolic layer is a many-sorted relational theory generated by a typed quiver, path equations, and positive Horn inclusions. A quiver representation assigns inner-product spaces to entity types and linear operators to relations. A cellular sheaf measures local-to-global consistency. Semiring provenance records derivations and supports machine-checkable certificates.
  The central principle is epistemic separation: learned geometry may rank and organize evidence, but cannot promote a hypothesis to certified ground truth. We show the certification criterion is invariant under arbitrary replacement of learned components. Further results include a conditional completeness bound, identification of the isometry group as the relevant symmetry for residual-based retrieval, a cohomological consistency diagnostic, and a bounded-bisimulation index for admissible-path expansion.
  PAGR is a mathematical architecture for separating where a system should look from what it is allowed to treat as knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAGR（Proof-Carrying Algebraic-Geometric Retrieval）框架，从数学上将RAG中三个常被混淆的问题——知识认证、潜在表示检索、多跳组合语义——分离处理。其核心原则是"认知分离"：学习得到的几何结构只能用于排序和组织证据，不能将假设提升为被认证的真实知识。
AI.motivation: 现有的图增强检索生成（graph-based RAG）虽然引入了关系结构，但对该结构的数学地位缺乏明确规定。论文识别出三个常被混为一谈的问题：哪些陈述被认证为知识、哪些潜在表示对检索有用、哪些多跳组合在语义上可被允许。这种混淆导致了形式化上的不严谨。
AI.method: PAGR由多个数学层构成：符号层为多类（many-sorted）关系理论，由类型化quiver、路径方程和正Horn包含生成；一个quiver表示将内积空间赋给实体类型、线性算子赋给关系；细胞层（cellular sheaf）用于度量局部到全局的一致性；半环溯源（semiring provenance）记录推导过程并支持机器可验证的证书。
AI.result: 论文证明：认证判据对学习组件的任意替换具有不变性；给出条件完备性界；识别等距群（isometry group）为基于残差检索的相关对称性；提出上同调一致性诊断方法；以及用于可允许路径展开的有界互模拟索引。
AI.conclusion: PAGR是一个数学架构，用于从概念和形式层面区分"系统应该在哪里查找"与"允许将什么当作知识"这两个问题，为RAG系统提供了一种可证明的认知边界机制。

title: Modeling Medea gene-drive population replacement: thresholds and release strategies
summary: Mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue, Zika, and yellow fever impose a substantial global health burden, motivating genetic control strategies that replace wild mosquito populations with disease-refractory ones. Maternal-effect dominant embryonic arrest (Medea) is a gene drive in which the offspring of a Medea-carrying mother die unless they inherit the Medea allele, producing biased inheritance capable of driving a linked refractory trait to high prevalence. We develop and analyze a continuous-time compartmental model of Medea dynamics in Aedes aegypti that tracks mosquito abundance by life stage and genotype, and that generalizes the drive mechanism to allow both imperfect Medea-killing and imperfect rescue. We characterize the biologically relevant equilibria and derive their local stability conditions, together with genotype-specific reproduction numbers and the basic reproduction number (R0) governing invasion from low frequency. Bifurcation analysis reveals bistability, and hence a release threshold that must be exceeded for Medea to take over, even though R0<1 at baseline. Imperfect killing and imperfect rescue reshape this bifurcation structure in distinct ways: killing leakage governs the invasion threshold, while rescue efficiency governs the composition of the resulting population. Sensitivity analysis identifies the fitness coefficient and killing leakage as the dominant drivers of both threshold and coverage outcomes, with mosquito demographic parameters affecting absolute abundances but not genotype proportions. Simulations of batched release programs inform efficient field deployment and show that reversing an established drive is substantially more costly than achieving forward invasion, though co-releasing both sexes accelerates reversal considerably more than it accelerates invasion.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并分析了埃及伊蚊中母性效应显性胚胎致死（Medea）基因驱动的连续时间分室模型，跟踪蚊虫各生命阶段和基因型的丰度，并推广驱动机制以允许不完全的Medea致死和不完全的拯救效应。研究刻画了生物学相关的平衡点及其局部稳定性条件，推导了基因型特异繁殖数和基本繁殖数（R0），通过分岔分析揭示了双稳态（即释放阈值）的存在，并系统分析了释放策略与逆转驱动的成本。
AI.motivation: 蚊媒疾病（如登革热、寨卡和黄热病）造成巨大的全球健康负担，促使研究者探索用疾病抗性蚊虫替代野生种群的遗传控制策略。Medea是一种能产生偏向性遗传的基因驱动，但对其在埃及伊蚊中的动力学特性（尤其是非理想驱动机制下）尚缺乏系统的数学模型分析，这对实际部署前的风险评估和释放方案设计至关重要。
AI.method: 建立连续时间分室模型，按生命阶段和基因型追踪蚊虫丰度；将Medea驱动机制推广为可同时包含不完全致死（killing leakage）和不完全拯救（imperfect rescue）的一般形式；通过平衡点分析、线性化稳定性判定、下一代矩阵方法推导基因型特异繁殖数与R0，并进行分岔分析以探究双稳态与释放阈值；结合敏感性分析和分批释放模拟评估现场部署策略与逆转驱动方案。
AI.result: 分析表明系统存在双稳态，因此在基线条件下即使R0<1，也需超过一定释放阈值Medea才能建立种群优势。不完全致死与不完全拯救以不同方式重塑分岔结构：致死泄漏主导入侵阈值，而拯救效率决定最终种群组成。敏感性分析显示适合度系数与致死泄漏是影响阈值和覆盖率的主导因素，蚊虫种群参数影响绝对丰度但不影响基因型比例。批量释放模拟表明逆转已建立的基因驱动比实现正向入侵成本更高，但双性别共释放对逆转的加速效果远大于对正向入侵的加速效果。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为Medea基因驱动在埃及伊蚊中的部署与可逆性提供了系统的理论框架，明确了驱动参数（致死泄漏、拯救效率、适合度系数）与种群动态的相互作用机制，为优化现场释放方案及评估基因驱动的持久性、逆转成本提供了定量指导。

title: Primes with Restricted-Digit Differences
summary: Fix a base $b\ge2$ and a digit set $\mathcal{D}\subset\{0,1,\dots,b-1\}$, and let $\mathcal C_k$ be the set of integers in $[0,b^k)$ whose $k$ base-$b$ digits all lie in $\mathcal D$. We study prime pairs and three-term arithmetic progressions in primes whose difference, or common difference, belongs to $\mathcal C_k$. Under a natural digit non-resonance condition, we establish a localized Fourier criterion guaranteeing asymptotic formulae with explicit leading constants for both problems. Using a transfer-operator argument, we verify this criterion in explicit parameter ranges for several natural families of digit sets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究素数对和素数三元等差数列中，其差（或公差）的基b展开数字全部属于给定数字集D的计数问题。在自然的数字非共振条件下，建立了局部化Fourier准则以保证渐近公式（含显式主常数），并通过转移算子方法在若干自然数字集族的显式参数范围内验证了该准则。
AI.motivation: 类似于将差限制在稀疏集合（如仅由少量允许数字组成的整数集）中，研究素数结构的算术统计规律，是对经典素数对猜想和三元素数等差数列问题在受限差集合下的推广，需要处理数字约束带来的数论与调和分析困难。
AI.method: 引入数字非共振条件，将问题归结为对Fourier指数和/或数字限制集合的局部Fourier型估计；利用转移算子（transfer operator）方法对数字集诱导的动力系统进行分析，从而在显式参数范围内证明该Fourier准则成立。
AI.result: 在数字非共振条件下，证明了素数对与三维等差素数（差属于C_k）的渐近公式，且主常数是显式的；进一步对若干自然数字集族（如稀疏允许数字集等）证明了Fourier准则成立的显式参数区间。
AI.conclusion: 本文为数字受限条件下素数对与素数等差数列的计数提供了统一的局部Fourier框架，并通过转移算子给出了可验证的充分条件，为后续扩张到更一般的受限差集合的结构问题提供了方法基础。

title: Ultrafast electron crystallography reveals the atomic pathway of a light-driven correlated insulator-to-metal transition
summary: Ultrafast phase transitions in correlated materials are often inferred from selected diffraction peak intensities or diffraction peak displacements, leaving the underlying three-dimensional atomic trajectories elusive. Resolving these trajectories is essential for identifying which atomic motions drive changes in electronic properties and how they couple to electronic degrees of freedom. We address this challenge in vanadium dioxide (VO2), a correlated oxide with a near-room-temperature transition between the insulating monoclinic (M1) phase and metallic rutile (R) phase. For this purpose, we introduce ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction, which enables refinement of the transient unit cell and internal V and O coordinates, revealing the V-V dimerization and zigzag motion during the phase transition. The refined atomic coordinates follow a linear trajectory in real space during the transition, in contrast to nonlinear or sequential transformation pathways inferred from more indirect observables in earlier work. Quantum many-body calculations treating each V-V pair as a correlated unit show that dimerization creates the level splitting responsible for the electronic gap, which is further enhanced by nonlocal electronic interactions between the paired V atoms. The gap collapses when dimerization is lost. This work turns time-resolved diffraction from order-parameter tracking into transient crystallography, directly connecting atomic trajectories to electronic mechanisms in correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 本文在VO₂中引入超快三维电子衍射技术，实现了相变过程中瞬态晶胞及V/O原子坐标的精修，揭示V-V二聚化和锯齿运动沿实空间线性轨迹演化，并结合量子多体计算阐明二聚化是电子能隙形成与崩塌的直接驱动力，将时间分辨衍射从序参量追踪提升为瞬态晶体学。
AI.motivation: 关联材料中超快相变通常仅通过选定的衍射峰强度或位移来推断，无法揭示底层三维原子轨迹。解析这些轨迹对于识别哪些原子运动驱动电子性质变化及其与电子自由度的耦合至关重要，因此需要一种能够直接解析瞬态原子坐标的方法。
AI.method: 本文开发了超快三维电子衍射技术，可精修相变过程中的瞬态晶胞内部V和O原子坐标；同时采用量子多体计算，将每个V-V对视为关联单元，解析二聚化对电子能级劈裂及能隙形成的作用。
AI.result: 精修得到的原子坐标在相变期间沿实空间线性轨迹演化，而非以往间接观测所推断的非线性或顺序转变路径。量子多体计算表明，二聚化产生能级劈裂从而形成电子能隙，配对V原子间的非局域电子相互作用进一步增强该能隙；当二聚化消失时能隙随之坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作将时间分辨衍射从序参量追踪转变为瞬态晶体学，直接将关联材料中的原子轨迹与电子机制联系起来，为理解超快相变提供了新的范式。

title: Can Acceleration in Gradient-Norm Minimization Be Anytime? Sharp Last-Iterate Limits in Smooth Convex Optimization
summary:
In smooth convex optimization, the gradient norm is a directly observable measure of stationarity. Accelerating a first-order method that minimizes the gradient norm is known to be more delicate than accelerating the minimization of function values. Optimal accelerated methods such as OGM-G (Kim & Fessler, 2021) are known to exist for any prescribed finite horizon, but their coefficients depend explicitly on the length of that horizon, i.e. the number of iterations.
  We ask what kind of acceleration is feasible when the stopping horizon is unknown to the method, i.e. for horizon-independent methods. Diakonikolas & Wang (2022) conjectured that an $Ω(N^{-1})$ lower bound on the squared gradient norm holds at every horizon $N$ for any nonadaptive, horizon-independent linear-span first-order method. We disprove this pointwise conjecture by exhibiting a method that achieves near-$N^{-2}$ last-iterate guarantees on a density-one set of horizons. We show instead that an $Ω(N^{-1})$ lower bound must hold for infinitely many horizons. More precisely, if $\mathcal G_N(\mathcal A)$ denotes the bound on the squared gradient norm after $N$ iterations for a method $\mathcal A$, we prove that $\limsup_{N\to\infty}N \mathcal G_N(\mathcal A) \ge 1/2$ for any method $\mathcal A$. This bound is sharp: the constant $1/2$ is exactly attained by the horizon-independent gradient-descent schedule of Rotaru et al. (2026).
  In addition, we show that the above two extreme behaviors cannot be achieved by the same method: any method $\mathcal A$ with an $o(N^{-1})$ guarantee on a subsequence of iterates must satisfy $\limsup_N N \mathcal G_N(\mathcal A)=\infty$. In contrast, best-so-far output admits a uniform $O(N^{-2})$ guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平滑凸优化中，在未知停止时间（即horizon-independent）的情况下，是否可以加速最小化梯度范数。作者反驳了Diakonikolas & Wang (2022)关于所有非自适应、horizon-independent的一阶方法在每一时间点都满足Ω(N^{-1})下界的逐点猜想，构造了一种在密度为一的时间集合上达到接近N^{-2}最后一轮迭代保证的方法。同时证明无穷多个时间点上Ω(N^{-1})下界必须成立：limsup N·G_N(A) ≥ 1/2，且常数1/2是紧的。此外，没有任何方法能同时实现上述两种极端行为。
AI.motivation: 在平滑凸优化中，梯度范数是衡量平稳性的直接可观测指标。虽然已知在给定有限迭代数下存在最优加速方法（如OGM-G），但系数依赖于迭代数。自然的问题是：当停止时间未知（horizon-independent）时，加速是否仍然可行？作者试图回答这一开放问题，检验Diakonikolas & Wang的猜想是否成立。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个horizon-independent的非自适应线性跨度一阶方法，在密度为一的时间集合上实现接近N^{-2}的last-iterate梯度范数上界，从而反驳逐点下界猜想。同时通过理论分析证明limsup N·G_N(A) ≥ 1/2对任何方法成立，并指出该常数由Rotaru等人(2026)的梯度下降调度精确达到。最后证明子序列上o(N^{-1})保证与limsup N·G_N=∞之间不可兼得，而best-so-far输出可提供均匀O(N^{-2})保证。
AI.result: （1）反驳了Diakonikolas & Wang的逐点猜想：存在horizon-independent方法在密度为一的horizon集合上达到接近N^{-2}的保证；（2）证明了无穷多个horizon上Ω(N^{-1})下界必须成立，limsup N·G_N(A) ≥ 1/2，且为紧界（Rotaru et al. 2026的调度精确达到常数1/2）；（3）证明了这两种极端行为互斥：若方法在某个子序列上仅o(N^{-1})，则在无限个horizon上必须有limsup N·G_N = ∞；（4）对比之下，best-so-far输出可获得均匀的O(N^{-2})保证。
AI.conclusion: Horizon-independent方法在最小化梯度范数问题上存在本质的速度-鲁棒性权衡：算法不可能在所有时间点都达到快速收敛，但可以在density-one的时间集合上做到接近N^{-2}；同时无穷多个时间点上慢下界不可避免。这种复杂性源于last-iterate分析对比best-so-far输出的差异。Diakonikolas & Wang的猜想需要修正为limsup形式而非逐点形式。

title: Robots Influencing Humans to Reveal their Goals during Collaboration and Competition
summary: We propose a unified strategy for fast goal inference in human-robot interaction. The core idea is to drive the human toward Critical Decision Points (CDPs)-states where competing human strategies prescribe different next actions and thus maximally reveal the goal. We formalise CDPs using a goal-conditioned policy divergence measure and incorporate them into a Receding-Horizon Planner that explores future action sequences while optimizing a cost function balancing task progress and information gain. We evaluate this approach in both a collaborative, fully observable cooking task and a competitive, partially observable hide-and-seek game, each in simulation and on real robots. In both scenarios, our method infers human goals more accurately and earlier than baseline strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一的人机交互快速目标推断策略，通过将人类引导至"关键决策点"(CDPs)，即不同竞争策略会产生不同动作从而最大程度暴露目标的（边缘）状态，并结合滚动时域规划器在任务进展与信息增益间权衡，实现更早、更准确的目标推断。
AI.motivation: 在人机交互中，快速、准确地推断人类意图目标对于高效协作或竞争至关重要。然而现有方法在有效引导人类揭示目标方面存在不足，缺乏一种统一且可量化的策略来主动生成最具信息量的交互，以加快目标推断的速度与精度。
AI.method: 论文提出：(1) 用目标条件化策略散度度量形式化"关键决策点"(CDPs)，即不同假设目标可能导致不同人类动作的（边缘）状态；(2) 将CDPs融入滚动时域规划器(Receding-Horizon Planner)，在有限前瞻内探索未来动作序列；(3) 优化兼顾任务进展与信息增益的成本函数，从而主动驱动人类到达CDP以最大化目标信号。
