AI.method: 将Ising二值模型推广至Potts多值框架，构建Rater Ising-Potts模型。模型以评分者间的同意性指示变量和类别标签为观测，利用LLM嵌入派生权重来刻画语义相似度；提出相似性归一化作为标准预处理，并引入可选幂变换作为可调参数，以锐化语义区分并适应不同数据集。
AI.result: 模型在多样化的构建式应答任务（包括平衡的短答案题与非平衡的AERA作文题）中与人类评分达到高度一致；绝大多数误分类发生在相邻分数等级之间，证明模型在无刚性假设条件下仍能保持评分量规的序数结构。相似性归一化和幂变换作为预处理步骤有效提升了语义区分效果。
AI.conclusion: LLM派生的语义相似性结合简洁的Potts型公式和灵活相似性缩放，为教育评估情境中的可靠性审计提供了稳健且可解释的框架。未来工作可扩展至多评分者和层级化评分过程。

title: Possible Sources of Iron Nuclei in Ultra-High-Energy Cosmic Rays
summary: The origin of a cosmic ray particle with an ultra-high energy of 2.44 x 10^20 eV recorded by the Telescope Array is discussed by assuming that it is a heavy nucleus, namely an iron or silicon nucleus. Iron is chosen as a heaviest element in cosmic rays, while silicon is chosen to find out how much the theoretical results obtained vary with the mass of the heavy nucleus. Assuming extragalactic origin of the particle with such energy, the constraints on the distances to possible sources are analysed using a routine calculation of the cosmic ray propagation in extragalactic space. These possible sources are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了望远镜阵列（Telescope Array）记录到的一颗能量为2.44×10^20 eV的超高能宇宙线粒子的起源，假设其为重原子核（铁或硅核），通过计算宇宙线在星系际空间的传播，分析了可能源的距离约束条件并讨论了候选源。
AI.motivation: 理解极高能量宇宙线粒子的起源是宇宙线天体物理学中的核心问题。该粒子的能量远超GZK截断预期，需要分析其作为重核在星系际空间传播时的能量损失与距离约束，从而识别可能的产生天体。
AI.method: 选取铁（最重的宇宙线元素）和硅作为两种假定的重核成分，使用常规的宇宙线在星系际空间的传播计算方法，对具有如此高能量的粒子进行源距离的约束分析。
AI.result: 作为重核（铁或硅）来分析该超高能粒子，得到了其在星系际空间传播时对可能源距离的约束条件，并据此讨论了可能的候选源。
AI.conclusion: 以铁或硅重核假设计算得到的源距离约束可用于评估该超高能宇宙线事件的可能产生天体，且结果随核质量的变化体现了理论结论对粒子成分假设的敏感性。

title: Entropic repulsion to the middle layer
summary:
We consider $\nabla\varphi$ height functions with even and convex interaction energy $W$ on the lattice $\mathbb{Z}^d$, which are restricted to take values in the set $\{-S, \ldots, S\}$ for some integer $S \ge 1$. We study the effect of entropic repulsion, which tends to push the spin values to the middle layer.
  We prove that the model has a unique Gibbs measure, with exponential decay of correlations, in the cases: (a) Dimension $d=2$ at all temperatures. (b) Dimensions $d\ge3$ at all temperatures, for a wide class of $W$ with non-increasing second derivative, including the family $W(x)=|x|^p$ for $p\in[1,2]$. (c) Dimensions $d\ge 3$ at both low and high temperatures, $T\in (0,\frac{W(1)d}{4(\ln d+\ln 8)})\cup(d W(2S),\infty]$, with the normalization $W(0)=0$. At low temperatures, our proof provides an alternative to Pirogov--Sinai methods.
  Conversely, we exhibit a class of even and convex interaction energies $W$ which, in high dimensions and suitable temperature regimes, have multiple Gibbs measures.
  Though uniqueness may fail, we show that the magnetization of every Gibbs measure lies in $(-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$. This implies the delocalization of the model restricted to take values in $\{0,1,\ldots\}$ (i.e., conditioned to lie above a floor) for all dimensions, any even and convex $W$, and all temperatures.
  Our methods extend to additional setups: We prove that height functions taking values in the real interval $[-1,1]$ always have a unique Gibbs measure, a result previously proved only for the quadratic interaction. For height functions taking values in $\{-S+\frac{1}{2}, \ldots, S-\frac{1}{2}\}$, $S \ge1 $ integer, we prove that the magnetization of every Gibbs measure lies in $(-1,1)$.
  The special case $W(x)=x^2$ of our results addresses questions left open in the work of Bricmont--El Mellouki--Fröhlich (1986).

AI.tldr: 本文研究限制在{-S,...,S}取值的有界∇φ高度函数模型，证明在多种维度与温度条件下（d=2全温、d≥3对广泛非增二阶导数W、d≥3低/高温区间）存在唯一Gibbs测度且关联指数衰减；反之在高维特定温度下构造了多重Gibbs测度的反例；并证明所有Gibbs测度的磁化强度落在(-1/2,1/2)，进而推导出下垫面条件化模型的去局域化性质。
AI.motivation: 有界高度函数模型中，熵排斥效应倾向于将自旋值推向中间层。已有研究（如Bricmont-El Mellouki-Fröhlich 1986针对二次相互作用）遗留了若干未解决问题，包括唯一性判据、低温和高温极限下的行为、以及推广到实数区间取值与半整数取值情形。本文旨在系统性地回答这些开放问题。
AI.method: 采用严格的数学分析工具：对于唯一性，利用非增二阶导数的凸交互能性质构造反射正与比值上界论证，在低/高温区域分别建立替代Pirogov-Sinai的简化证明；对于多重性反例，通过调节交互能量W的结构在高温维构造相变；利用磁化强度界结合不可压缩性论证推导去局域化结论。
AI.result: (a) d=2 在所有温度下唯一；(b) d≥3 对具有非增二阶导数的广泛W类（包括W(x)=|x|^p, p∈[1,2]）唯一；(c) d≥3 在低温区间(0,W(1)d/(4(ln d+ln 8)))和高温区间(dW(2S),∞]唯一。同时构造高维多重测度反例；所有Gibbs测度磁化强度∈(-1/2,1/2)；实数区间[-1,1]取值恒唯一；半整数取值情形的磁化强度∈(-1,1)。
AI.conclusion: 对∇φ有界高度函数模型给出了关于Gibbs测度唯一性与去局域化近乎完整的刻画：在多数自然条件下熵排斥足以克服交互压至使唯一性成立，但存在精心构造的反例表明在特定高维参数区域同样可出现多重测度；对二次相互作用情形完整解决了Bricmont等1986年遗留的开放问题。

title: Search for Axion Dark Matter around \texorpdfstring{$15.6\,μ\text{eV}$}{15.6 microeV} with a Broadly Tunable High-Temperature Superconducting Cavity
summary: We report an axion dark matter search in the mass range of $15.30\text{--}15.85\,μ\text{eV}$ using a broadly tunable high-temperature superconducting (HTS) haloscope. By soldering substrate-stripped rare-earth barium copper oxide (REBCO) films onto a copper shell, we achieved a quality factor 3--4 times higher than in copper cavities across its tuning band in an 8\text{-T} magnetic field. We set robust Frequentist 90\%~confidence-level exclusion limits on the axion--photon coupling down to 1.3 times the KSVZ coupling, while a complementary Bayesian analysis achieves KSVZ-level sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种使用高温超导（HTS）谐振腔的轴子暗物质搜索实验，覆盖15.30–15.85 μeV的轴子质量范围。通过在铜壳上焊接剥离衬底的REBCO薄膜，在8-T磁场下实现了比铜腔高3–4倍的品质因子，并设定了低至1.3倍KSVZ耦合的90%置信度Frequentist排除上限，贝叶斯分析则达到KSVZ级灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 传统的铜制haloscope腔体在轴子暗物质搜索中受限于有限的品质因子，限制了探测灵敏度。高温超导材料可以显著提高腔体品质因子，从而提升轴子-光子耦合探测的灵敏度，实现对更高轴子质量范围的扫描。
AI.method: 该实验采用可广泛调谐的高温超导（HTS）haloscope谐振腔。关键创新点在于：将基底剥离的REBCO（稀土钡铜氧）高温超导薄膜通过焊接方式附着于铜制外壳上，从而在8-T强磁场环境中实现高Q值。实验覆盖15.30–15.85 μeV的轴子质量调谐范围，并采用Frequentist与Bayesian两种互补的统计分析框架设置排除限。
AI.result: 在8-T磁场下，HTS腔体在整个调谐频段内实现了比常规铜腔高3–4倍的品质因子。Frequentist分析在90%置信水平下将轴子-光子耦合排除限压低至KSVZ耦合的1.3倍，同时Bayesian分析达到了KSVZ级（即1倍KSVZ）的灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了高温超导haloscope技术在实际轴子暗物质搜索中的可行性，HTS腔体相较于铜腔在灵敏度上有明显优势，并在15.30–15.85 μeV质量区间设定了前所未有的排除限，为未来更大规模HTS轴子搜索铺平了道路。

title: Representation and Extending structure of a Multiplicative Lie algebra
summary: In this paper, we attempt to develop a general notion of representation theory for multiplicative Lie algebras. Consequently, we study equivalent, irreducible, and completely reducible representations. We also introduce the notion of the action of a multiplicative Lie algebra on a vector space and show that there is a one-to-one correspondence between the action and the representation. We also studied the extended structure of a multiplicative Lie algebra through a group.

AI.tldr: 本文为乘法李代数建立了表示论的一般概念，研究了等价、不可约和完全可约表示，引入乘法李代数在向量空间上的作用概念，并证明了作用与表示之间的——对应关系，同时通过群研究了乘法李代数的扩张结构。
AI.motivation: 现有表示论主要局限于经典李代数，而乘法李代数作为更广泛的一类代数结构，缺少系统的表示理论研究。作者希望填补这一空白，为乘法李代数建立起统一且一般的表示论框架。
AI.method: 定义乘法李代数的表示概念，引入等价表示、不可约表示和完全可约表示等标准表示论概念；定义乘法李代数在向量空间上的作用，并证明该作用与表示之间存在双射（一一对应）；利用群来研究乘法李代数的扩张结构。
AI.result: 成功建立了乘法李代数的表示论基本框架，给出了等价、不可约与完全可约表示的定义与性质；证明乘法李代数在向量空间上的作用与表示之间存在一一对应关系；并通过群构造了乘法李代数的扩张结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为乘法李代数提供了系统化的表示论基础，建立了作用与表示的等价性，并通过群的视角拓展了对乘法李代数扩张结构的理解，为后续深入研究奠定理论基础。

title: Lattice point visibility along polynomials has density one
summary: We prove that every nonzero integer polynomial with at least two distinct complex roots has lattice point visibility density one, resolving the polynomial visibility conjecture of Chaubey-Pandey in the generality proposed by Lobsenz-Phillips. Visibility is taken along the curves y = tF(x) with rational t, with a point visible if no positive lattice point on the same curve has a smaller horizontal coordinate. The proof uses a greatest common divisor cutoff to reduce the problem to finitely many equations of the form F(b) = qF(a), with 0 < q < 1; for each equation, the positive integers a admitting a positive integer solution b < a form a set of density zero. This elementary argument removes the proper-power hypothesis of earlier work without requiring estimates uniform in the ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了每个具有至少两个不同复根的非零整数多项式都具有格点可见性密度1，解决了Chaubey-Pandey提出的多项式可见性猜想，并在Lobsenz-Phillips所建议的一般性层面予以解决。证明使用最大公约数截断将问题简化为有限多个形如F(b)=qF(a)（0<q<1）的方程，且每个方程中允许正整数解b<a的正整数a构成密度为零的集合。
AI.motivation: 多项式可见性猜想之前的证明依赖于proper-power假设，即对多项式的形式施加了额外限制。本文的目标是去除这一限制，在最一般的情形下解决该猜想，而不需要对比例q的估计保持一致。
AI.method: 采用最大公约数（GCD）截断技术，将原始的可见性问题约化为有限多个方程F(b)=qF(a)的分析。对于每个固定的比值0<q<1，证明使得方程存在正整数解b<a的a所构成的集合密度为零。这是通过初等方法实现的，无需依赖均匀性估计。
AI.result: 成功在无proper-power假设的一般情形下证明了多项式可见性猜想，即任意具有至少两个不同复根的非零整数多项式的格点可见性密度为1。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过初等且简洁的论证，在完全一般性层面解决了多项式可见性猜想，显著推广了先前的工作，之前的结果要求更强的proper-power条件以及关于比例的一致估计。

title: Exact fermionic dual of the Bose-Hubbard model
summary: Recent developments have established exact bosonization and fermionization with a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry as dualities through gauging. In this work, we apply fermionic gauging, which realizes generalized Jordan-Wigner transformations, to the Bose-Hubbard (BH) model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry and derive an exact dual description in terms of fermionic composites, built from bosons and fermions. In 1D, this duality generalizes the exact mapping between the extended hard-core BH model and the spinless Fermi-Hubbard model to now cover soft-core interactions. At low energies, the mapping reduces to the well-known equivalence between the sine-Gordon model and the Thirring model. The oscillation wave vector of the fermionic composite correlation function in the gapless phase is fixed by their density, providing a novel manifestation of Luttinger's theorem. We verify the exact duality using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations and demonstrate that the gapless phase and the phase transition are governed by the compact boson conformal field theory. Our construction naturally extends to generic bosonic systems and higher dimensions, opening new avenues for studying Bose-Fermi mixtures in optical lattices and other strongly correlated quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过费米型规范（gauging）实现广义Jordan-Wigner变换，将具有全局U(1)对称性的Bose-Hubbard模型精确对偶为玻色-费米复合粒子的费米子描述。在1D中，该对偶将扩展硬核BH模型与自旋less Fermi-Hubbard模型之间的精确映射推广到软核相互作用；在低能极限下还原为sine-Gordon模型与Thirring模型的等价性。作者用DMRG数值验证了该对偶，并展示了其自然推广到更高维度。
AI.motivation: 扩展已有的基于Z₂对称性的精确玻色化/费米化对偶框架，将其推广至具有连续全局U(1)对称性的Bose-Hubbard模型，从而建立涵盖软核相互作用的精确费米子对偶描述，并为研究玻色-费米混合体系与强关联量子系统提供新工具。
AI.method: 利用费米型规范（fermionic gauging）构造广义Jordan-Wigner变换，将Bose-Hubbard模型在具有U(1)对称性的条件下精确映射为玻色子和费米子构成的复合粒子描述；在1D中通过低能极限分析建立与sine-Gordon/Thirring模型等价性的联系，并使用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）数值验证对偶关系的准确性。
AI.result: 推导出Bose-Hubbard模型的精确费米子对偶描述，在1D中推广了hard-core极限下的已知映射至软核情形；低能时还原为sine-Gordon与Thirring模型的已知等价性；发现无隙相中费米复合粒子关联函数的振荡波矢由其密度决定，提供了Luttinger定理的新体现；DMRG计算确认对偶精确成立，无隙相和相变由紧致玻色子共形场论刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该费米型对偶构造不仅统一了已知的精确玻色化/费米化结果，还可自然推广至一般玻色系统和高维体系，为光学晶格中的Bose-Fermi混合物及其他强关联量子系统的研究开辟了新途径。

title: Low-rank matrix recovery landscapes beyond RIP with application to rank-one measurements
summary: We study the problem of low-rank matrix recovery from linear measurements via the global nonconvex landscape of a low-rank factored formulation of the matrix LASSO (nuclear-norm--regularized least-squares). If the landscape is benign, that is, has no bad local optima, then practical and scalable algorithms can compute good statistical estimates. Previous state-of-the-art landscape guarantees have typically assumed that the linear measurement operator has the restricted isometry property, that is, the operator is approximately an isometry over all low-rank matrices. This is an unrealistic assumption for many applications; in particular, when the individual measurement matrices are themselves low-rank, we typically have poor upper isometry constants. To overcome this, we establish new guarantees of a benign landscape under a weaker isometry condition: rather than requiring upper isometry over all low-rank matrices, we only require it over the linear low-rank tangent space to the low-rank ground truth matrix. To illustrate the utility of this result, we apply it to the problem of matrix recovery from random rank-one linear measurements; via high-probability concentration bounds on the random measurement operator, we prove a novel landscape guarantee with statistically near-optimal sample complexity and recovery error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低秩矩阵恢复问题，提出在更弱等距条件下（仅需在低秩真值矩阵的切空间上满足上等距性质），低秩因子化矩阵LASSO的全局非凸景观依然良性（无坏局部最优），并将其应用于随机秩一线性测量矩阵恢复，证明了具有统计近优样本复杂度和恢复误差的景观保证。
AI.motivation: 以往低秩矩阵恢复的景观保证通常假设线性测量算子具有受限等距性质（RIP），即算子对所有低秩矩阵近似为等距。然而在许多实际应用中这一假设不成立，尤其是当单个测量矩阵本身是低秩时，上等距常数通常较差。因此需要在更弱的条件下建立良性景观保证。
AI.method: 作者提出一种更弱的新等距条件：不再要求测量算子对所有低秩矩阵具有上等距性，而仅要求在低秩真值矩阵的线性低秩切空间上满足上等距性质。在此条件下证明了低秩因子化矩阵LASSO的全局非凸景观是良性的（不存在坏局部最优）。随后将这一结果应用于随机秩一线性测量下的矩阵恢复问题，通过随机测量算子的高概率集中界，推导出新的景观保证。
AI.result: 在随机秩一线性测量下，证明了低秩因子化矩阵LASSO具有良性全局景观，且其样本复杂度与恢复误差在统计意义下接近最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过放宽RIP条件至更弱的切空间等距条件，扩展了低秩矩阵恢复问题的良性景观保证适用范围，为实际中测量算子不满足全局RIP的场景（如秩一测量）提供了理论支撑。

title: A4A: Cross-Embodiment Transfer of Action-Oriented 4D Affordances from Human Demonstrations
summary: Human demonstrations contain rich manipulation knowledge, but it remains unclear what information can be transferred effectively to robot control. Existing affordance representations are typically formulated as 2D masks, 3D regions, contact points, or actionability scores, and therefore primarily identify where interaction may occur. However, effective manipulation also requires modeling how interaction-relevant geometry evolves during task execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce action-oriented 4D affordances, which represent the language-conditioned future trajectories of interaction-relevant 3D points. These trajectories capture task-conditioned geometric evolution rather than embodiment-specific actions, enabling transferable interaction priors across humans and robots. Based on this representation, we construct a large-scale action-oriented 4D affordance dataset from existing human--object interaction video data and complementary RGB-D demonstrations, and introduce A4A, an affordance-to-action framework that uses 4D affordance trajectory prediction to pretrain robot policies before manipulation fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and the real world validate the effectiveness of A4A, showing that pretraining with action-oriented 4D affordance data consistently improves the manipulation performance of diverse VLA policies. These results establish action-oriented 4D affordances as an effective cross-embodiment representation for transferring manipulation knowledge from human demonstrations to robot control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作导向的4D可功能性表征（action-oriented 4D affordances），将语言条件化的交互相关3D点未来轨迹作为跨实体（人类到机器人）的可迁移操作先验，并构建了大规模4D可功能性数据集和A4A框架，通过4D可功能性轨迹预测预训练机器人策略，在仿真和真实实验中验证了其对多种VLA策略操作性能的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有可功能性表征（如2D掩码、3D区域、接触点、可行动性分数）主要回答"在哪里可以交互"的问题，但有效操作还需要建模"交互相关几何在任务执行过程中如何演变"这一关键信息。这种几何演变的建模对于将人类操作知识有效迁移到机器人控制至关重要。
AI.method: （1）定义动作导向4D可功能性：语言条件化的交互相关3D点的未来轨迹，捕捉任务条件下的几何演变而非特定实体的动作； （2）从已有的人-物交互视频数据及RGB-D演示构建大规模动作导向4D可功能性数据集； （3）提出A4A框架，利用4D可功能性轨迹预测对机器人策略进行预训练，再进行操作微调。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，A4A框架验证了其有效性：使用动作导向4D可功能性数据进行预训练能够一致性地提升多种多样VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略的操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 动作导向的4D可功能性是一种有效的跨实体表征，能够将操作知识从人类演示迁移到机器人控制，弥补了现有可功能性表征仅关注"何处交互"而忽视"交互几何如何演变"的不足。

title: Fourier-cosine Tensor Trains for Density Recovery and Expectation Calculation
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures. COS-TT and COS-TT-CHF were first developed and documented by the authors in terms of a Msc thesis; this paper provides systematic derivations, error analysis, parameter-selection rules, and extensive tests in higher-dimensional settings
summary: The Fourier--cosine (COS) method of Fang and Oosterlee (2008) recovers densities and computes expectations semi-analytically from the characteristic function (ch.f.). In higher dimensions, both expansion synthesis and computation of COS coefficient-tensor entries scale exponentially with dimension. We address this curse of dimensionality with two tensor-train (TT) methods. COS-TT replaces the COS coefficient tensor by a TT representation, removing the exponential cost of online synthesis but not of offline construction. COS-TT-CHF, the main contribution of this paper, instead compresses a ch.f. sample tensor and maps it to the original Fourier--cosine coefficient tensor through an alternative COS representation. Apart from the model-dependent cost of one ch.f. evaluation, its offline and online costs scale linearly with dimension, while its error grows only algebraically with dimension. COS-TT-CHF introduces frequency-domain truncation and discretization errors absent from COS-TT; we derive explicit bounds and practical parameter-selection rules to control both. As a by-product, the construction yields cosine-basis functional TTs directly from the ch.f., converging to the density under square integrability. We further reduce expectations of nonseparable functions of additive scalar aggregates, including weighted sums of dependent variables, to one-dimensional COS calculations without tensorizing the target function. For basket-option pricing, closed-form TT-contraction integrals yield a semi-analytical formula. Experiments under geometric Brownian motion (GBM) and variance gamma (VG) confirm the parameter-selection rules and demonstrate that COS-TT-CHF remains accurate through 150 dimensions for GBM and 100 for VG. COS-TT-CHF thus reopens Fourier-based methods to problems previously considered out of reach in high dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于张量列（TT）的高维Fourier-cosine（COS）方法——COS-TT和COS-TT-CHF，解决COS方法在高维下随维度指数爆炸的问题。COS-TT-CHF是主要贡献，通过将特征函数（ch.f.）样本张量映射到Fourier-cosine系数张量，其离线和在线成本仅随维度线性增长，误差仅随维度代数增长；在GBM下可扩展到150维、VG下100维，使高维Fourier方法成为可行。
AI.motivation: 原始的COS方法在低维中高效，但推广到高维时，无论是展开合成还是COS系数张量项计算，其代价都随维度指数增长，遭遇严重的维度灾难。作者旨在打破这一瓶颈，使基于特征函数的Fourier方法能够处理此前被认为不可及的高维问题（如高维篮子期权定价）。
AI.method: 提出了两种张量列方法：（1）COS-TT：将COS系数张量用TT表示替代，消除在线合成的指数成本但保留离线构造的指数成本；（2）COS-TT-CHF（主要贡献）：压缩特征函数样本张量，再通过替代COS表示映射到原始Fourier-cosine系数张量。除一次特征函数求值外，其离线与在线成本均随维度线性增长。论文推导了频域截断误差与离散化误差的显式上界及实用的参数选择规则；作为副产品，直接从特征函数构造余弦基底泛函TT并收敛于密度。对加性标量聚合的非可分函数期望，将计算降为不张量化目标函数的一维COS计算；关于篮子期权定价，通过TT收缩积分的闭式表达式得到半解析公式。
AI.result: 在几何布朗运动（GBM）和方差伽玛（VG）模型下的实验验证了参数选择规则，COS-TT-CHF在GBM中保持150维、VG中100维的精度。研究还确认了COS-TT-CHF产生的频率域截断及离散化误差可通过显式界进行控制，并展示了其在不可分函数期望及篮子期权半解析定价方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: COS-TT-CHF通过张量列压缩将Fourier-based方法重新推广到高维问题，使得此前因维度灾难而无法实现的COS方法在高维场景下重新获得可行性，具有线性维度扩展能力和可控的误差界，为高维衍生品定价及相关应用提供了实际可用的计算框架。

title: Dynamic Latent Space Modeling of Inhomogeneous Poisson Network Processes with Applications to International Relations
summary: We study continuous-time relational event data, where time-stamped dyadic interactions reflect both individual node propensities and evolving relational proximity. We propose a dynamic latent space model for inhomogeneous Poisson processes, where event intensities depend on node-specific activity parameters and time-varying latent distances modeled via flexible B-splines. We prove model identifiability by decoupling baseline activity from latent position, ensuring high interaction volumes do not warp the spatial map. For scalability, we develop a minibatch stochastic gradient algorithm with stable initialization and geometric anchoring, alongside an effective-degrees-of-freedom BIC for tuning model complexity. Simulations confirm accurate parameter recovery and out-of-sample prediction. Applied to cooperative diplomatic events among 60 major economies (1995--2022), the model uncovers shifting patterns of international cooperation and isolates mobile geopolitical actors from stationary institutional anchors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于连续时间关系事件数据的动态潜空间模型，将事件强度建模为节点活动参数与B样条时变潜距离的函数，证明了模型可识别性，并提出小批量随机梯度算法与有效自由度BIC用于可扩展性与模型选择，在仿真与外交事件数据上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 连续时间关系事件数据中，个体倾向与随时间的互动模式交织在一起，现有方法难以同时刻画个体活动性差异和动态的关系邻近结构，且缺乏可扩展的估计方法与理论可识别性保证。
AI.method: 构建非齐次泊松过程的动态潜空间模型，事件强度由节点特定活动参数和基于柔性B样条的时变潜距离共同决定；通过解耦基线活动与潜位置实现模型可识别性；开发小批量随机梯度算法（含稳定初始化与几何锚定）进行可扩展估计；提出基于有效自由度的BIC准则用于模型复杂度选择。
AI.result: 仿真实验验证了参数恢复的准确性与样本外预测能力；应用于60个主要经济体1995-2022年的合作外交事件数据，揭示了国际合作模式的动态变化，并能够区分灵活的地缘政治行动者与固定的机制性锚定国家。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为关系事件数据提供了兼具理论可识别性、计算可扩展性和实际洞察力的动态潜空间框架，能有效揭示国际合作结构的演化及其参与者角色的分化。

title: NEXUS: Transient Searches and First Results from Year One Observations
comment: 35 pages, 19 figures, 5 tables. The jwst_psfmc package, designed to account for correlated noise in PSF photometry on drizzled images, is available at https://github.com/mingyangzhuang/jwst_psfmc
summary: We describe ongoing efforts of high-redshift transient searches using multi-epoch NIRCam imaging (F200W+F444W) and NIRSpec MSA/PRISM spectroscopy from the NEXUS JWST multi-cycle Treasury program targeting the north ecliptic pole region. The transient search area covers $\sim 61.5\,{\rm arcmin^2}$ between the reference epoch and each subsequent NEXUS-Deep epoch at a cadence of $\sim2$~months. In the first year of observations from NEXUS, we detect 68 robust transients, with the host photometric redshift distribution declining rapidly at $z>2$ but extending to $z_{\rm phot}\approx 6$. In addition, we obtained secure spectroscopic redshifts for 37 transients ($\sim54\%$) from NIRSpec/PRISM and NIRCam/WFSS, with seventeen at $1 < z < 2$, eight at $2 < z < 3$, two at $3 < z < 4$, and one tentative host association at z = 6.151. Overall, the NEXUS program recovers observed supernova (SN) rates broadly consistent with other SN search programs with JWST. While NEXUS achieves the highest transient detection efficiency, 6.6 SNe per imaging hr ($2.6\times$ COSMOS-SN and $26\times$ JADES-SN), the limited filter coverage (F200W+F444W only) limits robust identification and classification of high-$z$ SNe for deep spectroscopic follow-up. We describe the details of the data reduction and transient detection pipeline, and report the Year-1 transient sample along with their light curves, available MSA spectroscopy, host association, and the raw detection rate. We also describe and release a new PSF photometry package that properly accounts for correlated pixel noise from combining drizzled images.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了NEXUS JWST多周期国库项目在北黄极区域开展的高红移暂现源搜索工作。基于NIRCam多历元成像（F200W+F444W）和NIRSpec MSA/PRISM光谱，在约61.5 arcmin²的搜索区域内以约2个月的星历间隔进行监测。第一年观测探测到68个稳健暂现源，宿主星系测光红移分布至z≈6；37个暂现源（~54%）获得光谱红移确认，最高置信宿主红移为z=6.151。项目整体超新星（SN）探测率与其他JWST项目一致，但具有最高探测效率（6.6 SNe/成像小时，为COSMOS-SN的2.6倍、JADES-SN的26倍），同时仅覆盖两个滤光片限制了对高红移超新星的稳健识别与分类。文章还发布了新的PSF测光软件包以正确处理drizzled图像的相关像素噪声。
AI.motivation: 高红移暂现源（尤其是超新星）的探测对理解早期宇宙恒星演化、恒星形成历史以及宇宙学距离测量至关重要。JWST提供了前所未有的红外灵敏度和空间分辨率，使得在z>2的宇宙早期探测暂现源成为可能。本文旨在通过NEXUS多周期深场观测系统性地开展高红移暂现源搜索，建立大规模样本以研究早期宇宙超新星种群及其宿主星系性质。
AI.method: 利用JWST NIRCam F200W+F444W双波段多历元成像进行暂现源搜索，搜索面积为约61.5 arcmin²，历元间隔约2个月，共获得68个稳健暂现源。对其中约54%的目标使用NIRSpec MSA/PRISM及NIRCam/WFSS进行光谱观测以获取红移，结合宿主星系进行关联分析。自主开发了新的PSF测光软件包，能够正确处理drizzled图像中因合并产生的相关像素噪声，用于精确测量暂现源光变曲线。
AI.result: 第一年观测在NEXUS-Deep区域探测到68个暂现源，宿主测光红移分布至z≈6但Z>2后快速下降；37个暂现源（~54%）获得光谱红移，其中17个在1<z<2，8个在2<z<3，2个在3<z<4，1个候选宿主星系z=6.151。NEXUS探测效率高达6.6 SNe/成像小时，分别是COSMOS-SN的2.6倍和JADES-SN的26倍，整体超新星率与其他JWST搜索项目一致。发布了暂现源样本、光变曲线、MSA光谱数据和PSF测光软件包。
AI.conclusion: NEXUS展现了JWST深场多历元观测在高红移暂现源搜索中的高效性，探测效率显著优于其他JWST项目。但仅使用F200W+F444W两个滤光片限制了高红移超新星的光度分类和稳健识别，尤其不利于深光谱后随观测的目标筛选。未来需要更宽的滤光片覆盖和更高星历频率的能力以进一步提升高红移超新星的识别与分类能力。PSF测光软件包的发布为类似深场暂现源研究提供了工具支持。

title: Classification of Conformally Covariant 2-Tensors from the Kulkarni--Nomizu Product in Dimension 4
summary: We classify all natural, conformally covariant, symmetric (0,2)-tensors of conformal weight -2 and differential order less than or equal to 4 in dimension 4, built from the metric, the Schouten tensor, covariant derivatives, and the Kulkarni-Nomizu product. We prove that the space of such tensors is exactly 2-dimensional, spanned by the Bach tensor (order 2) and the Eastwood-Singer tensor (order 4). The algebraic core is formally verified using Lean 4 with Mathlib. The 8x11 constraint matrix and divergence-free condition are verified computationally with exact rational arithmetic. Both English and Russian versions provided; Russian version available as ancillary.

AI.tldr: 本文在4维空间中完整分类了由度量、Schouten张量、协变导数及Kulkarni-Nomizu积构造的、共形权重为-2、微分阶数不超过4的所有自然共形协变对称(0,2)-张量，证明其张成空间恰好为2维，由Bach张量（2阶）和Eastwood-Singer张量（4阶）张成。核心代数推理通过Lean 4与Mathlib形式化验证，约束矩阵和散度自由条件通过精确有理算术计算验证。
AI.motivation: 共形协变张量在共形几何和数学物理中具有核心地位，但此前缺乏对4维中特定权重和微分阶数下自然共形协变对称张量的完整分类。该研究旨在穷尽所有可能性，以数学上严格的方式确定生成元集合，并借助形式化验证工具确保代数推导的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用代数构造与分类方法：首先设定由度量、Schouten张量、协变导数和Kulkarni-Nomizu积张成的候选张量空间，施加共形协变性条件和权重-2的约束，构建8×11约束矩阵，利用精确有理算术进行计算验证，并通过推导散度自由条件缩小候选集合。关键代数推导使用Lean 4和Mathlib定理证明器进行形式化验证。
AI.result: 证明了维数为4时，满足所有条件的自然共形协变对称(0,2)-张量空间恰好为2维，且由Bach张量（微分阶数2）和Eastwood-Singer张量（微分阶数4）唯一张成。8×11约束矩阵及散度自由条件均通过精确有理运算在计算层面得到确认，形式化证明亦已完成。
AI.conclusion: 该结果在严格的数学意义上完成了4维中共形权重-2、微分阶数≤4的自然共形协变对称张量的完全分类，证实了该空间中不存在除Bach张量与Eastwood-Singer张量之外的独立生成元。形式化验证为该分类结果的正确性提供了高度可信的机器可检查证据。

title: Search for the doubly Cabibbo-suppressed decays $D^0\to K^+π^-η^\prime$ and $D^+\to K^+π^0η^\prime$
summary: We present the first search for the doubly Cabibbo-suppressed decays $D^0\to K^+π^-η^\prime$ and $D^+\to K^+π^0η^\prime$ using an $e^+e^-$ collision data sample corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 20.3 fb$^{-1}$, collected at a center-of-mass energy of 3.773 GeV with the Beijing Spectrometer III (BESIII) detector at the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider II (BEPCII). No significant signals are observed, and the upper limits on their decay branching fractions are set to be $3.0\times 10^{-5}$ and $2.1\times 10^{-5}$ at the 90% confidence level, respectively. By combining these results with the world-average branching fractions of the corresponding Cabibbo-favored decays, upper limits at the 90% confidence level are obtained on the ratios of doubly Cabibbo-suppressed to Cabibbo-favored branching fractions. The limits are determined to be $1.6\times \tan^4θ_C$ and $3.7\times \tan^4θ_C$ for $D^0\to K^+π^-η^\prime$ and $D^+\to K^+π^0η^\prime$, respectively, where $θ_C$ denotes the Cabibbo mixing angle.

AI.tldr: 本文首次搜索了双重Cabibbo压制衰变D^0→K^+π^-η′和D^+→K^+π^0η′，利用BESIII探测器在BEPCII上收集的质心能量为3.773 GeV、积分亮度为20.3 fb^-1的e^+e^-对撞数据。未观察到显著信号，在90%置信水平下设定这两个衰变分支比的上限分别为3.0×10^-5和2.1×10^-5。结合世界平均的Cabibbo允许衰变分支比，得到双重Cabibbo压制与Cabibbo允许分支比的比值上限分别为1.6×tan^4θ_C和3.7×tan^4θ_C。
AI.motivation: 对双重Cabibbo压制（DCS）衰变的搜索是检验标准模型Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa（CKM）矩阵结构及寻找新物理信号的重要途径。此前尚未有过对D→Kπη′通道中DCS衰变的实验搜索，该研究填补了这一空白，有助于加深对粲介子弱衰变机制的理解。
AI.method: 利用BESIII探测器在BEPCII上采集的质心能量3.773 GeV（对应ψ(3770)共振峰）的e^+e^-对撞数据，数据样本积分亮度为20.3 fb^-1。通过重建D^0→K^+π^-η′和D^+→K^+π^0η′候选事例，并结合D介子对标记方法进行信号搜索，统计显著性不足后采用上限设定方法（CLs或贝叶斯方法）在90%置信水平下给出分支比上限，并与世界平均的对应Cabibbo允许衰变分支比结合，计算DCS/CF分支比比值上限。
AI.result: 未观察到显著信号，在90%置信水平下，D^0→K^�π^-η′和D^+→K^π^0η′的分支比上限分别设为3.0×10^-5和2.1×10^-5。结合Cabibbo允许衰变的世界平均分支比，DCS/CF分支比比值上限分别为1.6×tan^4θ_C和3.7×tan^4θ_C（90%置信水平），其中θ_C为Cabibbo混合角。
AI.conclusion: 这是对这两个DCS衰变道的首次实验搜索。虽然未发现显著信号，但所给出的分支比上限及与CF衰变比值的上限为未来更大统计量的实验（如BESIII升级、Belle II等）提供了参考基准，对D介子衰变中Cabibbo压制效应的验证和标准模型检验具有重要意义。

title: $q$-Oper Structures on a Formal Punctured Disc
summary: Let $G$ be a connected reductive complex algebraic group and let $q\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}$ be not a root of unity. We prove that every $(G,q)$-connection on a formal punctured disc admits a $(G,q)$-oper structure.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在连通约化复数代数群G和非单位根q∈ℂ^×的条件下，形式穿孔圆盘上的每个(G,q)-联络都允许一个(G,q)-oper结构。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在推广经典G-联络与G-oper结构之间的存在性结果至q-差分范畴（即(G,q)-联络与(G,q)-oper），为量子群和q-差分方程理论提供几何基础。
AI.method: 利用代数群与约化群结构理论，通过构造形式穿孔圆盘上(G,q)-联络到(G,q)-oper的规范变换来证明存在性，避免q为单位根的情况以确保理论非退化。
AI.result: 证明了对任意连通约化复数代数群G以及非单位根的q，所有形式穿孔圆盘上的(G,q)-联络均具有(G,q)-oper结构。
AI.conclusion: 该结果建立了(G,q)-联络与(G,q)-oper之间的完整对应，是经典情形向量子情形的成功推广。

title: Normal Behavior and Periodic Points of a Pseudo-Aliquot Map Associated with the Dedekind Psi Function
summary: We study the iteration of (T(n)=ψ(n)-n), where (ψ) is the Dedekind psi function. We show that, for almost all integers, successive iterates satisfy strong asymptotic growth relations governed by (T(n)/n). As an application, we prove that for every fixed (\ell\ge1), the set of integers satisfying (T^{(\ell)}(n)=n) has asymptotic density zero, and hence so does the set of periodic points of any fixed period.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由Dedekind psi函数定义的迭代T(n)=ψ(n)-n，证明对几乎所有整数，连续迭代满足由T(n)/n控制的强渐近增长关系，并据此证明对任意固定ℓ≥1，满足T^(ℓ)(n)=n的整数集合渐近密度为零，即任意固定周期的周期点集合密度为零。
AI.motivation: 研究Dedekind psi函数的迭代动力学行为。T(n)=ψ(n)-n类似于经典的欧拉φ函数迭代（如Aliquot序列），作者希望理解这一映射在几乎所有整数上的典型增长行为，并探究其周期点（即满足T^(ℓ)(n)=n的整数）的分布密度问题。
AI.method: 作者通过对几乎所有整数建立渐近增长关系，利用T(n)/n的比值来控制连续迭代的增长率。核心策略是证明在几乎所有整数上，T(n)相对于n具有某种充分大的增长幅度，使得迭代序列无法回到原点（即无法形成周期性）。这种分析方法通常需要使用数论中的概率方法或密度估计工具来处理ψ(n)/n的平均行为和分布特征。
AI.result: 对于几乎所有整数，成功推得连续迭代满足由T(n)/n决定的强渐近增长关系。作为应用，证明了对于任意固定的ℓ≥1，集合{n: T^(ℓ)(n)=n}的渐近密度为零，从而任意固定周期的周期点集合也具有零渐近密度。
AI.conclusion: Dedekind psi函数迭代映射T在几乎所有整数上表现出明确的增长趋势，且该映射的周期点在整数中极为稀疏（零密度），表明这种迭代本质上不具有周期性回归的行为。

title: Hysteretic Coherence Collapse Across the First Order CDW Transition in 1T-TaS2
summary: The first order phase transition between the nearly commensurate (NC-CDW) and commensurate (C-CDW) charge density wave phases in 1T-TaS2 underpins its exotic electronic behavior, yet the spectroscopic evolution of the low energy electronic structure across this transition remains crucial to understand. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we investigate the low temperature C-CDW phase, characterized by a flat band commonly associated with the lower Hubbard band and a distinct in-gap state located closer to the Fermi level. Photon energy dependent measurements distinguish these two low energy features through their different spectral weight evolution. Temperature dependent ARPES across heating and cooling cycles reveals that the in-gap state undergoes an abrupt collapse upon heating into the NC-CDW phase and re-emerges sharply upon cooling back into the C-CDW phase. This pronounced thermal hysteresis provides direct spectroscopic evidence of the first order nature of the transition. Furthermore, the disappearance and recovery of the in-gap state closely track the corresponding changes in resistivity, highlighting its intimate connection to the electronic reconstruction across the C-CDW/NC-CDW phase transition.

AI.tldr: 本文利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）系统研究了1T-TaS2中近公度电荷密度波（NC-CDW）与公度电荷密度波（C-CDW）之间一级相变过程中低能电子结构的演化，发现带隙内态（in-gap state）在加热进入NC-CDW相时急剧消失、冷却回到C-CDW相时锐利重现，表现出显著的热滞回现象，直接提供了该一级相变的谱学证据，且该态的变化与电阻率变化紧密关联。
AI.motivation: 1T-TaS2中NC-CDW与C-CDW相之间的一级相变是其奇特电子行为的基础，但跨相变过程中低能电子结构的谱学演化仍未被充分理解，因此需要通过高能量分辨的谱学手段阐明这一关键物理过程。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）技术，对低温C-CDW相进行研究（该相具有平坦带及靠近费米能级的带隙内态）；通过光子能量依赖测量区分两个低能特征的不同谱权重演化；并在加热和冷却循环中进行变温ARPES测量以追踪电子结构的演化。
AI.result: 光子能量依赖测量成功区分了平坦带和带隙内态；变温ARPES显示带隙内态在加热进入NC-CDW相时突然崩塌，冷却回C-CDW相时迅速重现，展现了显著的热滞回现象；带隙内态的消失与恢复与电阻率变化密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 热滞回现象为C-CDW/NC-CDW相变的一级本质提供了直接的光谱证据，且带隙内态与电阻率的同步变化揭示了其与该相变过程中电子重构的内在联系，深化了对1T-TaS2中电荷密度波相变机制的理解。

title: Fast PAC Global Optimization via Restarted Langevin: Exploration, Exploitation, and Degenerate Cooling
summary:
We study the computational effort required for global optimization of a smooth, possibly nonconvex objective $Γ:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$. An algorithm satisfies the $(\varepsilon,δ)$-PAC performance requirement if its output $\widehat X$ obeys $\mathbb{P}\{Γ(\widehat X)-Γ^\star>\varepsilon\}\leqδ$. Algorithm design and analysis are in continuous time. We compare classical simulated annealing and fixed-temperature Langevin diffusion with two approaches introduced and analyzed here: parallel-restart Langevin and a Langevin--gradient scheme using stochastic dynamics for global exploration and gradient flow for local exploitation.
  Let $L=\log(1/δ)$ and let $E_*$ denote the dominant energy barrier. At logarithmic precision in the low-temperature regime, the first two approaches require simulation time exponential in $L/\varepsilon$. For parallel fixed-temperature Langevin, an appropriate number of independent trials gives $ C_3=L^{1+o(1)}/\varepsilon$ as $δ\downarrow0$, for each fixed $\varepsilon>0$.
  The most substantial improvement comes from separating exploration from exploitation. If $η$ is the attraction margin of a target region containing the global minimizers, a sufficient low-temperature estimate for total simulation time in the best-state Langevin--gradient variant is $ C_4^{(c)}\approx N\exp\{EL/(Nη)\} +O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$, with $E>E_*$. Thus global exploration is decoupled from the requested accuracy. Analysis beyond logarithmic precision reveals dimension-dependent prefactors, while experiments on the six-hump camel and Rastrigin objectives illustrate the benefits of warmer exploration and the usefulness of spectral information for understanding exploration time.

AI.tldr: 本文从计算复杂度的角度研究了光滑（可能非凸）目标函数的全局优化问题。在(ε,δ)-PAC性能框架下，比较了经典模拟退火、固定温度Langevin扩散与两种新方法（并行重启Langevin和Langevin-梯度混合方案）的计算代价。结果表明，并行固定温度Langevin可将模拟时间从指数级降至L^{1+o(1)}/ε；而分离探索与利用的Langevin-梯度方案实现了最大改进，总模拟时间约为N·exp{EL/(Nη)}+O(log(1/ε))，将全局探索与精度要求解耦。
AI.motivation: 全局优化非凸目标函数所需的计算代价尚不清晰。已有方法（如模拟退火和固定温度Langevin扩散）在低温和PAC框架下需要指数级模拟时间（与L/ε相关）。作者希望设计更高效的算法，通过区分探索（exploration）与利用（exploitation）来大幅降低计算负担，并分析其复杂度上界。
AI.method: 在连续时间框架下进行算法设计与分析。提出两种新方法：(1) 并行重启Langevin扩散——多个独立固定温度Langevin轨迹并行运行；(2) Langevin-梯度混合方案——用Langevin随机动力学进行全局探索，用梯度流进行局部利用。采用(ε,δ)-PAC准则，在低温和对数精度下推导各算法所需的模拟时间，并进一步分析超越对数精度的维度依赖前置因子。通过在六峰驼峰（six-hump camel）和Rastrigin目标上的实验验证理论结果。
AI.result: 1) 经典模拟退火与固定温度Langevin在低温和对数精度下所需的模拟时间与exp(L/ε)（指数级）相关。2) 并行固定温度Langevin在δ→0时的时间为C₃=L^{1+o(1)}/ε（对固定ε>0），实现了指数到多对数的质变。3) Langevin-梯度方案的总模拟时间约为C₄^(c)≈N·exp{EL/(Nη)}+O(log(1/ε))，其中E>E_*（E_*为支配能量势垒），η为目标吸引域裕度。若N足够大使EL/(Nη)上界可控，该量可与ε完全解耦（仅O(log(1/ε))）。4) 超越对数精度时出现维度相关的常数因子。5) 实验表明更温热（warmer）的探索有利，且谱信息有助于理解探索时间。
AI.conclusion: 将探索与利用分离是全局优化的核心设计原则。Langevin-梯度混合方案在PAC框架下实现了探索时间与目标精度的近乎完全解耦，这是对经典退火/扩散方法的重大改进。理论加实验共同表明，在目标吸引域信息（η）和能量势垒信息（E）可获取时，该方案提供了在非凸优化中兼顾全局收敛保证与计算效率的可行路径。

title: GIF: Agentic Generation of Interactive and Functional Object Compositions for Robot Learning
summary: Robot manipulation foundation models require scalable evaluation and data generation across diverse scenarios, with simulation providing an environment for both. Automated scene generation offers a promising path, yet prior work has largely emphasized coarse-grained scene layouts rather than fine-grained functional object compositions. Motivated by this gap, we present GIF, an agentic Generation framework for Interactive and Functional object compositions. In this framework, we recast this problem as disentangled reconstruction followed by relative pose recovery. CoGen produces instance-disentangled meshes with coarse initial poses leveraging complementary strengths of 2D and 3D generative models. GPRM refines the relative pose under joint geometric and physical guidance, and a VLM verifier selects the candidate that best matches the structured specification. We further construct a benchmark spanning eight representative contact-geometry classes and compare with state-of-the-art generators; GIF improves both asset quality and relation matching, while reducing collision rate to below 1%. Finally, we synthesize data for policy learning, revealing diversity scaling in both simulation and real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GIF框架，用于机器人操作基础模型中的交互式和功能性物体组合的自动化场景生成，通过解耦重建和相对位姿恢复实现高质量的功能化物体组合生成。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作基础模型需要可扩展的评估和数据生成环境，自动场景生成是重要路径，但现有工作主要强调粗粒度场景布局，而非细粒度的功能性物体组合（如物体间的接触几何和功能关系），存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: GIF框架包含三个核心组件：CoGen利用2D和3D生成模型的互补优势生成实例解耦的网格和粗略初始位姿；GPRM在联合几何与物理引导下细化相对位姿；VLM验证器从候选中选择最符合结构化规格的结果。问题被重构为解耦重建加相对位姿恢复。
AI.result: 构建了涵盖八类代表性接触几何类别的基准测试，与最先进生成器相比，GIF在资产质量和关系匹配上均有提升，碰撞率降至1%以下。合成数据用于策略学习，在仿真和真实部署中均展现出多样性扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: GIF通过解耦重建和相对位姿恢复的agentic框架，有效解决了细粒度功能性物体组合的自动生成问题，为机器人操作基础模型提供了可扩展的高质量数据生成与评估方案。

title: Weighted Laplace Spaces for Spectral Measures and Rational Approximation
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Generative AI has been used for this paper
summary: We introduce the weighted Laplace space $H_w$, an RKHS of Laplace transforms on $(0,\infty)$, and study spectral measures in its dual space $H'_w$. For conforming FEM discretizations of the Dirichlet Laplacian on bounded Lipschitz domains, we prove the dual-norm inequality $\|μ_h\|_{H'_w} \leq \|μ\|_{H'_w}$, where $μ= \sum_kδ_{λ_k}$ and $μ_h = \sum_k δ_{λ_{k,h}}$. The proof combines min-max monotonicity of FEM eigenvalues with a heat-trace representation of the dual norm. We then analyze $H_w$-adapted rational approximation of shifted symbols $φ(x)=(x+κ^2)^{-β}$ and give a conditional transfer principle for estimates proved in the corresponding weighted Laplace pre-image norm. Via dual pairing, the norm inequality yields uniform bounds for finite spectral sums and related transformed observables.

AI.tldr: 本文引入加权Laplace空间H_w（(0,∞)上Laplace变换的RKHS），研究其对偶空间H'_w中的谱测度。对有界Lipschitz域上Dirichlet Laplacian的协调有限元离散，证明了双范数不等式‖μ_h‖_{H'_w} ≤ ‖μ‖_{H'_w}（μ与μ_h分别为连续与离散特征值谱测度），其证明结合了FEM特征值的min-max单调性与双范数的热迹表示。进一步分析H_w适应的移位符号φ(x)=(x+κ²)^{-β}的有理逼近，给出条件传递原理，并通过对偶配对得到有限谱和及相关可观测量的一致界。
AI.motivation: 在数值分析中，有限元方法离散Laplacian算子的谱逼近误差通常利用特征值间的逐点比较或Weyl定律来估计，但这类估计对均匀谱界（uniform bounds）下有限谱和及变换可观测量的情形往往不够精细或不统一。作者希望通过构造一个自然的加权函数空间（RKHS），在其对偶范数下将连续谱测度与离散谱测度加以度量，从而以统一、简洁的不等式形式获得谱逼近的一致界，并为后续有理逼近（如移位符号φ(x)=(x+κ²)^{-β}）的误差传递提供理论框架。
AI.method: (1) 构造加权Laplace空间H_w，即Laplace变换在(0,∞)上构成RKHS的空间，并研究其对偶H'_w中谱测度的范数表示（通过热迹表示将双范数与热核相联系）。 (2) 对Dirichlet Laplacian的协调FEM离散（有界Lipschitz域），借助FEM特征值的min-max单调性（即λ_{k,h} ≥ λ_k），结合热迹表示证明双范数不等式‖μ_h‖≤‖μ‖。 (3) 分析H_w适应的有理逼近：对φ(x)=(x+κ²)^{-β}构造有理（如FEM预解相关）逼近，并给出条件传递原理，使在加权Laplace原像范数中证明的估计可传递给H'_w对偶范数下的误差界。 (4) 通过对偶配对（dual pairing），从上述范数不等式推导有限谱和及变换可观测量的均匀一致上界。
AI.result: 建立了含权和双范数的基本不等式：对协调FEM离散，离散谱测度μ_h在H'_w范数下不超过连续谱测度μ的H'_w范数，从而提供了谱逼近的单调族上界。给出了该范数框架下有移位有理逼近的误差分析及条件传递原则，并据此得到了有限谱和与变换可观测量的统一一致界。
AI.conclusion: 加权Laplace空间框架为FEM谱逼近提供了自然且统一的数学语言，使谱测度在对偶范数下的单调不等式成为可能，并可与有理逼近理论结合，形成完整的误差传递链条。该工作拓展了谱逼近估计的工具箱，适用于更一般的变换可观测量的均匀界分析。

title: Bayesian palaeoclimate reconstruction from zero-inflated count-compositional pollen data: A case study of Lago Grande di Monticchio in southern Italy
summary: Bayesian palaeoclimate reconstruction from fossil pollen counts relies on a modern pollen-climate calibration data set to infer the pollen-climate relationships used to reconstruct past climates. While geographically large calibration data sets improve coverage of climate space and reduce unreliable extrapolation, they also introduce substantial heterogeneity, structural zeros, and complex pollen-climate relationships. We propose a Bayesian modular framework for palaeoclimate reconstruction from count-compositional pollen data that addresses these challenges, and provides coherent uncertainty quantification. The framework employs the zero-and-$N$-inflated multinomial logistic-normal distribution to describe the compositional pollen counts coupled with Bayesian additive regression tree priors to model the nonlinear effects and interactions among the climate covariates. Inference is formulated through a cut posterior distribution that modularises the analysis into forward and reconstruction modules. The forward module is fitted once using a large modern calibration data set and its posterior uncertainty is subsequently propagated to reconstruct climate variables from fossil pollen counts. For the reconstruction module, we develop and compare three inverse posterior sampling schemes. Simulation studies and empirical validation on the modern data set demonstrate that a combination of sampling importance resampling with a multiple imputation technique and a continuous uniform prior over the domain of the modern climate variables achieves the best predictive performance, with well-calibrated uncertainty quantification for the climate reconstruction. In our motivating case study, we further illustrate the proposed methodology by reconstructing a three-dimensional climate vector from fossil pollen records collected at Lago Grande di Monticchio in southern Italy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个贝叶斯模块化框架，用于从花粉计数成分数据重建古气候，结合零和N膨胀多项logistic-正态分布与贝叶斯加性回归树先验，通过cut后验分布进行前向和重建模块的模块化推断，并在蒙特基奥湖案例中实现三维气候重建。
AI.motivation: 大规模花粉-气候校准数据集虽然能扩大气候空间覆盖并减少不可靠外推，但也引入显著异质性、结构零值和复杂非线性花粉-气候关系，现有方法难以同时处理这些挑战并为重建提供连贯的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 采用零和N膨胀多项logistic-正态分布建模成分花粉计数数据，使用贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）先验刻画气候协变量的非线性效应与交互作用；通过cut后验分布将分析模块化为前向模块（基于现代校准数据拟合一次）和重建模块（从化石花粉推断气候变量），并开发和比较三种逆向后验采样方案，包括采样重要重采样结合多重插补技术及连续均匀先验。
AI.result: 模拟研究和现代数据实证验证表明，采样重要重采样结合多重插补技术和现代气候变量域上的连续均匀先验的组合取得了最佳预测性能，且气候重建的不确定性量化校准良好；案例研究成功从意大利南部Lago Grande di Monticchio的化石花粉记录重建了三维气候向量。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化框架能有效处理大规模校准数据集的异质性和复杂关系，为古气候重建提供校准良好的不确定性量化，在实践中展现出良好的适用性。

title: LOFAR follow-up of sources in the First LHAASO Catalogue
summary: The First LHAASO Catalogue lists 90 sources of very-high-energy gamma-ray emission, many without an established counterpart at other frequencies, reopening the question of which Galactic accelerators produce the highest-energy cosmic rays. We search for low-frequency radio counterparts to the 55 1LHAASO sources that fall within the Galactic fields of the LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey Data Release Three (LoTSS-DR3), using 144~MHz continuum maps at $6''$ and $20''$ resolution, complemented with archival data from other radio surveys where available. We present an overview of the radio emission towards all 55 sources, and identify the structures potentially associated with the gamma-ray emission. We report 24 new supernova remnant (SNR) candidates, nine flat-spectrum radio shells with faint or no infrared counterpart, and six sources with no clear Galactic radio emission present in the LOFAR maps. A bootstrap analysis shows that 23 of the 50 sources in the Galactic plane footprint (46\%, for $|b| \leq 5$) overlap a catalogued SNR, whereas random placement yields only $10.0\pm2.8$ matches even if the underlying Galactic SNR population is ten times larger than currently catalogued; in the outer Galaxy, where chance alignment is rarest, 4 of 12 sources coincide with an SNR against a null expectation of $\lesssim2$. We estimate that at least a quarter, and up to half, of the 1LHAASO Galactic-plane sources genuinely reside in SNR environments, consistent with a population dominated by pulsar wind nebulae, SNR--PWN composites, and cosmic-ray-illuminated clouds. Individual results include a new SNR candidate inside the TeV shell HESS~J1912+101, a radio candidate for the SNR hypothesised to explain the GeV emission of 1LHAASO~J1945+2424, and the first proposed counterparts of 1LHAASO~JJ0056+6343u and 1LHAASO~J2200+5643u.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用LOFAR低频射电巡天（LoTSS-DR3）数据，对55个位于银河系天区的1LHAASO源进行了144 MHz低频射电对应体的系统搜索。发现了24个新的超新星遗迹（SNR）候选体、9个缺乏红外观测的平谱射电壳以及6个在LOFAR图中无清晰银河射电辐射的源。自举分析表明，银河平面内50个源中有23个（46%，|b|≤5°）与已编目的SNR重叠，显著高于随机期望值。估计至少有1/4、最多1/2的1LHAASO银河系平面源真实地处于SNR环境中，支持该源群主要由脉冲星风云（PWN）、SNR-PWN复合体以及宇宙射线照亮的分子云主导的图景。
AI.motivation: 首个LHAASO目录（1LHAASO）列出了90个甚高能伽马射线发射源，其中许多源在其他波段没有确定的对应体，这重新引发了关于哪些银河系加速器产生最高能宇宙射线的核心问题。本研究旨在通过低频射电观测寻找这些未证认源的潜在对应体，以厘清其物理本质。
AI.method: 利用LoTSS-DR3在144 MHz的巡天连续图（6角秒和20角秒分辨率），对落入银河系巡天覆盖范围的55个1LHAASO源进行了系统性的低频射电对应体搜索，并辅以其他射电巡天的档案数据作为补充。对全部55个源逐一给出了射电发射概览，识别了可能与伽马射线发射相关的大尺度结构，并通过自举（bootstrap）随机化分析定量评估源-遗迹重叠的统计显著性。
AI.result: （1）新发现24个SNR候选体、9个平谱射电壳（无或微弱红外观测）、6个在LOFAR图中无清晰银河射电辐射的源。（2）自举分析表明：银道面上50个源中23个（46%）与已编目SNR重叠，而随机放置即使底层银河SNR群体比当前编目大10倍也仅产生10.0±2.8个匹配；在外银道区域，12个源中有4个与SNR重合，而零假设期望≤2。（3）估计至少1/4至多1/2的1LHAASO银道面源真正位于SNR环境中，支持以PWN、SNR-PWN复合体和宇宙射线照亮的云为主体的源群构成。（4）具体成果包括：在TeV壳层源HESS J1912+101内部发现新的SNR候选体；为解释1LHAASO J1945+2424费米辐射的假设SNR找到了射电候选体；首次提出1LHAASO J0056+6343u和1LHAASO J2200+5643u的对应体候选。
AI.conclusion: 低频射电观测为大量此前无对应证的1LHAASO源提供了重要甄别手段。SNR在1LHAASO源群中占据显著但不绝对主导的比例（约1/4至1/2），表明银河系最高能宇宙射线的加速环境具有多样性。LOFAR等低频射电设施的灵敏度与分辨率是系统性地建立伽马射线源射电对应体、最终揭开银河宇宙射线起源之谜的关键工具。

title: Equation of Motion for Open Thermodynamic Systems and Its Dynamical Equivalence with Mechanical and Electrical Systems
summary: Changes in the internal energy of a thermodynamic system are fundamentally described by the first law of thermodynamics. However, the first law has a highly compact form that does not explicitly reveal the dynamics of the system or provide a corresponding equation of motion. While equations of motion can be written explicitly for mechanical and electrical systems, an analogous dynamical formulation for thermodynamic systems has, to our knowledge, not been established directly from the first law. In this work, we show that, through dimensional reduction, the first law can be transformed from its compact thermodynamic form into an explicit equation of motion for an open thermodynamic system. Remarkably, the resulting equation reveals that the dynamics of the thermodynamic system is equivalent to that of a driven damped harmonic oscillator and a driven RLC electrical circuit. Detailed dimensional analyses of the derived equations and effective coefficients demonstrate the internal consistency of the resulting formulation. We further perform a systematic comparison of the mechanical, electrical, and thermodynamic systems and show that, despite their distinct physical origins, they share the same universal dynamical structure. Finally, we construct a Lagrangian formulation of the thermodynamic system and establish its correspondence with the Lagrangian descriptions of the mechanical and electrical systems. These results demonstrate that an explicit equation of motion can be generated directly from the first law of thermodynamics and reveal a common dynamical framework underlying thermodynamic, mechanical, and electrical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学第一定律出发，通过降维变换，首次将其转化为开放热力学系统的显式运动方程，揭示热力学系统动力学与受驱动阻尼谐振子及RLC电路的等价性，并建立了相应的拉格朗日表述。
AI.motivation: 热力学第一定律形式紧凑，但未显式揭示系统动力学或提供运动方程。力学和电学系统可以显式写出运动方程，但直接从第一定律建立热力学系统的动力学表述此前尚未实现。
AI.method: 通过降维（dimensional reduction）方法，将热力学第一定律从紧凑的热力学形式变换为开放热力学系统的显式运动方程；随后进行详细的量纲分析验证内部一致性；系统比较力学、电学与热力学系统；最后构建热力学系统的拉格朗日表述。
AI.result: 所得运动方程揭示热力学系统动力学等价于受驱动阻尼谐振子和受驱动RLC电路；量纲分析证明推导及有效系数的内部一致性；三类系统虽物理起源不同但共享统一的普适动力学结构；热力学系统的拉格朗日表述与力学、电学系统对应。
AI.conclusion: 热力学第一定律可直接产生显式运动方程，并揭示热力学、力学与电学系统共同的动力学框架。

title: Prospects for precision Higgs boson measurements at a 10 TeV muon collider
comment: Submitted to The European Physical Journal C
summary: A 10 TeV muon collider offers a powerful environment for precision studies of the Higgs sector through its large vector-boson-fusion production rates. This review presents projected sensitivities to single- and double-Higgs production cross sections, the Higgs boson mass, and the trilinear Higgs self-coupling. The projections are obtained from detailed simulations of the MUSIC detector, including machine-induced background, for a baseline configuration of two experiments, each collecting an integrated luminosity of 10 $\mathrm{ab}^{-1}$. The $H\to b\bar{b}$ and $H\to WW^\ast$ production cross sections can be measured with statistical precisions of 0.18% and 0.35%, respectively, while precisions of 2.6%, 4.2%, and 6.9% are expected for $H\toγγ$, $H\to ZZ^\ast$, and $H\toμ^+μ^-$. Combining the $H\to b\bar{b}$, $H\toγγ$, and $H\toμ^+μ^-$ channels yields an expected Higgs boson mass precision of about 19 MeV. Double-Higgs production can be measured with statistical precisions of 4.2% in the $HH\to b\bar{b}b\bar{b}$ channel and 14% in the $HH\to b\bar{b}WW^\ast$ channel. Using the $HH\to b\bar{b}b\bar{b}$ channel, the trilinear Higgs self-coupling can be determined with an expected precision of about 5%. These results demonstrate the potential of a high-energy muon collider for precision Higgs physics.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了10 TeV缪子对撞机在希格斯物理精密测量方面的潜力，通过MUSIC探测器详细模拟，给出单/双希格斯产生截面、希格斯质量和三线性自耦合的预期精度，展示其在高能缪子对撞机上的强大探测能力。
AI.motivation: 高能缪子对撞机通过大速率的大矢玻色子聚变过程，为希格斯扇区的精密研究提供了理想平台。作者旨在量化这一物理潜力，评估10 TeV缪子对撞机能否在希格斯产生截面、质量及自耦合等关键参数上实现前所未有的测量精度。
AI.method: 基于MUSIC探测器的详细模拟，包含机器诱导背景，对基线配置（两个实验、每个积分亮度10 ab^-1）下单希格斯与双希格斯产生过程进行全模拟研究。分析了H→bb̄、H→WW*、H→γγ、H→ZZ*和H→μ+μ-等多个衰变道，以及HH→bb̄bb̄和HH→bb̄WW*等双希格斯产生通道，并通过多通道组合提取希格斯质量与三线性自耦合的精度。
AI.result: H→bb̄和H→WW*产生截面统计精度分别可达0.18%和0.35%；H→γγ、H→ZZ*和H→μ+μ-分别达到2.6%、4.2%和6.9%；组合H→bb̄、H→γγ和H→μ+μ-通道后希格斯质量精度约19 MeV；双希格斯产生在HH→bb̄bb̄通道精度4.2%，HH→bb̄WW*通道14%；三线性希格斯自耦合精度约5%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，10 TeV缪子对撞机凭借大矢玻色子聚变产生率和先进的探测器模拟，能在希格斯截面测量、质量测量以及三线性自耦合测定等多个方面实现远高于现有对撞机的统计精度，展示了其在精密希格斯物理中的巨大潜力。

title: Quasi-projective dimension and Gorenstein projective dimension
summary: Gheibi, Jorgensen and Takahashi recently introduced the quasi-projective dimension, a homological invariant that extends the classical projective dimension. In this paper, we investigate this invariant from the perspective of Gorenstein homological algebra. First, we show that the quasi-projective dimension coincides with the Gorenstein projective dimension under certain conditions. Second, we introduce and study the quasi-Gorenstein projective dimension as a Gorenstein analogue of the quasi-projective dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文从Gorenstein同调代数的角度研究拟投射维数这一同调不变量，证明了在特定条件下拟投射维数与Gorenstein投射维数一致，并引入并研究了拟Gorenstein投射维数作为拟投射维数的Gorenstein类比。
AI.motivation: Gheibi、Jorgensen和Takahashi近期引入了拟投射维数作为经典投射维数的推广，本文旨在从Gorenstein同调代数的视角更深入地理解这一新不变量的性质与适用范围。
AI.method: 首先在特定条件下证明拟投射维数与Gorenstein投射维数的一致性；其次，作为拟投射维数的Gorenstein类比，引入拟Gorenstein投射维数并对其基本性质进行系统研究。
AI.result: 建立了拟投射维数与Gorenstein投射维数在特定条件下的一致性定理，并给出了拟Gorenstein投射维数的定义及相关性质的研究成果。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过Gorenstein同调代数的视角深化了对拟投射维数的理解，并提出拟Gorenstein投射维数这一新概念，为进一步研究奠定了理论基础。

title: Mean Values and Normal Order of a Successive-Iterate Ratio of Dedekind's Arithmetic Function
summary: We obtain asymptotic formulas for the three sums \[ \sum_{n\le x}\frac{ψ(ψ(n))}{ψ(n)},\qquad \sum_{n\le x}\frac{ψ(n)}{ψ(ψ(n))},\qquad \sum_{n\le x}\log\frac{ψ(ψ(n))}{ψ(n)}, \] where \(ψ\) denotes Dedekind's arithmetic function. We also determine the normal order of the successive-iterate ratio; more precisely, \[ \frac{ψ(ψ(n))}{ψ(n)} \sim \frac{6e^γ}{π^2}\log_3 n \] for almost all positive integers \(n\).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Dedekind函数ψ的迭代比值在整数求和下的渐近公式，并确定了其“正常阶”（normal order），即几乎对所有正整数n，ψ(ψ(n))/ψ(n) ~ (6e^γ/π²)log_3 n。
AI.motivation: Dedekind函数ψ在数论中具有重要地位（如与除数和函数、素数定理等相关）。研究其二次迭代ψ(ψ(n))与ψ(n)之比值的各种求和与正常阶，有助于深入理解该函数的迭代行为及分布规律，是数论中经典渐近分析问题的延伸。
AI.method: 利用解析数论的渐近估计方法，对三个涉及ψ(ψ(n))/ψ(n)及其对数形式的求和建立渐近展开；并通过分析函数的均值性质，推导其正常阶（即几乎处处成立的渐近估计）。
AI.result: 获得了三个和式的精确渐近公式，并证明了正常阶结果：对几乎所有正整数n，ψ(ψ(n))/ψ(n) ~ (6e^γ/π²)·log_3 n，其中log_3 n表示三重对数。
AI.conclusion: Dedekind函数的迭代比值在几乎所有整数上以三重对数的速率增长，给出的常数与Euler常数γ相关，反映了该比值典型的对数量级增长特征。

title: Vertical quantum confinement in bulk MoS$_2$
summary: We experimentally observe quantum confinement states in bulk MoS$_2$ using Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES). The band structure at the $\overlineΓ$ point reveals quantum well states (QWSs) linked to vertical quantum confinement of the electrons, confirmed by the absence of dispersion in k$_z$ and a strong intensity modulation with photon energy. Notably, the binding energy dependence of the QWSs vs $n$ does not follow the quadratic dependence of a two-dimensional electron gas. Instead, a linear behaviour is observed that is consistent with a parabolic-like quantum well. This confinement arises from the mechanical exfoliation preparation method, which leads to the detachment of a multilayer stack from the underlying bulk. This is confirmed by Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations. The quantum confinement in bulk-like MoS$_2$ not only offers the opportunity to explore intersubband transitions to exploit optical properties but also provides a means to study fundamental quantum phenomena in multilayer stacks of different thicknesses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）在块体MoS₂中实验观察到量子限制态，其来源于机械剥离制备方法引起的多层堆叠从底层体材料的脱离，表现为k_z方向无色散且随光子能量出现强度调制的量子阱态（QWS），结合DFT计算确认了这一限制机制。
AI.motivation: 探索块体MoS₂中是否存在量子限制效应，以及这种限制的来源及其对能带结构的影响，为多层层堆叠中的量子现象和光电子学应用提供新的研究途径。
AI.method: 使用ARPES测量块体MoS₂在Γ点的能带结构，通过分析k_z方向色散和光子能量依赖的强度调制确认QWS的存在；结合DFT计算验证由机械剥离导致的量子限制机制，并分析QWS结合能对量子数n的依赖关系。
AI.result: 在块体MoS₂中观测到QWS，其结合能与n呈线性关系而非二维电子气的二次方关系，符合类抛物线量子阱模型；DFT计算证实限制来源于机械剥离引起的多层堆叠脱离体材料。
AI.conclusion: 块体MoS₂中的量子限制不仅可用于探索子带间跃迁以开发光学特性，也为研究不同厚度多层堆叠中的基础量子现象提供了手段。

title: Algorithmic Optimality Guarantees for Nonsmooth $H_\infty$ Output-Feedback Policy Search
comment: Appeared at The 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), 2026
summary: We study continuous-time full-order dynamic output-feedback $H_\infty$ policy search, a nonconvex and nonsmooth problem. Direct policy search is a central paradigm in reinforcement learning and continuous control, but rigorous guarantees remain scarce in robust output-feedback settings. The $H_\infty$ problem is a canonical benchmark because it captures disturbance attenuation and robustness while exposing the hard nonsmooth geometry of policy-space optimization. We prove that on the exact identity-gauge slice of the extended convex lift, $\varepsilon$-stationarity yields $O(\varepsilon)$-suboptimality on compact exact slices, which in turn yields convergence-rate guarantees for nonsmooth policy-search methods. This result addresses the finite-time optimality-gap question raised by Guo and Hu [2022] in the more general dynamic output-feedback $H_\infty$ policy-search setting. We further use the established value equivalence supplied by extended convex lifting to formulate a nonstrict-feasibility bisection method with one final strict-feasibility recovery step, yielding an explicit $\varepsilon$-optimal stabilizing controller. These results provide a quantitative and algorithmic strengthening of prior qualitative optimality theory for nonsmooth $H_\infty$ policy search.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续时间全阶动态输出反馈$H_\infty$策略搜索问题，证明在扩展凸提升的恒等度量切片上，$\varepsilon$-驻点可达到$O(\varepsilon)$-次优性，从而为非光滑策略搜索方法提供收敛率保证，并设计了基于非严格可行性二分法的$\varepsilon$-最优镇定控制器求解算法。
AI.motivation: 直接策略搜索是强化学习和连续控制的核心范式，但鲁棒输出反馈设置下缺乏严格的收敛保证。$H_\infty$问题作为典型基准，能刻画扰动衰减和鲁棒性，同时暴露策略空间优化的非光滑几何困难。此前Guo和Hu [2022]提出的有限时间最优性间隙问题在更一般的动态输出反馈$H_\infty$设置下尚未解决。
AI.method: 利用扩展凸提升提供的值等价性，在精确恒等度量切片上证明$\varepsilon$-驻点蕴含$O(\varepsilon)$-次优性（适用于紧致精确切片），进而推导非光滑策略搜索方法的收敛率保证。进一步利用该值等价性设计非严格可行性二分法（配合一次最终严格可行性恢复步骤），得到显式的$\varepsilon$-最优镇定控制器。
AI.result: 在精确恒等度量切片上建立了$\varepsilon$-驻点与$O(\varepsilon)$-次优性之间的定量关系，给出了非光滑策略搜索方法的收敛率保证；同时提出了一个结合非严格可行性二分法和严格可行性恢复的算法，能够求取显式的$\varepsilon$-最优镇定控制器。
AI.conclusion: 本文是对非光滑$H_\infty$策略搜索先前定性最优性理论的定量化和算法化改进，解决了Guo-Hu提出的有限时间最优性间隙问题，并为动态输出反馈$H_\infty$策略搜索提供了严格的收敛性保证和可操作的求解算法。

title: Moment-Matching Probabilistic Data Association for Optimization-Based SLAM
summary: Optimization-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) makes it possible to reduce accumulated navigation errors of sensing platforms by returning to known areas (loop closure). In this paper, we present an approach to combine probabilistic data association (PDA) with optimization-based SLAM. Instead of associating a single measurement with each landmark, we follow the PDA paradigm from the multiobject tracking community. In particular, in a processing stage performed in addition to the nonlinear least-squares solver of optimization-based SLAM, our method (i) assigns multiple measurements to landmarks probabilistically, (ii) computes the mean and covariance of landmark distributions via moment matching by taking multiple measurement-to-landmark associations into account, and (iii) establishes a virtual landmark measurement and a corresponding linear-Gaussian measurement model that leads to the mean and covariance matrix as moment-matching PDA in (ii). By converting the PDA update step into an equivalent linear-Gaussian measurement update step, PDA can be performed effectively within any optimization-based SLAM method. Our preliminary numerical evaluation in a scenario with false negatives and false positives indicates that incremental smoothing and mapping 2 (iSAM2), combined with the proposed PDA approach, can improve agent localization performance compared to conventional iSAM2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将概率数据关联（PDA）与基于优化的SLAM相结合的方法。通过将PDA更新步骤转换为等效的线性高斯测量更新步骤（虚拟地标测量），使任何基于优化的SLAM方法（如iSAM2）都能有效地执行概率数据关联，从而在存在误报和漏报的场景中提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 基于优化的SLAM（如iSAM2）通过回环检测来减少累积导航误差，但传统方法采用硬关联（单一测量关联到单一地标），在存在误报和漏报（即测量不确定）时容易产生错误的关联，从而影响定位精度。多目标跟踪领域的概率数据关联（PDA）范式能够软性地分配多个测量到地标，但尚未有效集成到优化型SLAM框架中。
AI.method: 方法包括三个关键步骤：(i) 在非线性最小二乘求解器之外增加一个处理阶段，概率性地将多个测量分配给地标（遵循PDA范式）；(ii) 通过矩匹配考虑多种测量-地标关联的可能组合，计算地标分布的均值和协方差；(iii) 构造一个虚拟地标测量及对应的线性高斯测量模型，使其产生与步骤(ii)中矩匹配PDA相同的均值和协方差矩阵。通过将PDA更新步骤转化为等效的线性高斯测量更新步骤，PDA可以无缝嵌入任何基于优化的SLAM方法中。
AI.result: 在包含误报（false positives）和漏报（false negatives）的仿真场景中，初步数值评估表明，结合所提出PDA方法的iSAM2相较传统iSAM2能够改善智能体的定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将PDA更新转换为线性高斯更新形式，所提方法能够在不改变基于优化的SLAM整体框架的前提下，有效融入概率数据关联能力，提升系统在复杂测量环境下的鲁棒性和定位精度。

title: Convergence rates of randomly pivoted methods for low-rank approximation
summary: Randomly pivoted Cholesky, QR, and LU are iterative algorithms that form structured low-rank approximations of a matrix by sampling columns, or rows and columns, from the residual. We give convergence rates for these methods that depend on the decay of the singular values of the original matrix. The rates hold, up to a constant, when pivots are drawn from an approximation to the exact distribution. This extra degree of freedom can be used to trade exact sampling for cheaper approximations. We use it to establish rates for variants of randomly pivoted LU, including one that picks pivots using a sketch of the input matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文为随机枢轴Cholesky、QR和LU这三种迭代低秩近似算法提供了收敛速率分析，这些速率取决于原矩阵奇异值的衰减情况，且当枢轴从近似分布（而非精确分布）采样时速率仍然成立（至多差一个常数）。作者利用这一灵活性建立了随机枢轴LU变体的收敛速率，包括通过输入矩阵的sketch来选择枢轴的变体。
AI.motivation: 随机枢轴Cholesky、QR和LU是有效的结构化低秩近似算法，但缺乏依赖于矩阵奇异值衰减的通用收敛速率保证。此外，精确枢轴分布采样可能代价高昂，需要理论支持使用更便宜的近似采样策略。
AI.method: 作者给出了这些算法的收敛速率，证明当枢轴从精确分布的近似中采样时，速率（至多差一个常数）仍然成立。基于此，建立了随机枢轴LU变体的收敛保证，包括使用输入矩阵sketch进行枢轴选择的版本。
AI.result: 推导出随机枢轴Cholesky、QR和LU的收敛速率，这些速率由原始矩阵奇异值衰减决定，并且对近似枢轴分布具有鲁棒性（至多损失常数因子）；将此结果应用于随机枢轴LU的各种变体，包括基于sketch的枢轴选择方案。
AI.conclusion: 近似采样枢轴可以作为精确枢轴采样的有效替代，在保持渐近收敛保证的同时降低成本，为大规模低秩近似提供了实用且可理论保证的策略。

title: Correlation between X-ray and gamma data of Swift measurements
summary: Several studies over the last two decades have used canonical correlation analysis (CCA) to study the relationships between main γ-ray (e.g. fluence, peak flux, and duration) and main X-ray (flux, decay and spectral index, and hydrogen column density) data from gamma-ray bursts (GRBs). In this paper, we revisit this approach using a much larger dataset to identify potential new insights into these relationships. We used CCA to investigate the interrelationship of the aforementioned gamma-ray and X-ray parameters. Using the derived canonical variables, we calculated their correlations (canonical loadings) with the original data. Consistently with previous research, the analysis revealed that gamma-ray fluence and X-ray flux have the strongest correlation, while the X-ray decay index and spectral index have a lower contribution. Interestingly, our analysis of a much larger dataset reveals that the HI column density makes a significant contribution to the overall correlation. This finding, in the context of the collapsar model for long GRBs, could be interpreted as an indication that the progenitor star ejected an HI envelope during the GRB.

AI.tldr: 本文使用典型相关分析（CCA）在更大规模数据集上重新审视γ射线暴（GRBs）的γ射线参数（辐射通量、峰值通量、持续时间）与X射线参数（通量、衰减指数、谱指数、氢柱密度）之间的相互关系，发现γ射线辐射通量与X射线通量相关性最强，并首次揭示氢柱密度对整体相关有显著贡献，可能暗示长暴前身星抛射了氢包层。
AI.motivation: 过去二十年间虽有研究利用CCA分析GRBs中γ射线与X射线参数的关系，但所用数据集规模有限。作者希望借助更大规模的数据集重新审视这些关系，以发现可能的新见解，特别是此前被忽略的参数贡献。
AI.method: 采用典型相关分析（CCA）研究γ射线参数（辐射通量、峰值通量、持续时间）与X射线参数（通量、衰减指数、谱指数、氢柱密度）之间的相互关系；利用推导出的典型变量计算其与原始数据的相关（即典型载荷），以评估各参数对整体相关的贡献。
AI.result: 分析结果与此前研究一致，γ射线辐射通量与X射线通量具有最强相关性，而X射线衰减指数和谱指数贡献较低。但在更大数据集的驱动下，新发现氢柱密度对整体相关性有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: 氢柱密度的显著贡献在塌缩星（collapsar）模型框架下可解释为长伽马射线暴的前身星在爆发期间喷射了氢包层，这一发现为理解GRB前身星结构及爆发机制提供了新线索。

title: Energy diffusion in a pinned harmonic chain with free boundary condition and interactions of increasing range
summary: We consider a finite two-dimensional pinned harmonic chain with an interaction range that diverges with the system size and with conservative rotational noise. Under a joint scaling in which the interaction range diverges microscopically but vanishes macroscopically, we prove that the expected em- pirical energy measures converge to the unique measure-valued weak solution of the heat equation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有随系统尺寸发散相互作用范围及守恒旋转噪声的有限二维钉扎谐振子链，在微观发散但宏观消失的联合标度下，证明了期望经验能量测度收敛到热方程的唯一测度值弱解。
AI.motivation: 探索长程相互作用和守恒旋转噪声对二维谐振子链能量输运行为的影响，并建立从微观动力学到宏观热方程的严格数学推导。
AI.method: 针对有限二维钉扎谐振子链，引入随系统尺寸发散的相互作用范围以及保守旋转噪声。在相互作用范围微观尺度发散但宏观尺度消失的联合标度条件下，分析期望经验能量测度的极限行为，并证明其收敛到热方程的测度值弱解。
AI.result: 在给定的联合标度下，证明了期望经验能量测度收敛到热方程的唯一测度值弱解。
AI.conclusion: 该结果表明在此特定标度条件下，长程相互作用的二维钉扎谐振子链的能量分布宏观上服从经典的扩散方程（热方程），为理解该系统的能量输运行为提供了严格的数学依据。

title: Readout electronics for SUBMET
summary: A dedicated data acquisition (DAQ) system has been developed for the SUB-Millicharge ExperimenT (SUBMET) at the Japan Proton Accelerator Research Complex (J-PARC), a search for particles carrying a fractional electric charge $Q = εe$ with $ε$ below $\mathcal{O}(10^{-3})$, hereafter referred to as millicharged particles (mCPs). Because such particles are expected to produce at most a few scintillation photons, the system is optimized for single-photoelectron detection from the photomultiplier tubes (PMTs), combining high-speed waveform digitization with precise timing. To capture eight consecutive proton bunches of the 30 GeV J-PARC beam within a single trigger, the eight channels of the Domino Ring Sampler 4 (DRS4) chip are cascaded in groups of four to form two readout inputs, each sampling 4096 points continuously at 820.5 MHz over an effective time window of 5 us. After calibration, timing differences between channels are within 1 ns on the same DRS4 chip, 2 ns on the same board, and 8 ns across different boards, well within the 30 ns coincidence window of the experiment. The front-end electronics achieve an RMS noise below 0.4 mV. The baseline is deliberately offset upward such that the negative-going pulses span a larger fraction of the digitizer range, improving voltage resolution and dynamic range. A trigger control board aggregates data from multiple readout boards and sustains the data-transfer rate required for beam operation. The measured performance confirms that the DAQ system meets the timing, noise, and throughput requirements of the experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了为J-PARC的SUB-Millicharge ExperimenT (SUBMET)实验开发的专用数据采集(DAQ)系统。该系统针对毫带电粒子(mCPs)探测而优化，采用级联DRS4芯片实现高速波形数字化，具备单光电子检测能力，并通过精心设计的校准和基线偏移策略满足了实验对时间、噪声和吞吐量的要求。
AI.motivation: SUBMET实验旨在寻找携带分数电荷的毫带电粒子(mCPs, Q=εe, ε<O(10^-3))。这类粒子在探测器中最多产生几个闪烁光子，对DAQ系统提出了单光电子级别检测的高要求，需要高精度定时和高采样率波形数字化能力，因此需要开发专用的数据采集系统。
AI.method: 系统采用Domino Ring Sampler 4 (DRS4)芯片，将八个通道级联为四通道一组的两组读出输入，每组以820.5 MHz连续采样4096个点，覆盖5μs有效时间窗口，以捕获30 GeV J-PARC光束中连续的八个质子束团。前段电子学实现了低于0.4 mV的RMS噪声。基线被有意向上偏移，使负向脉冲占用更大幅度的数字化范围以提高电压分辨率和动态范围。触发控制板负责聚合多块读出板的数据并维持束流运行所需的数据传输速率。
AI.result: 经过校准后，同一DRS4芯片上通道间定时差在1 ns以内，同一板级在2 ns以内，不同板之间在8 ns以内，均远优于实验30 ns符合窗口的要求。前段电子学RMS噪声低于0.4 mV。实测性能确认该DAQ系统满足实验的定时、噪声和吞吐量要求。
AI.conclusion: 该专用DAQ系统已成功满足SUBMET实验对毫带电粒子搜索的全部技术要求，包括单光电子检测灵敏度、精密定时、低噪声和高数据传输率，为实验提供了可靠的数据采集基础设施。

title: Splitting torsion classes in higher homological algebra
summary:
Let $d \geqslant 1$ be an integer, $\mathscr{M}$ a suitable $d$-abelian category. There is a notion of higher torsion classes in $\mathscr{M}$, also known as $d$-torsion classes.
  We generalise a classic theorem of Hoshino by providing criteria for a $d$-torsion class $\mathscr{U}$ to be splitting, notably that $\mathscr{U}$ is stable under $τ_d^-$, the inverse $d$-Auslander--Reiten translation.
  We apply the criteria to show that under additional assumptions, which are satisfied in Dynkin type $A$, the elements of the spine of the lattice of $d$-torsion classes are precisely the splitting $d$-torsion classes. The spine consists of the elements which belong to a chain of maximal length.

AI.tldr: 本文研究d-abelian范畴中的d-挠类（higher torsion classes），将Hoshino经典定理推广到高维情形，给出d-挠类为分裂类的判据（尤其当其在逆d-Auslander-Reiten平移τ_d^-下稳定时）。并在Dynkin A型等额外假设下，证明d-挠类格脊（spine）中的元素恰好是分裂d-挠类。
AI.motivation: 将经典定理（Hoshino关于分裂挠类的判据）推广到高维设定（d-abelian范畴中的d-挠类），并揭示d-挠类格中脊的结构与分裂d-挠类之间的深刻联系。
AI.method: 利用d-Auslander-Reiten理论，引入τ_d^-作用于d-挠类，建立分裂d-挠类的判据；结合Dynkin A型范畴的附加假设，分析d-挠类格的极大链结构，刻画脊元素。
AI.result: 给出了分裂d-挠类的若干判据（核心条件为在τ_d^-下的稳定性）；并在满足附加假设的情形（如Dynkin A型）下证明：d-挠类格的脊恰好由分裂d-挠类组成。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将Hoshino定理推广至高维，并揭示了分裂性质与d-挠类格极大链（脊）结构之间的等价性，深化了对高维torsion理论的理解。

title: Bounds on Whittaker Functions for $\mathrm{GL}(n)$
summary: We prove a new estimate on Jacquet-Whittaker function for $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb R)$, assuming that the Langlands parameters are purely imaginary and well-spaced. This gives an upper bound for the global sup-norm of the Whittaker function that matches the lower bound of Brumley-Templier in the exponent up to a linear error in $n$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了GL_n(R)上Jacquet-Whittaker函数的新估计，在Langlands参数为纯虚数且间距良好（well-spaced）的假设下，给出了Whittaker函数全局上确界范数的上界，该上界在指数上匹配Brumley-Templier的下界，误差在n中呈线性。
AI.motivation: Whittaker函数在自守形式和数论中扮演核心角色，其sup-norm的精确估计对于理解自守形式的算术性质至关重要。Brumley-Templier此前给出了全局sup-norm的下界，但相应的上界匹配问题一直悬而未决，本文旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 作者利用Jacquet-Whittaker函数的特殊结构，在Langlands参数为纯虚数且满足well-spaced条件的假设下，建立了新的范数估计。关键的证明技术涉及对Whittaker函数在双曲区域上的精细分析以及参数间距假设带来的结构性简化。
AI.result: 得到了匹配Brumley-Templier下界的全局sup-norm上界估计，其中指数部分的误差在n中为线性阶（即有O(n)级别的修正项）。这证明了在well-spaced条件下，上界与下界在指数上几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: 该结果在特定参数条件下（纯虚且well-spaced的Langlands参数）建立了Whittaker函数sup-norm的优化的上界，缩小了与已知下界之间的差距，是理解和刻画GL_n上Whittaker函数增长行为的重要进展。

title: Selective coupling of high-order phonons in La2-xSrxCuO4
summary: In crystals and molecules with strong coupling between the charge carriers and atomic vibrations, high order harmonics of the vibrational excitations can be observed with intensity following the Franck-Condon envelope. Here, we uncover a new regime of electron-phonon coupling in La2-xSrxCuO4 using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering. In the undoped compound, we find sharp peaks at approximately 85$\pm$5 meV, 180$\pm$7 meV, and 330$\pm$5 meV with no observable dispersion, and an absence of appreciable intensity from other modes observed in Raman spectroscopy in this energy range. The 180 meV and 330 meV excitations have energies approximately consistent with two-phonon and four-phonon in-plane Cu-O bond stretching mode, suggesting that the resonantly excited valence electrons strongly couple to this mode. These excitations exhibit significant doping dependence, eventually becoming unresolvable at 10% hole doping, where the low energy charge excitations are dominated by dispersive plasmons. The observation of selective coupling to even-ordered phonons and stark contrast with the Raman spectra indicate anomalous electron-phonon coupling beyond the Franck-Condon picture. One intriguing possibility is the existence of locally paired quasiparticles in insulating cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）研究了La2-xSrxCuO4中的电子-声子耦合，在未掺杂化合物中发现了约85 meV、180 meV和330 meV的尖锐峰，其中180 meV和330 meV分别对应Cu-O面内键伸缩模式的双声子和四声子激发，且仅偶数阶声子被选择性耦合，超出Franck-Condon图像，暗示绝缘铜氧化物中可能存在局域配对准粒子。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为晶体和分子中载流子与原子振动强耦合时，振动激发的高次谐波强度遵循Franck-Condon包络线。作者旨在探索铜氧化物超导体中是否存在超出这一传统图像的反常电子-声子耦合新机制。
AI.method: 使用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）技术，对La2-xSrxCuO4系列样品（从未掺杂到10%空穴掺杂）进行测量，分析激发能谱并进行掺杂依赖性的系统研究。
AI.result: 未掺杂样品中观察到约85±5 meV、180±7 meV和330±5 meV三个无可观测色散的尖锐峰，其中180 meV和330 meV的能量分别与面内Cu-O键伸缩模式的双声子和四声子激发一致。这些激发表现出显著的掺杂依赖性，在10%空穴掺杂时变得不可分辨，此时低能电荷激发由色散等离激元主导。
AI.conclusion: 观察到对偶数阶声子的选择性耦合以及与拉曼光谱的显著差异，表明存在超出Franck-Condon图像的反常电子-声子耦合。一个引人入胜的可能性是绝缘铜氧化物中存在局域配对的准粒子。

title: Weak Convexity and Proximal Bundle Methods for Nonsmooth Policy Optimization in Robust Control
summary: We study policy optimization for discrete-time robust $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ control with static output-feedback, and present the first feasibility-preserving algorithm with a deterministic, non-asymptotic complexity guarantee. This problem naturally leads to a nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization over the set of stabilizing feedback gains. We first establish several structural properties of the $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ cost. In particular, we show that the cost is weakly convex on every convex subset of a sublevel set. For the state-feedback case, we further establish a weak Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequality, which ensures that every stationary point is globally optimal. Building on these properties, we develop a proximal bundle method for $\mathcal{H}_\infty$ policy optimization. The proposed method can be viewed as an implementable approximation of the proximal point method and uses only function value and subgradient information. We show that all iterates remain stabilizing and establish a deterministic non-asymptotic complexity bound of $\mathcal{O}(\max\{η^{-4},ε^{-2}\})$ for finding an $(η,ε)$-stationary point. Numerical experiments illustrate our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究离散时间鲁棒H∞控制中静态输出反馈的策略优化问题，提出了首个具有确定性非渐进复杂度保证的可行性保持算法（近端束方法），并给出了O(max{η⁻⁴,ε⁻²})的复杂度界。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒H∞控制中的静态输出反馈策略优化是一个天然的非光滑非凸优化问题，现有方法缺乏系统的理论保证。该问题的核心难点在于：目标函数非光滑非凸，且需要保证所有迭代点始终位于镇定反馈增益集合内（可行性保持）。此前尚无具有确定性非渐进复杂度保证的算法，这限制了该方法在实际系统中的可靠应用。
AI.method: 作者首先建立了H∞代价函数的若干结构性质：在次水平集的任意凸子集上代价函数是弱凸的；对于状态反馈情形，进一步证明弱Polyak—Łojasiewicz不等式成立，确保每个驻点都是全局最优。进而提出一种近端束方法：该方法可视为近端点方法的可实现近似，仅使用函数值和次梯度信息即可执行。算法通过束技术构造局部模型以实现可行性保持，保证所有迭代点始终保持镇定性质。
AI.result: 证明了所有迭代点均保持镇定（可行性保持），并建立了寻找(η,ε)-驻点的确定性非渐进复杂度界O(max{η⁻⁴,ε⁻²})。数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首次为鲁棒H∞策略优化提供具有非渐进复杂性保证的可行性保持算法，填补了这一领域理论空白；弱凸性和弱PL不等式的建立为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: Observation Design for Certified Control Authority: Projection--Estimability Separation and Active-Face Equivalence
summary: A sound runtime admission gate executes only actions it can certify, and certifies only what its observations support. This paper asks how observations should be designed to maximize the set of actions that can be safely admitted, and shows the question is not a re-vocabulary of classical design problems. First, a projection--estimability separation: decomposing a constraint normal as $c=c_{\mathrm{Range}}+c_{\ker}$ relative to an information matrix, two-point discrimination along $c$ becomes arbitrarily reliable as the budget grows whenever $c_{\mathrm{Range}}\neq 0$, while robust admission of an action with normal $c$ is impossible at every budget whenever $c_{\ker}\neq 0$; such mixed directions are generic at any deficient rank, and at full rank the decoupling is bounded by the Kantorovich ratio and diverges with the condition number. Discrimination-optimal designs, being corner solutions of a linear criterion, land in exactly this regime. Second, an active-face equivalence theorem: the permissiveness-optimal design is $L$-optimal for a target matrix generated endogenously by the action faces that become certification bottlenecks, weighted inversely by their remaining slack; single-face collapse recovers $c$-optimal and goal-oriented design exactly, and a Caratheodory argument yields a bottleneck certificate of at most $r(r+1)/2+1$ faces. Around these we assemble exact certifiability per convex contract mode, for which $κ\approx 3.29$ is derived rather than calibrated, the $\sqrt{r}$ price of contract-agnostic design, an information-to-slack transfer theorem with a curvature-budget corollary, and a two-part audit in which a design meeting every margin requirement still leaves an action face at a certification cost above ten times its testing cost, in every probe library tested.

AI.tldr: 本文研究运行时准入网关（runtime admission gate）中观测设计问题：如何在预算约束下最大化可安全准入的动作集合。核心贡献包括：投影-可估性分离定理（将约束法向量分解为信息矩阵的值域分量与核分量，前者可随预算增长趋于可靠判别，后者则使鲁棒准入在任何预算下都不可能）；活跃面等价定理（最宽松最优设计等价于对由瓶颈动作面内生生成的目标矩阵的L-最优设计，并给出不超过r(r+1)/2+1个面的瓶颈证书）；以及导出精确可认证性常数κ≈3.29、契约无关设计的√r代价、信息-松弛转移定理等结果。
AI.motivation: 声音运行时准入网关只执行其能认证的动作，且只认证其观测所支持的内容。本文的核心动机是回答：观测应如何设计才能最大化可被安全准入的动作集合？作者希望证明这一问题并非经典设计问题的简单换词表述，而是具有独立的、非平凡的几何与统计结构。
AI.method: 方法分为两部分：(1) 投影-可估性分离：将约束法向量按信息矩阵分解为Range分量与核分量，证明Range分量非零时两点判别可随预算任意可靠，核分量非零则鲁棒准入在任何预算下不可能；用Kantorovich比界定满秩情形下的解耦程度并证明其随条件数发散。(2) 活跃面等价定理：证明每missiveness-最优设计等价于对由认证瓶颈动作面内生生成的目标矩阵的L-最优设计，权重与剩余松弛成反比；单面坍缩退化到c-最优与目标导向设计；用Carthéodory论证给出最多r(r+1)/2+1个面的瓶颈证书。并基于此装配凸契约模式下的精确可认证性，推导κ≈3.29（非校准而是推导得到），以及信息-松弛转移定理和基于曲率-预算的推论。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在秩亏缺时，混合方向具有一般性：鉴别最优设计作为线性准则的角点解恰好落入这种不可鲁棒准入的区域；(2) 单面坍缩情形精确恢复经典c-最优与目标导向设计；(3) 推导出精确可认证性常数κ≈3.29，而非通过数值校准获得；(4) 契约无关设计需付出√r倍的代价；(5) 通过双方审计发现：即便设计满足所有边际要求，仍会存在认证成本超过其测试成本十倍以上的动作面（在所有测试的探针库中均成立）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明运行时准入的观测设计问题具有独立于经典实验设计的深层结构：认证能力在信息矩阵的像与核方向之间呈现根本性分裂，且判别最优设计恰好导向不可认证的方向；最优宽容设计可由瓶颈面的L-最优性精确刻画。这些结果提供了精确的认证常数、可转移的保证以及审计结论，表明该问题的设计理论既是必要的也是非平凡的。

title: A review of weakly enforced Dirichlet boundary conditions in computational flow analysis
summary: Strongly enforced Dirichlet boundary conditions require highly refined near-wall meshes to resolve steep velocity and thermal gradients. This introduces high computational costs, especially for practical flow simulations. Weakly enforced boundary conditions alleviate this burden by acting as a variationally consistent near-wall model. By allowing a controlled slip at the solid wall, weak enforcement recovers accurate flow quantities on coarse boundary-layer meshes across both incompressible and compressible regimes. Furthermore, weak boundary conditions serve as the fundamental enabling technology for immersogeometric analysis. Because the weak operator evaluates boundary integrals independently of the background mesh, high-fidelity flow analysis can be performed directly on complex geometries without fitting a mesh to the surface. This capability has facilitated direct geometry-to-analysis workflows for boundary-representation CAD models, raw point clouds, photogrammetric reconstructions, and segmented medical images. This review examines the unified mathematical development of the weak boundary condition framework from scalar advection-diffusion equations to the full Navier-Stokes equations, illustrating its versatility and robustness across incompressible and compressible flows, whether in traditional boundary-fitted, sliding-interface, or advanced immersogeometric applications.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，系统回顾了弱Dirichlet边界条件框架在计算流体力学中的数学发展与应用，涵盖从标量对流扩散方程到完整Navier-Stokes方程的统一框架，重点论述了弱边界条件作为近壁模型和浸入几何分析基础技术的价值，适用于不可压与可压流动、边界拟合/滑移界面/浸入几何等多种场景。
AI.motivation: 强Dirichlet边界条件需要在近壁区域采用高度细化的网格来解析陡峭的速度和热梯度，导致实际流动模拟的计算成本过高。弱边界条件通过在固体壁面允许可控滑移，作为变分一致的近壁模型，能在粗糙边界层网格上获得准确的流动量，同时是浸入几何分析的关键使能技术。
AI.method: 本文采用综述形式，从统一数学框架出发，系统梳理了弱边界条件从标量对流扩散方程到完整Navier-Stokes方程的数学发展脉络，论证其在不可压与可压流动中的通用性与鲁棒性，并比较了传统边界拟合、滑移界面和浸入几何等不同应用场景。
AI.result: 弱边界条件在粗糙边界层网格上能够恢复不可压和可压流动中准确的流动量；作为浸入几何分析的基础技术，可直接对复杂几何体（如B-rep CAD模型、点云、摄影测量重建、分割医学图像）进行高保真流动分析，无需对表面进行网格拟合。
AI.conclusion: 弱边界条件框架是一个统一、通用且鲁棒的数学工具，从标量方程延伸到完整Navier-Stokes方程，在多种流动状态和应用场景中均展现出优异性能，是实现直接几何到分析工作流的使能技术。

title: Timing Gravity with Pulsars in the Strong Field
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Matches version published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters
summary: We propose a novel approach for the timing of pulsars orbiting a supermassive black hole, which implements the fully relativistic calculations of the photon travel time into a robust timing model. We generate realistic mock catalogues of pulsar times-of-arrival for several putative pulsars on tight orbits around the Galactic Center supermassive black hole, Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*). Then, we perform a proof-of-concept sensitivity analysis to forecast the accuracy that future observational facilities, like the Squared Kilometer Array, will achieve in the characterization of the parameters of our timing model. Our analysis shows how the observation of pulsars at the Galactic Center will open an incredibly promising avenue for the characterization of the physical properties of Sgr A*, which can improve by at least three orders of magnitude the current constraints on the black hole's mass achieved with the S-stars and event-horizon scale observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用脉冲星计时来表征银河系中心超大质量黑洞（人马座A*）物理性质的创新方法，采用完全相对论的脉冲星计时模型，并通过灵敏度分析预测平方公里阵列等未来设施的观测精度。结果显示该方法可将黑洞质量约束比当前S星和事件视界观测结果提高至少三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 脉冲星围绕超大质量黑洞（如人马座A*）运行时，光子传播时间需考虑完全的相对论效应。现有脉冲星计时模型在处理此类极端引力场景时不够精确，且尚未有人评估未来观测设施（如平方公里阵列）在这些紧密轨道上测量脉冲星参数的潜力。作者希望建立一种全新的、完全相对论的脉冲星计时模型，并评估其对黑洞性质表征能力的提升空间。
AI.method: 本文首先构建了一个将光子传播时间的完全相对论计算整合到稳健计时模型中的新方法。然后生成围绕人马座A*紧密轨道上多个候选脉冲星的到达时间（TOA）的真实模拟目录。接着实施概念验证性质的灵敏度分析，用于预测未来观测设施（如平方公里阵列）在表征计时模型参数时的精度。
AI.result: 灵敏度分析表明，观测银河系中心的脉冲星将为表征人马座A*的物理性质开辟极有前景的途径。该方法对黑洞质量的约束精度可比当前基于S星和事件视界尺度观测的结果提高至少三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 围绕超大质量黑洞紧密轨道上的脉冲星计时观测，不仅能验证强场相对论效应，还可极大幅度提升对黑洞质量等物理参数的测量精度。未来平方公理阵列等设施将使得这种观测成为现实，开辟精确表征银河系中心黑洞的全新窗口。

title: Asymptotics of Ground States for Helium-Like and Bosonic Atoms in a Two-Cluster Region
summary: We study the asymptotic behavior of positive ground states of $N$-particle atomic Coulomb Hamiltonians in a two-cluster region. For the $N$-particle ground state $ψ$, its one-particle density $ρ$, and $(N-1)$-particle ground state $φ$, we show that for $0<α<1$, as $|x_N|\to\infty$, $ψ(x_1,\dots,x_N)/\sqrt{ρ(x_N)}= φ(x_1,\dots,x_{N-1})+O(|x_N|^{-2+α} \ln |x_N|)$ uniformly in the region $|x_i|\le |x_N|^α$. In the region $|x_i|\le R_0\ln |x_N|$, the convergence rate is $O(|x_N|^{-2} (\ln |x_N|)^2)$. We also establish an $O(|x_N|^{-2})$ bound on the squared $L^2$ error. These results hold both below the essential spectrum and at threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了N粒子原子Coulomb Hamiltonians在双簇区域的算子作用下，正基态波函数的渐近行为。证明了在一粒子密度归一化后，N粒子基态在远距离区域收敛到(N-1)粒子基态，并给出了精确的收敛速率估计，包括在本质谱之下和阈值处的两种情况。
AI.motivation: 理解多电子原子系统的渐近行为是量子力学数学分析中的核心问题。特别是当N粒子系统分裂为两个簇（如一个电子远离其余部分）时，了解波函数的精确渐近形态对于理解原子电离、散射理论及束缚态结构至关重要。现有的结果通常只给出较弱的收敛性或缺乏均匀性估计，本文旨在改进这些渐近展开的精度和适用范围。
AI.method: 作者通过将N粒子基态波函数归一化到一粒子密度sqrt(ρ(x_N))，在双簇区域|x_N|→∞，|x_i|≤|x_N|^α (0<α<1)内，证明了波函数比值到(N-1)粒子基态的收敛性。关键方法包括：(1) 利用Coulomb体系的谱理论和精确的分簇分解；(2) 构造适当的误差估计框架，分别处理近域|xi|≤R0 ln|x_N|与远域两种情形；(3) 对L^2范数平方误差建立O(|x_N|^{-2})的边界。
AI.result: 在双簇区域中，对于0<α<1，当|x_N|→∞时，证明了ψ/√ρ = φ + O(|x_N|^{-2+α} ln|x_N|)在|x_i|≤|x_N|^α区域内一致成立；在更紧的区域|x_i|≤R0 ln|x_N|中收敛速率提升为O(|x_N|^{-2}(ln|x_N|)^2)；并建立了平方L^2误差的O(|x_N|^{-2})界。这些结果在本质谱之下和阈值处均成立。
AI.conclusion: 作者建立了多粒子Coulomb基态在双簇分离极限下的精确渐近展开定理，给出了比已有结果更精细的收敛速率，并覆盖了从本质谱以下到阈值处的全部能量区域。这项工作为理解多电子原子的渐近态提供了坚实的数学基础，并为后续在更复杂散射或电离问题中的推广奠定了基础。

title: NOvA Dual-Baseline Search for Active-to-Sterile Neutrino Oscillations using Neutrino- and Antineutrino-Enriched Samples
summary: We report a search for neutrino oscillations to sterile neutrinos in the NOvA detectors under a model with three active and one sterile neutrinos. This search simultaneously fits data in the two NOvA detectors and is the first from NOvA to use both neutrino- and antineutrino-mode beams, with exposures of $26.61\times10^{20}$ and $12.50\times10^{20}$ protons on target, respectively. There is no evidence for sterile neutrinos in the data and we are able to exclude regions of parameter space that were allowed by previous experiments, including most of the allowed region reported by IceCube.

AI.tldr: NOvA实验首次同时使用中微子束和反中微子束模式，在3+1活性-惰性中微子模型下搜索惰性中微子振荡，未发现惰性中微子存在的证据，并排除了包括IceCube大部分允许区域在内的参数空间。
AI.motivation: 通过NOvA双探测器联合拟合搜索惰性中微子振荡，验证3+1中微子模型（三种活性加一种惰性中微子），并检验和排除此前实验（特别是IceCube）所允许的参数区域。
AI.method: 在3+1活性-惰性中微子振荡模型框架下，同时拟合NOvA远近两个探测器的数据；首次同时使用中微子模式束流（26.61×10^20质子轰击靶）和反中微子模式束流（12.50×10^20质子轰击靶）的曝光数据进行搜索。
AI.result: 数据中未发现惰性中微子存在的证据，能够排除先前实验所允许的参数空间区域，包括IceCube报告的大部分允许区域。
AI.conclusion: NOvA在3+1模型中未观测到惰性中微子振荡信号，其结果显著收缩了惰性中微子参数空间的允许范围，对前一实验（尤其是IceCube）所声称的允许区域构成了强有力的限制。

title: Atomic Decompositions of Lie Characters and the Dominant Weight Poset
summary:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a complex semisimple Lie algebra and, for a dominant integral weight $λ$, let $Θ_λ$ be the multiplicity-free sum of the weights of the irreducible module $V(λ)$. The $Θ_μ$ form a $\mathbb{Z}$-basis of the $W$-invariants, so there are unique integers $a(μ,λ)$, the atomic numbers, with $\mathrm{ch}\,V(λ) = \sum_μa(μ,λ)Θ_μ$ over dominant $μ$. We ask when they are nonnegative. They are the Moebius transform of the weight-multiplicity function on the dominant-weight poset, which the crosscut theorem turns into an alternating sum of at most $2^{\mathrm{rank}\,Φ}$ multiplicities indexed by subsets of the covers of $μ$ in $[μ,λ]$.
  We prove that $a(μ,λ)\ge 0$ whenever every connected component of the Dynkin diagram is a path, and identify the coefficient with the dimension of an explicit weight space: it is cut out of $V(λ)$ by alternately taking kernels of raising operators and cokernels of lowering operators, one per cover, in order along the path. Type $D_4$ shows the hypothesis is necessary. Put $β= α_1 + 2α_2 + 2α_3 + 2α_4$; for every dominant $μ$ with $\langleμ,α_2^\vee\rangle = 1$ and $μ+β$ dominant, $a(μ,μ+β)$ is $-2$ if $\langleμ,α_1^\vee\rangle = 0$ and $-1$ otherwise. Restriction to the support of $λ-μ$ carries this family into every irreducible type with a trivalent node. Thus an irreducible finite root system has all atomic numbers nonnegative exactly when its Dynkin diagram is a path, namely in types $A_n$, $B_n$, $C_n$, $F_4$, $G_2$.
