  Deep in the dominant chamber, in an explicit range, $a(μ,λ)$ is the Kostant partition number of $λ-μ$ for the nonsimple positive roots; negative atomic numbers are therefore confined to boundary slabs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究复半单李代数中不可约模特征标的"原子数"(atomic numbers) a(µ,λ)的非负性问题。证明当Dynkin图为路径图(即类型A_n,B_n,C_n,F_4,G_2)时所有原子数非负，并将其等同于显式权空间的维数(沿路径依次取升高算子核与降低算子余核)。类型D_4的反例表明路径图假设是必要的，并给出负系数的精确值族(family)；由限制到支撑集，该族可转移到任何具有三叉节点的不可约类型。因此不可约有限根系的所有原子数非负当且仅当其Dynkin图是路径。在优室深层显式范围内，原子数等于非单正根的Kostant配分数，负数仅出现在边界层内。
AI.motivation: 权重多重集Θ_λ构成W-不变量的Z-基，由此定义唯一整数a(µ,λ)(原子数)使得特征标可用其线性组合表示。核心动机是判定这些原子数何时非负，从而获得特征标的非负(或组合)分解解释，并揭示原子数与幂零上同调/权空间结构的关系。
AI.method: 借助交叉截定理(crosscut theorem)将原子数表示为最多2^{rank}个权多重度(索引为µ在[µ,λ]中覆盖的子集)的交替和。随后对路径状Dynkin图，通过沿路径依次取升高算子的核与降低算子的余核构造显式权空间，证明其维数恰等于原子数进而非负。对D_4提出精确的计算公式，证明负性，并通过限制(restriction)到支撑集将反例族传递到所有含三叉节点的不可约类型。深处优室则由Kostant配分数刻画。
AI.result: (1) 当Dynkin图每个连通分支是路径时(即A_n,B_n,C_n,F_4,G_2)，a(µ,λ)≥0且等于特定显式权空间的维数。(2) 类型D_4中构造一族a(µ,µ+β)取-2或-1，证明路径假设必要；限制到支撑集将该族推广至所有含三叉节点的不可约类型，因此不可约类型全部原子数非负当且仅当图为路径。(3) 优室深层显式范围内a(µ,λ)等于非单正根的Kostant配分数，负原子数仅限边界平层。
AI.conclusion: 原子数的非负性完全由Dynkin图是否为路径决定：路径图给出显式的权空间维数解释(组合正性)，含有三叉节点的类型必出现负原子数且由D_4反例族经限制得到，负性在边界附近最为明显，深层优室则为Kostant配分数。这给出了该问题的完整分类。

title: Fields of definition of $p$-torsion points of elliptic curves and their ramification
summary: Let $E$ be an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We study the field $\mathbb{Q}_p(E[p])$ generated by the $p$-torsion points of $E$. When $E$ has good reduction, we determine not only $\mathbb{Q}_p(E[p])$ but also the field $\mathbb{Q}_p(P)$ for every point $P\in E[p]$. This classification yields criteria for the existence of $p$-torsion over unramified and Lubin--Tate extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$. As a global application, let $E/\mathbb{Q}$ be an elliptic curve and let $p$ be an odd prime of good reduction. Define $f_p(E)$ to be the multiplicative order of $a_p(E)$ modulo $p$ in the ordinary case, and set $f_p(E)=p^2-1$ in the supersingular case. We prove that $E(K)[p]=0$ for every number field $K/\mathbb{Q}$ with $[K:\mathbb{Q}]<f_p(E)$. When $E$ has bad reduction, we describe the ramified part of $\mathbb{Q}_p(E[p])/\mathbb{Q}_p$. For every reduction type, we determine the maximal upper ramification break of $\mathbb{Q}_p(E[p])/\mathbb{Q}_p$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究椭圆曲线E在p-adic局部域Q_p上的p-挠点生成的域Q_p(E[p])。对于具有良约化的椭圆曲线，作者不仅完全分类了Q_p(E[p])，还确定了每个p-挠点P生成的域Q_p(P)；对于坏约化情形，则刻画了Q_p(E[p])/Q_p的歧化部分，并在所有约化类型下确定了其最大上歧化断裂值。作为全局应用，作者证明了当Q上的椭圆曲线在奇素数p处具有良约化时，若数域K的度数小于某个由a_p(E)定义的函数f_p(E)，则E(K)[p]=0。
AI.motivation: 理解椭圆曲线p-挠点生成域的结构是数论中的基本问题，对于局部域上的Galois表示、全局域上的挠点消没定理以及Iwasawa理论等都有重要意义。已有的分类往往只给出同构类信息，而本文希望精确确定这些域本身，并利用约化类型信息（良约化/坏约化）获得更细致的描述，从而推广和改进全局数域上p-挠点消没的经典结果。
AI.method: 本文采用p-adic局部域理论中的工具，特别是利用p-可分群方案、p-可除群以及Lubin-Tate形式群理论。对于良约化情形，利用约化到有限域上椭圆曲线的结构（包括短Weierstrass模型上的filtration）对E[p]的每个点进行分类，结合正规基和Lubin-Tate扩展的理论确定每个Q_p(P)具体是什么域。对于坏约化情形，利用Tate曲线或分裂乘性约化的分类来描述歧化部分，并通过计算Galois群的惯性子群作用来确定最大上歧化断裂。全局应用部分通过局部-全局原理，将局部域上的p-挠点消没结果提升到任意数域的p-挠点消没。
AI.result: 1) 对于具良约化的E/Q_p，给出E[p]中每个点生成域的完整分类，进而给出p-挠点是否包含在非歧化扩展和Lubin-Tate扩展中的判定准则。2) 全局方面，证明了对任何数域K/Q满足[K:Q]<f_p(E)时有E(K)[p]=0，其中f_p(E)在ordinary情形为a_p(E)模p的乘法阶，在supersingular情形为p^2-1；该结果推广了已知的关于K=Q时的结论。3) 对于坏约化情形，描述了Q_p(E[p])/Q_p的歧化部分结构，并在所有约化类型下确定了最大上歧化断裂值。
AI.conclusion: 本文对p-adic局部域上椭圆曲线p-挠点生成域给出了系统而完整的描述，同时涵盖了良约化与坏约化的所有情形。在良约化情形下完全突破了以往仅确定同构类的局限性，精确刻画了每个挠点生成的域；在全局应用中给出一个简洁而强力的p-挠点消没判据；在坏约化情形下通过确定歧化断裂值加深了对惯性作用的理解。这些结果对进一步研究Galois表示、局部丰田理论以及模形式的p-adic性质均有潜在价值。

title: Textures as a phase-transition probe for quantum spin chains
summary: The idea of quantum texture has been recently proposed and used as a tool for quantifying coherences and for quantum gate identification. In this work we offer a study on its usage to quantum phase transitions, demonstrating the rugosity metric as a simple tool for effective phase-transition probing. We establish the link between rugosity in the computational basis and the hierarchy of spin correlators, and analyze rugosities defined in the global ground-state and in ground-states belonging to different magnetization sectors (to which we refer to as global vs symmetry-resolved rugosities) to study the phase diagram of the Heisenberg XXZ model. We find distinct rugosity signatures at both transition points. In particular, a sharp feature appears at $Δ=1$ already for small systems, revealing a pronounced sensitivity of the correlation hierarchy encoded by the texture to this point. Since the BKT transition coincides with the isotropic $SU(2)$ point of the XXZ model, this behavior may reflect a particular sensitivity of rugosity to the structure of the spin-correlation hierarchy at isotropy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子纹理（quantum texture）及其粗糙度（rugosity）指标在探测量子相变中的用途，以海森堡XXZ模型的相图为例，发现全局与对称性分辨的粗糙度在两个相变点均呈现独特特征，尤其在Δ=1处出现尖锐信号，可反映各向同性点处自旋关联层次结构的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 量子纹理最近被提出并用于量子相干性量化和量子门识别，但尚未被系统研究其在量子相变探测中的应用。作者希望探索粗糙度指标是否能作为探测量子相变的简单有效工具。
AI.method: 建立计算基下粗糙度与自旋关联函数层次结构之间的联系；定义全局（global）与对称性分辨（symmetry-resolved）两种粗糙度，分别基于全局基态和不同磁化扇区的基态；将其应用于海森堡XXZ模型的相图分析。
AI.result: 在两个相变点处观察到了不同的粗糙度特征。特别地，在Δ=1处即使对于小系统也出现尖锐的特征，表明纹理编码的关联层次结构对此点具有显著敏感性。由于BKT相变与XXZ模型的各向同性SU(2)点重合，这种行为可能反映了粗糙度对各向同性处自旋关联层次结构的高度敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙度指标可以作为探测量子相变的一种简单而有效的工具，尤其是在BKT相变点等使用传统序参量难以探测的情况下，其敏感性来源于量子纹理对自旋关联层次结构在特殊对称性点处的结构化响应。

title: Quantitative comparison of closed- and open-loop linear-quadratic $N$-player differential games
summary: We compare closed-loop and open-loop Nash equilibria in a finite-horizon stochastic linear-quadratic $N$-player game with decoupled state dynamics and interaction through the state costs. We introduce a block-diagonal reference game and a nearby perturbed game, and study each under both information structures. The closed-loop and open-loop problems lead to different Riccati systems, but for the reference game their induced equilibrium state and control processes coincide exactly. We then prove solvability and stability under weak perturbations of the state costs, yielding quantitative bounds between the corresponding equilibria. In particular, when the perturbation decreases sufficiently fast with the population size, the closed-loop and open-loop equilibria of the perturbed game become asymptotically equivalent. The comparison is carried out directly at the finite-player level, without requiring exchangeability or a mean-field limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限时域随机线性二次N人博弈中闭环Nash均衡与开环Nash均衡的比较问题，通过引入分块对角参考博弈及邻近扰动博弈，证明了两类信息结构下均衡的渐近等价性，且无需交换性或平均场极限假设。
AI.motivation: 在多人随机线性二次博弈中，闭环（closed-loop）与开环（open-loop）Nash均衡通常对应不同的Riccati方程系统，导致均衡状态与控制过程存在差异。如何在有限博弈者层面直接量化这种差异并建立两者之间的等价性条件，是一个尚未充分解决的基础理论问题。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个具有解耦状态动力学且仅通过状态成本相互作用的分块对角参考博弈，以及一个在此基础上施加弱扰动的邻近博弈。分别推导闭环与开环结构下的Riccati系统，证明参考博弈中两者的均衡状态与控制过程完全一致；随后利用弱扰动可解性与稳定性分析，推导出参考博弈解与扰动博弈解之间的定量界，进而证明当扰动随博弈人数增大而足够快衰减时，闭环与开环均衡渐近等价。整个分析均在有限玩家层面直接完成。
AI.result: 对于参考博弈，闭环与开环Nash均衡诱导的状态和控制过程完全一致。在状态成本弱扰动下，博弈仍可解且稳定，并获得对应均衡间的定量误差界。特别地，当扰动随人口规模N增大而足够快衰减时，闭环与开环均衡渐近等价。该结论不依赖玩家交换性或平均场极限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究从有限玩家层面直接建立了闭环与开环Nash均衡之间的理论桥梁，为两类经典信息结构下的均衡比较提供了系统性的稳定性框架，填补了此前依赖平均场近似的研究空白。

title: A Brain-inspired Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Robot Task Reasoning and Execution
summary: Robots that follow open-ended language instructions need to connect semantic intent to visual scene understanding, geometric feasibility, object states, and physical interaction conditions. End-to-end Vision-Language-Action policies have improved cross-task generalization, but they typically map visual and language inputs directly to robot actions, leaving limited explicit structure for long-horizon decomposition, physical verification, and recovery. We present \method, a zero-shot hierarchical framework functionally inspired by the division of roles in the human brain, comprising visual perception and state inference, language grounding and action-sequence generation from a shared atomic action library, cost-based plan selection, and real-robot execution and verification. The framework grounds commands in explicit object states, composes reusable atomic actions into task-conditioned sequences, ranks alternative sequences by execution cost, and verifies intermediate physical outcomes from refreshed observations. In the evaluation, \method{} completes 10/10 clean board trials, 10/10 pick-and-place trials, and 4/5 pyramid stacking trials for both the flat and irregular initial-layout conditions; the corresponding mean task progress is $99.03\%$, $100.00\%$, and $96.67\%$ respectively. Across all evaluated conditions, \method{} achieves higher success rates than ReKep, Dream2Flow, and $π_{0.5}$ benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining explicit object-state reasoning, compositional atomic actions, cost-based plan selection, and closed-loop execution verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种零样本分层框架（\method），受人类大脑分工机制启发，将视觉感知、语言语义、原子动作组合、代价排序和闭环执行验证集成为一个系统，用于开放指令下的机器人任务。
AI.motivation: 端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽在跨任务泛化上有所提升，但将视觉和语言输入直接映射为动作，缺乏显式结构来处理长时程任务分解、物理验证和失败恢复，难以应对开放指令下的复杂机器人操作。
AI.method: 提出零样本分层框架，包含：1）视觉感知与状态推断；2）基于共享原子动作库的语言解析与动作序列生成；3）基于执行代价的候选方案排序；4）真实机器人执行与中间物理结果的闭环验证。通过显式对象状态推理、可复用原子动作组合、代价驱动方案选择和刷新观测验证物理结果。
AI.result: 在评估中，\method在clean board任务、pick-and-place任务和金字塔堆叠任务（含平坦和不规则初始布局）上分别完成10/10、10/10和4/5的成功率，对应平均任务进度为99.03%、100.00%和96.67%。在所有测试条件下，该方法成功率均高于ReKep、Dream2Flow和π0.5等基线。
AI.conclusion: 结合显式对象状态推理、组合式原子动作、基于代价的方案选择以及闭环执行验证，能有效提升开放指令下机器人任务的完成效果，优于现有端到端VLA及传统方法基线。

title: Rough variational principles and applications to adjoint systems
comment: 1st version, 38 pages, 6 figures, all comments welcome
summary: We consider a Type-II variational principle driven by geometric rough path with split boundary conditions naturally suited to adjoint systems. From this rough variational principle we derive rough Hamilton's equations, establish their pathwise conservation laws and associated Hamilton--Jacobi equation. We then specialise the framework to rough adjoint systems, obtaining pathwise conservation and quasi-conservation laws that underpin adjoint sensitivity analysis with respect to initial conditions and parameters. On the discrete side, we construct a rough Galerkin discretisation of the rough Type-II variational principle and show that it generates a symplectic flow with discrete analogues of the continuous conservation laws. We establish it's equivalence to a class of Rough Symplectic Partitioned Runge--Kutta (RSPRK) methods and analyse its convergence and naturality properties. Lastly, we perform numerical experiments to validate the predicted convergence rates and demonstrate that RSPRK methods preserve the adjoint conservation laws to machine precision, yielding more accurate and stable gradients in optimisation problems than non-symplectic alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出由几何粗糙路径驱动的Type-II变分原理，并带适用于伴随系统的分裂边界条件。由此推导出粗糙Hamilton方程、路径保守律及Hamilton-Jacobi方程，并应用于粗糙伴随系统以实现对初值和参数的伴随敏感性分析。在离散层面构造了粗糙Galerkin离散格式，证明其生成辛流并等价于一类粗糙辛分块Runge-Kutta（RSPRK）方法，通过数值实验验证了收敛率与伴随守恒律的机器精度保持。
AI.motivation: 将经典的Type-II变分原理推广到粗糙路径框架下，以处理由不规则驱动信号（如噪声）所驱动的动力学系统，同时解决伴随系统在优化和敏感性分析中的变分结构与守恒性质问题。
AI.method: 基于几何粗糙路径理论构建带分裂边界条件的Type-II变分原理；推导连续层面的粗糙Hamilton方程与守恒律；针对粗糙伴随系统建立准守恒律；在离散层面构造粗糙Galerkin离散，等价于粗糙辛分块Runge-Kutta（RSPRK）方法，并分析其收敛性和自然性。
AI.result: 所构造的离散格式生成辛流并保持连续守恒律的离散对应；RSPRK方法与粗糙Galerkin离散等价；数值实验验证了理论收敛率，并显示RSPRK方法将伴随守恒律保持至机器精度，在优化问题中相比非辛方法产生更精确稳定的梯度。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙Type-II变分原理为不规则驱动伴随系统提供了路径一致的变分框架，其辛离散方法在保持守恒结构的同时显著提升了优化中梯度计算的精度与稳定性。

title: Oblique Collision of a Relativistic Cold Shell with an Ideal Reflecting Wall
comment: 17 pages, 21 figures, submitted to Physics of Fluids
summary: Relativistic flows are common in astrophysics and often form shocks when different parts of the flow collide at relativistic relative velocities. Such collisions are often oblique, forming two shocks whose shocked fluids are separated by a contact discontinuity, which is treated here as an ideal reflecting ``wall'' where the flow on either side is modeled separately. The latter is modeled in the lab frame $S$ as a uniform cold planar shell propagating into vacuum at velocity $v_1=β_1c$ normal to its vacuum interface, colliding with the wall at an incidence angle $α_1$. The collision point $P$ moves along the wall at a velocity $v_p=v_{1}/\sinα_1$, and a boost along the wall at $v_p$ leads to a steady-state frame $S'$ where this problem is highly simplified. However, a ``super-luminal'' regime exists where $v_p>c\Leftrightarrow\tanα_1<Γ_{1}β_{1}=(1-β_{1}^2)^{-1/2}β_1$ and no steady-state frame $S'$ exists. It corresponds to only very small $α_1$ in the Newtonian regime, but nearly all $α_1$ in the relativistic regime. We solve this problem \textit{\textbf{fully analytically}} using integral conservation laws, in the attachmrnt region where point $P$ is attached to the wall. This region of parameter space is bound at high $α_1$ by the detachment line, which coincides with the sonic line for a cold initial shell. A weak-shock solution exist in all this region, while a strong-shock solution exists only in the sub-luminal attachment region -- between the luminal line and the detachment/sonic line where the two solutions coincide and beyond which point $P$ detaches from the wall and shocked fluid spills into the vacuum.

AI.tldr: 本文解析求解了相对论斜向冲击壁问题。当相对论性冷壳层以入射角α₁斜撞理想反射壁时，碰撞点P沿壁面运动。作者识别出"超光速"区（vp>c，即tanα₁<Γ₁β₁），在此区域不存在稳态参考系，但通过积分守恒定律完全解析求解了附着区，并给出弱激波与强激波解的存在条件及与脱离/声速线的边界关系。
AI.motivation: 相对论性流体的斜向碰撞在天体物理中常见且重要，但传统上通过沿壁面洛伦兹变换求稳态解的"亚光速"方法在超光速区域失效。需要一种不依赖稳态系变换的解析方法来完整刻画这一参数空间。
AI.method: 将问题简化为均匀冷平面壳层以速度β₁c、入射角α₁撞击理想反射壁（接触间断），利用积分（整体）守恒定律在附着区（P点附着于壁面）进行完全解析求解，不依赖稳态参考系变换。
AI.result: 发现附着区在高α₁端由脱离线（与冷初始壳层的声速线重合）界定。整个附着区内存在弱激波解；强激波解仅存在于亚光速附着区（位于光速线与脱离/声速线之间）；两条解线在脱离/声速线上重合，此后P点脱离壁面，激波后流体溢入真空。
AI.conclusion: 通过积分守恒定律实现了对附着区相对论斜激波问题的完全解析求解，明确了亚光速（存在强+弱解）与超光速（仅弱解）附着区的边界结构，以及P点脱离壁面的临界条件。

title: Arithmetic triangular structures in the transfer-matrix of finite Kronig-Penney models
summary: This work provides a complete analytical characterization of the transfer- matrix structure associated with the finite Kronig-Penney model consisting of one-dimensional arrays of Dirac delta potentials recently introduced by Figueroa et al. (2025). Although their study identified the emergence of specific transfer-matrix entries and related combinatorial coefficients, a rig- orous derivation of the corresponding closed-form expressions has not yet been established. By expressing the N th power of the unit-cell transfer ma- trix in terms of Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind, we obtain explicit closed-form representations for the global transmission and reflection ampli- tudes. The proposed formulation reveals a previously unrecognized structural correspondence between multiple quantum scattering processes, discrete con- volutional patterns, and hypercomplex combinatorial structures.

AI.tldr: 本文对有限Kronig-Penney模型（一维Dirac delta势阵列）的转移矩阵结构给出了完整的解析表征，通过将单胞转移矩阵的N次幂用第二类Chebyshev多项式表达，获得了全局透射和反射振幅的闭式表达式，并揭示了多量子散射过程、离散卷积模式与超复数组合结构之间的新对应关系。
AI.motivation: 尽管Figueroa等人（2025）已识别出有限Kronig-Penney模型中特定转移矩阵元素及相关组合系数的出现，但其闭式表达式的严格推导尚未建立，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 将N个Dirac delta势单元组成的全局转移矩阵表示为单胞转移矩阵的N次幂，并利用第二类Chebyshev多项式对其展开，从而推导出全局透射与反射振幅的显式闭式解。
AI.result: 获得了全局透射和反射振幅的显式闭式表示，并揭示出多量子散射过程、离散卷积模式与超复数组合结构之间此前未被认识的结构化对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 该公式化框架不仅为有限Kronig-Penney模型提供了严格的解析基础，还建立了量子散射与组合数学/超复数结构之间的深层联系。

title: A virtual reality extension for the Geant4 toolkit
summary: Geant4 is a toolkit for simulating particle interactions in matter that is widely used in particle physics, nuclear physics, medical imaging, and astrophysics. At present, Geant4 visualizations are generally viewed on a conventional, two-dimensional computer display. To enhance immersion, we have developed G4VR, a virtual reality (VR) application that extends Geant4 with VR capabilities, providing a more intuitive and comprehensive way to understand these interactions. The user running G4VR in a headset can get detailed information about individual tracks, interactions, and energy depositions by selecting them with the hand controllers. G4VR also allows the user to examine the chronology of interactions, and includes animations of entire events as immersive movies. G4VR includes built-in event displays of several types that allow a first-time user to easily explore its various functionalities. To interface with Geant4, we have developed a new visualization driver called G4XR that allows direct integration with the Geant4 source code. This enables any Geant4 experiment to be loaded and experienced in VR seamlessly.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了G4VR，一个基于虚拟现实（VR）的扩展应用，为粒子物理模拟工具Geant4添加了VR功能。用户可以通过头戴设备和手部控制器在沉浸式环境中查看粒子轨迹、交互和能量沉积的详细信息，并通过G4XR可视化驱动程序实现与Geant4源码的无缝集成。
AI.motivation: Geant4的粒子交互模拟目前主要在传统二维显示器上呈现，缺乏沉浸感和直观性，难以让用户全面理解复杂的粒子物理交互过程。
AI.method: 开发了G4VR虚拟现实应用，通过手部控制器支持用户选取并查看粒子轨迹、交互和能量沉积的详细信息；支持交互时间线检查及整个事件动画的沉浸式电影播放；内置多种事件显示类型便于新用户使用；并开发了名为G4XR的新型可视化驱动程序以实现与Geant4源码的直接集成。
AI.result: G4VR能够加载并体验任何Geant4实验，提供完整的沉浸式VR交互体验，涵盖信息查询、时间线检查和事件动画展示等功能。
AI.conclusion: G4VR通过G4XR驱动实现了Geant4与VR的无缝集成，为用户提供更直观、更全面的粒子交互理解方式，增强了Geant4可视化的沉浸性。

title: Quasi-split iYangians: minimalistic presentations and coideal structures
summary: We study iYangians, namely twisted Yangians in the Drinfeld current presentation, associated with quasi-split symmetric pairs of type $\mathsf{ADE}$ with nontrivial diagram involution. We establish minimalistic presentations in terms of degree-zero and degree-one generators. Type $\mathsf A_{2n}$ is treated separately: the isolated rank-two case requires two additional relations, whereas in higher rank these relations are forced by the neighboring noncentral orbit. As a by-product, we strengthen Theorem 3.1 in arxiv:2511.07136 by proving that the extra relation in the minimalistic presentation of split iYangian is redundant whenever $\mathfrak g$ has rank at least two. We also construct explicit injective homomorphisms from quasi-split iYangians into Yangians, identify their images as right coideal subalgebras, and obtain isomorphisms between the Drinfeld and $J$ presentations. Finally, we derive triangular estimates for the Drinfeld currents and their coproducts and apply them to the ${}^\imath\ell$-weights arising by restriction from finite-dimensional Yangian modules.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了与ADE型拟分裂对称对（带非平凡图对合）相关联的iYangian（即Drinfeld current表示下的扭曲Yangian），建立了基于零次与一次生成元的极简表示，并给出与Yangian之间的嵌入构造及Drinfeld表示与J表示的同构。
AI.motivation: 拟分裂对称对对应的iYangian在Drinfeld current表示下缺乏系统性的极简生成元与关系描述；同时需要澄清并加强已有文献中关于分裂iYangian极简表示中多余关系的结论。
AI.method: 将类型A_{2n}作为特例单独处理（孤立秩二情形需额外两条关系；高秩情形这些关系由相邻非中心轨道强制导出）；构造拟分裂iYangian到Yangian的显式单射同态并识别其像为右余理想子代数；证明Drinfeld表示与J表示之间的同构；推导Drinfeld currents及其余积的三角估计，并应用于有限维Yangian模限制得到的^\imath\ell-权。
AI.result: 建立了ADE型拟分裂iYangian的极简表示；证明文[arxiv:2511.07136]中定理3.1可加强——当g秩至少为2时分裂iYangian极简表示中的额外关系是冗余的；构造了嵌入Yangian的单射同态并识别像；给出了两种表示的典范同构及Drinfeld currents的三角估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统完善了拟分裂iYangian的结构理论，既推广了分裂情形的极简表示结果，又为研究有限维Yangian模经限制诱导的^\imath\ell-权提供了新的定量工具。

title: Methods to Find Integer Points on the Elliptic Curve of Factorizable Polynomial Equation
comment: 4 pages, journal article in WSEAS TRANSACTIONS on COMPUTERS, DOI: 10.37394/23205.2025.24.18
summary: As a valuable theoretical and application problem, the integer points on two types of elliptic curve y^2=(x-a)(x-b)(x-c) and y^2 = (x-a)(x^2+ax+b) are studied. By using elementary number theory method, the solution of the original equations is reduced to the solution of simultaneous Pell equations or generalized Pell equation, which can improve the efficiency in searching integer solutions by computer. Effective methods are proposed to find the integer solutions of the equations, which are convenient for algorithm programming implementation. At the same time, the derivation of the methods leads to two sufficient conditions, which can determine the unsolvability of these two types of equation respectively. The methods proposed are for equations with undetermined coefficients, which are more general than the solutions of the equations with specific known coefficients, and more suitable for computer programming implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两类椭圆曲线y²=(x-a)(x-b)(x-c)和y²=(x-a)(x²+ax+b)上的整数点问题，通过初等数论方法将原方程求解转化为联立Pell方程或广义Pell方程的求解，提高了计算机搜索整数解的效率，并推导出判定方程无解的两个充分条件。
AI.motivation: 椭圆曲线上的整数点问题既具有重要的理论价值也具有实际应用意义。针对特定形式的椭圆曲线，如何高效、系统性地寻找其整数点（或证明其无整数点），是一个值得深入研究的课题。
AI.method: 采用初等数论方法，将原椭圆曲线方程的求解问题归约为联立Pell方程或广义Pell方程的求解问题；在此基础上提出适用于待定系数的有效求解方法，便于算法编程实现；同时通过方法推导得出两个判定对应类型方程不可解的充分条件。
AI.result: 提出了求解两类椭圆曲线整数点的有效方法，该方法适用于系数未定的广义方程，相比仅针对特定已知系数的求解更具一般性；并得到了能分别判定两类方程无整数解的两个充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法将整数点求解转化为Pell方程问题，显著提升了计算机搜索效率，且方法更具一般性和可编程性，既可用于求解整数点，也可用于判定方程的无解性，具有较好的理论意义和应用前景。

title: Observation of multipartite spin entanglement in a cuprate chain
summary: Quantum materials are believed to host highly entangled states of matter, but probing and quantifying such entanglement has long remained experimentally elusive. Here, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) as a probe of multipartite spin entanglement. By projecting the RIXS cross section onto the appropriate spin excitation channel, we show that the Quantum Fisher Information can be extracted directly from the measured spin fluctuation spectrum. We detect at least 7-partite spin entanglement in the model one-dimensional cuprate Sr$_2$CuO$_3$, revealing one of the largest entanglement depths yet reported in a solid. The observed entanglement depth agrees with Hubbard-model expectations and persists to elevated temperatures. Our results establish RIXS as an experimental probe of many-body spin entanglement and provide a platform for extensions to charge and orbital sectors and nonequilibrium settings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）作为多体自旋纠缠的探针，通过将RIXS截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，直接从测量的自旋涨落谱中提取量子Fisher信息（QFI）。在一维铜氧化物Sr₂CuO₃中检测到至少7体自旋纠缠，是迄今固体中报道的最大纠缠深度之一，且观测结果与Hubbard模型预期相符并持续到高温。
AI.motivation: 量子材料被认为蕴含着高度纠缠的量子态，但长期以来，探测和定量表征这种纠缠在实验上一直具有挑战性。
AI.method: 使用RIXS作为多体自旋纠缠探针，将RIXS截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，从而从测量的自旋涨落谱中直接提取量子Fisher信息（QFI）以量化纠缠深度。
AI.result: 在模型一维铜酸盐Sr₂CuO₃中检测到至少7体自旋纠缠，这是固体中迄今报道的最大纠缠深度之一。纠缠深度与Hubbard模型预期相符，且持续至高温。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了RIXS作为多体自旋纠缠实验探针的有效性，为扩展到电荷、轨道以及非平衡态体系提供了平台。

title: Isolated calmness of regularized linear inverse problems
summary: This paper studies the isolated calmness property of solution mappings arising from convex regularized linear inverse problems. We mainly establish a tangent-cone characterization of this property. For convex piecewise linear-quadratic regularizers, the isolated calmness coincides with the solution uniqueness, leading to simple verification procedures. In particular, for analysis sparsity regularization, our condition can be verified by linear programming.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了凸正则化线性逆问题中解映射的孤立平静性（isolated calmness）性质，建立了其切锥刻画，并证明对于凸分段线性二次正则子，该性质与解的唯一致性等价。
AI.motivation: 凸正则化线性逆问题在信号处理、统计学习等领域广泛应用，理解其解映射的稳定性（特别是孤立平静性）对于算法收敛性分析和解的可辨识性研究至关重要。
AI.method: 建立了孤立平静性的切锥（tangent-cone）刻画条件。对于凸分段线性二次（PLQ）正则子，证明孤立平静性与解的唯一性等价，从而简化了验证过程。特别地，对于分析稀疏正则化（analysis sparsity regularization），该条件可通过线性规划进行验证。
AI.result: 给出了孤立平静性的切锥刻画；对PLQ正则子，孤立平静性等价于解的唯一性；对分析稀疏正则化情形，验证条件可转化为线性规划问题求解。
AI.conclusion: 本文为凸正则化线性逆问题中解映射的孤立平静性提供了系统的理论刻画，并针对重要特殊类别（PLQ正则子、分析稀疏正则化）给出了简便且可计算的验证手段，特别是线性规划方法极大降低了验证成本。

title: GLoRI: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Tracking with Global-Local Reference Interaction for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires accurate whole-body motion tracking in the world frame for physical interaction. While local references preserve motion structure, they lack explicit constraints on absolute spatial placement, leading to accumulated global errors. Existing globally aware approaches augment teleoperation policies with global observations but do not explicitly integrate global correction with local motion guidance, limiting autonomous tracking accuracy. We present GLoRI, a closed-loop whole-body controller that integrates structured global reference and feedback with local motion guidance. Its GLoRI-Net uses Global-Local Cross Attention(GLCA) to refine local keypoint features with global target and pose-difference features, preserving motion structure while correcting world-frame placement. GLoRI achieves 100% completion and a g-MPJPE of 6.44cm on held-out HuMoTo motions. This accuracy remains robust under direct Isaac Gym-to-MuJoCo transfer without fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization. Furthermore, such accuracy and generalization enable autonomous loco-manipulation with a single policy on a real Unitree G1 interacting with diverse unseen objects, extending beyond prior systems that primarily rely on teleoperation or focus on single-object interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLoRI，一种融合全局参考与局部运动引导的闭环全身控制器，通过GLoRI-Net中的全局-局部交叉注意力机制（GLCA）改善人形机器人的locomotion-manipulation任务中的全身运动跟踪精度，在跨仿真环境转移和真实机器人上均表现出高鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人locomotion-manipulation需要在世界坐标系中进行精确的全身运动跟踪以支持物理交互。现有局部参考方法保持运动结构但缺乏对绝对空间位置的显式约束，导致全局误差累积；而全局感知方法虽引入全局观测，但未显式整合全局校正与局部运动引导，限制了自主跟踪精度。
AI.method: GLoRI是一个闭环全身控制器框架。其核心组件GLoRI-Net采用全局-局部交叉注意力（GLCA）机制，利用全局目标特征和位姿差异特征来精炼局部关键点特征，在保持运动结构的同时校正世界坐标放置偏差。
AI.result: GLoRI在HuMoTo保留动作上达到100%完成任务率和6.44cm的g-MPJPE（世界坐标平均每关节位置误差）。在无微调的Isaac Gym到MuJoCo直接迁移下保持精度，展示强泛化能力。该精度和泛化使得单一策略能够在真实Unitree G1机器人上自主执行locomotion-manipulation，且能与多样未见物体交互。
AI.conclusion: GLoRI通过显式整合结构化全局参考与局部运动引导，显著提升了人形机器人locomotion-manipulation的全身跟踪精度和泛化性，使自主（非遥操作）且面向多目标交互的全身操控成为可能，超越以往主要依赖遥操作或局限于单一物体交互的系统。

title: A counterexample to vertex interpolation by planar $C^1$ cubic splines
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure. Exact verification code is included as an ancillary Python file
summary: We construct a nondegenerate conforming straight-line triangulation of a polygonal disk on which some vertex data admit no continuously differentiable piecewise polynomial interpolant of total degree at most three. The triangulation has 41 vertices and 56 triangles, and the graph induced by its interior vertices is a tree with eight arms of length two. Every cubic $C^1$ spline on this triangulation satisfies an explicit linear relation with integer coefficients among its vertex values. We derive the relation by a weighted sum of Bernstein--Bézier smoothness equations and verify it using rational coordinates and weights. This disproves Alfeld's conjecture on vertex interpolation. The nonexistence proof does not require a matrix rank computation. A separate computation in exact arithmetic gives rank 40 for the vertex evaluation map and dimension 107 for the spline space, attaining the classical dimension lower bound for this triangulation.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个包含41个顶点和56个三角形的非退化直边形三角剖分，证明在该剖分上存在某些顶点数据无法被总次数不超过3的C1分片多项式插值器连续可微地插值，从而否证了Alfeld关于顶点插值的猜想。
AI.motivation: Alfeld猜想认为在某种条件下C1三次样条可以仅通过顶点数据实现插值。作者试图构造反例来验证该猜想的正确性，并展示顶点插值失败的三角剖分实例。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个具有特殊结构的三角剖分（内部顶点诱导图为具有八条长度为2的臂的树），通过加权求和Bernstein–Bézier光滑性方程，推导出顶点值之间的显式整数线性关系。使用有理坐标和权重进行验证，避免了矩阵秩计算。此外，通过精确算术计算得到顶点求值映射的秩为40，样条空间维数为107。
AI.result: 成功构造了反例三角剖分，存在顶点数据无法被三次C1样条插值。顶点求值映射秩为40，样条空间维数达到该剖分的古典维数下界107，从而否证了Alfeld猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的意义在于通过构造性方法（而非矩阵秩计算）否证了Alfeld猜想，展示了C1三次样条顶点插值的局限性和三角剖分结构的复杂性。

title: Mining the time axis with TRON - III. Discovery of a nulling pulsar towards the SMC with MeerKAT
comment: 11 pages, 11 figures, accepted for publication in MNRAS
summary: We report on the discovery of a nulling pulsar, PSR J0052$-$7551, in archival MeerKAT L-band observations of the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC). The discovery was made using the image-plane transient detection pipeline, TRON, which creates a residual image for each time sample and uses a heuristic pruning strategy to identify promising candidates in the resulting temporal image cube. The TRON pipeline triggered on the approximately minute timescale variability associated with the nulling behaviour of a canonical pulsar. Follow-up MeerKAT UHF-band beamformer observations revealed a pulsar with a spin period of 0.55 s and a measured period derivative of 6.1(6)$\times$10$^{-17}$s$\cdot$s$^{-1}$. The source is seen in projection toward the periphery of the SMC, and has a dispersion measure value of 29.24(2) pc$\cdot$cm$^{-3}$, which is on the order of the expected Milky Way contribution along the line of sight. We use a Gaussian Mixture Model to fit the nulling behaviour which yielded a nulling fraction of $\sim 32$%. We find that the null lengths are consistent with an exponential distribution indicating a stochastic process. Additionally, power spectra of the UHF visibility data reveal an unexplained quasi-periodic feature at ~5$-$7 s that cannot be attributed to the source itself, RFI, or standard instrumental effects. Following on from previous image-plane detections of pulsars by the TRON approach, which relied on either scintillation or eclipsing behaviour, this is the first detection triggered by nulling. This discovery confirms TRON's sensitivity to a wide range of astrophysical phenomena of medium timescale duration.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在MeerKAT巡天数据中发现的一颗新nulling脉冲星PSR J0052−7551，位于小麦哲伦云方向。该发现基于TRON图像平面瞬变探测流水线，通过其在约分钟级时间尺度上触发的可变性事件发现。后续射束成形器观测确认了其自旋周期0.55 s及周期导数，并通过高斯混合模型拟合得到约32%的nulling分数。这是首次通过nulling行为触发的TRON图像平面脉冲星探测。
AI.motivation: 验证TRON图像平面瞬变探测流水线对多种中等时间尺度天体物理现象的灵敏度，特别是检验其是否能通过脉冲星nulling行为而非仅依赖闪烁或掩食行为来发现脉冲星，从而证明该方法的通用性和有效性。
AI.method: 使用MeerKAT L波段观测数据，通过TRON图像平面瞬变探测流水线，对每个时间样本生成残差图像并采用启发式剪枝策略识别候选体。发现候选源后，利用MeerKAT UHF波段射束成形器进行后续观测，测量其自旋参数和色散量，并使用高斯混合模型（GMM）拟合nulling行为，同时分析功率谱以检测周期性特征。
AI.result: 发现脉冲星PSR J0052−7551，自旋周期为0.55秒，周期导数为6.1(6)×10⁻¹⁷ s·s⁻¹，色散量为29.24(2) pc·cm⁻³，nulling分数约32%。null长度符合指数分布，表明其本质是随机过程。UHF能见度数据功率谱中检测到约5-7秒的无法解释的准周期特征，不能归因于源本身、射频干扰或标准仪器效应。
AI.conclusion: 这是TRON流水线首次通过脉冲星nulling行为触发的图像平面探测，此前仅通过闪烁或掩食行为实现过探测。这一发现证实了TRON对多种中等时间尺度天体物理现象的灵敏度，拓展了图像平面瞬变探测方法的应用范围。

title: The phase coordinates transformation in Moyal noncommutative framework 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator and Painlevé second equation
summary:
This work aims to explore the physical application of Moyal noncom- mutative formalism with the the presentation of new transformations which connect the old canonical coordinates to purly noncommuting phase coordi- nates through the parameters describe the Moyal noncommutative deforma- tion. These transformations are consistent with the Moyal noncommunica- tive brackets and build sixteen components traceless anti-symmetric tensor. This formalism incorporates space-space and space-momentum noncommu- taivity rather then noncommutativity (Heisenberg quantum commutation ) only for the canonical coordinates. The transformations imply to construct noncommutative analogs of 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator with
  its superintegrability and Painlevé second equation. The associated deformed Hamiltonians additionally involve some extra symmetries and reveal a deep physical understanding of about the additional symmetries with noncommunicative structure. The Painlevé second noncommutative coordinates transformation are also efficiently applied to generate the first Yablonskii Vorobev polynomial with Painlevé second parameter transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在探索Moyal非对易形式体系的物理应用，提出了一种将经典正则坐标连接到纯非对易相空间坐标的新变换，该变换与Moyal非对易括号一致，并构建了十六分量无迹反对称张量。该形式体系同时涵盖了空间-空间和空间-动量非对易性（而非仅针对正则坐标的Heisenberg量子对易关系）。该变换被用于构建二维谐振子的非对易类比，涉及其超可积性和Painlevé第二方程。所得到的变形Hamilton量包含额外对称性，揭示了附加对称性与非对易结构之间的深层物理联系。Painlevé第二非对易坐标变换还被有效应用于通过Painlevé第二参数变换生成第一Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式。
AI.motivation: 探索Moyal非对易形式体系在物理中的应用，特别是构建连接经典正则坐标与纯非对易相空间坐标的新变换，以统一处理空间-空间和空间-动量非对易性，并深入理解非对易结构带来的额外对称性及其物理意义。
AI.method: 提出与Moyal非对易括号一致的新变换，将旧正则坐标变换到纯非对易相空间坐标，通过描述Moyal非对易形变的参数构建十六分量无迹反对称张量。该变换同时包含空间-空间和空间-动量非对易性。基于此变换构建二维谐振子的非对易类比及其超可积性，并推导相关的Painlevé第二方程。通过Painlevé第二非对易坐标变换与参数变换生成第一Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式。
AI.result: 得到了与原Heisenberg量子对易（仅针对正则坐标）不同的、同时涵盖空间-空间与空间-动量非对易性的Moyal变形框架；构建了二维谐振子的非对易类比并展示了其超可积性；所得到的变形Hamilton量具有额外对称性；通过Painlevé第二变换成功生成了第一Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式。
AI.conclusion: Moyal非对易形式体系不仅能够推广到同时包含空间-空间与空间-动量非对易性，还能为二维谐振子等物理系统提供带有额外对称性的变形Hamilton量，这些额外对称性与非对易结构有深层联系。此外，Painlevé第二非对易坐标变换可用于生成Yablonskii-Vorobev多项式，为相关数学物理结构提供了新的生成途径。

title: Presenting mirabolic quantum Schur algebras $\mathcal{MS}_v(2,d)$
summary: Let $v$ be an indeterminate. We give a presentation of the mirabolic quantum Schur algebra $\mathcal{MS}_v(2,d)$ in terms of generators and defining relations. More precisely, we determine the kernel of the natural epimorphism from Rosso's mirabolic quantum $\mathfrak{sl}_2$, $\mathbf U^{\mathrm{mir}}_v(2)=\langle e,f,k^{\pm 1},\ell\rangle$, onto $\mathcal{MS}_v(2,d)$. Setting $P_d(k)=\prod_{r=0}^{d}(k-v^{2r-d})$ and $Q_d(k)=\prod_{r=1}^{d}(k-v^{2r-d})$, we prove $\mathcal{MS}_v(2,d)\cong \mathbf U^{\mathrm{mir}}_v(2)/ \left\langle P_d(k),(\ell-1)Q_d(k)\right\rangle$. We further determine the split Wedderburn decomposition of this quotient and provide an equivalent presentation in terms of weight idempotents.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了mirabolic量子Schur代数MS_v(2,d)的生成元与定义关系表示，证明了其同构于Rosso的mirabolic量子sl_2模去由P_d(k)和(ℓ-1)Q_d(k)生成的理想，并进一步确定了该商的split Wedderburn分解及基于权幂等元的等价表示。
AI.motivation: 量子Schur代数与量子群之间存在着经典的Schur-Weyl对偶关系，而mirabolic量子Schur代数是这一框架在mirabolic旗簇情形下的推广。作者旨在为该代数提供一个显式的生成元与关系描述，从而深化对其结构及其与mirabolic量子群之间联系的理解。
AI.method: 作者将v视为不定元，从Rosso的mirabolic量子sl_2（由生成元e,f,k^{±1},ℓ定义）出发，确定其到MS_v(2,d)的自然满态射的核。通过构造多项式P_d(k)=∏_{r=0}^d(k-v^{2r-d})和Q_d(k)=∏_{r=1}^d(k-v^{2r-d})，证明该核恰由P_d(k)与(ℓ-1)Q_d(k)生成，从而给出MS_v(2,d)的显式表示。随后进一步分析该商的半单分解结构，并给出以权幂等元为框架的等价表示。
AI.result: 证明了MS_v(2,d)同构于U_v^{mir}(2)/⟨P_d(k),(ℓ-1)Q_d(k)⟩，确定了该商代数的split Wedderburn分解，并给出了一个基于权幂等元的等价表示。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为mirabolic量子Schur代数提供了完整而显式的代数结构刻画，揭示了其与Rosso的mirabolic量子群之间的精确商关系，为后续研究其表示论及在几何表示论中的应用奠定了基础。

title: Optimization of Quadratic Sieve Algorithm Implementation for Large Integer Factorization
summary: The quadratic sieve method is a core tool in number theory. In this paper, we present two optimization methods for the Quadratic Sieve algorithm. In the sieving process, the original polynomial root value accumulation step is changed from the original di to the mdi (m is a small integer), which can change the complexity from O(n) to O(n/m). Another optimization method is that for all parameter lookup steps, the original traversal lookup can be changed to an efficient binary search, which can change the complexity of the loop from O(n) to O(logn). This enhancement reduces the computational complexity of RSA modulus factorization in practical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种针对二次筛法（Quadratic Sieve）算法的优化方法：其一是在筛分过程中将多项式根值累积步长从d改为md（m为小整数），使复杂度从O(n)降至O(n/m)；其二是将所有参数查找步骤从遍历查找改为二分查找，使循环复杂度从O(n)降至O(logn)。这些改进在实用场景中降低了RSA模数分解的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 二次筛法是数论中分解大整数（特别是RSA模数）的核心算法，但其原始实现中存在较高的时间复杂度和低效的查找过程，需要优化以提高实际分解效率。
AI.method: 提出两种优化策略：(1) 在筛分阶段，将多项式根值累积步长由d改为md（m为小整数），利用步长压缩将时间复杂度从O(n)优化为O(n/m)；(2) 对所有参数查找步骤，将线性遍历查找替换为二分搜索，将查找循环时间复杂度从O(n)降为O(logn)。
AI.result: 两种优化分别在筛分和查找环节实现了显著的复杂度降低（O(n)→O(n/m)以及O(n)→O(logn)），从而在实用场景下有效减少了RSA模数分解所需的计算量。
AI.conclusion: 通过筛分步长优化和二分查找替代遍历查找，二次筛法算法在RSA模数分解中的计算效率得到增强，具有实际应用价值。

title: Successive Phase Transitions from a Composite Fermion Liquid to a Fractional Quantum Hall State at ν=3/2 Driven by In-Plane Magnetic Field
summary: We report an even-denominator fractional quantum Hall state at ν = 3/2 induced entirely by in-plane magnetic field B_|| in an ultra-high-mobility GaAs quantum well. As B_|| increases, the system undergoes two successive transitions: from a composite fermion liquid to a soft-gap FQH state (B_||~12.2 T), then via a topological phase transition to a hard-gap robust FQH state (B_||~14.7 T), accompanied by a daughter state at ν = 19/13. We present systematic data, and discuss a possible scenario in interpreting these findings. Our work demonstrates that topological order may be engineered through k-space Fermi contour splitting under an in-plane magnetic field.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在超高迁移率GaAs量子阱中，仅由面内磁场B_||诱导的ν=3/2偶分母分数量子霍尔态。随着B_||增大，体系经历两次连续转变：从复合费米子液体到软能隙FQH态（约12.2 T），再通过拓扑相变到硬能隙稳健FQH态（约14.7 T），并伴随ν=19/13的子态。系统性数据表明可通过面内磁场下k空间费米面劈裂来工程化拓扑序。
AI.motivation: 探索偶分母分数量子霍尔态的诱导机制，特别是仅通过面内磁场而非传统垂直磁场或器件工程手段来实现拓扑序的调控，以拓展对分数量子霍尔物理的理解和拓扑态的可控工程化途径。
AI.method: 在超高迁移率GaAs量子阱中施加纯面内磁场B_||，通过改变磁场强度观测体系在ν=3/2填充因子处的输运行为变化，记录相变位置及伴随的子态现象，并进行系统性测量。
AI.result: 观察到两次连续转变：B_||约12.2 T时从复合费米子液体转变为软能隙FQH态，B_||约14.7 T时通过拓扑相变进入硬能隙、稳健的FQH态，并且在更高填充因子处出现了ν=19/13的"子态"（daughter state）。实验证明偶分母FQH态可完全由面内磁场诱导产生。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证实了面内磁场可通过劈裂k空间费米面（Fermi contour splitting）来实现拓扑序的工程化调控，为制备和操控偶分母FQH态及相关拓扑物态提供了新的物理机制和实验平台。

title: Regularized coordinate minimization for nonconvex composite optimization with application to quantized image compression
summary: This paper presents a regularized cyclic coordinate minimization method for solving nonconvex composite optimization problems having the objective function formed as the sum of two terms, one is twice continuously differentiable and the second term is simple and separable. We analyze the convergence behaviour of our coordinate minimization method, in particular we provide convergence rates to a first-order optimality criterion and objective residual depending on the assumptions on the problem. Then, we show that our algorithmic framework can be efficiently applied for solving quantized matrix factorization problems that arise in e.g., lossy image compression. More specifically, on KODAK and CLIC 2024 datasets, our method notably outperforms JPEG at low bit rates, achieving savings in bits per pixel without excessive degradation and remains comparable at higher bit rates. Moreover, we evaluate both the original and quantized compressed images in a classification task using 3 well-known convolutional networks AlexNet, ResNet50 and MobileNetV2 based on floating point and integer arithmetic representations. Remarkably, when comparing the two numerical representations of the convolutional networks, there is no substantially accuracy degradation on ImageNet dataset. The numerical results on image compression and classification using real data show the flexibility and efficiency of our algorithm compared to well-established methods from the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种正则化的循环坐标最小化方法，用于求解非凸复合优化问题（目标函数为两项之和：一项二次连续可微，另一项简单可分离）。作者分析了该方法的收敛行为，包括一阶最优性准则下的收敛速率和目标残差。该方法可高效应用于量化矩阵分解问题（如有损图像压缩），在KODAK和CLIC 2024数据集上，低比特率下显著优于JPEG，高比特率下保持竞争力。同时，用三种卷积网络（AlexNet、ResNet50、MobileNetV2）的浮点与整数表示对压缩图像进行分类评估，发现两类表示在ImageNet上几乎无精度损失。
AI.motivation: 非凸复合优化问题广泛存在于信号处理、图像压缩和机器学习等领域，但目前缺乏简单高效且具有收敛保证的坐标最小化方法。此外，量化矩阵分解在图像压缩中的实际应用需要一种既能处理非凸结构又具备理论保障的算法，以在低比特率下超越传统JPEG方法并保持压缩图像在下游任务中的可用性。
AI.method: 提出一种正则化的循环坐标最小化算法（regularized cyclic coordinate minimization method），针对目标函数由二次连续可微项和简单可分离项组成的非凸复合优化问题。算法按循环顺序对每个坐标块进行最小化，并引入正则化项确保收敛性。作者在多种问题假设下推导了收敛速率，涵盖一阶最优性准则和目标残差。该框架被应用于量化矩阵分解（QMF）问题来解决图像压缩；在实验方面，使用KODAK与CLIC 2024数据集与JPEG对比，并利用AlexNet、ResNet50和MobileNetV2（分别基于浮点与整数算术）对压缩图像进行ImageNet分类评估。
AI.result: 理论方面：证明了所提方法在非凸设置下的收敛性，并给出了依赖问题假设的一阶最优性和目标残差的收敛速率。实验方面：在KODAK和CLIC 2024基准上，该方法在低比特率下显著优于JPEG，节省了每像素比特数且没有过度退化，在高比特率下与JPEG相当。分类实验表明，浮点与整数表示的卷积网络对压缩图像分类精度几乎无差异。数值结果整体证明了该方法相比既有方法在图像压缩和分类任务中的灵活性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 该正则化循环坐标最小化方法为非凸复合优化提供了具有收敛保证的高效求解框架，并在量化矩阵分解驱动的图像压缩中展现出优越性能，尤其在低比特率场景下优于JPEG，同时在下游分类任务中不损失实用性。该工作兼具理论深度与广泛的实际应用潜力，可推广至其他涉及非凸复合结构的优化问题。

title: How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted by CoRL 2026. Project page: https://whirl-dexterous.github.io/
summary: Multi-fingered dexterous manipulation remains a frontier for real-world reinforcement learning (RL) due to the high-dimensional action space and the prohibitive cost of hardware failures. While human-in-the-loop (HIL) RL allows operators to intervene before failures occur, current pipelines often treat these interventions as reactive corrections, discarding the rich safety signal inherent in the operator's decision to take control. In this paper, we ask: How can we learn from what a human would avoid? We present WHIRL, a safety-aware RL framework that transforms binary human interventions into forward-predictive signals for proactive risk avoidance. Our approach centers on an intervention-aware latent world model with four prediction heads: dynamics, reward, termination, and a novel per-state intervention-probability head that learns to predict the likelihood of a human takeover at future states. This head provides an actor-side risk-shaping term that discourages the policy from entering "intervention-prone" regions, modeling the operator's internal safety threshold. We evaluate our framework on a 16-DoF LEAP Hand across tasks spanning convex and irregular object grasping, prismatic manipulation, and long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Our results show that predictive risk-shaping enables the system to achieve a 96.7 percent success rate on complex grasping tasks while reducing the operator intervention burden by up to 84 percent in step-weighted terms. By closing the loop between human intuition and predictive world modeling, this work provides a practical safety-aware recipe for training complex dexterous agents in the real world while reducing operator fatigue and hardware-risk exposure.

AI.tldr: WHIRL是一个安全感知的强化学习框架，通过将人类操作员的二值干预信号转化为前向预测的风险规避信号，训练16-DoF LEAP手部完成灵巧操作任务，在复杂抓取任务中达到96.7%的成功率，并将操作员干预负担降低84%。
AI.motivation: 多指灵巧操作因高维动作空间和硬件故障成本而难以进行真实世界强化学习。虽然人在回路（HIL）RL允许操作员在故障前介入，但现有管线将这种介入视为被动修正，丢弃了操作员决定接管控制这一行为中蕴含的丰富安全信号。作者提出问题：如何从人类会避免的状态中学习？其动机在于利用这种此前被忽视的干预信号来训练更安全的策略。
AI.method: WHIRL框架包含一个干预感知的潜在世界模型，具有四个预测头：动力学预测、奖励预测、终止预测，以及一个新颖的逐状态干预概率预测头。该干预概率头学习预测未来状态下人类接管的可能性，并为actor提供风险塑形项，通过惩罚策略进入"易干预区域"来抑制其行为，从而建模操作员的内部安全阈值。
AI.result: 在16-DoF LEAP Hand上，跨凸面和不规则物体抓取、棱柱操作以及长时程多阶段任务进行评估。结果表明，预测式风险塑形使系统在复杂抓取任务中达到96.7%的成功率，并在按步加权的干预负担指标上减少了高达84%的操作员干预。
AI.conclusion: 通过在人类直觉与预测世界建模之间建立闭环，WHIRL为在真实世界中训练复杂灵巧操作智能体提供了一种实用的安全感知方案，有效降低了操作员疲劳和硬件风险暴露。

title: Sharp approximation rates for shallow ReLU neuralnetworks on critical Besov classes
summary:
Let $\mathbb D$ be the normalized ridge dictionary generated by $\operatorname{ReLU}^k$ on a bounded Lipschitz domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^d$. We determine the sharp algebraic rate of finite $n$-term approximation from $\mathbb D$ when the outer $\ell^1$ coefficient budget is independent of $n$. More precisely, let $d\ge3$, $k\in\mathbb N_+$, $0\le m\le k$, $0<p<1$, and $0<q\le1$. For the unit ball of the critical Besov space $B_{p,q}^{k+d/p}(Ω)$, measured in $H^m(Ω)$, the optimal algebraic exponent is \[
  \min\left\{\frac{k-m+d/2}{d-1},
  \frac{k-m+d/2+1/p-1/2}{d}\right\}. \] We prove two-sided estimates in the three regimes determined by the two branches of this minimum and give the corresponding logarithmic factors at and beyond the transition. The estimates coincide without logarithmic loss in the strict angular regime and at the transition when $q\le[1/2+(k-m+d/2)/(d-1)]^{-1}$. The upper estimate combines critical wavelet sparsity, localized Fourier--Radon representations, and a stable allocation of directions and biases. The lower estimates arise from two distinct obstructions, namely radial ridge approximation on the direction sphere and Gevrey localization in the joint direction--bias space. The critical smoothness is exactly the endpoint at which Besov regularity provides a uniform shallow-network variation bound without additional scale decay. The resulting representation exponent is strictly larger than the degree-limited exponent for fixed-degree isotropic finite elements under a parameter-count comparison. This last statement concerns best approximation, not training or computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了由ReLU^k生成的正规化脊字典在临界Besov空间中进行有限n项逼近时的最优代数指数，给出两个分支下的双边估计及过渡区域的log因子。
AI.motivation: 理解浅层神经网络（脊函数字典）在有限项逼近下的最优表示能力指数，特别是当ℓ^1系数预算独立于n时，临界Besov空间的逼近率尚未被精确刻画。
AI.method: 上界估计结合临界小波稀疏性、局部Fourier-Radon表示和方向/偏差的稳定分配；下界估计来自径向脊逼近方向和Gevrey局域化两个不同障碍。
AI.result: 得到的最优代数指数为min{(k-m+d/2)/(d-1), (k-m+d/2+1/p-1/2)/d}，在严格角域区和特定q条件下过渡点无log损失；该表示指数严格大于固定次数各向同性有限元在参数计数下的指数。
AI.conclusion: 临界光滑度是Besov正则性提供均匀浅层网络变分界而无额外尺度衰减的精确端点，表明脊字典表示在参数效率上优于固定次数有限元逼近。

title: A cosmic-ray database update: CRDB v4.2
summary: The cosmic-ray database, CRDB, has provided data and meta-data to the community since 2013. We present a new release, CRDB v4.2, which includes data and time series published in the last three years (from AMS-02, CALET, DAMPE, LHAASO, etc.), datasets missed in previous releases, and all peer-reviewed ultra-high energy cosmic-ray data (both historical and recent datasets). These data and meta-data are available from the web interface or from the CRDB pip-installable Python library. This release includes results from more than 60 experiments and publications, corresponding to 4534 new data points and 131624 time-series data points.

AI.tldr: CRDB v4.2是宇宙线数据库的新版本，包含了过去三年（来自AMS-02、CALET、DAMPE、LHAASO等实验）及历史超高能宇宙线数据与时间序列，通过网页界面或可pip安装的Python库提供访问，涵盖60多个实验和出版物、4534个新数据点和131624个时间序列数据点。
AI.motivation: 宇宙线数据库CRDB自2013年起为社区提供数据与元数据，但需要持续更新以纳入最新实验结果、补齐以往遗漏的数据集，并整合所有同行评审的超高能宇宙线数据，以满足研究社区对全面、及时数据资源的需求。
AI.method: 发布新版本CRDB v4.2，系统性地纳入了过去三年（来自AMS-02、CALET、DAMPE、LHAASO等）的实验数据和时间序列，补充了此前版本遗漏的数据集，并整合了全部同行评审的超高能宇宙线数据（包括历史与近期数据）。数据通过Web界面和pip可安装的Python库（CRDB）提供访问。
AI.result: 新版本包含来自60多个实验和出版物的数据，新增4534个数据点和131624个时间序列数据点。
AI.conclusion: CRDB v4.2是一个全面更新的、公开可用的宇宙线数据库版本，提供了丰富的新数据和时间序列资源，为宇宙线研究社区提供了更完整和便捷的数据获取途径。

title: On spatial decoherence in many-body systems
summary: We study the dynamics of a many-body quantum system strongly interacting with a bosonic reservoir. The coupling is given by a potential operator for the system and it is linear in the field. We show that in the limit of infinite coupling strength the system undergoes instantaneous spatial decoherence. To resolve the decoherence process in time we consider large coupling strengths $λ$ and short times scaling as $t\propto λ^{-α}$, with $α\ge0$, in the limit $λ\rightarrow\infty$. On short time scales $α>1$ the dynamics is trivial while on longer ones $0\leα<1$ the decoherence is instantaneous. We show that the decoherence process is resolved exactly for $α=1$, defining the fine-grained time scale $τ=λt$. We construct an approximate effective evolution map of the many-body system with controlled error estimates. Generically, the effective dynamics is markovian, but not given by a dynamical semigroup. As a physical application we give a rigorous description of the phenomenon of localization of macroscopic quantum objects in position space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多体量子系统与玻色子储库强耦合时的动力学，证明在无限耦合强度极限下系统发生瞬时空间退相干。通过将大耦合强度λ和短时间t∝λ^{-α}的缩放结合，发现当α=1时（细粒度时间尺度τ=λt）退相干过程可被精确分辨，并构建了带有可控误差估计的近似有效演化映射，其有效动力学通常是马尔可夫性的但并非动力学半群。作为物理应用，严格描述了宏观量子物体在位置空间的局域化现象。
AI.motivation: 理解强耦合条件下多体量子系统与玻色子环境相互作用的退相干动力学，特别是需要精确描述宏观量子物体在位置空间的局域化（环境诱导退相干）现象。
AI.method: 采用极限分析方法：考虑无限耦合强度极限下的瞬时退相干，然后引入耦合强度λ与时间t的缩放关系t∝λ^{-α}（α≥0），在λ→∞时对不同α值的时间尺度进行分类分析。对于α=1的临界情形，定义细粒度时间尺度τ=λt以精确解析退相干过程，并构造具有受控误差估计的近似有效演化映射。
AI.result: 短时间尺度（α>1）下动力学平凡；长时间尺度（0≤α<1）下退相干是瞬时的；当α=1时退相干过程被精确解析。得到的有效动力学通常是马尔可夫性的，但并非由动力学半群给出。该框架严格描述了宏观量子物体在位置空间的局域化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了强耦合量子系统退相干过程的严格数学描述，建立了多时间尺度框架来分辨瞬时退相干，并为宏观量子物体位置局域化现象提供了rigorous的理论基础。

title: Essential algebra of the shifted Burnside biset functor with abelian shift
summary: Let $T$ be a finite group and let $kB_T$ denote the shifted Burnside biset functor over a commutative ring $k$. We study the essential algebra $\widehat{kB_T}(G)$ of $kB_T$ at an arbitrary finite group $G$. We first establish criteria determining when a covering subgroup of $G\times G\times T$ factors, with respect to the star product, through a group of order strictly smaller than $|G|$; the first criterion places no hypothesis on $T$. As an application, we describe $\widehat{kB_T}(G)$ completely whenever no nontrivial quotient of $G$ is isomorphic to a section of $T$, extending the coprime case treated by Romero. When $T$ is abelian and $|T|$ is invertible in $k$, we prove that $\widehat{kB_T}(G)$ decomposes as a direct sum of matrix algebras over the group algebras of the groups $Out_T(A)$, where $A$ runs over the linkage classes of reduced subgroups of $G\times T$, and we parametrize the simple modules of $\widehat{kB_T}(G)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限群G上移位Burnside双函子kB_T的本质代数widehat{kB_T}(G)。首先建立了判定G×G×T的覆盖子群在星积下是否因子化通过更小阶群的准则（第一个准则对T无假设），并由此在G无非平凡商与T的截断同构时完全刻画widehat{kB_T}(G)，推广了Romero的互素情形。当T为交换群且|T|在k中可逆时，证明widehat{kB_T}(G)分解为关于Out_T(A)的群代数的矩阵代数的直和，其中A遍历G×T的约化子群的连通类，并参数化了其单模。
AI.motivation: 移位Burnside双函子（shifted Burnside biset functor）是表示论与有限群理论中的重要工具。理解其本质代数（essential algebra）的结构，尤其是与约化子群（reduced subgroups）及连通类（linkage classes）相关的分解性质，对于进一步研究该双函子的不可约模和整性结构具有基础性意义。Romero已处理互素情形，本文旨在扩展该结果并给出更一般的分解定理。
AI.method: 本文采用双函子理论与子群代数的技术手段。首先利用星积（star product）运算，建立判定G×G×T的覆盖子群何时因子化通过严格小于|G|阶的群的准则，第一个准则不依赖于T的结构。随后在此准则基础上，通过分析约化子群及其连通类，构造widehat{kB_T}(G)的代数分解。在T为交换群且|T|在k中可逆的条件下，利用外自同构群Out_T(A)的群代数，将本质代数分解为矩阵代数的直和。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 建立了覆盖子群因子化的判别准则，其一不要求对T施加任何条件；(2) 当G无非平凡商同构于T的截断时，完全描述了widehat{kB_T}(G)的结构，推广了Romero的互素情形；(3) 当T交换且|T|在k中可逆时，证明widehat{kB_T}(G)同构于矩阵代数关于Out_T(A)的群代数的直和，其中A遍历约化子群的连通类；(4) 给出了该本质代数单模的完整参数化。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统刻画了移位Burnside双函子的本质代数在一般有限群处的结构，通过因子化准则和连通类分解，将问题归结为外自同构群群代数的结构，并给出了单模的完整分类。这一结果显著拓展了此前仅适用于互素情形的Romero定理，为双函子的进一步应用奠定了代数基础。

title: Unsupported Cyclotomic Divisors in Three-Prime Integer Tilings
summary: Cyclotomic divisibility imposes strong prime-power structure on integer tiles. We study unsupported cyclotomic divisors: mixed-order divisors for which none of the prime-power components of the order divides the mask, although every prime in the order divides the tile cardinality. Kiss, Łaba, Marshall and Somlai asked whether such a phenomenon can occur in the three-prime setting. We prove that unsupported cyclotomic divisors already occur for periods with three distinct prime factors. For primes \(p<q<r\), we characterize the square-period case: an unsupported factor \(Φ_{pqr}\) occurs in a tiling of \(\ZZ_{(pqr)^2}\) if and only if \(r\in\langle p,q\rangle\), and every such tile lies in a single residue class modulo \(r\). Among cyclic tilings with the unsupported order dividing the specified modulus, the smallest modulus is \(180\); if the order has three distinct prime factors, it is \(900\). An Apéry-set construction gives examples for every triple at period \(p^2q^2r^3\).The proof of our results combines Fourier rigidity, a three-cylinder decomposition, and an integer mass obstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了整数环Z_n分圆tiling中"无支撑"分圆因子的存在性。作者证明了在三个不同素数p<q<r的乘积周期下，无支撑分圆因子Φ_{pqr}可以出现，并完全刻画了平方周期(pqr)^2的情形：当且仅当r∈⟨p,q⟩时存在tiling，且所有此类tile都位于模r的单一剩余类中。最小周期为180（三素数时为900），并通过Apéry集构造了p^2q^2r^3周期的普遍例子。
AI.motivation: Kiss等人此前提出开放问题：在三个素因子构成的周期中，无支撑分圆因子（即分圆因子的阶的各素数幂分量均不整除掩码的因子）是否会出现。该问题关系到分圆可除性对整数tile强素数幂结构的约束边界。
AI.method: 结合三种主要技术：(1)Fourier刚性分析；(2)三圆柱分解（three-cylinder decomposition）；(3)整数质量障碍（integer mass obstruction）论证。对p<q<r的平方周期情形给出充要刻画，并用Apéry集构造法生成一般三素数周期的例子。
AI.result: 无支撑分圆因子Φ_{pqr}在三个不同素数因子的周期中确实存在。平方周期(pqr)^2下出现无支撑因子当且仅当r落在由p,q生成的乘法子群中，且此时所有tile均同余于模r的单一剩余类。最小有这种结构的周期为180（当分圆因子阶含三个素因子时为900），p^2q^2r^3对任意素数三元组均给出例子。
AI.conclusion: 该文肯定地回答了Kiss等人的问题，给出无支撑分圆因子在三素数情形下的完整刻画，揭示了分圆可除性与乘法群结构之间的深层联系，并为更一般的分圆tiling问题提供了新的构造与证明工具。

title: Kane-Lubensky phonons in Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures; Supplemental Material included (11 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables)
summary: We show that zero-energy gapless Weyl-line phonons of the Kane-Lubensky's type can arise in the three-dimensional Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators through the magnetopological mechanics. In a pyrochlore antiferromagnet with the spin-lattice coupling, a magnetic field selects the spin state whose lattice distortion generates a $P4_3 32$ topological lattice. More crucially, the spin-lattice coupling and the spin configuration cause the bending of the neighbouring bonds, and converts the system into the topological Maxwell lattice. Remarkably, the resulting system is found to host the bulk zero-frequency Weyl-line phonons protected topologically, and these gapless phonons are not Goldstone modes. Unlike the conventional ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^3}$ for the Goldstone phonons, these one-dimensional zero-mode manifolds yield a characteristic low-temperature phonon specific heat ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^2}$. Our results could find applications in the Cr-based spinel systems, and moreover, we establish a low-energy platform where an extensive number of topological zero-frequency phonons can strongly couple to other degrees of freedom, opening a route to exotic phonon-mediated phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在三维Maxwell格子的阻挫Mott绝缘体中，通过磁拓扑力学可以产生Kane-Lubensky类型的无能隙Weyl线声子。在烧录石反铁磁体中，磁场和自旋-晶格耦合导致晶格畸变形成P4₃32拓扑晶格，并使其转化为拓扑Maxwell格子系统，最终在体态中产生受拓扑保护的本征零频Weyl线声子（非Goldstone模式），其低温声子比热呈现C_ph~T²特征，而非传统Goldstone声子的T³。
AI.motivation: 探索三维Maxwell格子系统中是否存在Kane-Lubensky类型的零能Weyl线声子，并寻找一个物理上可实现的平台（而非仅理论构造），使大量拓扑零频声子能与其他自由度强耦合，为奇异的声子介导现象开辟新途径。
AI.method: 利用烧录石反铁磁体中的自旋-晶格耦合机制：磁场选取特定自旋构型，引起晶格畸变产生P4₃32拓扑晶格；自旋-晶格耦合与自旋构型共同导致相邻键的弯曲，将系统转化为拓扑Maxwell格子系统，从而在体态中出现受拓扑保护的零频Weyl线声子，并通过声子比热的低温标度行为（~T²）加以表征和验证。
AI.result: 在烧录石反铁磁体中成功实现了拓扑Maxwell晶格，体态中零频Weyl线声子受拓扑保护且不是Goldstone模式；其声子比热呈C_ph~T²而非传统的T³标度；该体系可能应用于Cr基尖晶石材料。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了三维Maxwell格子阻挫Mott绝缘体中的拓扑零频声子低能平台，大量拓扑零频声子可与自旋等其他自由度强耦合，为声子介导的奇异物理现象提供了全新的研究平台，并指出Cr基尖晶石体系是潜在应用方向。

title: Riccati Stability Without Auxiliary Matrices
summary: In the 2004 collection \emph{Unsolved Problems in Mathematical Systems and Control Theory}, Erik Verriest posed the problem of characterizing Riccati stability ``without invoking additional matrices.'' We give such a characterization through a scalar invariant of the resolvent family. The invariant is defined by covariance balances using at most $n^2+1$ frequency--direction pairs. A finite-dimensional separation argument shows that this covariance radius equals the optimal common ellipsoidal norm of the resolvent family. Combined with the strict bounded real lemma, this yields a necessary and sufficient condition for Riccati stability involving only the Hurwitz property of the first matrix and a single scalar inequality. The invariant reduces to the ordinary spectral radius for one matrix, lies between the pointwise spectral-radius and unscaled small-gain levels of the resolvent family, and coincides with the operator-space spectral radius of Shalit and Shamovich for the natural resolvent function space.

AI.tldr: 本文回应了Verriest于2004年提出的公开问题：在不引入额外矩阵的前提下刻画Riccati稳定性。作者通过预解族的一个标量不变量给出了这样的刻画，该不变量由至多n²+1个频率-方向对定义的协方差平衡确定。
AI.motivation: Verriest在2004年的公开问题集中提出了一个悬而未决的难题：如何在不借助额外辅助矩阵的情况下，仅基于系统矩阵本身来刻画Riccati稳定性。本文旨在直接回应这一问题，提供一个纯粹的、内蕴的判据。
AI.method: 作者定义了一个预解族的标量不变量（称协方差半径），通过至多n²+1个频率-方向对进行协方差平衡来构造该不变量。利用有限维分离论证证明该协方差半径等于预解族的最优公共椭球范数。结合严格有界实引理，得到Riccati稳定性的充要条件，仅涉及第一个矩阵的Hurwitz性质和单个标量不等式。
AI.result: 该不变量在单矩阵情形退化为普通谱半径；位于预解族的逐点谱半径水平与无缩放小增益水平之间；对于自然预解函数空间，与Shalit和Shamovich的算子空间谱半径一致。由此给出了Riccati稳定性的必要且充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功回答了Verriest的公开问题，证明了一个纯标量的内蕴不变量即可完全刻画Riccati稳定性，避免了传统方法中引入额外辅助矩阵的必要性，并将该不变量与谱半径类概念建立起了清晰的联系。

title: FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite
comment: Index Terms: Robot Learning, Flight Control, Reinforcement Learning, Autonomous Navigation, Control and Dynamics, Modeling and Simulation, Wind In Ground Vehicles
summary: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under realistic conditions. The simulator supports both CPU and GPU backends via Torch and NVIDIA Warp, enabling high-throughput parallel execution suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control rollouts. A unified interface accommodates a range of controllers (both RL and optical control algorithms) across tasks such as altitude regulation and trajectory tracking. Cross-validation with X-Plane and JSBSim is also supported to facilitate engineering integration and visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模块化、高保真的仿真框架，用于固定翼飞行器近地飞行控制策略的开发与基准测试。框架包含完整的6自由度刚体物理、半经验地面效应气动模型、执行器动态、传感器噪声和环境扰动，并支持CPU/GPU后端及多种控制器接口，可进行大规模强化学习训练和最优控制验证。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真器多采用简化动力学或面向悬停的模型，无法真实反映固定翼飞行器近地飞行时的复杂物理特性（如地面效应），缺乏高保真且可扩展的仿真平台来支撑低空飞行控制策略的开发与系统评估。
AI.method: 构建模块化仿真框架，集成6自由度刚体物理模型、半经验地面效应气动模型、执行器动态、传感器噪声与环境扰动；基于Torch和NVIDIA Warp实现CPU/GPU双后端，支持高吞吐并行计算；提供统一控制器接口以兼容强化学习与最优控制算法；支持与X-Plane和JSBSim的交叉验证。
AI.result: 框架支持高度调节、轨迹跟踪等任务的验证，具备面向地面效应等近地飞行特性的精细建模能力；通过CPU/GPU并行后端支持大规模强化学习训练和最优控制rollout；与成熟仿真器（X-Plane、JSBSim）的交叉验证增强了工程集成和视觉真实感。
AI.conclusion: 该仿真框架通过高保真物理建模与模块化设计，为固定翼飞行器近地飞行控制研究提供了统一、可扩展的仿真与基准测试环境，兼具物理真实性、计算效率及工程兼容性。

title: High-Order Structure-Preserving SBP Finite Difference Methods for the Vlasov-Maxwell System on Matrix-Free GPUs
summary: In this paper, we present a high-order, stable summation-by-parts (SBP) finite difference method for solving the Vlasov-Maxwell system in a 2D2V phase space. Central SBP operators for the advection terms are not stable when the solution becomes non-smooth and fine-scale filamentary structures develop, as is typical in high-dimensional Vlasov-Maxwell simulations. To address this issue, the method is stabilized using high-order upwind SBP operators. High-order explicit Runge-Kutta methods are employed for time integration. We prove that the fully discrete scheme exactly conserves mass and preserves momentum up to truncation error. Furthermore, we present a matrix-free implementation of the method on modern GPU architectures. A range of challenging benchmark problems is solved to demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and performance of the proposed scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高精度稳定的求和分部（SBP）有限差分方法，用于求解2D2V相空间中的Vlasov-Maxwell系统。该方法采用高精度迎风SBP算子处理对流项以解决非光滑解和细丝状结构导致的数值不稳定性，并使用高阶显式Runge-Kutta方法进行时间积分。理论证明了全离散格式精确守恒质量且动量保持至截断误差阶。此外，该方法在GPU架构上实现了无矩阵（matrix-free）计算，并通过一系列挑战性基准问题验证了其精度、鲁棒性和性能。
AI.motivation: 在高维Vlasov-Maxwell模拟中，解常演化为非光滑的细丝状结构，而中心SBP算子在处理此类对流问题时会产生数值不稳定性。因此需要一种既能保持高精度又可稳定求解该系统的数值方法。
AI.method: 采用高精度迎风SBP算子替换中心SBP算子以稳定对流项离散，结合高阶显式Runge-Kutta方法进行时间推进，并设计了GPU友好的无矩阵实现方案，同时给出了全离散格式的质量守恒和动量保持性质的严格证明。
AI.result: 通过多个具有挑战性的基准问题验证了所提出方法的精度、鲁棒性和计算性能，确认了该格式在GPU上的高效实施能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于迎风SBP算子的高阶有限差分方法能够稳定且高效地求解Vlasov-Maxwell系统，兼具严格的质量守恒/动量保持性质与GPU高性能计算潜力。

title: Interior Magnetic Fields in Magnetars and Radio Pulsars
summary: Magnetic fields are fundamental for neutron star physics and play a central role in powering the extreme phenomenology of magnetars, including Soft Gamma Repeaters and Anomalous X-ray Pulsars. However, the structure and stability of their internal magnetic fields remain largely unconstrained, as they cannot be directly probed by electromagnetic observations. Using 3D general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics simulations across a range of rotation rates and magnetic field strengths, we identify two distinct evolutionary regimes leading towards dynamically stable magnetic configurations. In rapidly rotating stars, the Alfvén crossing timescale exceeds the rotation period, allowing differential winding to amplify a strong toroidal magnetic component before the onset of instabilities, leading to long-lived, stable configurations. In contrast, in magnetically dominated stars, instabilities in the poloidal field drive rapid field decay, leaving only a comparatively weak toroidal component. These results imply that the internal magnetic structure of neutron stars depends sensitively on their rotational state: rotation-dominated stars like radio pulsars develop strong toroidal fields, while magnetars are characterized by predominantly poloidal configurations. Our findings therefore show that a neutron star's rotational history shapes its internal magnetic structure, providing a unifying physical picture that connects the observed diversity of neutron star classes to their hidden field configurations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，揭示了中子星内部磁场存在两种不同的演化路径，其结构与中子星的自转状态密切相关：快速自转的射电脉冲星趋向形成强环向磁场，而磁主导的磁星则呈现以极向为主的结构。
AI.motivation: 中子星内部磁场结构无法通过电磁观测直接探测，但其对于理解磁星极端现象（如软伽马重复暴和反常X射线脉冲星）至关重要。作者旨在厘清不同旋转速率和磁场强度下中子星内部磁场如何演化至动态稳定构型。
AI.method: 采用三维广义相对论磁流体动力学（GRMHD）模拟，系统扫描不同的旋转速率与磁场强度参数空间，追踪中子星内部磁场从初始状态演化至动态稳定构型的过程，并区分阿尔芬穿越时间与旋转周期的相对大小所导致的不同演化路径。
AI.result: 识别出两种截然不同的演化机制：在快速旋转的恒星中，阿尔芬穿越时间超过旋转周期，差动缠绕将极向场放大为强环向分量并抑制不稳定性，形成长寿稳定的磁场结构；而在磁主导的恒星中，极向场的不稳定性导致磁场快速衰变，仅残留较弱环向分量。由此推断旋转主导的中子星（如射电脉冲星）具有强环向磁场，磁星则呈现以极向为主的构型。
AI.conclusion: 中子星的旋转历史深刻塑造其内部磁场结构，这为统一解释不同中子星类别的观测多样性提供了物理图像：同类致密天体的差异可用其旋转状态与内部磁场构型之间的耦合关系来理解。

title: The inverse problem of time-dependent density functional theory on the torus
summary: We prove that, for any given sufficiently regular one-particle density, there exists a unique external potential for which the solution to the many-body Schrödinger equation has this prescribed density. This implies in particular that one can exactly reproduce the time-dependent density of an interacting system using non-interacting electrons, which is at the heart of time-dependent density functional theory. Our result covers the Coulomb interaction and densities arising from extended nuclei.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于任意给定的足够正则的单粒子密度，存在唯一的外势使得多体薛定谔方程的解具有该指定密度，从而为含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）提供了严格的理论基础。
AI.motivation: 含时密度泛函理论的核心假设是：相互作用系统的含时密度可以精确地被非相互作用电子系统再现。然而这一假设长期以来缺乏严格的数学证明，作者旨在为这一关键问题提供严格的理论基础。
AI.method: 作者针对多体薛定谔方程，证明了对任意给定的足够正则（sufficiently regular）的单粒子密度，存在唯一的外势使得方程解具有该密度。证明涵盖了库仑相互作用以及由扩展原子核（extended nuclei）产生的密度情形。
AI.result: 证明了多体薛定谔方程解的密度与外势之间的一一对应关系，特别地证明了可以通过非相互作用电子精确再现相互作用体系的含时密度。
AI.conclusion: 该结果严格验证了含时密度泛函理论的核心假设，为TDDFT提供了坚实的数学基础，且适用范围包括实际的库仑相互作用和扩展原子核体系。

title: The Auslander-Reiten conjecture for algebras with radical cube zero
summary: Let $A$ be a split finite-dimensional algebra over a field whose radical $J$ satisfies $J^3=0$, and let $s$ be the number of isomorphism classes of simple $A$-modules. We prove that a non-projective module $M$ with ${\rm Ext}_A^i(M,A)=0$ for all $i>0$ has a non-zero self-extension in some degree between $1$ and $3s+1$. In particular, $A$ satisfies the Auslander--Reiten conjecture, which asserts that every self-orthogonal generator is projective. As a consequence, every finite-dimensional algebra over an algebraically closed field with radical cube zero satisfies the Auslander-Reiten conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了：对于分裂有限维代数A（其根J满足J³=0），若非投射模M满足对所有i>0有Ext_A^i(M,A)=0，则M在1到3s+1之间存在非零自扩张（s为简单A-模的同构类数量）。由此得出Auslander-Reiten猜想成立，即每个自正交生成子都是投射的。作为推论，代数闭域上所有根立方为零的有限维代数都满足Auslander-Reiten猜想。
AI.motivation: Auslander-Reiten猜想是表示论中的一个重要公开问题，断言有限维代数上每个自正交生成子都是投射模。虽然该猜想在多种代数类上已被验证，但对于根立方为零（J³=0）的代数，此前尚未被完全证明。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过研究这类代数的模论性质来证明该猜想。
AI.method: 设J为代数的根且J³=0，s为简单模的同构类数。证明的核心策略是：假设存在非投射模M使得Ext_A^i(M,A)=0对所有i>0成立，然后利用根立方为零的特殊结构，通过分析Ext_A^i(M,M)在1到3s+1之间的行为，构造出非零的自扩张，从而导出矛盾。最终利用这一结果推出Auslander-Reiten猜想，并推广到代数闭域上的所有根立方为零的有限维代数。
AI.result: 证明了满足J³=0的分裂有限维代数上，任何满足右极值消解（Ext_A^i(M,A)=0对所有i>0）的非投射模必在1到3s+1的某个度存在非零自扩张。由此推出该类代数满足Auslander-Reiten猜想，并作为直接推论，代数闭域上所有根立方为零的有限维代数均满足Auslander-Reiten猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该结果扩展了Auslander-Reiten猜想的已知适用范围，将根立方为零的有限维代数全部纳入已验证的范畴，为进一步研究更一般代数的该猜想提供了重要进展和方法参考。

title: Generalized Zeckendorf expansions of the 2nd order
summary: We generalize Zeckendorf's theorem to second-order linear recurrences of the form $G_{k+2} = gG_{k+1} + hG_{k}$ with arbitrary, coprime initial values $(G_1, G_2)$. We analyze the asymptotic behavior of the count $\#R_G(X)$ of positive integers less than or equal to $X$ that have an expansion under the standard rule of expansions $\mathcal{E}$ associated with the recurrence. Additionally, we provide sufficient conditions under which $G$ has the unique expansion property under the rule of expansions. Finally, we completely characterize the $g$-golden ratio recurrence family when $G_1 = 1$ or $G_2 = 1$. Our approach directly investigates the algebraic structure of the expansions, simplifying and completing previous partial results.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Zeckendorf定理推广到一般二阶线性递推序列$G_{k+2}=gG_{k+1}+hG_k$（具有任意互素的初值$(G_1,G_2)$），分析了在标准展开规则$\mathcal{E}$下正整数展开计数的渐近行为，给出了唯一展开性质的充分条件，并完全刻画了当$G_1=1$或$G_2=1$时$g$-黄金比递推族。
AI.motivation: Zeckendorf定理是数论中关于斐波那契数列展开的基础性结果。此前的工作仅覆盖了特殊情形，尚未在一般二阶线性递推的框架下系统分析唯一展开性质及展开计数问题。作者旨在填补这一空白，通过直接研究展开的代数结构来简化并完善前人的部分结果。
AI.method: 文章直接研究展开的代数结构，而非依赖逐项分析。对形如$G_{k+2}=gG_{k+1}+hG_k$的递推序列（初值$G_1,G_2$任意且互素），分析在标准展开规则$\mathcal{E}$下计数函数$\#R_G(X)$的渐近行为；推导保证唯一展开性质的充分条件；并对$g$-黄金比递推族在$G_1=1$或$G_2=1$的情形给出完整的刻画。
AI.result: 论文获得了展开计数$\#R_G(X)$的渐近分析结果，建立了$G$具有唯一展开性质的充分条件，并在$G_1=1$或$G_2=1$时对$g$-黄金比递推族进行了完全的表征。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接分析展开的代数结构，作者统一并拓展了Zeckendorf定理到一般的二阶线性递推情形，简化了先前碎片化的结果并补全了缺失的情形，为该领域提供了更完整的理论框架。

title: Theory of Kondo hybridization wave in Kondo lattice
summary: Recent scanning tunneling microscopy experiments have discovered emergent spatially modulated Kondo hybridization wave (KHW) order in the heavy fermion superconductor UTe$_2$ and the artificial Kondo lattice system 1T/1H-TaS$_2$, challenging the conventional paradigm of spatially uniform Kondo hybridization in heavy fermion physics. Here, we develop a microscopic theory for KHW order based on the canonical square-lattice Kondo lattice model within the large-$N$ fermionic mean-field approximation. We systematically identify stable modulated KHW phases and establish their ground-state phase diagram. The prominent $\boldsymbol{Q}=(0,π)$ KHW phase yields uniaxial stripe modulation of the Kondo hybridization gap, which faithfully reproduces the spatial modulation pattern observed in UTe$_2$. Moreover, its inherent unit-cell-doubling modulation precisely accounts for the spectroscopic features measured in 1T/1H-TaS$_2$. We further predict a characteristic in-plane conductivity anisotropy that serves as a definitive transport fingerprint to discriminate KHW states with distinct ordering wavevectors. Our work provides a microscopic foundation for the newly observed KHW order and establishes a unified theoretical framework for understanding emergent modulated hybridization phenomena in heavy fermion materials.

AI.tldr: 本文基于大-N费米子平均场近似下的方形晶格Kondo晶格模型，建立了Kondo杂化波(KHW)序的微观理论，发现Q=(0,π)的KHW相可精确再现UTe₂中的空间调制模式及1T/1H-TaS₂中的谱学特征，并预言了可作为判别不同KHW态输运指纹的面内电导各向异性。
AI.motivation: 最近STM实验在重费米子超导体UTe₂和人工Kondo晶格体系1T/1H-TaS₂中发现了空间调制的Kondo杂化波(KHW)序，这对传统重费米子物理中Kondo杂化在空间上均匀的范式提出了挑战，但目前缺乏系统的微观理论解释。
AI.method: 基于方形晶格Kondo晶格模型，在大-N费米子平均场近似框架内发展了KHW序的微观理论，系统识别稳定的调制KHW相并建立基态相图，结合实验特征分析不同KHW态的谱学与输运性质。
AI.result: 识别出显著的Q=(0,π) KHW相，该相产生单轴条纹状Kondo杂化能隙调制，忠实重现了UTe₂中观察到的空间调制图案；其固有的晶胞倍增调制精确解释了1T/1H-TaS₂中的谱学特征。此外预言了面内电导各向异性可作为判别不同KHW态的输运指纹。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为新观察到的KHW序提供了微观基础，建立了理解重费米子材料中涌现的调制杂化现象的统一理论框架。

title: 1.73-Optimal Echelon Stock (R,nQ) Policies in Two-Stage Stochastic Serial Systems
comment: 32 pages of main text and references, plus an online appendix; 5 figures
summary: We consider a classical two-stage continuous-review serial inventory system with unit-sized Poisson demand of rate lambda, backlog cost rate p, lead times L_1, L_2, echelon holding-cost rates h_1, h_2, and fixed shipment costs K_1, K_2. The classical echelon stock (R,nQ) policy offers a simple operating rule: Stage 1 orders a fixed Q_1-lot, Stage 2 orders n >= 1 such lots at a time, and a Stage-1 request waits until a complete lot is available. Existing uniform guarantees restrict lead times or induced lot sizes, and the known all-instance guarantee is primitive-dependent, leaving open whether this restrictive integer-ratio class admits any uniform guarantee over the full primitive space. We develop a setup-preserving cost-allocation lower bound and show that the infimum cost within the classical class is at most 1.73 times the optimal cost over a rate-balanced admissible comparison class, for every lambda, p, L_1, L_2, h_1, h_2, K_1, K_2 >= 0. The result holds for exact integer lot sizes and under both setup conventions, one charging each positive dispatch and the other every complete lot. On the boundaries the guarantee is one, as an equality of infima, when lambda=0, p=0, or h_2=0, and improves to 5/3 when K_2=0. Numerically, across three broad parameter grids, the best-found (R,nQ) policy costs at most 1.098 times the evaluated lower bound, with a median ratio of 1.007; a deliberately adversarial stress test reports 1.6004 under the conservative lot-cost convention. At that point, finite searches under shipment-cost accounting find no benefit from allowing Stage 2 to ship an incomplete Q_1-lot, which is consistent with looseness in the evaluated lower bound. The simple (R,nQ) policy, therefore, combines a straightforward fixed-lot implementation with a uniform guarantee over the full nonnegative primitive space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经典两级连续盘点串行库存系统，在该系统上使用传统阶梯库存(R,nQ)策略。作者开发了一种保持配置的成本分摊下界方法，证明了在完整非负参数空间上，该策略的最优成本至多为某个可比类最优成本的1.73倍，并给出了边界情形下的精确保证改进。
AI.motivation: 现有针对阶梯库存(R,nQ)策略的均匀性能保证要么限制提前期或诱导批量大小，要么依赖于具体原语参数，因而此前不清楚这一整数比率限制类在完整参数空间上是否存在任何均匀保证。作者希望填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 开发一种保持配置（setup-preserving）的成本分摊下界方法，通过对比一个速率平衡的可容许比较类的最优成本，推导出(R,nQ)策略在完整非负参数空间上的均匀逼近比。
AI.result: 证明在任意lambda, p, L1, L2, h1, h2, K1, K2非负下，(R,nQ)策略成本至多为最优成本1.73倍；在lambda=0、p=0或h2=0时保证为1（下确界相等），K2=0时改进至5/3。数值实验表明在三个参数网格上最优(R,nQ)策略平均成本至多为下界的1.098倍，中位比1.007。
AI.conclusion: 简单的阶梯库存(R,nQ)策略凭借固定批量实现的直接性，结合了在完整非负参数空间上的均匀性能保证，为实际库存管理提供了可靠的理论支撑。

title: SCoCaT: Success Conditioned Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Spacecraft Docking
summary: Termination-based constrained reinforcement learning is attractive for safety-critical robotic deployments: it avoids online optimization at inference, scales easily to many constraints via a single scalar per constraint, and is simpler to implement than commonly used Lagrangian methods. Instead of pricing violations through summed cost penalties, this approach makes violations structurally unprofitable by shortening the effective horizon for each violation. We identify a structural failure mode of this method class on terminal-navigation tasks: reaching a precise goal configuration while satisfying safety constraints that tighten along the final approach. When the goal sits inside the region close to where the constraints become active, the survival-weighted objective makes dwelling outside the goal region strictly preferable to entering, producing high constraint compliance with low task completion. We formalize this pathology and show that a minimal augmentation to off-the-shelf RL algorithms like PPO resolves this ``feasibility collapse''. We empirically demonstrate that adding a dense per-step success signal via an auxiliary value critic improves the task completion rate while maintaining safety-critical constraint compliance. Validation across two representative spacecraft platforms: a 6U-CubeSat spanning the mass and degree-of-freedom envelope of operational proximity operations, and a floating platform testbed for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in our laboratory, supports the generality of these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了基于终止（termination）的约束强化学习方法在终端导航任务中的结构性失效模式——"可行性坍缩"（feasibility collapse），并提出通过辅助值批评家（auxiliary value critic）添加稠密每步成功信号来修复，在两类航天器平台上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 基于终止的约束强化学习在安全关键机器人部署中具有吸引力（推理时无在线优化、可轻松扩展到多约束、实现简单），但在终端导航任务中发现其存在结构性问题：当目标位于约束即将激活的区域附近时，生存加权目标函数使得停留在目标区域外严格优于进入目标区域，导致高约束合规但低任务完成率。
AI.method: 形式化该病态现象（feasibility collapse），提出对现成RL算法（如PPO）的最小化增强方案：通过辅助值批评家（auxiliary value critic）添加稠密每步成功信号，以缓解生存加权目标导致的激励扭曲。
AI.result: 在两种代表性航天器平台上（覆盖近距操作质量和自由度范围的6U立方星，以及实验室浮平台测试平台进行零样本仿真到实物迁移）进行实证验证，该方法在维持安全关键约束合规性的同时显著提升任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 通过辅助值批评家添加稠密成功信号可以有效解决基于终止的约束RL在终端导航中的"可行性坍缩"问题，兼顾任务完成率与安全约束合规性，且该结论在仿真和实物平台（sim-to-real）上具有普适性。

title: Rate of convergence of a fully discrete structure-preserving midpoint scheme for the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation
summary: The stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (sLLG) equation is a strongly nonlinear stochastic PDE with a non-convex pointwise constraint arising in the theory of micromagnetics. We analyse a fully discrete, structure-preserving finite element approximation of the sLLG equation with coloured multiplicative Stratonovich noise on a bounded interval. The method utilises continuous piecewise affine finite elements, mass lumping, and midpoint time discretisation to preserve the unit-length constraint exactly at the finite element nodes. Under suitable regularity assumptions on the initial data and the noise, we establish uniform higher-moment stability and develop an error analysis for the scheme. The analysis exploits the geometric structure of the equation and the stochastic midpoint discretisation. For every $γ\in(0,\frac12)$, we prove first-order spatial convergence and temporal convergence of order $γ$ in the natural discrete energy norm, locally in mean square on events of arbitrarily large probability and, consequently, in probability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first convergence-rate result for a fully discrete structure-preserving finite element scheme solving the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了带色乘性Stratonovich噪声的随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（sLLG）方程的全离散结构保持有限元逼近方案，在区间上利用连续分段仿射有限元、质量集中和中点时间离散精确保持节点单位长度约束，建立了均匀高阶矩稳定性并给出了误差分析，首次获得了全离散结构保持有限元格式的收敛速率结果。
AI.motivation: sLLG方程是微磁学中出现的强非线性随机PDE，具有非凸逐点约束，缺乏全离散结构保持数值格式的收敛性分析，此前尚无此方向的收敛速率结果。
AI.method: 采用连续分段仿射有限元结合质量集中技术进行空间离散，中点格式进行时间离散，在有限元节点上精确保持单位长度约束；利用方程的几何结构和随机中点离散特性进行稳定性分析与误差估计。
AI.result: 在初始数据和噪声的正则性假设下，对任意γ∈(0,1/2)，证明了在自然离散能量范数下空间一阶收敛、时间γ阶收敛，结果以局部均方意义在大概率事件上成立，进而推出依概率收敛。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对求解sLLG方程的全离散结构保持有限元格式的收敛速率结果，填补了该领域结构保持数值方法收敛性分析的空白。

title: Bridging the Population Synthesis of Supermassive Binary Black Holes and the Gravitational Wave Background
summary: Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain population properties of supermassive binary black holes (SMBHBs) through the observation of the gravitational wave background (GWB). Unlike other approaches that interpolate population-synthesis libraries or only consider the mean of the strain spectrum, here we capture its full strain probability density directly from semi-analytic population models. We apply our new method to the semi-analytic SMBHB population model, independently reproducing the parameter estimation for this model performed by the NANOGrav Collaboration with their 15-yr data. We also show the extent to which discrete SMBHB contributions to the GWB resolve degeneracies in the population parameter space. Finally, using the source-count intensity as the intermediate product in our calculation, we map PTA observations, as a proof of principle, to the SMBHB model based on the galaxy merger prescriptions from numerical hydrodynamical simulations "Illustris". We find the effect of delay times $τ$ between kiloparsec and subparsec SMBHB separations following galaxy mergers, finding $h_{\rm c}$ spanning $(1$-$6)\times10^{-16}$ and $N_{\rm c}$ spanning $(0.3$-$7.1)\times10^{-3}$ for $τ$ up to 8 Gyr.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新方法，直接从半解析种群模型中捕获超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）引力波背景（GWB）的完整应变概率密度，而非仅使用均值或插值。该方法独立复现了NANOGrav协作组15年数据对该模型的参数估计，并展示了离散SMBHB贡献对种群参数简并的解析作用。作为原理验证，该方法还通过源计数强度将PTA观测映射到Illustris模拟的星系合并模型，研究了延迟时间τ对h_c和N_c的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅考虑应变谱的均值或依赖于插值种群合成库，无法完整捕捉引力波背景的全应变概率分布，从而限制了参数空间简并的解析能力和参数估计的精度。
AI.method: 开发了一种直接从半解析SMBHB种群模型计算完整应变概率密度的新方法，以源计数强度（source-count intensity）作为中间产物；将该方法应用于NANOGrav 15年数据验证，并将其推广至基于Illustris数值流体模拟的星系合并模型，系统扫描延迟时间τ的影响。
AI.result: 该方法独立复现了NANOGrav协作组对半解析模型的参数估计结果；证明了离散SMBHB贡献可解析种群参数的简并性；基于Illustris模型的映射结果显示，延迟时间在kpc到亚pc尺度的SMBHB间距之间时，τ最高达8 Gyr，得到h_c在(1-6)×10^-16、N_c在(0.3-7.1)×10^-3范围内变化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能够更完整地利用PTA观测数据以概率方式约束SMBHB种群性质，同时通过与Illustris等模拟的耦合验证了GWB谱的不确定性来源（特别是延迟时间），为后续PTA数据分析提供了新的框架。

title: From Pre-triangulation to Triangulation: Obstructions and Exact Lifting
summary:
We give a new equivalent formulation of Verdier's octahedral axiom. An initial square in a pre-triangulated category determines an obstruction in a quotient of ordinary Hom groups. Its vanishing is equivalent to the existence of a good completion, and $\mathrm{TR4}$ is equivalent to this vanishing for the squares associated with composable morphisms. As a consequence, if two pre-triangulations have the same underlying additive category and one is triangulated, then the other satisfies $\mathrm{TR4}$ precisely when their relative inverse Heller comparison admits an exact lift along every short exact sequence in the Freyd category.
  As applications, we prove that the exotic pre-triangulated category of Díaz Cabrera--Muro is in fact a triangulated category over every algebraically closed field. We construct scalar families for type-$A_{3a-1}$ preprojective algebras over arbitrary fields and for a range of Dynkin preprojective algebras in characteristic two; in each family the zero parameter is the unique triangulated member. The local equations also yield separable descent, including canonical triangulations for non-modular equivariantizations and for the Markman--Mehrotra K3 deformation categories.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了Verdier八面体公理（TR4）的一个新的等价表述：预三角范畴中的初始方块决定了普通Hom群商空间中的一个障碍，该障碍的消失等价于好的补全存在性，且TR4等价于与复合态射关联的方块上的这一消失条件。作为推论，若两个预三角化共享同一加性范畴且其中之一是三角化的，则另一个满足TR4当且仅当其相对逆Heller比较在Freyd范畴中沿每个短正合列存在精确提升。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在深入理解Verdier八面体公理的结构本质，为验证预三角范畴是否为真正的三角范畴提供更具体、可操作的判别条件，并由此解决若干具体范畴（如Díaz Cabrera--Muro的奇异预三角范畴、preprojective代数相关的范畴）是否满足TR4的问题。
AI.method: 引入"初始方块"的概念，通过构造与方块相关联的Hom群商空间中的障碍类来刻画好补全的存在性。利用Freyd范畴和Heller比较作为桥梁，将TR4的满足等价地转化为相对逆Heller比较沿短正合列的精确可提升性条件，从而建立起一个统一的判别框架。
AI.result: 证明了Díaz Cabrera--Muro的奇异预三角范畴在任意代数闭域上实际上是三角范畴。构造了type-A_{3a-1} preprojective代数（任意域）和一系列Dynkin preprojective代数（特征2）上的标量族，其中仅零参数对应的成员是三角范畴。局部方程还导出了可分下降结果，包括非模等变化和Markman--Mehrotra K3形变范畴上的典范三角结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为八面体公理提供了新的结构性理解，并展示了这一新判别方法在多种具体范畴（包括奇异预三角范畴、preprojective代数族和形变范畴）中的强大应用，揭示了TR4与代数结构（如相对Heller比较）之间的深层联系。

title: A Fricke transformation for cubic-residue eta products of level 13
summary: We prove an explicit Fricke transformation for the two-dimensional space generated by normalized reciprocal products on the cubic-residue cosets modulo 13. The transformation matrix is a scalar multiple of a matrix of differences of cubic Gaussian periods. Its projective action is defined over the cyclic cubic field, whereas the normalized matrix is defined over the real cyclotomic field. The proof uses generalized eta functions, a modular unit of degree two on $X_1(13)$, and a five-coefficient identity. A separate divisor argument lifts the projective transformation to the asserted linear transformation. We also record the Fricke images at an arbitrary prime $p\equiv1\pmod3$ and prove that their normalized sine constants belong to the associated cyclic cubic subfield.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了模13的立方剩余陪集上归一化倒数乘积所生成的二维空间的一个显式Fricke变换，其变换矩阵是三次高斯周期差矩阵的标量倍数，并通过广义η函数、X_1(13)上的二次模单位及五系数恒等式完成证明，同时给出任意素数p≡1 (mod 3)的Fricke像并证明其归一化正弦常数属于相应循环三次子域。
AI.motivation: 探索显式Fricke变换在特殊模（如13）上的具体结构，建立变换矩阵与三次高斯周期之间的深刻联系，并推广到一般p≡1 (mod 3)的情形，以理解其算术性质。
AI.method: 作者利用广义η函数构造模单位，借助X_1(13)上的二次模单位以及一个五系数恒等式来完成核心推导；通过除子论证将射影变换提升为线性变换；对于一般素数情况，通过显式Fricke像并分析其归一化正弦常数的域隶属关系来完成。
AI.result: 获得了模13情形下的显式Fricke变换矩阵（为三次高斯周期差矩阵的标量倍数），其射影作用定义在循环三次域上，归一化矩阵定义在实分圆域上；对任意p≡1 (mod 3)记录了fricke像，并证明了对应的归一化正弦常数属于相关的循环三次子域。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了数论中Fricke变换、高斯周期与模形式之间新的显式联系，揭示了这些对象在循环三次域和实分圆域中的算术结构，为该方向的进一步研究提供了具体而深刻的结果。

title: High-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with tunable magnetic field
summary: The control and perturbation of quantum phenomena with magnetic fields is an indispensable tool in materials research. Recently, in-situ field tuning was implemented into angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (magneto-ARPES), which provides direct momentum and energy-resolved information of the field-dependent electronic structure. However, aberrations of the electron trajectories were shown to be substantial, leading to significant spectral distortions and broadening even in small fields. Here we show that the electronic structure can be recovered from magneto-ARPES spectra with high accuracy while maintaining high momentum resolution even when strong trajectory aberrations are present. We studied Bi$_2$Se$_3$ in a dipole field of a coil using a laser-based ARPES system. The electronic structure was reconstructed in post-processing using detailed electron trajectory simulations. We identify two-dimensional (2D) momentum mapping, a micron beam spot size, and precise numerical field simulations as critical technical requirements for high-resolution magneto-ARPES. We show how circular dichroism can provide additional information about the coupling of the magnetic field to the spin. The experimental achievements and the scaling laws from our simulations provide a road map towards magneto-ARPES in larger fields.
