AI.result: 发现EP250304a的X射线光变在~1千秒内呈现两个宽脉冲且峰值通量相当，罕见特征；前3天的光学快速冷却信号符合冲击茧模型；而3-88天的超新星光变曲线无法仅由56Ni放射性衰变解释，SNEC模拟网格揭示了明显的晚期能量盈余；引入中心磁星模型后得到最佳拟合自转周期~12.60毫秒、磁场~3.52×10^15高斯，该模型能同时自洽解释晚期热光度曲线和早期X射线脉冲结构。
AI.conclusion: EP250304a/SN 2025fhm的能源机制更可能来自一颗快速自转、强磁化的中心磁星，而非单纯的放射性衰变。这一结论为EFXT及其关联超新星的能量预算和物理起源提供了新的约束与见解，展现了中心引擎在驱动此类暂现源的重要作用。

title: The method of telescoping continued fractions
summary:
We give an approach to discover continued fractions for series of the form $$\sum_{k=0}^\infty \frac{ε^k}{(x+k)^s},$$ where $ε= \pm 1$. We find a continued fraction of the form \begin{equation*}
  \frac{a_1}{b_1(x)} \fplus \frac{a_2}{b_2(x)} \fplus \fdots \end{equation*} where $a_k$ are constants and $b_k(x)$ are polynomials. Our technique involves telescoping continued fractions.
  This provides a discovery approach to continued fractions given by Ramanujan for $$2\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{(-1)^{k+1}}{x+2k-1}, 2\sum_{k=0}^\infty \frac{1}{(x+2k+1)^2}, 2\sum_{k=0}^\infty \frac{(-1)^k}{(x+2k+1)^2}, \sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{(x+k)^3}, $$ and the like.
  We display the first few terms of several continued fractions obtained in this manner for larger values of $s$, including $s=5, 7, 9, 11$. They do not follow as simple a pattern as Ramanujan's continued fractions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用望远镜连续分数（telescoping continued fractions）技术，为形式为 ∑ ε^k/(x+k)^s 的级数系统性地发现连续分数表示的方法，其中 ε=±1。该方法能够重构出拉马努金已知的若干连续分数，并为更大的 s 值（如 5,7,9,11）生成新的连续分数。
AI.motivation: 拉马努金曾给出多种特殊级数的优美连续分数表示，但缺乏一种系统的发现方法来推导此类结果。作者旨在建立一种一般性框架，能够自动生成这类级数的连续分数，从而既能解释已有结果，又能探索新的情形。
AI.method: 核心方法是"望远镜连续分数"（telescoping continued fractions）技术。给定形如 ∑ ε^k/(x+k)^s 的级数，构造形式为 a₁/(b₁(x)+a₂/(b₂(x)+...)) 的连续分数，其中分子 a_k 为常数，分母 b_k(x) 为多项式。通过望远镜技巧逐项匹配级数与连续分数的展开，从而确定各系数。
AI.result: 该方法成功重现了拉马努金给出的多个经典连续分数（涉及调和级数型、平方倒数型等）。对于 s=5,7,9,11 等较大指数值，作者展示了生成的新连续分数的前若干项。这些结果不像拉马努金的连续分数那样遵循简单的模式，表明该框架可发现结构更加复杂的连续分数。
AI.conclusion: 望远镜连续分数技术提供了一种系统发现被积级数连续分数表示的途径。该方法不仅统一解释了拉马努金已知的结果，还能扩展到更一般的 s 值，尽管这些新连续分数的模式更为复杂，仍表明该方向具有进一步探索的潜力。

title: Real-time Dyson expansion for the nonequilibrium $GW$ approximation: Correlated spectra and dependence on the reference propagator
summary: Electronic spectra provide direct insight into the excitations and correlations of condensed matter systems. Their description requires electron correlations beyond mean field. In equilibrium, the $GW$ approximation has become the method of choice for many materials. Extending this approximation to nonequilibrium, however, is challenging. Full two-time $GW$ simulations within the nonequilibrium Green's functions approach scale at least cubically with propagation time, whereas improved scaling schemes such as time-local (adiabatic) approximations or the generalized Kadanoff--Baym ansatz usually retain only mean-field character in the spectra. The recently introduced real-time Dyson expansion recovers dynamical correlations in the spectrum at time-linear cost, but has so far been restricted to the second-order Born approximation with mean-field reference propagators. Here we formulate and implement the RT-DE for the nonequilibrium $GW$ self-energy with reference propagators of general form whose off-diagonal evolution is time local. In particular, we assess Hartree--Fock propagators, propagators with statically screened exchange with nonequilibrium screening, and a correlated propagator based on the Hartree--Fock GKBA. Benchmarks against exact diagonalization for a driven two-band lattice model with long-range interactions show that the mean-field and statically screened references yield the most accurate spectra, including satellite structures absent at mean-field level, whereas the GKBA-based approach best captures scattering-induced occupation dynamics, but artificially broadens and splits spectral peaks. When applied to large systems that are beyond the reach of exact methods, the scheme resolves the excitonic replica of the valence band and satellites identified as exciton shake-up, as well as their reshaping with increasing excitation density.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了基于实时Dyson展开（RT-DE）的非平衡GW自能方法，支持任意形式的参考传播子（含时间局域的离对角演化）。通过与精确对角化对比，发现基于平均场和静态屏蔽交换的参考传播子能最准确地再现谱学特征（含卫星结构），而基于GKBA的关联传播子能更好地捕捉散射引起的占据数动力学但会人为展宽和分裂谱峰。该方法可应用于超出精确方法范围的大型系统，并揭示了价带激子复本和激子shake-up卫星结构。
AI.motivation: 非平衡GW近似对光谱计算很重要，但全双时间GW模拟随传播时间至少三次方增长，现有改进方案（时间局域近似或广义Kadanoff-Baym ansatz）通常只能保留平均场特征。实时Dyson展开虽能以时间线性代价获得动力学关联，但此前仅限于以平均场参考传播子为基础的二阶Born近似，缺乏GW级别的自能描述。
AI.method: 将实时Dyson展开（RT-DE）推广到非平衡GW自能，支持一般形式的参考传播子（离对角演化为时间局域）。具体考察三类参考传播子：(1) Hartree-Fock传播子；(2) 含非平衡屏蔽的静态屏蔽交换传播子；(3) 基于Hartree-Fock GKBA的关联传播子。
AI.result: 在驱动双带晶格模型（含长程相互作用）上对标精确对角化发现：平均场和静态屏蔽参考传播子给出最准确的谱学结果（含平均场缺失的卫星结构）；GKBA方法虽能最好地捕捉散射诱导的占据数动力学，但会人为展宽和分裂谱峰。在大规模系统中解析出价带激子复本及激子shake-up卫星，并揭示了激发密度增加时的结构重塑。
AI.conclusion: RT-DE推广到GW自能层面在保持时间线性计算代价的同时，为选择适当的参考传播子提供了权衡框架：谱学精度优先选平均场/静态屏蔽参考，动力学占据演化精度优先选GKBA参考。该方法可扩展到超出精确方法的大系统，揭示非平衡激子关联谱学特征。

title: An Exact Dual for Second-Order Cone Programming Using Only Lorentz-Cone Constraints
summary: Without a constraint qualification, second-order cone programs can have a duality gap or an unattained dual value. For every such program with arbitrary real coefficients, we construct an exact dual using only affine equations and memberships in products of Lorentz cones. Every feasible dual point gives a valid bound. Whenever the primal is feasible with finite value, the dual attains that value. This answers a question raised by Pólik and Terlaky and reiterated in subsequent work: whether an exact dual for second-order cone programming can use only Lorentz-cone constraints. The same construction produces an affine second-order cone system that is feasible exactly when a given affine second-order cone system is infeasible, including in the weakly infeasible case. Both formulations have polynomial size and are obtained uniformly from the input coefficients using only fixed rational constants. These are formulation-size results over exact real data; they do not imply polynomial-time solvability or polynomial bounds on the bit length of rational certificates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无约束规格条件下的二阶锥规划（SOCP）对偶间隙或对偶值不可达问题，构造了一个仅使用仿射等式和Lorentz锥乘积成员关系的精确对偶。该对偶对任意可行对偶点给出有效界，且在原始问题可行且有限值时可达到对偶值，回应了Pólik和Terlaky提出的公开问题。
AI.motivation: 在二阶锥规划中，当缺少约束规格条件时，经典对偶理论可能失效，产生对偶间隙或对偶值不可达的问题。Pólik和Terlaky提出了一个公开问题：是否存在仅使用Lorentz锥约束的精确对偶。本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 对具有任意实系数的二阶锥规划，作者构造了一个仅含仿射等式和Lorentz锥乘积中成员关系的精确对偶。构造过程还产生一个仿射二阶锥可行系统，其可行性恰好与原系统不可行性等价（包括弱不可行情形）。两种构造均为多项式规模，使用固定有理常数，从输入系数统一获得。
AI.result: 构造的精确对偶满足：每个可行对偶点提供有效下界；当原始问题可行且具有有限值时，对偶可达到该值。同时获得了关于弱不可行性判定的仿射SOCP系统。构造的公式具有多项式大小，统一地从输入系数获得。
AI.conclusion: 本文正面回答了Pólik和Terlaky提出的问题，证明精确对偶可以仅使用Lorentz锥约束实现。但这些是精确实数据上的公式规模结果，不暗示多项式时间可解性或有理证书的比特长度的多项式界。

title: OcclusionCBF: Backup Control Barrier Functions for Safe Navigation Among Hidden Dynamic Obstacles
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: https://www.taekyung.me/occlusion-cbf
summary: Robots navigating under occlusion may enter states from which no admissible input can avoid a dynamic obstacle once it becomes visible. We present OcclusionCBF, a safety filter that extends backup control barrier functions to reachable-occupancy predictions for potentially hidden dynamic obstacles in occluded regions. The method certifies a prescribed backup rollout against collision-inflated occupancy and a verified terminal set, yielding affine constraints for minimally invasive quadratic-program filtering. We establish recursive feasibility of the resulting safety filter, and collision avoidance for every hidden-obstacle motion covered by the occupancy prediction. Randomized benchmarks, MetaUrban simulations, and hardware experiments demonstrate improved task success over reactive and occlusion-aware predictive baselines with millisecond-scale computation.

AI.tldr: 提出OcclusionCBF安全滤波器，扩展备份控制屏障函数以处理遮挡区域中潜在隐藏动态障碍物，通过可达占用预测保证安全性，并验证了递归可行性与碰撞避免。
AI.motivation: 在遮挡环境下导航的机器人可能在障碍物可见前进入无法通过任何可行输入避免碰撞的状态，现有方法缺少对隐藏动态障碍物的严格安全保证。
AI.method: 将备份控制屏障函数（backup CBF）扩展至可达占用预测，对可能的隐藏动态障碍物进行碰撞膨胀占用评估，验证预设的备份轨迹是否安全；将安全条件转化为仿射约束，用于最小侵入式二次规划滤波，并确保隐藏障碍物运动在占用预测覆盖范围内时具有递归可行性和碰撞避免保证。
AI.result: 随机基准测试、MetaUrban仿真和硬件实验均表明，该方法相比反应式和遮挡感知预测式基线在任务成功率上有所提升，且计算延迟为毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: OcclusionCBF为遮挡环境下的机器人安全导航提供了一种轻量、可保证的安全滤波器，兼具理论安全性保证与实际部署可行性。

title: A Generalized Finite Difference-Based Fragile Points Method for Heat Conduction Problems in Non-Homogeneous Media
summary: This paper presents an enhanced formulation of the Fragile Points Method (FPM), a truly meshless approach for efficiently modeling implicit interfaces in two-dimensional differential equations involving non-homogeneous materials. The proposed framework eliminates the need for specialized numerical integration techniques and provides a systematic mathematical foundation for solving interface problems. Discontinuities in both primary and secondary variables across interfaces are naturally handled through the inherently discontinuous shape functions of FPM. Unlike conventional Galerkin methods, FPM employs simple, local, point-based polynomial trial and test functions constructed via a generalized finite difference approach. These discontinuous functions bypass the continuity requirements of standard Galerkin frameworks. To address the resulting inconsistency due to discontinuities, we incorporate numerical flux corrections inspired by the discontinuous Galerkin method. The proposed method is validated through several benchmark problems, demonstrating its efficiency and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种增强的Fragile Points Method (FPM)公式，用于高效求解含非均匀材料的二维微分方程中的隐式界面问题。该方法通过固有的不连续形函数自然处理界面上的主变量和次变量不连续性，并结合受间断伽辽金法启发的数值通量修正来解决不连续带来的不一致性。数值算例验证了该方法的高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统伽辽金方法需要满足连续性要求，在处理含非均匀材料的界面问题时面临挑战；现有的无网格界面方法往往需要专门的数值积分技术。作者旨在消除这一需求，提供一个系统的数学框架来解决界面问题。
AI.method: 本研究基于FPM框架，采用经由广义有限差分方法构造的简单、局部、基于点的多项式试函数和检验函数。由于这些函数是不连续的，打破了标准伽辽金框架的连续性约束，从而天然处理界面处主变量和次变量的不连续性。为弥补不连续引起的不一致性，引入受间断伽辽金方法启发的数值通量修正方案。
AI.result: 通过多个基准算例对所提方法进行了验证，结果表明该方法在求解非均匀材料接口问题时兼具高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该增强型FPM成功提供了一种无需专用数值积分技术的无网格界面求解方案，为含非均匀材料界面的偏微分方程问题提供了系统性的数学基础，具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Near-Horizon Tidal Disruption Events
summary: Tidal disruption events (TDEs) offer a unique dynamical probe of the spacetime geometry around supermassive black holes (SMBHs). While conventional TDEs occur around SMBHs of $M_\bullet \sim 10^6 - 10^7 M_\odot$, where stars are disrupted far from the event horizon, here we identify a special class of TDEs around rapidly spinning SMBHs with masses $M_\bullet \gtrsim 10^8 M_\odot$, where the tidal-disruption radius approaches the gravitational radius. We term these events "near-horizon TDEs" and, by calculating geodesics in Kerr spacetime, investigate how the proximity of the horizon modifies the debris evolution and subsequent fallback. We find that for stars encountering the SMBH on parabolic orbits, up to $\sim (90 \%-95 \%)$ of the stellar debris either plunges directly into the SMBH or escapes the system. Bound orbits, by contrast, retain a substantially larger fraction of the debris. Using the resulting debris distribution, we calculate the fallback rates and find that bound orbits produce intrinsically higher peak fallback rates and shorter decay timescales, by factors of $\sim 10^3$ relative to parabolic orbits. However, when the stellar orbital angular momentum is particularly low, the peak fallback rate can be substantially suppressed by debris lost to plunge orbits. This combination of rapid fallback and a mass deficit naturally explains overluminous TDEs such as ASASSN-15lh, which standard TDE models have struggled to reproduce. Our work establishes near-horizon TDEs as a new probe of strong-field gravity and a promising tool for identifying massive, rapidly spinning SMBHs.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并研究了一类新型的"近地平线潮汐瓦解事件"(near-horizon TDEs)，即发生在质量≥10^8太阳质量、快速旋转的超大质量黑洞周围的潮汐瓦解事件。由于潮汐瓦解半径接近引力半径，事件视界的接近从根本上改变了碎片演化和回降过程。研究发现束缚轨道产生的回降率峰值和衰减时标与抛物轨道相差约10^3倍，且可自然解释ASASSN-15lh等过亮TDE事件。
AI.motivation: 传统潮汐瓦解事件(TDEs)发生在质量约10^6-10^7太阳质量的黑洞周围，此时恒星在远离事件视界处被瓦解。然而，在质量更大(≥10^8太阳质量)且快速旋转的超大质量黑洞周围，潮汐瓦解半径接近引力半径，视界附近的强引力效应将显著影响碎片演化。现有标准TDE模型难以解释某些过亮事件（如ASASSN-15lh），因此需要在强场引力框架下探索新型TDE事件。
AI.method: 作者在Kerr时空中计算测地线，系统的近地平线TDEs。具体包括：(1) 识别质量≥10^8太阳质量、快速旋转SMBH周围潮汐瓦解半径接近引力半径的事件类别；(2) 通过Kerr测地线计算研究视界邻近度对碎片演化和回降的影响；(3) 比较抛物轨道和束缚轨道两种情形下的碎片保留与损失；(4) 基于碎片分布计算回降率。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 对抛物轨道相遇的恒星，约90%-95%的碎片直接坠入黑洞或逃逸系统；(2) 束缚轨道能保留显著更多碎片；(3) 束缚轨道产生的峰值回降率比抛物轨道高约10^3倍，且衰减时标更短；(4) 当恒星轨道角动量特别低时，碎片坠入导致峰值回降率被显著抑制；(5) 快速回降与质量亏损的组合可自然解释ASASSN-15lh等标准模型难以解释的过亮TDEs。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作确立了近地平线TDEs作为强场引力新探针的地位，并为识别大质量、快速旋转的超大质量黑洞提供了有前景的工具。该发现展示了近地平线TDEs如何为强引力区域的研究开辟新途径。

title: Counting Representations of Quadratic Forms
summary: We answer a question of C. S. Herz about the number of integral $k\times m$ matrices $T$ such that $T^tT\leq R$ for a fixed positive definite $m\times m$ matrix $R$. We give an asymptotic formula for the count. This can be seen as a generalization of the Gauss circle problem, as counting representation of quadratic forms by the identity $I_k$, and as counting integral points bounded by the Stiefel manifold $T^tT=R$. The main tool is a bound for Bessel functions of matrix argument that was proved over Jordan algebras.

AI.tldr: 本文回答Herz关于计数满足T^tT ≤ R的整数k×m矩阵T数量的问题，给出了渐近公式，可作为Gauss圆问题的推广。
AI.motivation: Herz提出了关于整数矩阵计数的问题。该问题同时可视为Gauss圆问题、二次型表示计数（by identity I_k）、以及Stiefel流形T^tT=R上有界整数点计数的推广，具有重要的数论与几何意义。
AI.method: 主要工具是利用在Jordan代数上证明的矩阵参数Bessel函数的界，通过该解析工具导出计数函数的渐近公式。
AI.result: 给出了满足T^tT≤R的整数k×m矩阵T的数量（固定正定m×m矩阵R）的渐近公式。
AI.conclusion: 该结果推广了经典的Gauss圆问题及相关二次型表示计数问题，并展示了Jordan代数上矩阵参数Bessel函数界在数论计数问题中的有效应用。

title: On spectral properties of Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz
summary: The Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz with mean-field propagators is increasingly used to simulate non-equilibrium quantum fermionic and bosonic systems. Compared with the full Kadanoff--Baym equations, its mean-field propagators substantially reduce computational cost, enabling simulations with computational effort that scales linearly with propagation time. However, the time-diagonal structure of the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz obscures spectral properties within the collision integral of the transport equation. Here, we recover and investigate these hidden spectral properties using the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz. For a Hubbard cluster, we compare ground-state spectral functions obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz against those from standard Kadanoff--Baym equations. At moderate interaction strengths, the spectral functions show good agreement. At large interaction strengths, however, significant deviations emerge, and the spectral function obtained with the extended Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz becomes negative. These results demonstrate that, despite its computational advantages, the Generalized Kadanoff--Baym Ansatz has important limitations in strongly interacting regimes and may produce unphysical spectral properties when interactions become sufficiently large.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带有平均场传播子的广义Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz(GKBA)在非平衡量子费米子和玻色子系统模拟中的应用，通过扩展GKBA恢复并研究了其碰撞积分中被隐藏的谱性质。研究发现，在中等相互作用强度下谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程结果吻合良好，但在强相互作用区域出现显著偏差，甚至产生负的谱函数，揭示了GKBA在强关联体系中的局限性。
AI.motivation: GKBA因其计算成本随传播时间线性增长而被广泛用于非平衡量子系统的模拟，但其时间对角结构导致输运方程碰撞积分中的谱性质被遮蔽，而这些隐藏的谱特性尚未被系统研究。作者旨在通过扩展GKBA方法来揭示这些潜在问题。
AI.method: 采用扩展广义Kadanoff-Baym Ansatz(extended GKBA)来恢复标准GKBA中被遮蔽的谱信息，并在Hubbard团簇模型上，将扩展GKBA得到的基态谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程的结果进行对比分析，考察不同相互作用强度下的表现。
AI.result: 在中等相互作用强度下，扩展GKBA得到的谱函数与标准Kadanoff-Baym方程结果吻合良好；但在大相互作用强度下出现显著偏差，且扩展GKBA得到的谱函数变为负值，表明GKBA产生了非物理的谱特性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管GKBA具有显著的计算优势（计算时间线性增长），但在强相互作用区域存在重要局限，可能产生非物理的谱性质，因此在使用GKBA时需谨慎对待强关联体系的模拟结果。

title: Gramian-Informed Framework for Edge Flow Network Analysis Against Nodal Attacks
summary: We study the first-order effects of nodal inputs on edge flows of network systems through controllability Gramians. We consider both discrete- and continuous-time dynamics subject to impulse and step input disturbances. To characterize their impact on network behavior, we introduce the notion of a vulnerability matrix (VM) and provide explicit Gramian-based expressions that reveal the critical role played by the interplay between network topology and dynamics. For the class of directed line networks, we particularize these closed-form expressions in terms of edge weights, input duration, and graph distance to the nodal input. Numerical simulations on directed line and random Erdős-Rényi networks show a tight correspondence between influential nodes identified with the VM and conventional time-domain performance metrics, such as $\mathscr{H}_2$ and $\mathscr{H}_{\infty}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究节点输入对网络系统边流的一阶影响，通过可控性格拉姆矩阵引入脆弱性矩阵（VM）概念，提供基于格拉姆矩阵的显式表达式，刻画网络拓扑与动力学交互的关键作用。对定向线网络的闭式表达式以边权、输入持续时间和图距离为依据，数值实验表明VM识别的影响节点与H2/H∞时域指标高度一致。
AI.motivation: 网络系统中，外部扰动或节点输入如何影响边上的流量是一个基础但重要的问题。现有方法多侧重于节点层面的可控性分析，缺乏对边流层面影响的系统性度量。作者旨在建立一种基于可控性格拉姆矩阵的形式化框架，量化节点输入对边流的首阶影响，从而为网络的脆弱性评估提供理论工具。
AI.method: 本研究同时考虑离散时间和连续时间动力学，分别对脉冲和阶跃输入扰动进行建模。核心方法是引入脆弱性矩阵（VM）概念，推导出基于可控性格拉姆矩阵的显式闭式表达式。对于定向线网络这一特殊图类，将表达式进一步具体化为边权、输入持续时间及到节点输入的图距离的函数。最后，通过定向线网络和随机Erdős-Rényi网络上的数值仿真验证方法有效性。
AI.result: 数值模拟结果表明，VM识别出的高影响节点与传统的时域性能指标（H2范数和H∞范数）所量化的结果之间存在紧密的对应关系，验证了VM作为网络脆弱性度量的有效性。同时，定向线网络的闭式解揭示了网络拓扑（图距离）与动力学参数（边权、输入时长）对边流影响的显式交互规律。
AI.conclusion: 本文为网络系统中节点输入对边流的影响提供了一种基于可控性格拉姆矩阵的系统化度量框架。脆弱性矩阵（VM）不仅能够在不同动力学设定（离散/连续、脉冲/阶跃）下统一刻画这种影响，还与经典的H2/H∞性能指标高度一致，可作为网络脆弱性分析和关键节点辨识的有效工具。

title: LANTERN: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for VLM-Based Cooperative Driving with Temporally Grounded Warnings
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, and 8 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: We present LANTERN, a closed-loop benchmark for temporally grounded cooperative warnings. LANTERN separates warning onset, hazard onset, warning termination, and post-hazard recovery, and evaluates each physical event under matched warning and no-warning executions so that the warning's contribution is measured in isolation rather than confounded with onboard vision. The benchmark spans six safety-critical scenario families and provides 3,272 sequences with 236,309 frames for training, together with 120 matched route pairs for closed-loop evaluation. Each hazard route is evaluated under the warning and no-warning conditions, while its no-hazard control penalizes unconditional braking. We further introduce the Cooperative Unified Score (CUS), a safety-gated metric that jointly rewards route progress, anticipation, clearance, and recovery. Fine-tuning a representative VLM driving model raises CUS from 34.6 without warnings to 75.5 with them, demonstrating both the value of cooperative warnings and the discriminative power of the paired protocol. All resources will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LANTERN，一个用于时间上落地的协同预警闭环基准测试，通过配对（有/无预警）执行协议将预警贡献与车载视觉解耦，并提出安全门控的协作统一评分（CUS）指标。在代表性VLM驾驶模型上，预警将CUS从34.6提升至75.5。
AI.motivation: 现有协同预警基准未能将预警的实际贡献与车载视觉能力分离测量，导致评估结果受感知方差干扰；同时缺乏对预警开始、危险发生、预警终止及危险后恢复等时间事件的精细定义与物理场景级别的隔离评估。
AI.method: 1) 设计闭环基准LANTERN，将预警时间轴分为四个阶段（预警开始、危险发生、预警终止、危险后恢复）；2) 对每个物理事件构建匹配的有预警与无预警双条件执行，确保预警贡献被单独度量；3) 涵盖6类安全关键场景家族，提供3,272条训练序列（236,309帧）及120条配对闭环评估路线；4) 采用无危险对照组惩罚无条件刹车行为；5) 引入安全门控的CUS指标，联合评估路线进展、预判、清障与恢复。
AI.result: 对代表性VLM驾驶模型进行微调，有预警条件下CUS从34.6提升至75.5，证明了协同预警的有效性以及配对协议在评估中的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: LANTERN为协同预警系统提供了更严谨、可区分的闭环评估框架，消除了感知混淆偏差，并验证了结构化对标方法在量化预警系统附加值方面的价值。所有资源将公开。

title: Data Assimilation with Sparse Observations
summary: Data assimilation by nudging (also called CDA) yields exponentially decaying errors and an infinite predictability horizon if the method parameter is large enough and the observations are frequent enough in time and dense enough in space. We consider the complementary case of moderate parameters and sparse and infrequent observations. We prove that assimilation with any data and any(positive) parameter strictly decreases errors and strictly increases the (now finite) predictability horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种称为"nudging"（即连续数据同化，CDA）的方法，证明了即使观测稀疏且不频繁、参数适中（而非参数足够大），该方法仍能严格减少误差并严格延长（虽然有限的）可预测性期限。
AI.motivation: 以往的研究表明，当nudging方法的参数足够大、观测在时间和空间上足够密集时，误差呈指数衰减且可预测性期限为无限。本文旨在填补参数适中、观测稀疏且不频繁这一互补情形下理论分析的空白。
AI.method: 采用数学证明的方法，针对连续数据同化（CDA）中参数适中、观测时空稀疏且不频繁的情况进行理论分析，证明误差的严格递减性和可预测性期限的严格增加性。
AI.result: 证明了在参数为正且任意数据的情况下，nudging同化方法总能严格减小误差，并使（原本有限）的可预测性期限得到严格延长。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将连续数据同化的理论基础从理想条件下的指数收敛（无限预测期限）拓展到了更实际、更一般的观测条件下，表明即使在中等参数和稀疏观测情境下，nudging方法依然具备有价值的预测增强效果。

title: Sharpening the Mass Measurement of PSR J1048+2339 via High-Cadence Photometry
summary: Neutron stars are among the densest objects in the universe, and the mass measurements are crucial to the understanding of their equation of state. Pulsars in tight binaries can be weighed dynamically, but accurate mass estimates are often hampered by uncertainties in orbital inclinations. In this paper, we report on multi-epoch optical monitoring of the pulsar binary, PSR J1048+2339, using the 0.5-m RIFT telescope at Lulin Observatory. Our observations reveal frequent optical flares with eclipses caused by the companion. Using the eclipse duration with archival photometric data and orbital ephemeris in the literature, we constrain the inclination to 78.0+/-1.0 degrees and the pulsar mass to 1.79 (+0.09, -0.08) solar masses. This measurement is among the most precise for any redback system to date, demonstrating a novel way to improve the pulsar mass measures with small aperture optical telescopes. Furthermore, the optical eclipse duration is significantly shorter than that measured in M/GeV gamma-rays, possibly suggesting that a fraction of the eclipsed gamma-ray emission originates from the apex of the intrabinary shock. Based on these constraints, we estimate the magnetic field strength of the companion to be 30-170 G. This is consistent with the high field strength implied by the X-ray orbital modulation observed.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用鹿林天文台0.5米RIFT望远镜对脉冲星双星系统PSR J1048+2339进行多历元光学监测，通过光食变持续时间结合档案测光数据与轨道星历，将轨道倾角约束为78.0±1.0度，脉冲星质量测定为1.79(+0.09,-0.08)太阳质量，这是红背系统中精度最高的质量测量之一。
AI.motivation: 中子星是宇宙中最致密的物体之一，其质量测量对于理解物态方程至关重要。紧密双星系统中的脉冲星可以通过动力学方法称重，但精确的质量估计常受轨道倾角不确定性的阻碍。本研究旨在通过小型光学望远镜的光学光食观测来改进这一限制。
AI.method: 对PSR J1048+2339进行多历元光学监测，利用光学耀斑和伴星引起的光食现象，结合文献中的档案测光数据与轨道星历，通过食持续时长约束轨道倾角，进而推导脉冲星质量。
AI.result: 将轨道倾角约束为78.0±1.0度，脉冲星质量测定为1.79(+0.09,-0.08)太阳质量；发现光学食持续时间显著短于M/GeV伽马射线食，可能表明部分被食的伽马射线发射源于双星内激波顶端；估算了伴星磁场强度为30-170高斯。
AI.conclusion: 该测量是红背系统中最精确的质量测量之一，展示了利用小型口径光学望远镜改进脉冲星质量测量的新方法，并为伴星磁场强度提供了与X射线观测一致的新约束。

title: A Proof of Bala's Congruence Conjectures for A158690
summary: Let $a(n)$ be the sequence A158690 in the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), defined by the exponential generating function $\sum_{n\ge0} a(n)t^n/n! = 1+\sum_{m\ge1}\prod_{j=1}^m(1-e^{-(2j-1)t})$. We prove two congruence conjectures of Peter Bala. The first states that, for every integer $k\ge1$, the sequence $a(n)$ modulo $k$ is eventually periodic with period dividing $\varphi(k)$. We prove the stronger statement that the Carmichael function $λ(k)$ is an eventual period. The second conjecture asserts the shifted Gauss congruences $a(np^r+i)\equiv a(np^{r-1}+i)\pmod{p^r}$ for every $i\ge0$, every prime $p$, and all $n,r\ge1$. Both results follow from a general theorem for exponential generating functions of the form $G(e^t-1)$ with $G\in\mathbb Z[[y]]$, together with the standard power-sum formula for Stirling numbers of the second kind.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Peter Bala关于OEIS序列A158690的两个同余猜想：其一是该序列模任意整数k最终周期且周期整除Carmichael函数λ(k)（比原猜想中φ(k)更强的结论）；其二是移位Gauss同余 a(np^r+i)≡a(np^{r-1}+i) (mod p^r)。两个结果均由关于形如G(e^t-1)的指数生成函数的一般定理结合第二类Stirling数的幂和公式推导得出。
AI.motivation: 该论文旨在解决Peter Bala提出的关于序列A158690的两个同余猜想。A158690是由特定指数生成函数定义的整数序列，其周期性和同余性质此前一直是悬而未决的问题。该工作不仅验证了猜想，还通过证明更强的周期结论（以Carmichael函数取代Euler函数）推进了对这类由e^t代入幂级数生成的指数生成函数所对应序列同余性质的理解。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个一般性定理，适用于形式为G(e^t-1)的指数生成函数（其中G∈Z[[y]]），该定理给出此类生成函数对应系数序列的模周期性质及移位Gauss同余。关键工具是第二类Stirling数的标准幂和公式。通过验证所研究的生成函数恰好属于上述形式，并将一般定理特化，即可同时获得两个猜想所需的结论。
AI.result: 1) 证明了序列a(n)模任意整数k是最终周期的，且周期整除Carmichael函数λ(k)，这强于Bala原猜想中周期整除φ(k)的表述。2) 证明了移位Gauss同余a(np^r+i)≡a(np^{r-1}+i) (mod p^r)对所有i≥0、素数p及n,r≥1成立。
AI.conclusion: 该论文完整解决了Bala的两个同余猜想，并将结果推广至更一般的情形：任何由G(e^t-1)（G∈Z[[y]]）生成的指数生成函数系数序列，其模周期性和移位Gauss同余性质均受此一般理论支配，表明所研究现象的深层结构源于第二类Stirling数的同余特性。

title: Green's Functions from Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization: An Impurity Solver for Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
summary: We generalize the sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization (SKQD) method from ground-state calculations to the evaluation of single-particle Green's functions. By constructing and sampling unitary Krylov subspaces in the N +/- 1 particle-number sectors and evaluating all sector-connecting overlaps classically, the approach reconstructs the Green's function via a Lanczos continued fraction while retaining the shallow-circuit, ancilla-free character of SKQD. The quantum device is required only to prepare and sample short-time evolutions. Applied to the particle-hole-symmetric single-impurity Anderson model in chain geometry, with the discrete bath representation used in dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), the method recovers the spectral function using a relatively small fraction of the full Hilbert space. Across a range of interaction strengths that spans the metal-insulator transition, the main spectral features are reproduced. These results suggest that SKQD-based Green's-function calculations may allow DMFT impurity solvers with a larger number of bath sites on near-term quantum hardware than is currently practical.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于样本的Krylov量子对角化（SKQD）方法从基态计算推广到单粒子格林函数的计算。通过在N±1粒子数扇区构造并采样酉Krylov子空间，并经典地评估所有连接扇区的重叠，该方法通过Lanczos连分式重构格林函数，同时保留了SKQD的浅电路和无辅助比特特性。量子设备仅需制备和采样短时演化。在粒子-空穴对称的单杂质Anderson模型的链几何中（使用DMFT中的离散浴表示），该方法能用相对较小的完整希尔伯特空间子集恢复谱函数。在跨越金属-绝缘体相变的多种相互作用强度范围内，主要谱特征均被重现。结果表明，基于SKQD的格林函数计算可能使DMFT杂质求解器在近端量子硬件上处理比当前实际可行的更多浴位点。
AI.motivation: 目前的量子计算方法对DMFT杂质求解器的实用性有限，主要受限于所需浴位点数量难以在近期量子硬件上实现。SKQD方法此前仅用于基态能量计算，尚未推广到格林函数（频率分辨的谱性质）计算领域，而格林函数对于研究强关联体系（如金属-绝缘体相变）至关重要。作者旨在将SKQD的能力扩展到单粒子格林函数计算，以突破当前量子硬件的实用瓶颈。
AI.method: 将SKQD从基态推广至格林函数计算。具体而言：（1）在N+1和N-1两个粒子数扇区分别构造和采样酉Krylov子空间；（2）在经典侧计算所有连接不同粒子数扇区的重叠矩阵元；（3）利用这些量通过Lanczos连分式重构单粒子格林函数；（4）整个过程中量子设备仅需制备并采样短时幺正演化，保持浅电路深度且无需辅助量子比特。方法在粒子-空穴对称的单杂质Anderson模型（链几何 + DMFT离散浴表示）上进行了验证。
AI.result: 在粒子-空穴对称单杂质Anderson模型的链几何中，该方法利用完整希尔伯特空间的相对较小子集即可恢复谱函数。在跨越金属-绝缘体相变的多种相互作用强度范围内，主要谱特征均被成功重现，验证了方法的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 基于SKQD的格林函数计算方法有望使DMFT杂质求解器在近期量子硬件上支持更多的浴位点数，这超出目前实际可行的范围。该工作为强关联量子多体系统在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上的频率分辨谱计算开辟了新途径。

title: First-Order Optimization under Uniform Nondegeneracy: Geometry, Computation, and Information
summary: Strongly convex minimization and its natural indefinite extension to strongly convex--strongly concave minimax problems combine quantitative control of curvature with a prescribed curvature orientation. We disentangle these two roles by retaining uniform nondegeneracy alone: curvature remains uniformly separated from zero but may have either sign, with no prescribed positive--negative splitting. Surprisingly, a large part of the familiar theory nevertheless re-emerges. We first derive an intrinsic formulation through first-order secant inequalities, making the gradient on $\mathbb{R}^d$ a global bi-Lipschitz homeomorphism and yielding a unique stationary point. We then pair signed Moreau envelopes to construct a smooth scalar merit that recovers the missing descent geometry at both zeroth and first order, and the resulting paired proximal descent method achieves global linear convergence with dimension-free first-order oracle complexity. Meanwhile, we show that this tractability can break down on restricted domains: merely assuming the existence of a stationary point in the domain may lead to the curse of dimensionality, even with access to an infinite-order oracle. To overcome this information barrier, we introduce certified feasibility, an observable localization condition that enables feasible continuation. Together, these results establish a first-order optimization theory under uniform nondegeneracy that spans geometry, computation, and information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"均匀非退化"（曲率一致远离零但符号可正可负）条件下的凸最小化与强凸-强凹极小极大问题的推广。作者通过一阶割线不等式建立内在刻画，引入符号莫罗包络构造平滑标量蜜物函数，提出配对近端下降方法实现全局线性收敛与维度无关的一阶oracle复杂度；同时揭示了受限域上该可处理性可能崩溃（即使有无限阶oracle也可能遭遇维度灾难），并提出"可认证可行性"这一可观测局部化条件来克服信息障碍。
AI.motivation: 传统强凸最小化及强凸-强凹极小极大问题要求曲率具有"控制性"（定量大小）且"方向性"（正负号有规定的分割）。作者希望将这两个角色解耦：只保留曲率一致远离零这一条件（均匀非退化），允许曲率符号任意，探索在此更宽松假设下理论能在多大程度上保留。
AI.method: 1) 通过一阶割线不等式给出内在（intrinsic）刻画，证明梯度是$\mathbb{R}^d$上的全局双Lipschitz同胚，从而存在唯一驻点；2) 配对两个带符号的moreau包络来构造一个平滑标量蜜物函数，在零阶和一阶上恢复缺失的下降几何；3) 提出配对近端下降方法；4) 研究受限域情形，证明仅假设域内存在驻点可能导致维度灾难（即使有无限阶oracle）；5) 引入"可认证可行性"（certified feasibility）条件实现可行延拓。
AI.result: 配对近端下降方法在均匀非退化条件下达到全局线性收敛，并具有维度无关的一阶oracle复杂度。在无约束设定下问题可处理；但在受限域上，仅假设存在驻点仍可能遭遇信息层面的根本障碍（高维不可处理性），而"可认证可行性"条件可作为可观测的局部化条件克服此信息屏障。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了一个横跨几何、计算与信息三个层面的均匀非退化一阶优化理论，表明曲率符号规定的丧失并不导致整个理论的崩溃，但受限域上的可处理性依赖于更强的可观测结构条件。

title: OVMAN: A Task and Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary Motion-Aware Navigation
summary: Homes change between a robot's visits. Navigation benchmarks pose their goals in the world the agent currently sees, and the two-visit benchmarks that exist score recall or rearrangement rather than navigation. None of them can express go to the chair that was moved or go to where the vase used to be. OVMAN is a task in which an agent tours a scene, returns after a scripted change, and must navigate to a goal specified by the change itself. Two of its six change relations answer with a place an object has left, where nothing remains to be detected. We release 219 two-visit episodes, each certified solvable by an oracle agent that completes it three times. Two released systems fail as predicted. A zero-shot object-goal navigator reaches the change-defined target in 11.4% of episodes and essentially fails at vacated locations, 0.000 on former and 0.025 on removed. A self-maintaining open-vocabulary map answers past-tense queries at about a third of the rate of the same maps read as two visits, even when grounding is supplied. A simple two-visit reference agent reaches 45.2% when navigating, against an embodied oracle of 99.5%. An error decomposition places the remaining difficulty in open-vocabulary instance grounding rather than in geometry or in selecting the answer once positions are known.

AI.tldr: OVMAN是一个两访导航基准任务：智能体先参观场景，在场景发生脚本化变化后返回，并导航到由变化本身定义的目标位置。该任务包含六种变化关系，其中两种要求导航到物体离开后的空缺位置。论文发布了219个两访回合（均可由oracle验证可解），并测试了现有系统，发现它们在该任务上表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的导航基准都在当前可见的世界中设定目标，已有的两访基准只评估重排或召回而非导航能力，无法表达诸如"去被移动的椅子那里"或"去花瓶原来所在的位置"这类需要跨访问记忆和变化推理的目标。这揭示了一个能力缺口。
AI.method: OVMAN任务：智能体先参观场景，场景发生脚本化变化后返回，目标由变化本身定义（六类变化关系）。其中两类关系需要回答"物体离开后的位置"，该位置已无残留物体可检测。论文发布219个两访回合数据，并通过oracle智能体三重复跑来认证可解性。测试了零样本object-goal导航器和自维护开放词汇地图系统。
AI.result: 零样本object-goal导航器仅在11.4%回合中到达变化定义的目标；在前位置（former）上得分为0.000，在移走（removed）位置上为0.025，基本失败。自维护的开放词汇地图在处理过去时态查询时，即使提供grounding支撑，其成功率也仅为同地图以两访读取时的约三分之一。一个简单的两访参考智能体导航成功率达45.2%，而具身oracle为99.5%。误差分解显示剩余困难主要在于开放词汇实例grounding，而非几何或位置已知后的答案选择。
AI.conclusion: 现有导航系统无法有效处理跨访变化驱动的目标导航任务，核心瓶颈在于开放词汇级别的实例grounding能力，而非几何推理或答案选择。OVMAN基准为该难题提供了可用的评测平台。

title: Null--Space--Free 6D Spectral Embedding with Local Rayleigh Quotient Recovery for 3D Quasiperiodic Maxwell's Eigenproblems
summary: We develop a numerical framework for three-dimensional quasiperiodic Maxwell eigenvalue problems obtained through a six-dimensional periodic embedding. A projected Bloch--Fourier discretization yields a structured generalized eigenvalue problem with a large gradient-type kernel. Explicit orthonormal bases for the longitudinal and transverse subspaces remove this kernel exactly and reduce the original generalized eigenvalue problem to a null-space-free standard eigenvalue problem containing only the positive spectrum. An explicit inverse representation of the reduced operator avoids nested inner--outer linear solves and leads to an inverse Lanczos method whose main inner computation is a Hermitian positive definite conjugate-gradient solve with condition number bounded by that of the mass matrix; a residual estimate quantifies the effect of inner solves on the inverse Ritz pairs. To recover the computed modes in physical space, the six-dimensional Fourier eigenvectors are reconstructed on a three-dimensional Yee grid by a separated multi-center Taylor expansion, which avoids the dense Fourier-to-grid phase matrix and remains practical when direct dense reconstruction becomes prohibitively expensive. Local weighted Rayleigh quotients provide an independent physical-space validation, and their mass-weighted expectation is proved to equal the cropped Yee Rayleigh quotient under a partition-of-unity condition. Numerical experiments confirm the accuracy and computational effectiveness of the proposed framework and its physical-space recovery of three-dimensional quasiperiodic Maxwell modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过六维周期嵌入求解三维准周期麦克斯韦特征值问题的数值框架，利用投影Bloch–Fourier离散化、显式正交基消除核以及逆Lanczos方法，并结合多中心Taylor展开在物理空间重构模式，实现了大规模三维准周期光子模式的高效计算。
AI.motivation: 三维准周期结构的麦克斯韦特征值问题在物理上具有重要应用，但其数值求解面临两大挑战：一是六维周期嵌入导致离散化后产生大型梯度型核，直接求解广义特征值问题困难；二是傅里叶域到物理空间（三维Yee网格）的稠密重构矩阵计算代价过高，难以实际应用。已有方法缺乏系统、高效且可验证的数值框架。
AI.method: 本文方法包含以下关键步骤：（1）通过六维周期嵌入将三维准周期问题转化为周期特征值问题，采用投影Bloch–Fourier离散化得到结构化广义特征值问题；（2）构造纵向与横向子空间的显式标准正交基，精确去除梯度型核，将广义特征值问题约化为仅含正谱的无核标准特征值问题；（3）给出约化算子的显式逆表示，避免嵌套内外层线性求解，进而提出逆Lanczos方法，其内层核心计算为Hermitian正定共轭梯度求解，条件数受质量矩阵约束；（4）通过残差估计量化内层求解对逆Ritz对的影响；（5）在物理空间恢复时，利用分离多中心Taylor展开在三维Yee网格上重构六维Fourier特征向量，避免稠密傅里叶到网格相位矩阵；（6）采用局部加权Rayleigh商进行独立物理空间验证，并在单位分解条件下证明其质量加权期望等于裁剪后的Yee Rayleigh商。
AI.result: 数值实验证实了该框架的精度和计算有效性，以及其三维准周期麦克斯韦模式物理空间恢复的能力。包括核的精确消除、逆Lanczos方法的高效性、多中心Taylor展开重构的可行性以及Rayleigh商验证的一致性均得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个完整的数值框架，系统地解决了三维准周期麦克斯韦特征值问题中核处理、约化算子求逆和物理空间重构等核心难题，为大规模准周期光子结构模拟提供了高效且经过严格数学验证的算法路径。

title: Nuclear equation-of-state effects on the two-dimensional post-outburst thermal evolution of magnetized neutron-star crusts
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to Chinese Physics C
summary: We present a controlled two-dimensional study of nuclear-equation-of-state (EOS) effects on the post-outburst thermal relaxation of magnetized neutron-star crusts. Six EOS models are evolved at a fixed gravitational mass of $1.4 M_{\odot}$ with EOS-specific TOV backgrounds, crust compositions, and transport inputs under identical magnetic-field and heating prescriptions. Our analysis combines self-consistent multi-EOS evolution with a BSk-family factorization that separates structural, microphysical, and interaction contributions, together with an accepted-step energy ledger and a numerical-sensitivity budget. The models show EOS-dependent changes in both the early response and the later redistribution of heat between the surface, crust, and inner boundary; light-curve crossings near $10^2$ days demonstrate that the EOS effect is not a simple luminosity rescaling. By 1000 days the cumulative surface-photon energy fraction differs by less than one percentage point, whereas the internal energy partition differs much more strongly. The updated sensitivity tests show that the late-time luminosity differences and the largest peak contrasts exceed the corresponding BSk24 numerical-sensitivity scales, while the smallest early peak contrast remains less securely resolved. The calculations are intended as a reproducible EOS-sensitivity benchmark rather than an observational fit.

AI.tldr: 本文对磁化中子星外壳在爆发后的热弛豫进行了受控的二维核状态方程(EOS)效应研究,使用六个EOS模型在固定引力质量下进行演化,结合BSk系列因子化分析、能量记账和数值灵敏度预算,揭示EOS效应并非简单的光度重标定,而是影响热在表面、外壳和内边界之间的再分配。
AI.motivation: 理解核物质状态方程如何影响中子星外壳爆发后的热弛豫过程,此前缺乏在一致磁场和加热方案下对多个EOS模型进行系统性比较的受控研究。
AI.method: 在固定引力质量1.4M☉下,采用六个EOS模型并配备EOS特定的TOV背景、外壳组成和输运输入;采用与BSk族因子化相结合的自洽多EOS演化方法,分离结构、微观物理和相互作用贡献;辅以接受的步长能量账本和数值灵敏度预算;进行二维磁化外壳热演化。
AI.result: EOS相关变化出现在早期响应和后期热再分配中;约10²天处的光变曲线交叉表明EOS效应非简单光度重标定;1000天时累计表面光子能量分数差异小于1个百分点,但内能分配差异显著;后期光度差异和最大峰对比度超过BSk24数值灵敏度尺度,而最小早期峰对比度分辨率不足。
AI.conclusion: 该工作旨在作为可复现的EOS灵敏度基准而非观测拟合,表明EOS效应对中子星外壳热弛豫的晚期行为有实质影响,需以数值灵敏度为参照谨慎解读。

title: Parameterized partial theta identities and a unified $q$-difference proof
summary: We establish five families of integer-parameter extensions of Ramanujan's partial theta identities. The families follow from a common two-parameter specialization of Andrews' transformation, for which we give an independent proof based on a $q$-difference recurrence and a boundary estimate. Specializations of the integer parameter recover six identities from Ramanujan's lost notebook. As an application, a residue argument applied to the fifth family gives an integer-parameter extension of Lovejoy's residual identity, from which we construct a corresponding family of conjugate Bailey pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了拉马努金部分theta恒等式的五族整数参数推广，源于Andrews变换的一个共同双参数特化，并通过对五族应用留数论证得到Lovejoy残差恒等式的整数参数推广，进而构造共轭Bailey对。
AI.motivation: 将拉马努金丢失笔记本中的部分theta恒等式及其相关结果（如Lovejoy残差恒等式）推广到更一般的整数参数情形，从而在更大的参数空间内统一和理解这些恒等式。
AI.method: 利用Andrews变换的一个双参数特化作为共同来源推导五族恒等式的整数参数推广，其中该特化基于q-差分递推和边界估计给出了独立证明；对第五族应用留数论证得到Lovejoy残差恒等式的推广，并据此构造共轭Bailey对。
AI.result: 建立了五族整数参数推广的部分theta恒等式，参数取特化值时恢复拉马努金丢失笔记本中的六条恒等式；同时得到Lovejoy残差恒等式的整数参数推广和相应的共轭Bailey对族。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为拉马努金型部分theta恒等式提供了一个统一且可推广的框架，并通过构建共轭Bailey对连接了残差恒等式与q级数更广泛的理论。

title: Input-to-State Stability Framework for Fully Distributed Primal-Dual Dynamics for Quadratic GNEPs Without Multiplier Consensus
summary: Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems (GNEPs) often arise in multi-agent engineering applications that require distributed algorithms. Unlike traditional approaches that enforce consensus on multipliers, our method removes the need to share multipliers, reducing communication and improving privacy. As a result, different initializations can lead to different GNEs, including non-variational ones. We establish convergence under sufficient conditions using an input-to-state stability (ISS) framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于广义纳什均衡问题(GNEP)的分布式算法，无需共享乘子，降低了通信开销并增强了隐私性，并利用输入-状态稳定性(ISS)框架建立了收敛性条件。
AI.motivation: GNEP广泛出现在多智能体工程应用中，需要分布式算法求解。传统方法需要强制乘子达成共识（即共享乘子），这不仅增加了通信负担，还可能泄露隐私。因此需要一种无需共享乘子的分布式算法。
AI.method: 提出的方法放弃了乘子共识的约束，使得不同初始化可以收敛到不同的广义纳什均衡（包括非变分形式的GNEP解）。收敛性分析采用输入-状态稳定性(ISS)框架，给出了充分条件。
AI.result: 在ISS框架下建立了充分的收敛性条件，证明了算法在无需共享乘子的情况下仍能收敛到广义纳什均衡（可能为非变分均衡）。
AI.conclusion: 通过去除乘子共享，算法在降低通信成本和提升隐私保护的同时，借助ISS理论保证了收敛性，能够处理包括非变分均衡在内的一般情况。

title: Collision Snapshot Guided Time-Reversed Safety-Critical Scenario Generation
summary: The generation of safety-critical traffic scenarios is essential for training and evaluating autonomous vehicles. Prior approaches typically perturb the trajectories of existing agents in a traffic scenario using simplified adversarial objectives to induce safety-critical interactions, which can limit the plausibility and diversity of the generated scenarios. Although inserting new adversarial vehicles can alleviate this limitation, determining when and where to introduce them in a scenario-specific manner remains challenging. In this work, we introduce \underline{CO}llision \underline{S}napshot guided \underline{T}im\underline{E}-\underline{R}eversed safety-critical scenario generation (COSTER), a framework that leverages learned traffic priors to determine plausible collision times and locations. COSTER first constructs a collision snapshot by inserting a new vehicle in contact with the target vehicle at the identified collision state within a traffic scenario. Starting from this collision snapshot, a conditional variational autoencoder is used to perform a time-reversed rollout, reconstructing the trajectory of the inserted vehicle backward toward earlier timesteps. Experiments show that COSTER outperforms existing methods in plausibility, diversity, and data efficiency. Moreover, agents trained on COSTER-generated scenarios reduce collision rates by 31\% on safety-critical scenarios from the Waymo Open Motion Dataset while also improving ego task completion. The project website is available at https://anonym-121.github.io/COSTER/.

AI.tldr: COSTER提出了一种新型的安全关键交通场景生成框架，通过学习交通先验确定合理的碰撞时间和位置，利用碰撞快照引导时间逆向回滚生成多样化、高可信度的场景，在生成质量与下游训练效果上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全关键场景生成方法通常对已有智能体轨迹进行扰动，使用简化的对抗目标诱导安全关键交互，限制了场景的可信度与多样性；虽然插入新的对抗车辆可以缓解这一问题，但如何在场景特定方式下确定插入的时机和位置仍然困难。
AI.method: COSTER首先利用学习到的交通先验确定合理的碰撞时间和位置，构造碰撞快照（在识别出的碰撞状态下将新车辆插入到与目标车辆接触的位置）；随后从该碰撞快照出发，使用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）执行时间逆向回滚，将插入车辆的运动轨迹向更早的时间步重建。
AI.result: 实验表明COSTER在可信度（plausibility）、多样性（diversity）和数据效率（data efficiency）方面均优于现有方法；此外，在COSTER生成场景上训练的智能体，在Waymo开放运动数据集的安全关键场景上碰撞率降低了31%，同时提升了自车任务完成度。
AI.conclusion: COSTER通过"碰撞快照+时间逆向生成"的范式，有效解决了新车辆插入时机与位置难以确定的问题，生成的场景既安全关键又具可信度和多样性，并能显著提升自动驾驶智能体的安全性。

title: Uniform Inf-Sup Norm Equivalence and Robust Operator Preconditioning for Stokes Flow in tight domains with Periodic Pillars
summary:
Many microfluidic and porous-media computations reduce to the same core task: solving a Stokes saddle-point system on a domain perforated by a dense periodic array of pillars, as in deterministic lateral displacement (DLD) particle sorters. After rescaling the device to unit size, the geometry is controlled by a single dimensionless parameter $m$---the number of pillars across the device, equal to the inverse period. In realistic devices $m$ reaches the hundreds or thousands, and as it grows the Stokes inf-sup constant decays like $m^{-1}$, the pressure Schur complement becomes severely ill-conditioned, and standard block solvers slow down in proportion to the pillar density.
  We remove this bottleneck by identifying the pressure norm that the divergence operator induces on such geometries. For periodic pillar arrays in the proportional-hole regime, we prove that this inf-sup norm is uniformly equivalent to the $L^2+σ_εH^1$ $K$-functional norm at the pore scale $σ_ε\asympε$, with constants independent of the period, the pillar count $m$, and the mesh size $h$. The equivalence identifies the perforated Stokes problem with a Brinkman problem at a homogenized permeability, and its Riesz map reduces to a pressure-mass inverse plus a scaled stiffness inverse. Combined with operator preconditioning, this yields a block preconditioner built from standard algebraic-multigrid solves whose iteration count is essentially independent of both mesh size and pillar density. Two-dimensional Taylor--Hood experiments confirm the predicted robustness in mesh refinement, pillar density, geometric scale, close packing, and time step.

AI.tldr: 本文针对微流控及多孔介质计算中周期性柱体内Stokes鞍点系统的病态问题，识别出散度算子在该几何上诱导的压力范数与孔隙尺度K-泛函范数均匀等价，从而将穿孔Stokes问题与均匀化Brinkman问题联系起来，构造了一个基于代数多重网格的块预处理器，其迭代次数对网格尺寸和柱体密度几乎不敏感。
AI.motivation: 确定性横向位移（DLD）粒子分选器等设备中，需在密集周期柱体阵列上求解Stokes鞍点系统。当无量纲参数m（跨设备的柱体数/逆周期）增至数百甚至数千时，inf-sup常数随m^-1衰减，压力Schur补严重病态，标准块求解器计算变慢与柱体密度成正比。这种瓶颈严重限制了实际设备的数值模拟效率。
AI.method: 作者识别出周期性柱体阵列（比例孔径区域）上散度算子诱导的压力范数，证明了该inf-sup范数与孔隙尺度σ_ε≈ε下的L^2+σ_εH^1 K-泛函范数均匀等价，常数独立于周期、柱体数m和网格尺寸h。该等价性将穿孔Stokes问题识别为具有均匀化渗透率的Brinkman问题，其Riesz映射可约化为压力质量逆加一个缩放刚度逆，再结合算子预处理构造基于标准代数多重网格的块预处理器。
AI.result: 得到的块预处理器迭代次数在网格尺寸和柱体密度上基本独立。二维Taylor-Hood元实验验证了该方法在网格细化、柱体密度、几何尺度、近堆积排列和时间步长等多个维度上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论上破解了高柱体密度下Stokes求解器性能退化这一核心瓶颈，通过揭示穿孔几何中特有的压力范数结构，建立了从Stokes到Brinkman的连续体识别，使预处理器的复杂度与柱体密度解耦，为DLD等大规模微流控仿真提供了高效且稳健的数值框架。

title: Constraints on the Low-frequency Radio Emission of the Galactic FRB Source SGR 1935+2154
summary: We present a search for radio pulses from the Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154, a well-known source of fast radio bursts (FRBs), at $\sim$110 MHz using the Large Phased Array (LPA) of the Pushchino Radio Astronomy Observatory. Data from two active periods in 2020 (March -- May and September -- November, with $\sim 3.5$ minutes of daily coverage) were analyzed with new methods tailored to both FRB-like single pulses and pulsar-like periodic signals. No significant FRB-like pulses were found. Using Monte Carlo simulations, $3σ$ upper limits were derived for the burst rate: for a log-normal energy distribution the limit is $\sim$${10}^{1.5}~{\rm{d}}^{-1}$ for a mean of average monochromatic isotropic luminosity $L_{ν{\rm ,mean}}\sim1.3\times{10}^{29}~{\rm{erg~s^{-1}~ {Hz}^{-1}}}$ and a natural log-space scatter of $σ\sim0.85$; while for a power-law distribution it is $\sim$${10}^{1.8}~{\rm{d}}^{-1}$ for an index $β\lesssim3.0$ and a minimum average monochromatic isotropic luminosity $L_{ν{\rm{,min}}}\lesssim0.7\times{10}^{25}~{\rm{erg~s^{-1}~{Hz}^{-1}}}$. When folded at the known 3.24781628 s period of SGR 1935+2154, a weak pulse was noted (S/N $<$ 3.16), but the significance is insufficient for a secure detection of the pulsar-like emission signal. A conservative upper limit on the average monochromatic isotropic luminosity of any possible periodic emission is $2.08\times{10}^{19}~{\rm{erg~s^{-1}~{Hz}^{-1}}}$. Our results offer meaningful low-frequency upper limits on the burst rate of SGR 1935+2154, and hint for very faint pulsar-like radiation at meter wavelengths.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用普希金诺射电天文台的Large Phased Array (LPA)在约110 MHz频率下搜索了银河系磁星SGR 1935+2154的射电脉冲。分析了2020年两个活跃期的数据（3-5月和9-11月，每日约3.5分钟覆盖），采用针对FRB样单脉冲和脉冲星样周期信号的新方法。未发现显著的FRB样脉冲，通过蒙特卡洛模拟给出了爆发率3σ上限；按已知周期折叠时发现一个弱脉冲（S/N<3.16），但显著性不足以确认脉冲星样辐射。最终给出了平均单色各向同性光度上限为2.08×10^19 erg s^-1 Hz^-1。
AI.motivation: SGR 1935+2154是已知的快速射电暴（FRB）源，但其在低频（~110 MHz）下的脉冲辐射行为和周期性信号特征尚未被充分研究。本研究旨在利用低频射电观测搜索该磁星的FRB样单脉冲及脉冲星样周期信号，以填补低频段对该源研究的空白，并为其辐射机制提供约束。
AI.method: 使用普希金诺射电天文台的LPA阵列在~110 MHz频率下对SGR 1935+2154进行监测，覆盖2020年两个活跃期（3月至5月、9月至11月），每日约3.5分钟观测时间。数据分析采用两种方法：一种针对FRB样单脉冲搜索，另一种针对脉冲星样周期信号折叠分析。对于爆发率上限，使用蒙特卡洛模拟，分别假定对数正态能量分布和幂律能量分布，推导3σ置信水平下的上限。周期信号方面，按已知3.24781628秒的旋转周期进行折叠分析。
AI.result: 未发现显著的FRB样脉冲。在对数正态能量分布假设下，爆发率上限约为10^1.5 d^-1（平均单色各向同性光度~1.3×10^29 erg s^-1 Hz^-1，自然对数空间散度σ~0.85）；在幂律分布假设下，上限约为10^1.8 d^-1（谱指数β≲3.0，最小平均单色各向同性光度≲0.7×10^25 erg s^-1 Hz^-1）。按3.24781628秒周期折叠发现一个弱脉冲（S/N<3.16），但显著性不足。对可能的周期辐射，保守的周期辐射平均单色各向同性光度上限为2.08×10^19 erg s^-1 Hz^-1。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为SGR 1935+2154提供了低频波段（~110 MHz）有意义的爆发率上限，约束了其在米波波段的FRB活动。同时，折叠分析中发现的弱脉冲暗示可能存在极微弱的脉冲星样辐射，但需更高灵敏度的观测加以确认。低频弱周期辐射存在的可能性为进一步观测指明了方向。

title: The Normal Form of Smith's Matrices
summary:
For any integers $x$ and $y$, let $(x,y)$ and $[x,y]$ stand for the greatest common divisor and the least common multiple of $x$ and $y$, respectively. We denote by $|T|$ the number of elements of a finite set $T$. Let $a,b$ and $n$ be positive integers and let $S=\{x_1,...,x_n\}$ be a set of $n$ distinct positive integers. Let $(f((x_i,x_j)))$ (abbreviated by $f(S)$) and $(f([x_i,x_j]))$
  (abbreviated by $(f([S]))$) stand for the $n\times n$ matrices whose $(i,j)-$entry is $(f((x_i,x_j)))$ and $(f([x_i,x_j]))$
  respectively. In 1989, Beslin and Ligh gave a description of the lower triangular decomposition of $((x_i,x_j))$. In 1992, Bourque and Ligh showed that if $S$ is factor closed (i.e., S contains all positive divisors of any element of S), then the GCD matrix $((x_i,x_j))$ divides the LCM matrix $([x_i,x_j])$ (written as $((x_i,x_j))|([x_i,x_j])$) in the ring $M_n(\mathbb{Z})$ of $n\times n$ matrices over the integers.
  In this paper, we will show the diagonalization of $((x_i,x_j))$ and its applications. Our main new contributions are Theorems 4.1 and 4.2, which extend previous results to gcd-closed sets satisfying condition $\mathcal{G}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究整数集合S上由最大公约数(x_i,x_j)和最小公倍数[x_i,x_j]构成的n×n矩阵的分解与对角化性质。作者改进了Beslin和Ligh以及Bourque和Ligh的经典结果，将其扩展至满足条件G的gcd-closed集合，主要贡献体现在定理4.1和4.2中。
AI.motivation: GCD矩阵与LCM矩阵在数论和矩阵论中具有重要地位。Beslin和Ligh在1989年给出了GCD矩阵的下三角分解，Bourque和Ligh在1992年证明了对于因子封闭集合S，GCD矩阵整除LCM矩阵。本文旨在进一步拓展这些经典结果至更一般的gcd-closed集合（满足特定条件G），并展示对角化方法的新应用。
AI.method: 利用数论中的最大公约数、最小公倍数及其性质，通过构造满足条件G的gcd-closed集合上的GCD矩阵，建立其下三角分解与对角化方法，并将该结果应用于分析GCD矩阵与LCM矩阵之间的整除关系（在整数矩阵环M_n(Z)中）。
AI.result: 获得了定理4.1和定理4.2，将Bourque和Ligh关于因子封闭集上GCD矩阵整除LCM矩阵的经典结果推广到满足条件G的gcd-closed集合上，同时给出了GCD矩阵的对角化结果及相关应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过对GCD矩阵进行对角化分析，本文在gcd-closed集合（满足条件G）这一更广泛情形下推广了前人的经典结论，为GCD/LCM矩阵的结构研究提供了新的理论工具。

title: Equivalence Between Continuous-Time Risk-Sensitive Control and Rényi Divergence Minimization
summary: In this study, we show that a continuous-time risk-sensitive control problem is equivalent to a Rényi divergence minimization problem over trajectory path measures. Reformulating stochastic optimal control as probabilistic inference via Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimization avoids the computational intractability of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. However, standard KL control is inherently risk-neutral, and recent minimax extensions remain restricted to risk-averse settings. Our equivalence result resolves this limitation by offering a unified probabilistic framework for arbitrary risk attitudes in continuous-time nonlinear systems. Based on Girsanov theorem, we explicitly map the risk sensitivity to the Rényi divergence order, deriving a noise-dependent control penalty scaled by risk preference. This formulation seamlessly modulates tail-weighting behaviors, interpolating between zero-forcing for risk-averse policies and mass-covering for risk-seeking policies. These findings bridge stochastic control and information-theoretic inference, providing a foundation for sampling-based control algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文证明连续时间风险敏感控制问题等价于在轨迹路径测度上的Rényi散度最小化问题，通过将风险敏感度显式映射为Rényi散度阶数，构建了一个统一的风险态度概率框架，能够在零逼迫（风险厌恶）与质量覆盖（风险追求）之间平滑插值。
AI.motivation: 标准KL散度控制的随机最优控制推理框架本质上是风险中性的，而现有的minimax扩展仅适用于风险厌恶场景。这限制了概率推理视角在任意风险态度下的应用。此外，Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的计算不可解性也是推动该研究的核心动机。
AI.method: 基于Girsanov定理，作者建立了连续时间风险敏感控制问题与轨迹路径测度上Rényi散度最小化之间的等价关系，将风险敏感度显式映射为Rényi散度阶数，并推导出依赖噪声的风险偏好缩放控制惩罚项。
AI.result: 该等价关系能够无缝调节尾部加权行为，在风险厌恶策略的零逼迫行为与风险追求策略的质量覆盖行为之间实现插值，形成了一个适用于连续时间非线性系统中任意风险态度的统一概率框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究弥合了随机控制与信息论推断之间的鸿沟，为基于采样的控制算法提供了理论基础，解决了标准KL控制无法表达的任意风险偏好问题。

title: \textbf{PLATO}: \emph{Preintegration Learning from Accurate Trajectory Observations} for Neural Inertial Odometry
summary: Neural inertial odometry has demonstrated strong potential for motion estimation in challenging environments, yet inertial-only preintegration remains sensitive to IMU bias and uncertainty. To this end, this paper introduces \textbf{PLATO}:~\emph{Preintegration Learning from Accurate Trajectory Observations}, a likelihood-based framework that leverages accurate trajectory observations to jointly learn IMU bias dynamics modeled by a neural ordinary differential equation~(NODE) and gyroscope and accelerometer noise covariances. Optimization exploits the sparse structure of the negative log-likelihood, with IMU noise-parameter gradients computed by forward differentiation. A tailored double-adjoint scheme couples a discrete invariant-error adjoint with a continuous-time adjoint for the bias NODE, enabling memory-efficient likelihood optimization over the nested bias-dynamics and IMU-preintegration rollouts. Validation on EuRoC shows improved performance, and underwater robot experiments demonstrate applicability under intermittent lighting failures and visual degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLATO框架，通过联合学习IMU偏置动态（由神经ODE建模）和陀螺仪/加速度计噪声协方差，利用似然最大化优化惯性预积分参数，并在EuRoC数据集和水下机器人实验中验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 纯惯性预积分对IMU偏置和不确定性敏感，而现有的神经惯性里程计方法未能有效联合建模偏置动态和噪声统计特性，导致运动估计精度受限。
AI.method: 提出PLATO（Preintegration Learning from Accurate Trajectory Observations）似然框架，利用精确轨迹观测联合学习：1) 由神经ODE建模的IMU偏置动态；2) 陀螺仪和加速度计的噪声协方差。优化过程中利用负对数似然的稀疏结构，通过前向微分计算IMU噪声参数梯度，并提出双重伴随方案（离散不变误差伴随结合连续时间伴随）实现内存高效的嵌套偏置动态与预积分rollout的似然优化。
AI.result: 在EuRoC数据集上验证了改进性能，并在水下机器人实验中展示了在间歇性照明故障和视觉退化环境下算法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: PLATO通过联合学习偏置动态和噪声协方差，有效提升了神经惯性里程计在复杂及退化环境下的运动估计鲁棒性和精度。

title: Limiter-based fully-discrete entropy stable explicit DG schemes for ideal MHD equations
summary: We propose a class of high-order fully-discrete entropy stable (ES) explicit discontinuous Galerkin (DG) solvers for the compressible ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) equations. Our main theoretical contribution is the introduction of a novel generalized-path-decomposition framework for MHD equations in Godunov's symmetric form. By innovatively interpreting the interior volume integral of the non-conservative source term as a path integral along a generalized path constructed by the solution polynomial, we establish the weak cell entropy inequality for the fully-discrete DG schemes. This overarching framework also accommodates other existing DG solvers based on the symmetric form. Combined with a carefully designed ES limiter, the proposed scheme satisfies the genuine fully-discrete cell entropy inequality. With this property, a Lax--Wendroff-type theorem can be obtained to show that the solution limit satisfies the entropy condition. Finally, the scheme is naturally compatible with the locally divergence-free space. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the scheme's low numerical dissipation and strong robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类用于可压缩理想磁流体力学（MHD）方程的高阶全离散熵稳定（ES）显式间断伽辽金（DG）求解器，通过引入广义路径分解框架在Godunov对称形式下建立全离散弱单元熵不等式，并结合ES限制器满足真正的全离散单元熵不等式，最终通过Lax-Wendroff型定理保证解极限满足熵条件，且方案天然兼容局部无散度空间。
AI.motivation: MHD方程中非守恒源项的存在使得传统熵稳定DG格式的理论分析面临困难，尤其是在全离散层次上难以建立严格的熵不等式以保证数值解的物理合理性。
AI.method: 提出广义路径分解框架，将内部体积分中的非守恒源项创新性地解释为沿解多项式构造的广义路径的路径积分，从而在Godunov对称形式下建立全离散弱单元熵不等式；结合精心设计的ES限制器实现真正的全离散熵不等式。
AI.result: 通过Lax-Wendroff型定理证明了解的极限满足熵条件；格式天然兼容局部无散度空间；大量数值实验表明该格式具有低数值耗散和强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了基于对称形式的现有DG求解器，为MHD方程的高阶熵稳定DG格式提供了完整的全离散理论保证与实践有效性验证。

title: Supermassive black hole binaries in the multi-messenger context of ground and spaceborne VLBI
comment: Accepted by Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific (PASP) for the BHEX focus issue. 22 pages, 10 figures
summary: Evidence of a gravitational wave background suggests the existence of a population of sub-parsec supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), with characteristic angular separations on the order of 1-10 $μ$as. Spaceborne extensions of Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) and the next generation ground arrays introduce the possibility of directly imaging these SMBHBs. In this work, a binary Spectral Energy Distribution (SED) model is used to predict the detectability of SMBHBs with ground and spaceborne VLBI. We consider the Black Hole Explorer (BHEX), a proposal for a spaceborne VLBI mission, as our primary case study. We explore the detectable SMBHB parameter space and identify distinguishable binary signatures that could exist in the visibility domain. We find that for a flux-density-limited sample, ground array observations are more effective at detecting a wider region of the binary parameter space, with $M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$ solar mass systems detectable out to redshift, $z=0.075$ and beyond. Conversely, inclusion of a spaceborne element such as BHEX, offering finer angular resolution ($\sim6\,μ$as) and sampling of the (u,v) plane not limited by Earth rotation synthesis, will provide significant benefits in constraining binary properties, resulting in improvements in characterisation of the separation and position angle of SMBHBs by a factor of $\sim4$. Near-future ground and/or spaceborne VLBI may achieve the first direct observation of a SMBHB, contributing significantly to multi-messenger studies of such systems with pulsar timing arrays and observations across the electromagnetic spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过地基和天基VLBI（甚长基线干涉测量）直接成像亚秒差距级超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）的可行性。研究发现，地基阵列对于流量受限样本能探测更广的参数空间，而天基VLBI（如BHEX任务）虽探测范围略窄，但在约6微角秒的角分辨率和不受地球自转合成限制的(u,v)平面采样方面具有显著优势，可将双星分离度和位置角的表征精度提高约4倍。
AI.motivation: 引力波背景的证据暗示存在亚秒差距尺度的超大质量黑洞双星种群，其特征角间距约为1-10微角秒。天基VLBI扩展和下一代地基阵列可能直接对这些双星系统进行成像观测，因此需要量化评估其探测能力。
AI.method: 采用二元光谱能量分布（SED）模型，预测SMBHB在地基和天基VLBI下的可探测性。以BHEX（黑洞探测器）天基VLBI任务为主要案例，探索可探测的双星参数空间，并识别在可见度域中可区分的二元特征。
AI.result: 对于流量受限样本，地基阵列在探测更广的双星参数空间方面更有效，总质量大于约10^9太阳质量的系统可探测至红移z=0.075及更远。天基VLBI（如BHEX）提供约6微角秒的更精细角分辨率及不受地球自转合成限制的(u,v)平面采样，在约束双星性质方面具显著优势，分离度和位置角的表征精度提升约4倍。
AI.conclusion: 近未来的地基和/或天基VLBI可能实现对SMBHB的首次直接观测，这将显著促进与脉冲星计时阵列及全电磁频谱观测相结合的多信使研究。

title: On a problem of Nathanson related to minimal asymptotic bases and maximal asymptotic nonbases
summary: Let $\mathbb{N}_0=\{0,1,2,\ldots\}$ and let $h\ge2$ be an integer. For a set $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_0$, write $hA$ for the set of all sums of $h$, not necessarily distinct, elements of $A$. In this paper, we prove that for every $h\ge2$, there is a partition $\mathbb{N}_0=A\sqcup B$ such that $A$ is a minimal asymptotic basis of order $h$ and $B$ is a maximal asymptotic nonbasis of order $h$. This solves an open problem posed by Nathanson in 1974.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于任意整数 h≥2，可以将自然数集 N₀ 划分为两个不相交的集合 A 和 B，其中 A 是 h 阶最小渐近基，B 是 h 阶最大渐近非基，从而解决了 Nathanson 于 1974 年提出的一个开放问题。
AI.motivation: Nathanson 在 1974 年提出了一个长期未解决的开放问题：是否存在一种自然数集的划分方式，使得其中一个部分构成最小渐近基而另一部分构成最大渐近非基。本文旨在解决这一数论中的基础性问题。
AI.method: 作者通过构造性的方法，对任意整数 h≥2 显式构造出满足要求的划分 N₀ = A ⊔ B。构造中需要同时确保 A 是 h 阶最小渐近基（即 A 是 h 阶渐近基且去掉任何元素后不再成为 h 阶渐近基），B 是 h 阶最大渐近非基（即 B 不是 h 阶渐近基，但加入任何元素后都成为 h 阶渐近基）。
AI.result: 作者成功证明了对于每一个整数 h≥2，都存在这样的划分，使得 A 是 h 阶最小渐近基且 B 是 h 阶最大渐近非基，彻底解决了这个自 1974 年以来悬而未决的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完成了对 Nathanson 开放问题的最终解决，深化了人们对渐近基与渐近非基结构性质的理解，属于加性数论（additive number theory）中的一个重要成果。

title: Mapping locally nondominated curves in multiobjective topology optimization of compliance and volume
summary: This paper studies the nondominated set for topology optimization of compliance and volume. In the multiobjective topology optimization literature, scalarization is a popular method to approximate this set, which is better known as the Pareto frontier. However, previous work indicates that the pointwise approximation obtained by scalarization obfuscates its underlying mathematical structure: under an imposed length scale, it consists of locally nondominated curve segments. To investigate this structure, the paper uses a simple methodology to (i) generate local optima with a tightly controlled topology and (ii) use continuation to extend these points to locally nondominated curves. The paper then performs two rounds of numerical experiments. The first round applies the methodology to several cantilever examples. This leads to novel insights regarding topological complexity and symmetry and confirms prior conclusions regarding continuity, smoothness and convexity. The second round investigates two numerical instabilities: (i) a lack of uniqueness and (ii) discontinuities of the locally nondominated curves. The former is linked to an observed flatness of the optimization landscape, whereas the latter is attributed to branch splitting and linked to bifurcation theory. Namely, we classify these discontinuities as higher-dimensional analogues of the subcritical, symmetry-breaking pitchfork bifurcation. The paper concludes with suggestions for future research to address these features of the multiobjective optimization landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拓扑优化中柔度与体积多目标优化的非支配集（Pareto前沿），通过结合受控拓扑的局部最优生成与延拓方法构造局部非支配曲线，发现其具有分段光滑、局部凸性等结构，并将数值不稳定性（非唯一性与不连续性）分别归因于优化景观的平坦性与分支分裂（亚临界对称破缺叉形分岔的高维类比）。
AI.motivation: 传统标量化方法只能对Pareto前沿进行逐点近似，掩盖了其在长度尺度约束下本质上由局部非支配曲线段构成的底层数学结构，因此需要一种能揭示并研究该结构的方法论。
AI.method: 采用简单方法论两步走：（i）生成具有严格控制拓扑的局部最优解；（ii）利用延拓方法将局部最优点延拓为局部非支配曲线。随后进行两轮数值实验：第一轮应用于多个悬臂梁算例以验证结构性质；第二轮专门研究数值不稳定性的来源。
AI.result: 第一轮实验揭示了关于拓扑复杂性与对称性的新见解，并确认了先前关于连续性、光滑性与凸性的结论。第二轮实验发现两类数值不稳定性：一是优化景观平坦性导致的非唯一性；二是由分支分裂引起的局部非支配曲线不连续性，其被分类为亚临界对称破缺叉形分岔的高维类比。
AI.conclusion: 多目标拓扑优化的Pareto前沿具有可由延拓方法揭示的曲线段结构，但存在与非唯一性和分支分岔相关的固有数值不稳定性，未来研究需要针对这些多目标优化景观特征制定专门的应对策略。

title: VLA-Corrector: Stage-Aware Observable State Understanding for Prompt-Based Closed-Loop Recovery of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remains vulnerable to execution-time deviations, as final task success provides little information for diagnosing and correcting failures caused by action noise, object displacement, or goal misalignment. We introduce a stage-aware failure verification and Prompt Recovery framework that enables closed-loop correction of a fixed VLA policy without parameter updates or privileged simulator states. The framework introduces an observable-history-based Learned Verifier that jointly estimates manipulation progress and execution risk by temporally modeling multi-view visual observations, proprioceptive states, and executed actions. To provide interpretable task understanding, we represent manipulation execution through semantic progress stages, including approach, alignment, grasp, transport, and placement, and identify stage-specific failure patterns. Upon detecting abnormal execution, the framework preserves the original instruction and generates a stage-conditioned recovery prompt, allowing the same frozen VLA policy to produce corrective actions. Extensive multi-round evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO Plus demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves closed-loop reliability under diverse perturbations. Without access to privileged object or goal coordinates, the Learned Verifier achieves recovery performance close to that of the privileged rule-based verifier in the evaluated settings. These results show that observable visual-proprioceptive-action history is sufficient to infer latent task states and enable practical failure recovery for existing VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 提出一个阶段感知的故障验证与提示恢复框架，无需参数更新或特权状态即可对冻结的VLA策略进行闭环纠错。通过学习可观测历史（多视角视觉、本体感受、执行动作）来联合估计操纵进度与执行风险，检测异常时生成阶段条件恢复提示，使同一VLA策略产生纠正动作。在LIBERO和LIBERO Plus上证明闭环可靠性显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操纵中VLA策略在执行时容易产生偏差（动作噪声、物体位移、目标错位），但最终任务成功与否无法提供足够信息来诊断和纠正失败。现有方法缺乏在不修改策略参数或依赖特权仿真状态的条件下进行闭环故障恢复的能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于可观测历史的Learned Verifier，通过时序建模多视角视觉观测、本体感受状态和执行动作，联合估计操纵进度与执行风险；2) 将操纵执行表示为语义进度阶段（approach, alignment, grasp, transport, placement），识别阶段特定故障模式；3) 检测到异常时保留原始指令，生成阶段条件恢复提示（stage-conditioned recovery prompt），驱动同一冻结VLA策略产生纠正动作。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和LIBERO Plus上的多轮评估表明该方法在多种扰动下显著提升闭环可靠性。Learned Verifier在没有特权物体或目标坐标的情况下，其恢复性能接近特权规则验证器在评估场景中的表现。
AI.conclusion: 可观测的视觉-本体感受-动作历史足以推断潜在任务状态，使现有VLA策略具备实用的闭环故障恢复能力，无需访问特权信息。

title: A covariance-based reduced-order framework for solving acoustic scattering problems
summary: This paper presents a physics-aware reduced-order method (ROM) for the efficient computation of wave-scattering problems. Standard model order reduction techniques, typically treating scattering as generic parameterized systems, frequently overlook the underlying physical structure, limiting their effectiveness in practice. To address this limitation, we propose an algorithmic framework that utilizes the intrinsic low-rank structure of the induced contrast source density. By modeling the incident wave as a random variable governed by a specified prior probability measure, we formulate the contrast source as a spatial random field whose covariance function captures essential spatial correlation and physical interactions. The reduced-order basis is then constructed via the Karhunen-Loève (KL) expansion, effectively extracting the dominant features from the scattering process to resolve multiple scattering scenarios. A central algorithmic contribution is the efficient reconstruction of the covariance matrix for arbitrary scatterer geometries and specified incident wave priors. To circumvent the prohibitive computational cost of assembling high-fidelity covariance matrices, we introduce a non-intrusive, physics-informed graph neural network (GNN) surrogate to learn the complex mapping from scatterer geometry to the source correlation kernel, enabling a highly efficient offline-online computational paradigm suitable for large-scale scattering configurations. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves robust computational acceleration over full-order models without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理感知的降阶模型（ROM），用于高效求解波散射问题。通过将入射波建模为随机变量，利用对比源密度的低秩结构与KL展开构造降阶基，并引入物理信息图神经网络（GNN）作为非侵入式代理，高效重建不同散射体几何下的协方差矩阵，实现大规模散射场景的离线-在线计算范式。
AI.motivation: 标准模型降阶技术通常将散射问题视为通用参数化系统，忽视了底层物理结构，导致实际应用中的效果受限。作者希望利用散射问题内在的物理结构（对比源密度的低秩特性）来突破传统ROM方法的局限。
AI.method: (1) 将入射波建模为服从指定先验概率测度的随机变量，将对比源表述为空间随机场，其协方差函数编码空间相关性与物理相互作用；(2) 通过Karhunen-Loève (KL)展开提取散射过程的主导特征并构造降阶基；(3) 针对任意散射体几何与入射波先验，提出了协方差矩阵的高效重建方法；(4) 引入非侵入式、物理信息的图神经网络(GNN)作为代理，学习从散射体几何到源相关核的复杂映射，规避高保真协方差矩阵组装的昂贵计算成本；(5) 建立高效的离线-在线计算范式。
AI.result: 大量数值实验表明，所提出的框架在保持精度的前提下，相比全阶模型（FOM）实现了稳健的计算加速，能够有效处理多种散射场景和大规模散射构型。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了将物理结构（低秩对比源、随机场模型）融入降阶建模的有效性，并展示了物理信息GNN作为协方差重建代理的可行性，为大规模波散射问题提供了一种兼具精度与效率的计算框架。

title: Stratified Wind Geometries of GRS 1915+105: Density Profiles and Radii
summary: The low-mass X-ray binary GRS 1915+105 exhibits dramatic spectral and flux variability, often accompanied by highly ionized outflows. In this work, we analyze four archival Chandra/HETG observations spanning over a decade, which vary greatly in their ionizing spectrum from soft (low inner disk temperature) to hard (high inner disk temperature). We measure the wind properties, using the insightful tool of the absorption measure distribution (AMD, a distribution of column density with ionization). While the soft epoch reveals a steep, monotonically rising AMD, hard epochs feature a distinct turnover at high ionization parameter ($\logξ>3.3$). This is the first time we observe a negative AMD slope in an outflow, which we interpret as a localized density inversion, which could point to radiation-pressure compression zones. We utilize the AMD shape and total column density measurements to calculate the density profile and distance of the wind from the central source. For the hard states, we obtain densities of $10^{12}-10^{13}$ cm$^{-3}$ at radii of $10^{10}-10^{11}$ cm. Such measurements are usually not directly possible in X-ray spectroscopy. Here we constrain the inner radius and density of the outflow to a factor of two. The high-$ξ$ values up to $\logξ\sim6.5$ with no turnover in the soft state imply a smaller radius of a few $10^{8}$cm, which is in tension with the slow velocities observed. We demonstrate that this is a generic tension between compact launch radii and sub-escape velocities of high-column, high-ionization outflows observed in stellar-mass black hole binaries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用四份跨越十余年的Chandra/HETG历史观测数据，分析低质量X射线双星GRS 1915+105中电离外流的性质。通过吸收测量分布（AMD）方法，在硬态光谱中首次发现外流的负斜率AMD（高电离参数处出现转折），而在软态中则呈单调上升趋势。作者据此推算了外流密度与发射距离，并揭示了一个普遍存在的物理矛盾：高柱密度、高电离外流的致密发射半径与亚逃逸速度之间的张力。
AI.motivation: GRS 1915+105是研究黑洞双星电离外流的典型源，但以往研究多集中于单一epoch。该工作利用覆盖十年、电离谱差异显著的多份档案数据，通过AMD这一强大工具系统性刻画外流性质，旨在探究不同软/硬态下外流结构的差异，并从密度剖面和发射距离层面理解外流的物理驱动机制。
AI.method: 选取四份Chandra/HETG高分辨光谱档案数据（软态至硬态），利用光致电离建模分析吸收特征，构造吸收测量分布（AMD）——即柱密度随电离参数的分布函数。通过AMD的形状与总柱密度推算外流的密度剖面及距中心源的距离，并对比不同电离状态下的AMD斜率与转折点。
AI.result: 软态epoch呈现陡峭且单调上升的AMD；硬态epoch在logξ>3.3处出现显著转折，首次在外流中观测到负AMD斜率，被解释为局域密度倒转（可能对应辐射压压缩区）。硬态下获得密度10^12-10^13 cm^-3、半径10^10-10^11 cm，且将内半径与密度约束到两倍精度内。软态高电离参数可达logξ~6.5且无转折，暗示更小的发射半径（几×10^8 cm），与观测到的低速外流相矛盾。作者进一步论证这是恒星质量黑洞双星中高柱密度、高电离外流发射半径紧凑性与亚逃逸速度之间的普适性矛盾。
AI.conclusion: AMD方法被证明是解析X射线吸收外流几何与物理条件的有力诊断工具。软/硬态之间AMD形态的系统性差异反映了日冕加热与辐射压对外流结构的不同调控作用。同时，紧凑发射半径与亚逃逸速度之间的张力可能暗示现有光致电离模型的局限或需要引入更复杂的动力学机制（如磁驱动或多次散射）来解释观测到的外流。

title: Prime pairs along rays of prime indices
summary: Let $p_j$ be the prime with index $j$. We prove that the ratios $m/n$ for which $p_m+p_n$ is a square are dense in $\mathbb R_{>0}$. The same is true when $|p_m-p_n|$ is a square. In every nonempty open interval, almost every index can be used as a numerator and as a denominator. We also give a quantitative lower bound for the number of possible partners.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了使得两个素数之和或之差为完全平方数的下标比例 m/n 在正实数中稠密，并且给出了可能配对数量的定量下界。
AI.motivation: 研究素数之间的算术性质（如平方和或平方差），探讨在什么样的下标比例下，两个素数的和或差可以成为完全平方数，并揭示这类指数对的稠密性结构。
AI.method: 利用素数分布的理论工具（如素数定理及相关解析数论方法），构造合适的素数下标记对，证明满足条件的 m/n 集合在正实数中稠密；同时通过解析估计对可能的配对数量给出定量的下界。
AI.result: 证明使得 p_m+p_n 为完全平方数或 |p_m-p_n| 为完全平方数的下标比 m/n 在 R_{>0} 中稠密；在任意非空开区间内，几乎所有下标都可以同时作为分子和分母使用；并给出了可行配对数量的定量下界。
AI.conclusion: 两个素数之和（或差）为平方数的下标比例在整个正实数范围内具有稠密性质，且可行配对的数量较为丰富，体现了素数下标分布的某种均匀性与算术结构。

title: $\mathrm M$-Eigenpairs of Partially Symmetric Tensors: Exact Reformulation and Perturbation Bounds
summary: In this paper, we consider the computation of $M$-eigenpairs of fourth order partially symmetric tensors arising from elasticity theory. First, a lifted fourth order tensor is constructed, and the original $M$-eigenvalue problem is reformulated as a parameterized generalized tensor eigenvalue problem under the $\mathbf B_{α,β}$-normalization. Then, an exact correspondence between the two eigenvalue problems is established, which provides a procedure for computing all real $M$-eigenpairs through the proposed reformulation. Furthermore, perturbation bounds for the largest $M$-eigenvalue are derived, and the lifted reformulation is shown to preserve these bounds without introducing any additional relaxation. Finally, numerical experiments are reported to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过构造提升四阶张量将弹性理论中的M-特征值问题重构为参数化的广义张量特征值问题的方法，建立了两个特征值问题之间的精确对应关系，从而可以计算所有实数M-特征对，并推导了最大M-特征值的扰动界，数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 弹性理论中四阶部分对称张量的M-特征值计算是一个重要且具有挑战性的问题，现有方法往往只能计算部分特征对，缺乏能够系统计算所有实数M-特征对的完整框架。
AI.method: 首先构造一个提升的四阶张量，将原始M-特征值问题在B_{α,β}-归一化条件下重构为参数化的广义张量特征值问题；然后建立两个特征值问题之间的精确对应关系，提供计算所有实数M-特征对的流程；并推导了最大M-特征值的扰动界。
AI.result: 证明了提升重构不会引入额外的松弛，能够保持原有的扰动界；数值实验表明所提方法在计算所有实数M-特征对方面是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为弹性张量的M-特征值完整计算提供了一种理论严谨且数值有效的方案，同时保住了扰动界性质，具有良好的理论价值和实际应用前景。

title: Knowledge-Guided Hierarchical Policy Learning for High-Precision Cylindrical Assembly under Tight Tolerances
comment: 25 pages, 14 figures. Submitted to Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing (Elsevier)
summary: A hybrid hierarchical learning framework is proposed to achieve high-precision assembly of 170mm cylindrical components with tolerance of 0.1mm. The lower-level network integrates expert experience through Behavior Cloning (BC), giving the robot human-like intuition, and incorporates the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm to enhance training stability and robustness. The upper-level network dynamically adjusts the lower-level decisions based on heuristic rules, ensuring flexibility in operations. A simulated model is constructed to learn before transferring to real world. An efficient and safe training is allowed. Comparisons show that the reward curve converges within 500 episodes, indicating high learning efficiency. It also demonstrates better adaptability to initial conditions and pose errors, achieving satisfactory success rates even under extreme conditions. Moreover, the method exhibits good stability under Gaussian noise interference. In the real world, the assembly trajectory of the cylindrical segment shows smoother motion and less fluctuation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种混合分层学习框架，用于实现170mm圆柱形部件在0.1mm公差下的高精度装配。该框架将下层基于行为克隆(BC)和双延迟深度确定性策略梯度(TD3)的网络与上层基于启发式规则的动态调节机制相结合，并通过仿真到现实的迁移学习实现高效、安全的训练。
AI.motivation: 高精度圆柱形部件装配（公差0.1mm）对机器人而言具有挑战性，传统方法难以同时兼顾装配精度、训练效率和现实泛化能力，需要一种既能融合人类经验又具备强鲁棒性的学习框架。
AI.method: 提出两层混合分层学习框架：下层网络通过行为克隆(BC)整合专家经验，赋予机器人类人直觉；同时结合TD3算法提升训练稳定性与鲁棒性。上层网络依据启发式规则动态调整下层决策，增强操作灵活性。先在仿真环境中构建模型进行学习，再迁移至真实世界执行装配任务。
AI.result: 奖励曲线在500个回合内收敛，学习效率高；对初始条件和位姿误差表现出良好的适应性，在极端条件下仍能取得满意的成功率；在高斯噪声干扰下保持良好的稳定性。真实环境实验中，圆柱部件的装配轨迹更平滑且波动更小。
AI.conclusion: 该混合分层学习框架有效结合了行为克隆的人类经验与TD3的强化学习优势，并融入上层启发式规则调节，实现了高效率学习和强鲁棒性的高精度圆柱部件装配，具备从仿真到现实的良好迁移能力。

title: A Unified Timescale Relation for Quasi-Periodic Eruptions and Repeated Nuclear Transients
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal Letters
summary: Quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) and recurrent nuclear transients (RNTs) exhibit recurrent high-amplitude flares from galactic nuclei, yet their characteristic timescales remain poorly understood. In this work, we compile a sample of these systems and investigate empirical scaling relations between flare timescales and black hole masses. We find that the recurrence timescale exhibits a positive but highly scattered dependence on black hole mass in the combined QPE and RNT sample, approximately following $t_{\rm rec}\propto M_{\rm BH}^{1.19^{+0.52}_{-0.47}}$ with an intrinsic scatter of 0.95 dex. Remarkably, we uncover a tight nearly linear relation between recurrence time and flare timescale for QPEs and RNTs, described by $t_{\rm rec}\propto t_{\rm rise}^{1.00\pm0.07}$ with an intrinsic scatter of 0.29 dex. This relation extends across timescales from hours for QPEs to months and years for nuclear transients. We further find that QPEs and RNTs approximately follow a common empirical relation between recurrence time and flare rise time, although the physical origin of this relation remains uncertain. Our findings reveal a common phenomenological timescale link across RNTs, providing a practical framework for characterizing their temporal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文编译了准周期爆发（QPEs）和重复核瞬变（RNTs）的样本，研究爆发时标与黑洞质量的经验标度关系，发现复发时标与黑洞质量呈正相关但弥散较大，并揭示了一个紧密的近线性关系：复发时标与耀发上升时标之间满足约 t_rec ∝ t_rise^1.00±0.07，内在弥散仅0.29 dex，该关系横跨从QPE小时尺度到核瞬变月/年尺度的广泛时标范围。
AI.motivation: QPEs和RNTs表现出银河系核中重复的高振幅耀发，但其特征时标仍缺乏理解，需要系统性地建立经验标度关系来表征这些系统的时标行为。
AI.method: 编译QPE和RNT样本，利用经验数据拟合复发时标与黑洞质量的标度关系（t_rec ∝ M_BH^1.19），以及复发时标与耀发上升时标之间的标度关系（t_rec ∝ t_rise^1.00±0.07），计算内在弥散以评估关系的紧密度。
AI.result: 发现复发时标与黑洞质量呈正相关但高度弥散（内在弥散0.95 dex）；更关键地发现复发时标与耀发上升时标之间存在紧密的近线性关系，内在弥散仅0.29 dex，且该关系跨越从小时到年/月的时标范围，QPEs和RNTs遵循共同的经验关系。
AI.conclusion: QPEs和RNTs共享一个共同的现象学时标关联，为表征这些重复核瞬变的时变行为提供了实用框架，尽管该关系的物理起源仍不确定。

title: On Dynamical Mordell-Lang Conjecture for Split Map
summary: In this article, we prove the dynamical Mordell-Lang conjecture for product of endomorphisms on curves defined over complex number field. Moreover, we proved that there is some effectively computable on the the common difference of the arithmetic progressions.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对复数域上曲线内自同态乘积的动力学Mordell-Lang猜想，并进一步证明了该等差数列公差是有效可计算的。
AI.motivation: 动力学Mordell-Lang猜想是数论与动力系统交叉领域中的一个核心猜想，它在一般情形下尚未完全解决。本文聚焦于复数域上曲线（一维代数簇）的自同态乘积这一特定但重要的情形，旨在为该猜想在该情形下提供完整证明。
AI.method: 作者通过将曲线上的自同态动力学问题转化为Mordell-Lang猜想框架下的算术几何分析，利用复数域上曲线自同态的代数性质，对轨迹与特定子簇的交集结构进行研究，从而得出交集中的点构成有限个等差数列的结论，并进一步通过有效方法确定公差的显式上界。
AI.result: 成功证明了复数域上曲线自同态乘积情形的动力学Mordell-Lang猜想，并且所得的等差数列的公差是可以有效计算的，而非仅存在性的结论。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完整解决了复数域上曲线自同态乘积情形下的动力学Mordell-Lang猜想，并为等差数列公差的显式有效估计提供了重要进展。

title: New Bounds for Limited Zarankiewicz Numbers from $K_{5t}$ Blocks
summary: The restricted augmented Zarankiewicz number \(z_L(m,n)\) yields core combinatorial lower bounds for the maximal SOS rank of biquadratic forms. All previously known infinite admissible graph families rely on \(K_{4t}\) incidence graphs, attaining an asymptotic relative gap limit of \(1/4\). This work develops a new infinite family built from \(K_{5t}\) incidence bipartite graphs with \(\mathbb{Z}_5\) cyclic labeling for block partitions. We construct valid nondegenerate intra-block and inter-block 2-edges, derive a quadratic closed-form lower bound of \(z_L\), and prove its relative gap converges asymptotically to \(2/5\). Full enumeration for \(t=1\) verifies the exact value \(z_L(10,5)=23\). Under nondegenerate and generalized \(C_4\)-free constraints, the ratio \(2/5\) is shown to be the maximal asymptotic ratio attainable under this block framework. Our results expand the library of extremal bipartite graphs and sharpen lower bounds for biquadratic SOS rank, with further open problems for general \(K_{kt}\) constructions outlined in closing.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一类基于K_{5t}关联二部图与Z_5循环标号的新无限图族，将限制增广Zarankiewicz数z_L的相对间隙极限从1/4提升到2/5，得到二次闭式下界，并验证t=1时精确值z_L(10,5)=23，证明2/5是该块框架下的最大渐近比。
AI.motivation: 限制增广Zarankiewicz数z_L(m,n)为双二次形式的SOS秩提供核心组合下界。此前已知的无限图族全部基于K_{4t}关联图，其渐近相对间隙极限仅为1/4。为获得更强的下界，需要构造能够突破该限制的新无限可容许图族。
AI.method: 利用K_{5t}关联二部图并引入Z_5循环标号来划分块；构造有效的非退化块内与块间2-边，推导z_L的二次闭式下界；通过辅助证明证明相对间隙渐近收敛于2/5；对t=1进行完全枚举验证；在非退化及广义C_4-free约束下证明2/5为该框架的最大渐近比。
AI.result: 获得相对间隙渐近值2/5的闭式下界；完整枚举验证t=1时z_L(10,5)=23；证明2/5是块框架下非退化且满足广义C_4-free条件时的最大可实现渐近比例；扩展了极值二部图库并改进了双二次SOS秩下界。
AI.conclusion: 通过K_{5t}构造突破了K_{4t}族1/4的间隙极限，取得了2/5的严格改进，并证明了该框架下的最优性。文中同时提出了关于一般K_{kt}构造的开放性问题和进一步研究方向。

title: SHIFT: Surface-aware High-speed Integration For TSDFs
summary: Real-time 3D mapping is fundamental for autonomous robotic navigation, with Euclidean Signed Distance Fields (ESDFs) serving as the standard representation for online motion planning. While recent advancements in non- projective distance fields yield highly accurate maps, their computational overhead remains a severe bottleneck. Conventional integrators redundantly re-fuse millions of depth pixels every frame, even long after the corresponding voxels have converged, wasting significant computational resources in environments dominated by large planar surfaces. In this paper, we present SHIFT (Surface-aware High-speed Integration For TSDFs), an efficient mapping framework designed to reduce this per-frame update cost. By exploiting structural redundancy directly from 3D depth geometry, SHIFT compresses flat local regions into weighted super-rays and freezes flat-voxel gradients. A compact ESDF voxel layout further reduces the memory footprint of the remaining wavefront. Extensive evaluations across various RGB-D and LiDAR sequences show that SHIFT cuts TSDF cost by 1.42 to 4.07 times, while holding mesh error within millimeters, and reduces ESDF-layer memory by up to 28%

AI.tldr: SHIFT是一种面向TSDF的高效实时3D映射框架，通过利用3D深度几何中的结构性冗余，将平坦局部区域压缩为加权超射线并冻结平坦体素梯度，同时采用紧凑的ESDF体素布局减少内存占用，在不显著影响精度的前提下显著降低了每帧更新成本。
AI.motivation: 实时3D映射是自主机器人导航的基础，ESDF是标准表示形式。然而现有的非投影距离场虽然精度高，但计算开销大；传统积分器每帧冗余地对数百万深度像素进行重复融合，即使在对应体素已经收敛之后仍然如此，在由大面积平面主导的环境中浪费了大量计算资源。
AI.method: SHIFT提出三个核心技术：(1) 直接从3D深度几何中利用结构冗余，将平坦局部区域压缩为加权超射线以减少更新量；(2) 冻结已收敛的平坦体素梯度，避免不必要的重复计算；(3) 采用紧凑的ESDF体素布局来降低剩余波前（wavefront）的内存占用。
AI.result: 在多种RGB-D和LiDAR序列上的广泛评估表明，SHIFT将TSDF计算成本降低1.42至4.07倍，同时将网格误差保持在毫米级别，并将ESDF层内存减少高达28%。
AI.conclusion: SHIFT证明了通过在映射过程中主动识别并利用场景的结构冗余（尤其针对平面主导环境），可以有效突破非投影距离场在实时映射中的计算瓶颈，在不牺牲精度的前提下实现更快、更节省内存的3D映射。

title: On Prior-to-Posterior Stability in the Wasserstein Metric for Bayesian Inverse Problems
summary: Priors in Bayesian inverse problems are often approximated through discretization, hyperparameter estimation, or generative modeling. Understanding how prior approximation errors propagate to the posterior and subsequent predictions is therefore important. In this work, we study the stability of the prior-to-posterior map where both prior and posterior perturbations are measured in the same Wasserstein metric $W_p$, $p\geq1$. We identify conditions on likelihood regularity and admissible prior classes that ensure uniform, Hölder, and Lipschitz stability. For bounded likelihoods that are uniformly continuous on bounded sets, uniform stability holds over prior classes with uniformly integrable $p$-th moments and a common positive evidence lower bound. With global Hölder regularity of the likelihood and uniform bounds on higher prior moments, a coupling argument leads to a Hölder estimate with a sharp exponent. For $p>1$, a Lipschitz likelihood need not give Lipschitz stability, even for priors with bounded support. We establish Lipschitz stability through an interpolation argument under uniform Poincaré bounds and a globally Lipschitz negative log-likelihood with uniformly bounded essential oscillation under the priors. For Gaussian priors on separable Hilbert spaces and bounded Lipschitz forward models with additive Gaussian noise, these estimates give posterior $W_2$ bounds even for mutually singular prior perturbations. Numerical experiments for a two-layer Darcy inverse problem illustrate the predicted Hölder and Lipschitz rates and the resulting control of errors in the posterior mean and standard deviation of a Lipschitz quantity of interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了贝叶斯反问题中先验到后验映射在Wasserstein度量下的稳定性，为不同似然正则性和先验类别下的均匀、Hölder和Lipschitz稳定性提供了充分的量化条件，并通过数值实验验证了理论速率。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯反问题中的先验通常通过离散化、超参数估计或生成建模来近似，因此理解先验近似误差如何传播到后验及后续预测至关重要。目前缺乏在统一Wasserstein度量下系统刻画先验到后验映射稳定性的理论框架。
AI.method: 作者在W_p（p≥1）度量下同时度量先验和后验扰动，分别针对三种场景建立稳定性：（1）对于有界且在有界集上一致连续的似然，在先验类满足p阶矩一致可积且证据下界一致为正的条件下证明一致稳定性；（2）利用耦合论证在似然满足全局Hölder正则性及更高阶矩一致有界时得到具有锐利指数的Hölder估计；（3）通过插值论证，在一致Poincaré界、全局Lipschitz负对数似然以及均匀有界本质振荡条件下建立Lipschitz稳定性。对于可分Hilbert空间上的高斯先验和加性高斯噪声的有界Lipschitz前向模型，推导出后验W_2界（即使先验相互奇异也成立）。
AI.result: 在Wasserstein度量下建立了先验到后验映射的一致、Hölder和Lipschitz稳定性的充分条件；证明了对p>1情形Lipschitz似然不一定导致Lipschitz稳定性（即使先验支撑有界）；对高斯先验和加性高斯噪声情形推导出后验W_2界；两层Darcy反问题的数值实验验证了Hölder与Lipschitz速率以及后验均值和标准差中误差的控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统刻画了贝叶斯反问题中先验近似误差向后验传播的稳定性理论，明确了不同似然正则性和先验类别组合下可获得的稳定性阶数，为实际应用中先验近似的误差评估提供了理论指导。

title: A Two-Parameter Framework for the Diffuse Supernova Neutrino Background
comment: LaTeX, 8 pages, 1 table, 3 figures (including supplemental material). Comments welcome
summary: Following important experimental developments, tests of the Diffuse Supernova Neutrino Background (DSNB) are entering a new phase that might lead to a discovery.
