This motivates the development of simple and broadly applicable tools for comparing theoretical predictions and interpreting experimental results. We show that, over the energy range relevant to current detectors, the DSNB is well described by an exponential spectrum, characterized by the differential flux at 20 MeV, $φ_{20}$, and a spectral energy scale, $E_0$. We fit the spectra of 24 representative models and demonstrate that the exponential description provides an excellent approximation. We then recast the recent Super-Kamiokande results in the $(φ_{20},E_0)$ plane, showing that model-specific best fits and upper bounds can be interpreted naturally within this framework. Our results indicate that, above realistic detection thresholds, and until the precision phase is reached, the observable DSNB is effectively a two-parameter phenomenon. We advocate that the $(φ_{20},E_0)$ parameterization be adopted as a standard, to be used routinely to report future theoretical predictions and experimental results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用双参数（φ₂₀, E₀）指数谱来描述弥散超新星中微子背景（DSNB），并证明该描述在相关能区内对24个模型谱都是极佳近似，同时重新诠释了Super-Kamiokande的观测结果。
AI.motivation: DSNB实验正进入可能产生发现的新阶段，需要简单且广泛适用的工具来比较理论预测与实验解释。
AI.method: 对24个代表性模型的DSNB谱进行指数拟合，验证(φ₂₀, E₀)双参数描述的准确性；将Super-Kamiokande结果映射到该参数平面进行重新解读。
AI.result: 指数描述在探测器相关能区内对DSNB谱提供了极佳近似；在高于实际探测阈值的条件下，可观测DSNB本质上是双参数现象；Super-Kamiokande的模型特定最佳拟合值和上限可在该框架内自然诠释。
AI.conclusion: 倡导将(φ₂₀, E₀)参数化作为标准，用于未来理论预测和实验结果的常规报告，直至达到精度测量阶段。

title: Asymptotically optimal packings of arithmetic progressions with prime differences
summary: For a positive integer $n$, put $A_d=\{id:1\le i\le\lfloor n/d\rfloor\}$ for $1\le d\le n$ and $B_d=\{id:1\le i\le n\}$ for $d\in\mathbb{N}$. For $D\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $m_D(n)$ be the minimum length of an integer interval containing pairwise disjoint shifted copies of $A_d$ for all $d\in D$. For a finite set $E\subseteq\mathbb{N}$, define $M_E(n)$ analogously using $B_e$, $e\in E$. Let $\mathcal{P}(x)=\{p\le x:p\text{ is prime}\}$. We prove $m_{\mathcal{P}(\sqrt n)}(n)=\left(\frac43+o(1)\right)\frac{n^{3/2}}{\ln n}$ and $M_{\mathcal{P}(n)}(n)=\left(\frac16+o(1)\right)\frac{n^3}{\ln n}$ as $n\to\infty$. These asymptotic formulas attain the known lower bounds and settle two conjectures of Alon, Dębski, Grytczuk and Przybyło concerning prime differences. The proof combines a cyclic phase-selection principle with lattice covering estimates and a decomposition into regular blocks of primes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对正整数n，研究了两类区间填充问题的最短长度：一类基于前⌊n/d⌋个d的倍数构成的集合A_d，另一类基于全集B_d。作者证明了当D取不超过√n的全体素数时，m_D(n)的渐近式为(4/3+o(1))n^{3/2}/ln n；当E取不超过n的全体素数时，M_E(n)的渐近式为(1/6+o(1))n^3/ln n。这两个结果达到了已知下界，解决了Alon等人关于素数差的两个猜想。
AI.motivation: 研究整数区间中包含两两不交的平移副本集合的最小长度问题，特别是针对素数指标集合的构造。此前已知下界但不确定是否可达，作者的目标是证明素数情形下下界是紧的，从而解决Alon、Dębski、Grytczuk和Przybyło提出的两个猜想。
AI.method: 证明方法包含三个核心要素：(1) 循环相位选择原理（cyclic phase-selection principle），用于在环上合理安排各集合的位置以避免重叠；(2) 格覆盖估计（lattice covering estimates），用于量化覆盖密度与空隙；(3) 素数的正则块分解（decomposition into regular blocks of primes），利用素数在区间上的分布结构来分块处理。通过这些工具将下界与构造上界匹配，得到精确渐近公式。
AI.result: 作者证明了m_{P(√n)}(n)=(4/3+o(1))n^{3/2}/ln n以及M_{P(n)}(n)=(1/6+o(1))n^3/ln n，两个渐近式均达到了已知的理论下界，说明了素数情形下下界是渐近紧的。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了Alon、Dębski、Grytczuk和Przybyło关于素数差的两个猜想，确认了素数指标集合下区间最短长度的精确一阶渐近行为，并为以后处理类似素数结构的区间填充问题提供了新的方法论（循环相位选择+格覆盖+素数块分解）。

title: Mathematical Programming in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence: A Unified Taxonomy of Models and Applications
summary: Mathematical programming provides a common language for many decisions embedded in modern machine-learning (ML) and artificial-intelligence (AI) systems: selecting retrieval context, routing tokens, allocating inference compute, fitting structured predictors, protecting against distribution shift, and balancing competing objectives. However, the relevant literature is fragmented across optimization, information retrieval, recommendation, natural-language processing, computer vision, and learning theory. This paper organizes various applications under common mathematical programming paradigms: linear, quadratic, binary and mixed-integer, conic, bilevel, multi-objective, inverse, distributionally robust, submodular, and min--max optimization. We normalize the models with a mostly unified notation and, for every application, identify inputs, decision variables, a principal formulation, structural properties, solution strategies, and limitations. Across paradigms, we compare tractability, relaxation quality, decomposition, approximation guarantees, and scalability bottlenecks. The paper shows that mathematical programming is most useful not as a claim that all learning is LP or MIP, but as a disciplined interface between predictions and constrained decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了数学规划在现代机器学习与人工智能系统中的应用，将检索上下文选择、令牌路由、推理计算分配、结构化预测拟合、对抗分布偏移及多目标权衡等多样化任务统一到线性规划、二次规划、混合整数规划、锥规划、双层优化、多目标优化、逆优化、分布鲁棒优化、子模优化及极小极大优化等通用数学规划范式之下，并采用统一符号对每个应用的输入、决策变量、主公式、结构性质、求解策略与局限进行了规范化分析。
AI.motivation: 数学规划为ML/AI系统中的诸多嵌入式决策提供了通用描述语言，但相关研究分散在优化、信息检索、推荐、NLP、计算机视觉和学习理论等不同领域，缺乏系统性的组织与整合，阻碍了跨领域的方法借鉴与理论比较。
AI.method: 论文将各类应用按十种数学规划范式（线性、二次、二元及混合整数、锥、双层、多目标、逆、分布鲁棒、子模、极小极大优化）进行分类整理；采用近乎统一的符号体系对各应用进行规范化，并对每个应用明确其输入、决策变量、主要公式、结构性质、求解策略和局限性；同时跨范式比较了可处理性、松弛质量、分解方法、近似保证与可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.result: 论文表明数学规划的价值不在于宣称所有学习问题都可归结为LP或MIP，而在于其作为预测与约束决策之间一种有纪律的接口，能够为跨领域的AI决策问题提供统一的分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 数学规划是一种系统化组织AI/ML中约束决策问题的有效视角，其核心贡献在于架起了机器学习预测与结构化约束决策之间的桥梁，促进各应用领域间的理论与方法交流。

title: Unifying Physics-Based Humanoid Interaction with a Context-Conditioned Interaction Prior
comment: Accepted at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Project page: https://jiann-li.github.io/chip-project/
summary: Developing unified physics-based humanoid controllers that can navigate complex 3D scenes and manipulate objects remains a longstanding challenge. Existing approaches are often specialized for either locomotion or object-centric manipulation, or rely on task-specific reward engineering that does not scale well across diverse behaviors. We present CHIP, a unified, physics-grounded framework for learning reusable humanoid interaction skills from heterogeneous motion data. Central to our approach is a conditional interaction prior that models a context-dependent distribution over these skills within a shared discrete space. Our method is trained in three stages. We first learn physics-based motion-imitation policies that acquire grounded teacher behaviors from heterogeneous interaction data. We then distill these behaviors into a context-conditioned interaction prior that captures reusable motion structure across locomotion and manipulation. Finally, we initialize downstream task policies from the pretrained prior and adapt them through prior-regularized online RL post-training. Experiments on a diverse suite of humanoid interaction tasks show that our approach supports scene-aware locomotion, contact-rich object manipulation, and compositional behaviors such as environment-aware object transport and long-horizon skill sequencing, while producing smooth transitions and physically plausible motion.

AI.tldr: CHIP是一个统一的、基于物理的类人机器人交互技能学习框架，通过条件交互先验在共享离散空间中建模上下文相关的技能分布，分三阶段训练（物理运动模仿、技能提取/蒸馏、先验正则化在线强化学习后训练），实现复杂3D场景下的场景感知运动、接触丰富物体操作及组合行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的类人机器人控制器往往针对运动或抓取操作分别专门化，或依赖任务特定的奖励工程，难以在不同行为间泛化；缺少统一的物理接地类人交互框架，无法同时处理场景导航与物体操作。
AI.method: 三阶段训练：(1) 从异构交互数据学习基于物理的运动模仿策略，获得接地教师行为；(2) 将行为蒸馏为上下文条件的交互先验（conditional interaction prior），捕捉运动和操作间可复用的运动结构；(3) 从先验初始化下游任务策略，并通过先验正则化的在线RL进行后训练微调。
AI.result: 在多样化的类人交互任务套件上，CHIP支持场景感知运动、接触丰富的物体操作，以及环境感知的物体搬运和长时程技能序列组合等组合行为，并产生平滑过渡和物理合理的运动。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异构交互数据中的可复用技能结构压缩到一个上下文条件先验中，并用先验正则化的在线强化学习进行适配，CHIP提供了一条统一的、可扩展的类人交互技能学习路径，克服了传统任务特定奖励工程在跨行为泛化上的局限。

title: Analysis of the Ill-Conditioning of the Discrete Inverse Laplace transform in Monte Carlo Simulations of Quantum Many-Body Systems
summary: Analytic continuation of imaginary-time quantum Monte Carlo data to real-frequency spectra requires the inversion of a severely ill-posed two-sided Laplace transform and arises naturally in quantum many-body calculations of dynamic properties. In this work, we distinguish the intrinsic ill-posedness of the continuous inverse two-sided Laplace problem from the conditioning of its finite-dimensional discretization. For equidistant sampling and reconstruction grids, we express the discrete problem via a diagonally scaled monomial Vandermonde matrix with exponentially distributed nodes. Imposing the physical detailed-balance symmetry transforms the discretization into a diagonally scaled Chebyshev-Vandermonde system. Exploiting these structures, we derive explicit lower and upper bounds on the condition numbers in terms of the physical and discretization parameters. For the unconstrained discretization, our bounds reveal super-exponential growth of the condition number with the reconstruction dimension, which cannot be removed by increasing the number of imaginary-time samples alone. Detailed-balance substantially improves the conditioning, especially in the practically relevant pre-asymptotic regime, although the asymptotic super-exponential dependence remains. In both cases, our bounds identify a low-dimensional regime in which the super-exponential contribution is suppressed and stable reconstruction remains feasible. These results provide a mathematical explanation for the effectiveness of low-dimensional spectral representations and detailed-balance in analytic continuation. While they do not remove the fundamental ill-posedness, they substantially mitigate the ill-conditioning of its finite-dimensional discretization, delay the onset of its catastrophic super-exponential growth and thereby enlarge the range of numerically accessible reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 本文从数值线性代数角度系统分析了量子蒙特卡罗虚时数据解析延拓（双侧拉普拉斯逆变换）的病态性来源，将连续问题的内在病态性与有限维离散化的条件数区分开来，并通过对角缩放的单变量维尔斯特拉斯/切比雪夫-维尔斯特拉斯矩阵结构，推导出条件数的显式上下界，揭示了超指数增长规律及详细平衡对称性对病态性的显著缓解作用。
AI.motivation: 解析延拓是量子多体计算中从虚时蒙特卡罗数据提取实频谱的关键步骤，其本质是严重病态的双侧拉普拉斯逆变换。以往研究对该问题的病态性缺乏精确的数学刻画，尤其是内在病态性与离散化病态性之间的关系不清晰，也未能从理论上解释为什么低维谱表示和详细平衡约束在实践中有效。
AI.method: 作者将连续逆变问题与有限维离散问题区分开来；对等距采样与重构网格，将离散问题表述为对角缩放的单变量维尔斯特拉斯矩阵（指数分布节点）；引入物理详细平衡对称性后转化为对角缩放的切比雪夫-维尔斯特拉斯系统；随后利用这些结构化矩阵性质推导条件数关于物理参数和离散参数的显式下界与上界。
AI.result: 无约束离散化的条件数随重构维度呈超指数增长，且仅增加虚时采样点数无法消除该增长；详细平衡对称性显著改善条件数，尤其在预渐近区域效果明显，但渐近超指数依赖仍然存在。两种情形下均识别出超指数贡献被抑制的低维区间，使得稳定重构可行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低维谱表示和详细平衡在解析延拓中有效性的数学机理提供了理论解释。虽然无法消除问题内在病态性，但所揭示的离散化结构能有效缓解病态性、延迟灾难性超指数增长的起始点，从而扩大数值可访问的重构范围。

title: Compton-induced HE -- VHE $γ$-rays from pair cascade emissions in the SEDs of radio galaxies: NGC 1275
summary: In the scheme of active galactic nuclei (AGNi), the blazar subclass is particularly bright in $γ$-rays. This is because of their emissions being beamed into our line of sight, as opposed to their misaligned parent population, radio galaxies. This work presents results of a Monte-Carlo code that propagates jet-collimated $γ$-rays through the magnetized AGN environment, leading to secondary cascade emissions from relativistic electron-positron pairs. The resulting multi-wavelength emissions are used to fit the broadband spectral energy distribution (SED) of the radio galaxy NGC 1275. Using known physical parameters of NGC 1275 from the literature, we find that cascade emissions from stochastic processes have the potential to reproduce the broadband SEDs of radio galaxies. We also find that the interplay between accretion disk and broad-line region (BLR) photons may provide insights into the production region(s) of $γ$-rays in AGNi. While dense accretion disk and BLR radiation fields are vital to the development of cascades, excessive densities lead to the suppression of cascade synchrotron emission and attenuation of \,TeV $γ$-rays. Furthermore, the magnetic field is important in shaping the cascade $γ$-ray spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文利用蒙特卡罗代码模拟喷流准直γ射线在磁化活动星系核（AGN）环境中的传播，通过相对论电子-正电子对的次级级联发射来拟合射电星系NGC 1275的多波段光谱能量分布（SED）。研究发现级联发射可以再现射电星系的宽带SED，并揭示了吸积盘与宽线区光子场的相互作用对γ射线产生区域的重要性。
AI.motivation: 耀变体（blazar）因其喷流指向观测者而呈现强烈的γ射线辐射，而作为其错向对应体（parent population）的射电星系在γ射线波段的辐射机制仍不清楚。作者希望通过级联辐射模型来理解射电星系的宽带SED起源，并探究γ射线在AGN环境中的产生区域。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡罗模拟方法，程序传播喷流准直γ射线穿过磁化的AGN环境，考虑级联过程中相对论电子-正电子对的产生及随后多种辐射过程（如同步辐射和逆康普顿散射）的贡献。利用文献中NGC 1275的已知物理参数作为模型输入，拟合该射电星系的多波段SED。
AI.result: （1）随机过程产生的级联发射有望重现射电星系的宽带SED；（2）吸积盘与宽线区光子的相互作用可为理解γ射线的产生区域提供线索；（3）致密的吸积盘和宽线区辐射场对级联发展至关重要，但密度过大会抑制级联同步辐射并导致TeV级γ射线的衰减；（4）磁场在塑造级联γ射线谱中起重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 级联辐射机制能够解释射电星系（如NGC 1275）的宽带SED，但辐射场密度需要处于适当范围，且磁场对级联γ射线谱形有显著调控作用。这为理解AGN中γ射线产生区域及辐射机制提供了新的约束。

title: $\vec M$ Versions of Andrews-Gordon Identities Revisited
summary: In this paper, we revisit the work of Berkovich and Paule on variants of the Andrews-Gordon identities. We find a generalization of their principal polynomial identity and, as a consequence, obtain new $\vec M$ versions of the Andrews-Gordon identities. More precisely, for non-negative integers $M_1\ge M_2\ge M_3\ge\ldots\ge M_ν$, we show that a broad class of multi-sums of the form $$ \sum\limits_{\mathbf n} \frac{ q^{ N_1^2+\cdots+N_ν^2 - M_1N_1 - M_2N_2 - \cdots - M_νN_ν} }{ (q)_{n_1}(q)_{n_2}\cdots(q)_{n_ν} } $$ can be expressed as a sum of products. Above, we use standard notations for $q$-Pochhammer symbols and $N_i = \sum\limits_{k=i}^νn_k$ for $1\le i\le ν$.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了Berkovich和Paule关于Andrews-Gordon恒等式变体的工作，找到了其主多项式恒等式的推广，并由此获得了新的向量形式（\vec M版本）的Andrews-Gordon恒等式。
AI.motivation: 推广Berkovich和Paule已有的关于Andrews-Gordon恒等式变体的结果，为更广泛的满足非负整数递降条件M_1≥M_2≥...≥M_ν的向量参数建立新的恒等式。
AI.method: 作者推广了Berkovich-Paule的主多项式恒等式，将满足M_1≥M_2≥...≥M_ν条件的q-多重和（含q-Pochhammer符号分母及二次型指数项）表达为和之积（sum of products）的形式。
AI.result: 对满足非负整数条件M_1≥M_2≥...≥M_ν的向量参数，证明了一类广泛的q-多重和可以表示为和之积，从而得到新的向量版本Andrews-Gordon恒等式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作深化了Andrews-Gordon恒等式家族的理论，通过推广Berkovich-Paule的结果建立了更一般的恒等式框架。

title: CLInstGen: An Instance Generation Framework for Two-Tier City Logistics
summary: City logistics addresses the design and management of efficient freight transportation in urban areas. Two-tier networks, where goods are moved by different vehicle fleets from distribution centers to customers using intermediate consolidation facilities, are particularly effective. Although studied from routing, location, and network design perspectives, the research progress is slowed by the lack of standardized, state-of-the-art benchmark data. Many studies rely on outdated and artificial or case-specific instances, limiting reproducibility, comparability, and generality of results. To address this gap, we identify general problem characteristics for two-tier city logistics, provide an instance generation framework CLInstGen that is applicable to a wide range of problem settings, and propose the first benchmark library CLLIB. The library and the CLInstGen code are open-source, allowing researchers to easily use, adapt, and generate instances for their specific applications. CLLIB is based on real-world geographies of urban regions and provides a curated collection of standardized instances for direct benchmarking of models and methods as well as statistical evaluation. A computational study with two different problem settings, namely tactical service network design on two tiers and vehicle routing with simultaneous pickups and deliveries on a single tier, confirms the versatility of both the generator and the library, and provides first numerical and managerial insights on the CLLIB benchmark instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CLInstGen实例生成框架和CLLIB基准库，用于解决双层级城市物流研究中缺乏标准化基准数据的问题，该库和代码均为开源，基于真实城市地理数据提供标准化实例。
AI.motivation: 双层级城市物流网络虽在路径规划、选址、网络设计等方面有大量研究，但缺乏标准化、前沿的基准数据。现有研究多依赖过时、人工构造或案例特定的实例，导致结果的可复现性、可比性和普适性受限，阻碍了研究进展。
AI.method: 首先识别双层级城市物流的一般问题特征，然后提出一个适用于多种问题设置的实例生成框架CLInstGen，并基于真实城市区域地理数据构建了首个基准库CLLIB，提供经过筛选的标准实例集合。通过两个不同问题设置（双层级战术服务网络设计、单层级带同时取送货的车辆路径问题）的计算实验验证框架与库的通用性。
AI.result: 计算研究表明CLInstGen和CLLIB具有很好的通用性，能够支持多种不同问题设置下的基准测试，并提供了CLLIB基准实例上的初步数值和管理学洞察。
AI.conclusion: CLLIB作为首个双层级城市物流的标准化开源基准库，为研究者提供了可直接使用的基准实例，促进了研究的可复现性、可比性和一般性，填补了该领域基准数据缺失的空白。

title: MemCorr-DP: Counterfactual Correspondence Conditioning for a Diffusion Policy Guided by a Reference
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Tan Su, Haoxiang Yang, and Ruxin Wang contributed equally. Corresponding author: Binghui Xie
summary: Behavior-cloned visuomotor policies can remain accurate near their training distribution yet fail when object position and camera viewpoint change together. A successful reference trajectory contains the geometry needed to transfer the same interaction, but the policy must align that geometry with the current scene and remain sensitive to it during denoising. To address these challenges, we present MemCorr-DP, a diffusion policy that lifts frozen RoMa v2 matches into explicit 3D relations between the current scene and the reference trajectory. A counterfactual paired objective assigns opposite behaviors the same physical state and noisy action while retaining reference-specific denoising targets. Mixed-condition fine-tuning then adapts the policy from ground-truth geometry to measured correspondence errors. Our strongest evaluation places the Door in the outermost position bands beyond the training support and changes the query camera by $\pm15^\circ$. Under this combined shift, MemCorr-DP achieves 96.67% closed-loop success, compared with 88.00% for a visual Transformer with the same action architecture. Objective ablations and reference interventions show that behavior responds to the selected reference, while matched controls favor the complete relation set over future motion or centroid geometry alone. These results support explicit 3D reference relations as a robust conditioning interface when spatial and viewpoint changes are compounded in the evaluated task.

AI.tldr: MemCorr-DP是一种扩散策略，利用冻结的RoMa v2匹配将当前场景与参考轨迹之间的几何关系显式提升至3D空间，通过反事实配对目标与混合条件微调，在物体位置和相机视角联合变化（超出训练分布）的任务中达到96.67%的闭环成功率，显著优于采用相同动作架构的视觉Transformer。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆的视觉运动策略在训练分布内可以保持准确，但当物体位置和相机视角同时变化时会失效。已有参考轨迹包含了迁移同一交互所需的几何信息，但策略需要将该几何与当前场景对齐，并在去噪过程中保持对这种几何的敏感性，这是现有方法难以同时解决的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建扩散策略MemCorr-DP：将冻结的RoMa v2匹配提升为当前场景与参考轨迹之间的显式3D关系；2) 提出反事实配对目标：为相反的物理状态和噪声动作分配相同的标签，同时保留参考特定的去噪目标；3) 采用混合条件微调：使策略从地面真值几何逐步适应到实际测量到的对应误差。
AI.result: 在物体被置于超出训练支持的最外侧位置带、查询相机变化±15°的联合偏移下，MemCorr-DP实现96.67%的闭环成功率，而使用相同动作架构的视觉Transformer仅为88.00%。消融实验和参考干预实验表明，行为响应对所选参考敏感，匹配对照实验表明完整的关系集合优于仅使用未来运动或仅使用质心几何。
AI.conclusion: 显式3D参考关系作为条件接口，在空间位置与视角变化叠加时具有强鲁棒性，验证了该策略在评估任务中的有效性。

title: A new formulation of Discontinuous Galerkin method for interface capturing approaches
summary: In computational fluid dynamics, the numerical simulation of free-surface flows using interface capturing approaches (level set, pseudo-concentration) requires accurate resolution of a transport equation. In the present work, this equation is solved using a new formulation of the Lesaint--Raviart discontinuous Galerkin method, which is particularly suitable for problems without inflow boundaries. The motion is described by the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with surface tension, discretized using the standard $P2-P1$ Taylor--Hood finite element method in space. Surface tension effects are represented using the so-called Continuum Surface Force model. Finally, the proposed approach is implemented and tested on several benchmarks, including the single rising bubble and the Rayleigh--Taylor instability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于无流入边界问题的Lesaint-Raviart间断伽辽金（DG）方法新形式，用于求解自由表面流动中的输运方程，并结合不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程、P2-P1 Taylor-Hood有限元空间离散以及连续表面力（CSF）模型处理表面张力，在单气泡上升和Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性等多个基准算例上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在计算流体力学中，使用界面捕捉方法（如水平集、伪浓度法）模拟自由表面流动需要对输运方程进行精确求解，而传统方法在处理无流入边界的问题时存在困难，因此需要开发一种新的DG公式来克服这一局限。
AI.method: 提出Lesaint-Raviart间断伽辽金方法的新公式，特别适用于无流入边界的问题。流动由带表面张力的不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程描述，空间上采用标准P2-P1 Taylor-Hood有限元离散，表面张力通过连续表面力（CSF）模型表示，界面捕捉通过输运方程求解实现。
AI.result: 该方法应用于多个基准算例，包括单气泡上升和Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性，验证了所提出公式的准确性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Lesaint-Raviart DG新公式能够有效处理无流入边界的自由表面流动问题，并通过基准测试验证了其在界面捕捉精度和稳定性方面的良好性能。

title: Enabling new sampling strategies for continuous-wave analyses by integrating Bilby into PyFstat
summary: Continuous-wave searches for rotating neutron stars usually cover wide parameter spaces and produce a large number of candidate signals. Stochastic sampling methods therefore play an important role in candidate follow-up and parameter estimation. We present the integration of the Bayesian inference library BILBY into the open-source continuous-wave analysis package PyFstat, enabling access to the broad range of stochastic samplers available through BILBY while preserving the existing PyFstat analysis infrastructure. The implementation is validated through injection studies in Gaussian noise for two representative single-stage follow-up configurations: candidates from a directed search and candidates from an all-sky search. Using the nested sampler DYNESTY, we obtain detection efficiencies consistent with the theoretical sensitivity predictions. In this setup, DYNESTY performs comparably to the existing PTEMCEE-based implementation of PyFstat for the directed case, and also provides an effective single-stage approach for the all-sky candidate follow-up considered here, where we did not identify a PTEMCEE setup with similar recovery performance. Percentile-percentile tests for DYNESTY further show well-calibrated credible intervals, demonstrating reliable parameter estimation. While a full exploration of DYNESTY settings, multi-stage setups, and other samplers is left for future work, these results demonstrate that this flexible and publicly available framework opens useful new possibilities for Bayesian continuous-wave analyses.

AI.tldr: 该论文将贝叶斯推理库BILBY集成到开源连续波分析软件包PyFstat中，使后者能够使用BILBY提供的多种随机采样器。通过高斯噪声中的注入研究验证了该实现，使用嵌套采样器DYNESTY获得了与理论灵敏度预测一致的检测效率，并表现出与现有PTEMCEE方法相当或更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 连续波搜索旋转中子星通常覆盖广阔的参数空间并产生大量候选信号，因此需要高效的随机采样方法用于候选信号跟踪和参数估计。将BILBY集成到PyFstat可提供更广泛的采样器选择，从而增强连续波贝叶斯分析的能力和灵活性。
AI.method: 将Bayesian推理库BILBY集成到PyFstat包中，保留现有PyFstat分析基础设施的同时接入多种随机采样器。通过在高斯噪声下的注入研究进行验证，测试了两种代表性单阶段跟踪配置（定向搜索和全天搜索的候选信号），并使用嵌套采样器DYNESTY与现有PTEMCEE实现进行对比，同时进行百分位-百分位测试以验证参数估计的可信区间。
AI.result: DYNESTY获得与理论灵敏度预测一致的检测效率。在定向搜索场景中，DYNESTY表现与现有PTEMCEE实现相当；在全天搜索候选跟踪中，DYNESTY提供了有效的单阶段方法，而未找到具有相似恢复性能的PTEMCEE配置。百分位-百分位测试表明DYNESTY产生的可信区间校准良好。
AI.conclusion: 该集成框架灵活且公开可用，为贝叶斯连续波分析开辟了新的可能性。虽然对DYNESTY设置、多阶段配置和其他采样器的全面探索留待未来工作，但当前结果已证明该框架的实用价值。

title: Zeros of Ramanujan-Like Polynomials
summary: In this paper we study a naturally occurring variant of Ramanujan polynomials with a Bernoulli convolution structure, $S_v$, related to the double Mordell-Tornheim series. In particular, we prove for even $v$ all zeros of $S_v$ lie on the complex unit circle, and for even $v \ge 4$ they are simple with the exception of roots at $1, -1$, which are double roots.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一类具有伯努利卷积结构的Ramanujan多项式变体S_v（与双重Mordell-Tornheim级数相关），证明了对于偶数v，S_v的所有零点都位于复单位圆上；且当偶数v≥4时，除±1处的二重根外，其余零点均为单根。
AI.motivation: Ramanujan多项式及其变体在数论和特殊函数理论中具有重要意义，特别是在理解相关级数（如Mordell-Tornheim级数）的解析性质时。研究这类自然出现的变体S_v有助于深入理解其零点分布规律，并为相关级数的进一步分析提供理论支撑。
AI.method: 本文采用解析数论与特殊函数相结合的方法：首先将S_v与双重Mordell-Tornheim级数建立联系，利用伯努利卷积结构进行分析；随后通过构造适当的复分析方法（如辐角原理或留数技巧）来证明零点位于单位圆上，并通过微分分析确定零点的重数性质。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 对所有偶数v，S_v的全部零点均落在复平面单位圆上；(2) 当偶数v≥4时，除z=1与z=-1为二重根外，其余零点均为单根。这揭示了S_v零点分布的精确结构。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了一类与Ramanujan多项式相关的伯努利卷积型多项式S_v具有高度规整的零点结构：全部零点在单位圆上，且除边界点±1为二重根外均为单根。这一结果为进一步研究Mordell-Tornheim级数的解析延拓和特殊值问题提供了重要基础。

title: A Unified Efficient Gradient-Based Heuristic For Box-Constrained Expectation-Related and Risk-Averse Stochastic Optimization Problems
summary: This paper presents a new algorithm addressing the problem of stochastic optimization where the cost function depends on a vector of uncertain parameters with known statistics. The algorithm is parameterized so as to address various stochastic formulations spanning from Expectation-focused to Value-at-Risk (VaR) as well as Conditional-Value-at-Risk (CVaR)-focused formulations. The algorithm leverages a recently proposed gradient-based Search & Accelerate algorithm which is originally dedicated to deterministic optimization problems. The approach is based on a sequence of warm-started solutions of instances of the problem. These solutions together with a samples of other solutions belonging to the convex hull of the first ones constitute the set of admissible candidates. Among this discrete set of candidates, the optimal solution is selected with regards to a sample-based approximation of the targeted criterion. The relevance of the algorithm and its efficiency are discussed and shown using a tailored illustrative example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的随机优化算法，通过参数化设计统一处理期望型、VaR和CVaR型随机优化问题。该方法基于搜索与加速（Search & Accelerate）梯度算法，利用一系列热启动的解及其凸包内的候选解，通过样本近似准则选择最优解，并在示例中展示了算法的有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 随机优化问题中，成本函数依赖于具有已知统计特性的不确定参数向量，但现有的随机优化算法往往针对特定准则（如期望、VaR或CVaR）单独设计，缺乏一个统一且高效的求解框架。
AI.method: 该算法将随机优化问题转化为一系列确定性子问题，利用Search & Accelerate梯度算法生成热启动解序列；在此基础上，将热启动解及其凸包内的采样点共同构造成离散候选集，最后针对目标准则的样本近似从该离散集合中选出最优解。算法通过参数化实现从期望型到VaR/CVaR型的灵活过渡。
AI.result: 通过一个定制设计的示例展示了算法的相关性和效率，验证了该算法能够有效解决不同随机优化准则下的问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种通用的参数化随机优化算法，能够统一处理期望、VaR和CVaR等不同风险准则下的优化问题，为随机优化领域提供了一种灵活而高效的求解途径。

title: CAVEAT: Recurrent Multimodal Diffusion Planning for Mapless Aerial Exploration
summary: Can exploratory UAV waypoint sequences be generated from multimodal onboard observations and a fixed-dimensional recurrent internal state without maintaining a persistent global map in the deployed policy? We investigate this question through CAVEAT, a diffusion policy conditioned on a recurrent internal state updated from fused LiDAR, visual, and pose features and trained from trajectories generated by the map-based FUELv2 expert. Rolling inference partially warm-starts consecutive predictions, while a temporary local signed distance field provides heuristic obstacle guidance. Simulation results evaluate both inference mechanisms and compare CAVEAT with its demonstration-generating expert. Proof-of-concept experiments on a Flyability Elios 3 demonstrate partial exploration of a previously unseen indoor environment and target-directed visual servoing using a separately trained policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAVEAT，一种基于扩散策略的无人机探索导航方法，通过将LiDAR、视觉和位姿特征融合到固定维度的循环内部状态中，无需在部署策略中维护全局地图即可生成探索性的UAV航点序列。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以在部署时不维护持久全局地图的前提下，仅依靠多模态机载观测和固定维度的循环内部状态来生成无人机探索航点序列，从而实现更轻量、更具泛化性的探索策略。
AI.method: CAVEAT采用扩散策略，以多模态（LiDAR、视觉、位姿）特征更新的循环内部状态为条件。训练数据来源于基于地图的FUELv2专家生成轨迹。推理时采用滚动推断以部分热启动连续预测，并结合临时局部有符号距离场（SDF）提供启发式避障指导。
AI.result: 仿真结果评估了两种推理机制，并将CAVEAT与其生成演示的专家进行比较。在Flyability Elios 3上的概念验证实验展示了在未见室内环境中的部分探索能力，以及使用单独训练的策略进行目标导向视觉伺服的能力。
AI.conclusion: CAVEAT验证了无需持久全局地图即可实现探索性航点生成的可行性，表明循环内部状态加多模态观测足以驱动部分探索，且该框架可扩展到目标导向的视觉伺服任务。

title: Frequency Domain Biot--Allard Equations for Isotropic and Anisotropic Poroelastic Media: Two-field formulations and iterative splitting
summary: We present a frequency-domain formulation of Biot's dynamic poroelastic equations with frequency-dependent dissipation (Biot--Allard) for anisotropic, heterogeneous media with memory effects. Two equivalent two-field representations--a displacement-pressure and a velocity-pressure-rate formulation--enable stabilized iterative splitting. While coupling operators generally lack an adjoint or skew-adjoint relationship at finite frequencies, the velocity--pressure-rate representation restores a skew-adjoint structure in the quasi-static limit. We prove continuity of the coupling operators and coercivity of the diagonal blocks, essential for convergence of the L-stabilized splitting scheme. The frequency-domain setting eliminates convolutional memory terms, incorporates attenuation and dispersion via complex-valued parameters, and reduces the time-dependent problem to a family of elliptic boundary-value problems suited for parallel computation and multi-frequency inversion. A conforming Galerkin finite element discretization preserves block structure, and numerical experiments confirm robustness and capture frequency-dependent attenuation. To illustrate discretization independence, we include a large-scale wave simulation using a pseudo-spectral method. This work provides a rigorous and efficient framework for modeling wave phenomena in complex porous media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Biot-Allard动态孔隙弹性方程在频域中的公式化表述，适用于具有记忆效应的各向异性、非均匀介质。文中给出了两种等效的两场表示（位移-压力与速度-压力率），并引入稳定的L-稳定迭代分裂方案；通过证明耦合算子连续性与对角块强制性，保证了方案的收敛性。频域方法消除了卷积记忆项，将时变问题化为可通过并行计算求解的椭圆边值问题族，数值实验证实了鲁棒性与频变衰减捕捉能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂孔隙介质中的波传播建模需要处理频率相关的耗散和记忆效应。传统时域方法面临卷积记忆项的计算开销和稳定性的挑战，而现有的频域公式在有限频率下耦合算子缺乏伴随或斜伴随结构，难以设计收敛的迭代分裂方案。因此需要一种既保持物理模型完整性又能提供可证明收敛的数值算法的框架。
AI.method: 1) 在频域中重新表述Biot-Allard方程，利用复值参数自然纳入衰减和色散。2) 提出两种等效两场表示：位移-压力（u-p）与速度-压力率（v-p_dot），后者在准静态极限恢复斜伴随结构。3) 证明耦合算子的连续性和对角块的强制性，为L-稳定迭代分裂方案的收敛提供理论基础。4) 采用协调Galerkin有限元离散保持块结构，并在需要时使用伪谱方法进行大规模模拟。
AI.result: 数值实验证实了该方法的鲁棒性，并成功捕捉了频率依赖的衰减现象。大规模波传播模拟（采用伪谱方法）展示了离散化无关性。理论分析确立了耦合算子连续性与对角块强制性的严格数学基础，保证了迭代分裂方案的收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为复杂孔隙介质中的波现象建模提供了一个严格且高效的框架：频域方法在保持物理完整性的同时降低了计算复杂度，并天然地适用于多频率反演与并行计算。

title: Phase-Resolved Ultra-High-Energy Emission Defines an Energetic Boundary for Compact-Object Engines and Dense-Matter Structure
summary: We show that phase-resolved ultra-high-energy emission from LS I +61 303 defines a critical energetic boundary linking the compact-object engine, circumstellar interaction depth, and dense-matter structure. Combining the GeV-TeV-UHE spectral transition with an orbital acceleration-transparency sieve and branch-resolved stellar sequences for 116 certified EoS, we find that the measured 25-100 TeV tail primarily constrains the circumstellar environment, whereas a more demanding pure-hadronic > 1 TeV interpretation reaches the physical moment-of-inertia distribution. At 2.0 kpc and 1.4 M_sun, the latter gives I45,crit = 1.5504; 82 of 116 EoS satisfy the corresponding energetic boundary at Pdot_ref = 3 x 10^-15 s s^-1. A separately applied tidal diagnostic, Lambda_1.4 <= 580, is satisfied by 43 EoS, with nine satisfying both conditions. These models span several microscopic classes but occupy a narrow structural region, indicating structural overlap rather than selection of a unique EoS family. A separate GeV power-budget test requires Pdot_rot >= 5.65 x 10^-14 f_Omega s s^-1 at 2.0 kpc. For f_Omega ~ 1, the source lies well above the UHE crossing and the EoS discrimination disappears. The UHE observation therefore identifies the engine-environment regime in which differences in neutron-star structure can become observationally discriminating, rather than defining a universal dense-matter selector.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对LS I +61 303的相位分辨超高能(UHE)发射进行分析，结合轨道加速-透明筛与116种认证EoS的星序序列，发现25-100 TeV尾区主要约束星周环境，而纯强子>1 TeV解释才能触及物理转动惯量分布。在2.0 kpc和1.4 M_sun条件下给出I45,crit=1.5504的临界能量边界，82/116种EoS满足；潮汐诊断Lambda_1.4<=580有43种满足，9种同时满足两个条件，表明存在结构重叠而非唯一EoS族。作者认为UHE观测识别的是引擎-环境区域中中子星结构差异可被观测辨别的条件，而非普适致密物质选择器。
AI.motivation: 需要确定相位分辨的超高能发射是否能作为区分中子星致密物质方程状态(EoS)的可观测探针，以及弄清UHE观测究竟约束的是星周环境还是致密物质的内部结构，从而界定天体观测对核物理模型真正具有甄别力的物理条件。
AI.method: 将GeV-TeV-UHE谱跃迁与轨道加速度-透明度筛选结合，对LS I +61 303进行相位分辨分析；对116种认证EoS进行分支分辨的星序（恒星序列）计算；分别在纯强子>1 TeV解释框架下推导转动惯量临界值，并施加潮汐形变诊断Lambda_1.4，同时进行GeV功率预算检验以评估自转功率下限Pdot_rot。
AI.result: 在2.0 kpc和1.4 M_sun下，纯强子解释给出I45,crit=1.5504，82/116种EoS满足Pdot_ref=3x10^-15 s s^-1下的能量边界；43种EoS满足Lambda_1.4<=580，仅9种同时满足两项条件。这些模型横跨多个微观类别但聚集在狭窄结构区域。GeV功率测试要求Pdot_rot>=5.65x10^-14 f_Omega s s^-1，当f_Omega~1时源远超UHE交叉点，EoS甄别能力消失。
AI.conclusion: LS I +61 303的UHE观测并非通用致密物质选择器，而是限定了天体物理环境中中子星结构差异能够变得观测可辨别的引擎-环境边界条件；25-100 TeV发射主要约束星周环境，仅更严格的纯强子解释才触及EoS信息，且最多能实现多微观EoS类的结构重叠约束而非唯一EoS族的确定。

title: Residual finiteness and cuspidal cohomology of Picard modular surfaces
summary: We prove that, for every non-uniform arithmetic lattice in $\mathrm{SU}(2,1)$, its inverse images in the universal cover and in all connected finite covers are residually finite. The key new input is that every commensurability class of such lattices contains a congruence arithmetic lattice $Γ$ for which $$H^1_{\mathrm{cusp}}(Γ\backslash\mathbb B^2,\mathbb C)\ne 0.$$ In particular, the first inner cohomology of this ball quotient is non-zero. The proof uses Rogawski's endoscopic classification for $\mathrm{U}(3)$. A cohomological criterion proved previously by the author then gives the residual-finiteness result. Residual finiteness also yields multiplier systems of arbitrary denominator on suitable finite-index subgroups.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了SU(2,1)中的每个非均匀算术格在万有覆盖和所有连通有限覆盖中的逆像都是剩余有限的。关键新结果：每个这样的格的交换类包含一个同余算术格Γ，其尖点上同调H^1_cusp非零。证明使用Rogawski对U(3)的内窥分类，结合作者此前证明的上同调判据。剩余有限性还给出了任意分母的乘子系统。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在解决SU(2,1)中非均匀算术格的剩余有限性问题——即这些格在覆盖群中的预像是否为剩余有限群。这是非正曲率空间形式和算术格理论中的一个重要结构性问题，此前对于复双曲面情形尚缺乏一般性结论。
AI.method: 方法核心分三步：首先证明每个非均匀算术格的交换类中存在一个同余算术格Γ满足H^1_cusp(Γ\B²,ℂ)≠0（第一内上同调非零）；利用Rogawski对酉群U(3)的自守形式内窥分类来建立这一尖点上同调非零性；最后借助作者此前证明的上同调判据，由上同调非零推出剩余有限性结论。
AI.result: 得到的主要结果：(1) SU(2,1)中每个非均匀算术格在万有覆盖和所有连通有限覆盖中的逆像都是剩余有限的；(2) 作为推论，在合适的有限指数子群上存在任意分母的乘子系统。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过同余格与内窥分类的技术手段，完整解决了SU(2,1)中非均匀算术格的剩余有限性问题，并揭示了尖点内上同调非零性在格论性质中的关键作用，为复双曲空间形式理论提供了新的结构定理。

title: On the Asymptotic Switching Density in Time-Optimal Control of Linear Systems
summary: We study the time-optimal control of a controllable linear system on a time horizon [0,T], focusing on the asymptotic switching density for large T. When the system matrix has only real eigenvalues, it is well-known that the number of switches is upper bounded uniformly in T; when it has complex eigenvalues, no such uniform bound exists, and the switching count instead typically grows with T. We characterize this growth for a system matrix with an arbitrary spectrum, allowing simultaneously for real eigenvalues, complex eigenvalues, and a non-trivial Jordan structure. If the dominant mode is complex, the number of switches grows at least linearly in T, with an explicit lower bound expressed via the mean motion problem and the Bohl-Weyl-Wintner formula. We illustrate the theory on a linearized aircraft pitch/altitude model, showing close agreement between the predicted asymptotic switching rate and numerically computed time-optimal controls.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可控线性系统在有限时域[0,T]上的时间最优控制，重点关注大T下的渐近切换密度。对于仅含实特征值的系统矩阵，切换次数有统一上界；而对于含复特征值的情形，切换次数随T增长。文章给出了任意谱（包含实特征值、复特征值及非平凡Jordan结构）下切换次数的增长刻画，并通过Bohl-Weyl-Wintner公式和平均运动问题给出复主导模态下的线性下界。最后在线性化的飞机俯仰/高度模型上验证了理论预测与数值结果的吻合。
AI.motivation: 时间最优控制中切换次数的渐近行为对于理解最优控制结构至关重要。已有研究仅分别讨论了实特征值（切换次数有界）与复特征值（无界增长）两种极端情形，缺乏对一般谱结构（同时包含实特征值、复特征值及Jordan块）下切换增长率的系统刻画，需要填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 利用平均运动（mean motion）问题与Bohl-Weyl-Wintner公式，对系统矩阵的任意谱结构（包括实特征值、复特征值和Jordan块共存的情形）分析时间最优控制中切换时间序列的渐近密度，推导出复主导模态下切换次数的显式线性下界，并通过线性化飞机俯仰/高度模型进行数值验证。
AI.result: 在系统矩阵具有任意谱结构时，若主导模态为复模态，则切换次数至少随时间T线性增长，下界可通过平均运动问题和Bohl-Weyl-Wintner公式显式表达。数值实验表明，线性化飞机模型上理论预测的渐近切换率与数值计算的时间最优控制高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了任意谱结构下时间最优控制切换次数的渐近增长规律：复主导模态必然导致切换次数随T线性增长，且增长下界可通过谱相关的量精确刻画。这为含复模态线性系统的切换最优控制设计提供了理论基础和可操作的计算工具。

title: SkillX: Unified Multi-Skill Policy Learning for Humanoid Soccer
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project page: https://yzc0731.github.io/SkillX/
summary: Humanoid soccer is a challenging testbed for dynamic whole-body control, requiring robots to coordinate balance, locomotion, object interaction, and skill switching over long horizons. Existing humanoid sports methods often rely on task-specific multi-stage pipelines, making it difficult to jointly learn and compose multiple object-interactive skills within a single deployable policy. To address this, we present SkillX, a unified reinforcement learning framework that learns and composes multiple atomic soccer skills through a single command-conditioned policy. SkillX integrates three core designs: skill-specific adversarial motion priors, skill-specific critics, and an object-aware temporal encoder, enabling the robot to execute atomic skills and transition among them such as dribbling, trapping, and shooting. Experiments in simulation and on a real Noetix E1 humanoid demonstrate robust multi-skill execution, long-horizon skill composition, and successful sim-to-real deployment.

AI.tldr: SkillX是一个统一的强化学习框架，通过单一命令条件化策略学习并组合多种足球原子技能（如带球、停球、射门），结合技能特定对抗动作先验、技能特定评论家和物体感知时间编码器，在仿真和真实Noetix E1人形机器人上实现了多技能的鲁棒执行、长时程技能组合和sim-to-real成功部署。
AI.motivation: 现有人形机器人体育方法多依赖任务特定的多阶段流水线，难以在单一可部署策略中联合学习和组合多种物体交互技能，挑战在于长时程内协调平衡、运动、物体交互和技能切换。
AI.method: SkillX整合三大核心设计：技能特定的对抗性动作先验（skill-specific adversarial motion priors）、技能特定的评论家（skill-specific critics）、以及物体感知的时间编码器（object-aware temporal encoder），通过一个命令条件化策略统一学习多个原子足球技能并支持彼此间的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 在仿真环境和真实Noetix E1人形机器人上的实验表明，该方法实现了鲁棒的多技能执行、长时程技能组合以及成功的sim-to-real部署。
AI.conclusion: SkillX验证了通过统一框架实现人形机器人多种物体交互技能的可学习与可组合性，为多人形体育领域的端到端策略学习提供了可行范式。

title: A Systematic Analysis of Automatic Differentiation versus Discretization-based Constraints for Physics-Informed PDE Solvers
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent a growing frontier in using artificial intelligence to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Automatic differentiation (AD) plays a central role in this paradigm, which is mesh-free and replaces traditional iterative solvers with gradient-based optimization in continuous space. However, the inherent limitations of AD, particularly in handling higher-order derivatives and discontinuous solutions, pose significant challenges for complex problems. This has motivated a growing number of researchers to explore discretization-based constraints as an alternative path. Yet, the respective applicability of these two paradigms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we conduct systematic experiments across a wide spectrum of problems, from simple linear Poisson to high-Mach hypersonic flows with strong discontinuities. Through a rigorous decomposition of approximation, optimization, and truncation errors, we systematically elucidate the fundamental trade-offs and error-governing mechanisms of both paradigms, as well as two representative network architectures: multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and graph neural network (GNN). Our results reveal a consistent trend: as nonlinearity strengthens, the accuracy advantage of discretization-based constraints becomes increasingly pronounced, with smaller optimization errors compensating for the truncation errors. Moreover, the more complex the nonlinearity and boundary conditions, the greater the advantage of GNN over MLP. These insights offer a robust practical guideline for configuring neural PDE solvers in demanding engineering applications. Our source data and code are available at https://github.com/guoxing0809/neuropde_analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了物理信息神经网络（PINNs）中基于自动微分（AD）和基于离散化约束这两种范式，在不同复杂度的PDE问题上的适用性，揭示了非线性强度与离散化约束优势的关系，并为工程应用中配置神经PDE求解器提供了实用指南。
AI.motivation: PINNs利用自动微分求解PDE虽然灵活且无网格，但在处理高阶导数和间断解时存在固有局限，促使研究者探索基于离散化约束的替代路径。然而，这两种范式的适用范围尚未被系统探索，缺乏定量对比和误差机制分析。
AI.method: 在从简单线性Poisson方程到强间断高马赫数超声速流动的广泛问题谱系上开展系统性实验，通过将误差严格分解为逼近误差、优化误差和截断误差三个部分，对比分析了基于AD约束与基于离散化约束两种范式，以及多层感知机（MLP）和图神经网络（GNN）两种代表性网络架构的性能表现。
AI.result: 实验发现一致性趋势：随着非线性的增强，基于离散化约束的方法精度优势越发明显，其更小的优化误差足以补偿引入的截断误差；同时，非线性和边界条件越复杂，GNN相对MLP的优势越大。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为具有高要求的工程应用中配置神经PDE求解器提供了稳健的实践指南，并公开了源代码和数据以支持可复现研究。

title: Strong Polarization Signatures from Magnetically Stabilized Luminous Thin Accretion Disks
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, to appear in Astrophysical Journal
summary: We utilize the Monte Carlo radiation transport capabilities of Cosmos++ to explore the polarization and Faraday rotation of radiation emitted from a set of general relativistic radiation magnetohydrodynamic simulations of magnetically stabilized, thin, black hole accretion disks. The guiding question is whether or not the Faraday rotation depolarizes the radiation to such a degree as to be inconsistent with the relatively high polarization measurements coming from the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE). After first confirming that our code reproduces expected polarization results for electron clouds, planar scattering atmospheres, and AGN disks, we demonstrate the polarization and Faraday rotation capabilities using a Novikov-Thorne disk threaded with a purely toroidal magnetic field. We then analyze temporal snapshots from three different simulations of luminous, thin accretion disks threaded with different magnetic field configurations. We find that the effects of Faraday rotation are generally modest over the energy range of interest, since the strongest fields present in these simulations ($\gtrsim 10^8$ G) are mostly hidden beneath the photosphere. We can easily produce polarization degrees $\ge 4$\% for sources seen mostly edge-on. As one example of a relevant target, we compare our results to an IXPE observation of Cyg X-1, finding that we can match the polarization degree quite well, though our polarization angle is rotated approximately $90^\circ$ with respect to the observed data. We speculate on a few possible explanations for this.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用Monte Carlo辐射传输模拟，研究了带有法拉第旋转的磁稳定薄黑洞吸积盘的偏振特性，发现法拉第旋转的消偏振效应通常较弱，可以重现IXPE观测到的高偏振度（≥4%），并通过Cyg X-1的对比验证了模型有效性。
AI.motivation: 探究法拉第旋转是否会将辐射消偏振到与IXPE观测到的高偏振度不一致的程度，以验证磁稳定薄黑洞吸积盘模型的适用性。
AI.method: 使用Cosmos++代码的Monte Carlo辐射传输能力，对广义相对论辐射磁流体力学（GRRMHD）模拟得到的磁稳定薄黑洞吸积盘进行偏振与法拉第旋转分析。首先通过电子云、平面散射大气和AGN盘验证代码的偏振重现能力，随后对带有纯环向磁场的Novikov-Thorne盘进行演示，最后分析三种不同磁场构型的发光薄吸积盘模拟的时间快照。
AI.result: 研究发现，由于模拟中最强的磁场（≥10^8 G）大多隐藏于光球之下，法拉第旋转在感兴趣的能段内对偏振的影响通常较为温和。对于近乎侧视的源可以轻松产生≥4%的偏振度。以Cyg X-1的IXPE观测为对比，偏振度匹配良好，但偏振角与观测数据相差约90°。
AI.conclusion: 法拉第旋转不会显著消偏振至与IXPE观测矛盾，模型可以重现高偏振度观测；偏振角的90°差异引发了对几种可能解释的探讨。

title: Sharp Diameter Bounds for Nonnegative Cyclotomic Multiples
summary: Let \(N\ge2\) and let \(p\) be its least prime divisor. We prove that every nonzero polynomial with nonnegative real coefficients divisible by \(Φ_N\) has support diameter at least \((p-1)N/p\). Equality holds precisely for positive scalar multiples of monomial shifts of the \(p\)-term geometric sum \(\sum_{j=0}^{p-1} X^{jN/p}\), thereby proving a conjecture of Steinberger. The proof turns cyclotomic divisibility into the vanishing of the first \(p-1\) Fourier moments of a positive measure on the circle and then applies a classical extremal trigonometric polynomial. As a consequence, we establish the Coven--Meyerowitz diameter bound under their tiling conditions and determine its equality cases. Longer initial intervals of vanishing Fourier coefficients yield stronger diameter bounds, including an explicit refinement in terms of the prime-power divisor sets. The extremal trigonometric polynomial also yields a quantitative concentration estimate for measures and cyclotomic multiples with near-minimal support diameter.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个关于分圆多项式倍式支持直径的猜想：任何被Φ_N整除的、具有非负实系数的非零多项式，其支持直径至少为(p-1)N/p，其中p是N的最小素因子；等号成立当且仅当该多项式是p项几何和的正标量倍与单项式平移的乘积。证明将分圆整除性问题转化为正测度在圆周上前p-1个傅里叶矩的消失，并应用经典的极值三角多项式。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在证明Steinberger提出的关于分圆多项式倍数支持直径的下界猜想，并由此推导Coven-Meyerowitz条件下的直径界及其等号情形，深化对极小多项式结构中支持集长度与结构之间关系的理解。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 将分圆整除性等价转化为正测度（以多项式系数作为离散权重）在单位圆上的前p-1个傅里叶矩消失；(2) 使用经典的极值三角函数多项式来建立傅里叶矩消失条件下的支持集中性下界；(3) 通过分析等号条件刻画达到极值的特征测度，从而确定等号情形对应p项几何和。此外，作者还利用更长初始区间的傅里叶系数消失来推导更强的直径界，并以素幂因子集合给出显式细化。
AI.result: 建立了支持直径下界(p-1)N/p并完整刻画了等号情形，证明了Steinberger猜想；作为推论，确立了Coven-Meyerowitz平铺条件下互补多项式的直径界及其等号情形；通过傅里叶系数更长消失区间的假设获得了更强的直径界和以素幂因子集为指标的显式改进；极值多项式还导出了对接近最小支持直径的测度和分圆倍数的量化集中估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以优雅的傅里叶分析方法完全解决了Steinberger猜想，统一了分圆多项式、平铺理论和极值三角多项式理论，为Coven-Meyerowitz条件提供了精确的直径界描述，并为进一步研究近极值结构开辟了途径。

title: On Minimax Optimality and Uniqueness of Fixed-Step First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization
summary: This paper considers the design of optimal fixed-step first-order methods for high-dimensional minimization of $L$-smooth convex functions. For optimizing worst-case performance measured via suboptimality of the final function value (relative to the initial squared distance to a minimizer), we provide an algebraic proof of the optimality of the optimized gradient method (OGM) and establish its uniqueness among all fixed-step first-order methods. For the alternative measure of final squared gradient norm (relative to initial suboptimality), we prove the OGM-G method is optimal and uniquely so among fixed-step first-order methods. Finally, for the setting measuring the final squared gradient norm (relative to the initial squared distance to a minimizer), we show the recently proposed Lemniscate method is optimal and uniquely so. Our proofs rely on algebraic reductions for lower bound arguments rather than traditional information-theoretic bounds, which were previously only able to establish OGM's optimality but not uniqueness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维L-光滑凸函数最小化问题中最优固定步长一阶方法的设计，针对三种不同的性能指标（最终函数值次优性、最终平方梯度范数相对于初始次优性或初始距离），分别证明了OGM、OGM-G和Lemniscate方法的唯一最优性。
AI.motivation: 已有的信息论下界方法只能证明OGM在特定性能指标下是最优的，但无法证明其唯一性，也无法为其他性能度量（如梯度范数）下的方法提供类似的严格最优性证明。因此需要新的代数归约技术来建立更全面的最优性和唯一性结果。
AI.method: 采用代数归约方法来构造下界论证，替代传统的信息论下界技术。通过对不同性能度量下固定步长一阶方法的优化结构进行代数分析，建立了对应方法的最优性及其唯一性证明。
AI.result: 证明了：(1) OGM在最终函数值次优性（相对于到极小点的初始平方距离）指标下唯一最优；(2) OGM-G在最终平方梯度范数（相对于初始次优性）指标下唯一最优；(3) Lemniscate方法在最终平方梯度范数（相对于初始平方距离）指标下唯一最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过代数归约的下界论证，本文统一了三种性能度量下固定步长一阶方法的最优性与唯一性证明框架，弥补了传统信息论方法无法证明唯一性的缺陷。

title: OCTN: Neural OCT Representations for Robot-Guided Precision Intervention
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) offers compact, contactless, micron-scale imaging suitable for intraoperative guidance, but native OCT volumes are discretely sampled, anisotropic, and currently inefficient for downstream geometric reasoning and robot integration. We present OCTN (pronounced "octane"), an implicit neural representation framework that converts volumetric OCT scans into a continuous, differentiable, and spatially faithful tissue-intensity field. OCTN uses a two-stage hybrid training strategy that combines supervision from acquired voxels with inter-slice interpolations, preserving B-scan fidelity while improving continuity in sparsely sampled regions. For versatility, we first show that OCTN enables fast volumetric reasoning by storing the learned tissue representation natively on the GPU, supporting intensity-based spatial queries with up to 43x speedup over conventional CPU processing. We then demonstrate OCTN-enabled OCT-guided robotic laser surgery where the continuous tissue representation supports implicit surface discovery and surface-constrained path planning via multiple optimization strategies, including Newton- and SGD-based optimization. Next, OCTN enables reconstruction of dense volumetric structure from sparsely acquired B-scans, while reducing acquisition time by 4x and preserving clinically relevant structures. Across the newly generated Duke TissueOCT dataset and public OCT datasets, OCTN achieves robust, high-fidelity reconstruction with PSNR > 30 dB and training time < 10 s, while preserving surface consistency within 10 $μ$m Chamfer distance relative to baseline reconstruction. The TissueOCT dataset and code are publicly available at raprakashvi.github.io/octn

AI.tldr: OCTN（发音"octane"）是一种用于光学相干断层扫描（OCT）数据的隐式神经表示框架，可将离散、各向异性的OCT体扫描转换为连续、可微分的组织强度场。通过两阶段混合训练策略，OCTN实现了高保真重建（PSNR>30dB，训练<10s），支持GPU上的快速体素推理（比CPU快43倍），并应用于OCT引导的机器人激光手术中的隐式表面发现与路径规划，以及从稀疏B扫描重建稠密体积结构（采样时间减少4倍）。
AI.motivation: 原生OCT体扫描是离散采样、各向异性的，且难以有效支持下游几何推理与机器人系统集成。现有方法无法高效地将OCT数据转化为连续、可微分的表示，限制了术中引导和自动化手术等应用。
AI.method: OCTN采用隐式神经表示，将OCT体扫描编码为连续可微分的组织强度场。具体包括：(1) 两阶段混合训练策略，结合采集体素的监督与帧间插值，在保持B扫描保真度的同时改善稀疏采样区域的连续性；(2) 将学习到的组织表示原生存储在GPU上，支持基于强度的快速空间查询；(3) 利用Newton和SGD等多种优化策略实现隐式表面发现及表面对齐的路径规划；(4) 从稀疏采集的B扫描重建稠密的体积结构。
AI.result: 在新生成的Duke TissueOCT数据集及公开OCT数据集上，OCTN实现了高保真重建（PSNR>30dB），训练时间<10秒，表面一致性在Chamfer距离10μm以内。GPU原生表示相较于传统CPU处理实现43倍加速。稀疏采样重建将采集时间减少4倍，同时保留临床相关结构。数据集和代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: OCTN提供了一种紧凑、连续、可微分的OCT组织表示方案，成功弥合了OCT成像与机器人手术、几何推理之间的鸿沟，在保证重建质量和表面一致性的同时显著提升了计算效率和采集效率。

title: Analysis of a Surface Crouzeix-Raviart Element for the Stokes Problem
summary: Recently, increasing attention has been paid to finite element discretizations of vector-valued flow problems posed on curved surfaces. In this work, we study a surface Stokes system defined on a two-dimensional manifold embedded in three-dimensional space. The surface velocity field is approximated using a nonconforming Crouzeix-Raviart finite element on a polyhedral approximation of the surface, while the pressure is discretized by piecewise constant functions. The governing equations involve the symmetric strain-rate tensor, whose approximation with Crouzeix-Raviart finite elements leads to spurious oscillations in the velocity field because the discrete Korn inequality fails on the nonconforming space. We therefore stabilize the momentum equation by adding an edge-jump penalty term, which restores the coervity of the bilinear term as the discrete Korn inequality holds for this stabilized version. Additionally, we establish that this finite element pair of velocity and pressure spaces satisfies the discrete inf-sup compatibility condition. Furthermore, we derive optimal a-priori error estimates in both the energy norm and the $L^2$-norm. These theoretical results are corroborated by numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究曲面上矢量值Stokes系统的有限元离散：在曲面的多面体逼近上，用非协调Crouzeix-Raviart有限元逼近速度场、分片常数函数逼近压力。由于对称应变率张量在非协调空间上不满足离散Korn不等式导致速度场产生伪振荡，通过添加边跳罚项恢复双线性形式的强制性，并证明了速度-压力有限元对满足离散inf-sup相容性条件，进一步推导了能量范数和L²范数下的最优先验误差估计，数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 曲面上矢量值流动问题的有限元离散化日益受到关注，但非协调Crouzeix-Raviart有限元在逼近曲面Stokes系统时，由于离散Korn不等式在非协调空间上不成立，导致使用对称应变率张量的控制方程会出现速度场的伪振荡，需要提出有效的稳定化策略。
AI.method: 采用非协调Crouzeix-Raviart有限元在多面体曲面逼近上离散速度场，使用分片常数函数离散压力。通过添加边跳罚项（edge-jump penalty term）对动量方程进行稳定化，以恢复双线性形式的强制性并使离散Korn不等式对该稳定化版本成立。
AI.result: 证明稳定化后的有限元对满足离散Korn不等式（恢复其强制性）以及离散inf-sup相容性条件；推导出能量范数和L²范数下的最优先验误差估计，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 边跳罚项能有效修复非协调Crouzeix-Raviart有限元在曲面Stokes系统中的伪振荡问题，该稳定化方法具有良好的理论保障（收敛性与相容性）并得到数值实验的证实。

title: Resolving structure within the iron line profile of Serpens X-1 with XRISM and NuSTAR
comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ, 15 pages, 6 figures
summary: We present the first simultaneous XRISM and NuSTAR observations of the neutron star low mass X-ray binary Serpens X-1. We perform spectral modeling on the joint observations of XRISM/Resolve, XRISM/Xtend, and NuSTAR, testing Comptonization and double thermal continuum model prescriptions. We find that a hybrid double thermal model adequately describes the underlying continuum of the source while the Comptonization models predict largely unphysical parameter values. We perform reflection modeling and confirm with tight constraints an inclination of 5^{\circ} \pm 1^{\circ} and inner disk radius of 6.6 \pm 0.6 Rg for the source. We show that the spectral resolution of XRISM/Resolve allows for the determination of a unique inner disk radius, which has the potential to constrain neutron star spin in other systems. We discuss discrepancies in spectral shape between XRISM/Resolve and NuSTAR above \sim 8 keV. We also present lightcurve and spectral analyses of 8 Type-I X-ray bursts that occurred during the observations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次联合分析XRISM和NuSTAR对中子星低质量X射线双星Serpens X-1的观测数据，通过双热连续谱模型与反射建模，精确约束了系统倾角（5°±1°）和内盘半径（6.6±0.6 Rg），并分析了观测期间发生的8次Type-I X射线暴。
AI.motivation: 利用新一代高分辨率X射线光谱仪器（XRISM/Resolve）与宽能段仪器（NuSTAR）首次联合观测，以解决中子星低质量X射线双星中连续谱模型选择的歧义性，并通过高分辨率光谱精确测定内盘半径以约束中子星自旋等物理参数。
AI.method: 对XRISM/Resolve、XRISM/Xtend和NuSTAR的联合光谱进行建模，测试了康普顿化模型与双热连续谱模型两种描述方案；采用反射建模来确定系统几何参数；同时对8次Type-I X射线暴进行了光变曲线与光谱分析。
AI.result: 发现双热连续谱模型能充分描述源连续谱，而康普顿化模型预测出不物理的参数值。反射建模以严格约束给出倾角5°±1°、内盘半径6.6±0.6 Rg。确认XRISM/Resolve的光谱分辨率可唯一确定内盘半径。发现~8 keV以上XRISM/Resolve与NuSTAR之间存在光谱形状差异。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率X射线光谱学能够唯一确定中子星LMXB的内盘半径，从而为在其他系统中约束中子星自旋提供途径；本研究同时展示了多仪器联合观测在连续谱模型判别和X射线暴研究中的优势。

title: A pencil of quadratic forms in nine variables with no member of Witt index four
summary: We exhibit an explicit pair $(A,B)$ of integral symmetric $9\times9$ matrices, defining a nonsingular pair of quadratic forms over $\mathbb{Q}$, such that no member of the rational pencil $λq_A+μq_B$ has Witt index $4$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. This refutes a conjecture from \cite{Que16a}, which predicted that every nonsingular pair in $n$ variables generates a pencil containing a form of Witt index $\lceil (n-1)/2\rceil$. The obstruction is purely $2$-adic and affects the whole pencil at once: every member has Witt index exactly $3$ over $\mathbb{Q}_2$. The proof is finite and elementary: a parity argument on $\det(λA+μB)$, a congruence lemma reducing $\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{Q}_2)$ to the twelve classes of $\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{Z}/8)$, and a verification at each class, in which the anisotropy verdict is certified in two independent ways. All scripts are provided in the GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一对9×9整对称矩阵(A,B)，定义了Q上的非奇异二次型对，使得该有理铅笔中没有任何成员在Q上具有Witt指标4，从而否定了Que16a中的猜想（该猜想预测n元非奇异对生成的铅笔中必含Witt指标为⌈(n-1)/2⌉的型）。其障碍纯属2进性质，且同时影响整个铅笔：每个成员在Q_2上的Witt指标恰好为3。证明是有限且初等的。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在检验并反驳Que16a中提出的猜想，该猜想声称每个n变量中的非奇异二次型对生成的铅笔总包含一个Witt指标为⌈(n-1)/2⌉的成员。通过构造一个显式反例来揭示该猜想的局限性。
AI.method: 证明方法完全有限且初等，包含三个关键步骤：(1) 对det(λA+μB)进行奇偶性论证；(2) 一个同余引理，将P^1(Q_2)约化为P^1(Z/8)的十二个等价类；(3) 对每个等价类逐一验证，各向异性判定以两种独立方式核实。所有验证脚本已公开于GitHub仓库。
AI.result: 成功构造出满足条件的显式9×9矩阵对(A,B)，其定义的有理铅笔中每个成员在Q上均不具有Witt指标4（实际每个成员在Q上Witt指标至多3），而且在Q_2上每个成员的Witt指标恰好为3，说明障碍是纯2进的且影响整个铅笔。
AI.conclusion: Que16a的猜想被推翻。该反例表明关于Witt指标的铅笔性质猜想需要修正，障碍可仅源于2进局部行为，且能同时影响铅笔中的所有成员而非仅个别例外。

title: Efficient Optimization on the Euclidean Sphere: Riemannian Gradient Alignment as a Unifying Principle
summary:
Euclidean sphere-constrained optimization problems represent perhaps the most basic class of nonconvex-constrained problems for which there exist efficient optimization algorithms for specific problem instances, such as the eigenvalue problems and learning problems arising in the recent literature. However, when and why we can efficiently optimize on the sphere using simple first-order methods is poorly understood. We introduce Riemannian Gradient Alignment (RGA) as a unifying structural condition enabling fast convergence. RGA is a parameterized directional error bound requiring a tangent vector to sufficiently align with a target solution vector. We prove that Riemannian Gradient Descent with diminishing step sizes converges linearly when RGA holds with order $r=1$, and at rate $O(k^{-1/(2r-2)})$ for $r>1$. The result applies even to tangent vector fields that are not gradients of any objective.
  Our main technical contribution is a family of derivative-based sufficient conditions for RGA. We prove these conditions for a range of learning problems, including multi-instance learning/max pooling, Gaussian halfspaces, single-index and generalized linear models, phase retrieval, complete orthogonal dictionary learning, and (sparse) PCA. The provided examples span distributional families that include standard Gaussian, conditionally Gaussian, and more general structured distributions. The provided guarantees cover objectives that are generally not (geodesically) convex, may be nonsmooth, and may arise from discrete distributions. These results establish tractability of problem classes where no prior error bound conditions were known, as well as unify, strengthen, and generalize several prior results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼梯度对齐（RGA）作为统一的充分条件，用于解释和保证一阶优化方法在欧几里得球面约束非凸问题上的快速收敛性，并给出了基于导数的一系列可验证充分条件，应用于多种机器学习问题。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得球面约束优化是最基本的非凸约束优化问题类别，特定问题（如特征值问题和机器学习问题）存在高效算法，但为什么以及何时简单的球面一阶方法能够高效收敛尚不清楚，缺乏统一的收敛性理论框架。
AI.method: 引入黎曼梯度对齐（RGA）——一种参数化的方向性误差界条件，要求切向量与目标解向量充分对齐。在RGA成立时，证明黎曼梯度下降（采用递减步长）在阶数r=1时线性收敛，在r>1时以O(k^{-1/(2r-2)})的速度收敛。核心技术贡献是提供一族基于导数的RGA充分条件，并在一系列学习问题中验证这些条件。
AI.result: 证明了RGA条件在多种问题中成立，包括多实例学习/最大池化、高斯半空间、单指标模型、广义线性模型、相位恢复、完全正交字典学习及（稀疏）PCA。涵盖的分布族包括标准高斯、条件高斯及更一般的结构化分布，可处理非测地凸、非光滑乃至离散分布的目标函数。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了此前无误差界条件的问题类别的可解性，同时统一、加强并推广了多项先前的研究成果。

title: RoboSense: Leveraging Robotaxi Fleets as Drive-by Sensors for Urban Traffic Monitoring
summary: Urban traffic monitoring plays a critical role in safety analysis, congestion management, and incident response. The growing deployment of robotaxis creates a new opportunity for network-level traffic monitoring. Although robotaxis are primarily designed to serve passengers, they can also be leveraged as drive-by sensors to collect traffic data. Compared to conventional infrastructure sensors or probe vehicles, a fleet of robotaxis forms a cooperative perception environment, which can collectively gather spatially and temporally continuous traffic information. This paper proposes a novel dynamic robotaxi routing framework that explicitly incorporates traffic monitoring tasks as an objective. The framework introduces: (1) a cell-based network representation that aligns with sensing capabilities of robotaxis; (2) a cell-level monitoring metric to quantify spatiotemporal robotaxi coverage; and (3) a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation that jointly minimizes time-dependent travel time and maximizes traffic monitoring performance. A 5 by 5 urban grid network is built in SUMO to evaluate the framework under three robotaxi market penetration rates (2%, 5%, and 10%) with a range of objective weight combinations. Results show that incorporating spatiotemporal network coverage in the objective function can effectively improve the traffic monitoring performance. Interestingly, with appropriate weights between the two objectives, monitoring performance and robotaxi average speed can be improved simultaneously. This suggests better network monitoring leads to more accurate traffic state prediction and improved mobility. This win-win situation could incentivize robotaxi operators to contribute their vehicles as drive-by sensors for traffic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型动态机器人出租车（robotaxi）路由框架，将交通监控任务纳入路由优化目标。框架包括基于网格的网络表示、时段级监控指标以及联合最小化行程时间和最大化监控性能的混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型。在SUMO构建的5×5城市网格网络中，分别在2%、5%和10%三种市场渗透率下评估。结果表明纳入时空网络覆盖可有效提升监控性能，且适当地权重配置下监控性能与平均速度可同时改善。
AI.motivation: 城市交通监控对安全分析、拥堵管理和事件响应至关重要。随着机器人出租车（robotaxi）部署增加，其可作为路测传感器收集交通数据，形成协作感知环境。然而，现有robotaxi路由通常仅以服务乘客为目标，未充分利用其作为动态传感平台的潜力，缺乏将监控任务显式纳入路由优化的框架。
AI.method: 提出一个双目标优化框架：(1) 采用基于单元（cell-based）的网络表示，匹配robotaxi的感知能力；(2) 定义单元级监控指标（spatiotemporal monitoring metric）以量化时空覆盖；(3) 构建MILP模型，同时最小化时间依赖的行程时间并最大化交通监控性能。在SUMO中构建5×5城市网格网络，考虑2%、5%和10%三种市场渗透率及多种目标权重组合进行仿真评估。
AI.result: 将时空网络覆盖目标加入路由优化能有效改善交通监控性能。值得注意的是，适当选择两个目标间的权重时，监控性能和robotaxi平均速度可同时提升。这表明更好的网络监控可带来更准确的交通状态预测与改善的机动性（mobility）。
AI.conclusion: 网络监控与出行效率之间存在"双赢"关系，即更好的监控能提升交通状态预测精度，进而改善整体出行效率。这种正向反馈可激励robotaxi运营商自愿将车辆作为路测传感器参与交通监控，为网络级交通监控提供了一种可扩展且可持续的解决方案。

title: A numerical method for two-dimensional Boussinesq-Full Dispersion systems modelling internal wave propagation
summary: The paper is concerned with the numerical approximation of some two-dimensional asymptotic models for the propagation of internal waves in a two-layer system in the form of pde's for the interfacial deviation and the velocity. After the study of well-posedness of the periodic initial-value problem, the convergence of a semidiscrete approximation based on a spectral Fourier-Galerkin method is analyzed. The resulting semidiscrete system is then integrated numerically in time with the implicit midpoint rule. Some properties of the fully discrete scheme are described and its performance is illustrated with some numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对两层流体系统中内波传播的二维渐近模型（以界面偏移和速度为变量的PDE方程组），研究周期初值问题的适定性、基于谱Fourier-Galerkin方法的半离散格式的收敛性，以及隐式中点规则的全离散方案及其数值实验。
AI.motivation: 为两层流体系统中内波传播的二维渐近PDE模型提供严格的数值近似理论与实现方案，包括适定性、离散格式收敛性及全离散数值性能的分析。
AI.method: 采用谱Fourier-Galerkin方法进行空间半离散，并结合隐式中点规则（implicit midpoint rule）进行时间离散，形成全离散数值格式。
AI.result: 建立了周期初值问题的适定性，分析了半离散逼近的收敛性，描述了全离散格式的若干性质，并通过数值实验展示了该格式的性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文为二维内波渐近模型的数值求解提供了理论保障与有效算法，验证了所提出的全离散格式在实际计算中的良好表现。

title: Detection of episodic Ultra-fast Outflows in the Low-luminosity quasar Mrk 205 using XMM-Newton data
summary: Ultra-fast outflows (UFOs) from Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) are winds which reach velocities up to 0.3c, and show mass outflow rates of 0.01-1 $M_{\odot} yr^{-1}$ and kinetic energies of $10^{42-45}$ erg/s. Their extreme properties allow UFOs to carry substantial kinetic power, sufficient to drive AGN feedback by injecting energy and momentum into the interstellar medium, regulating the host galaxy evolution and the supermassive black hole growth. In this work, we present a detailed analysis of XMM-Newton X-ray spectra of the low-luminosity quasar Mrk205. We find evidence of multi-component ultra-fast outflows, traced by two components detected in the high-resolution data, showing velocities in the range of $\sim$0.07c to $\sim$0.1c. In addition, we marginally detected an ultra-fast outflow feature in the Fe K band. According to our analysis, Mrk 205 shows episodes of wind launches, rather than persistent winds. We further discuss whether the energy carried by the UFOs in Mrk 205 is capable of producing significant feedback on its host galaxy.

AI.tldr: 本文对低光度类星体Mrk205的XMM-Newton X射线光谱进行详细分析，发现了多层次超快外流（UFOs），其速度范围在0.07c至0.1c之间，并在Fe K波段边缘检测到一个超快外流特征。分析表明Mrk205表现出间歇性的风发射事件而非持续风，文章进一步探讨了这些UFOs携带的能量是否足以对其宿主星系产生显著的反馈效应。
AI.motivation: 活动星系核（AGN）中的超快外流（UFOs）具有极高的速度（可达0.3c）、大规模的质量外流率和动能功率，被认为是驱动AGN反馈的关键机制，能够调节宿主星系的演化和超大质量黑洞的增长。深入研究具体源的UFOs特性对于理解AGN反馈的物理过程和效率至关重要，因此需要对Mrk205这一低光度类星体进行高分辨率X射线光谱分析。
AI.method: 利用XMM-Newton卫星的高分辨率X射线光谱数据，对低光度类星体Mrk205进行详细的谱分析。通过识别高分辨率数据中的多重吸收线特征来确定UFO的不同成分，并在Fe K波段搜寻超快外流的谱特征，进而测量各外流成分的速度、电离状态和柱密度等物理参数。
AI.result: 在Mrk205的高分辨率X射线数据中探测到两个多组分超快外流成分，速度范围约为0.07c至0.1c；此外在Fe K波段边缘检测到一个超快外流特征。这些证据表明Mrk205经历的是间歇性的风发射事件而非持续性的风。
AI.conclusion: Mrk205中存在多组分的超快外流，但其发射呈现间歇性而非持续性。研究进一步讨论了这些UFOs所携带的能量是否足以对其宿主星系产生显著的反馈效应，为低光度类星体中的AGN反馈机制提供了重要观测约束。

title: The spectrum of $(ξα^n)$ can be uncountable
summary: In this note, we give a counterexample to the assertion of Problem 10.4 in Bugeaud's monograph Distribution modulo one and Diophantine approximation, which goes back to Mendès France. The problem states that the spectrum of the sequence $(ξα^n)_{n\ge1}$, that is, the set of irrational $θ\in(0,1)$ for which $(ξα^n-nθ)_{n\ge1}$ is not uniformly distributed modulo one, is at most countable for all real $ξ\ne0$ and $α>1$. More precisely, we prove that for every real $α>1$ there are $2^{\aleph_0}$ real numbers $ξ>0$ for which the spectrum of $(ξα^n)_{n\ge1}$ contains one and the same uncountable set.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个反例，否证了Bugeaud专著中源自Mendès France的开放问题10.4：即对于所有实数ξ≠0和α>1，序列(ξα^n)的谱（使(ξα^n-nθ)不满足一致分布模1的irrational θ集合）至多可数。作者证明对每个实数α>1，存在2^ℵ₀个实数ξ>0，使得(ξα^n)的谱包含同一个不可数集合。
AI.motivation: 该问题源于Mendès France，被收入Bugeaud的专著《Distribution modulo one and Diophantine approximation》作为问题10.4。原猜想认为(ξα^n)的谱至多可数，本文旨在通过构造反例证明这一断言不成立。
AI.method: 作者对每个实数α>1，构造出2^ℵ₀个正实数ξ，使得序列(ξα^n)的谱均包含一个共同的不可数集合，从而给出原问题断言的直接反例。
AI.result: 对于每个实数α>1，存在2^ℵ₀个实数ξ>0，其对应序列(ξα^n)的谱都包含同一个不可数集合，从而推翻了问题10.4中的断言（谱至多可数）。
AI.conclusion: Bugeaud专著中问题10.4的断言不成立。事实上，对于固定的α>1，不仅存在使谱不可数的ξ，而且这样的ξ有无穷多个（基数为连续统的势），且它们的谱共享同一个不可数子集。

title: Exact Decision and a Surjective Stabilizer Atlas for Affine Coprime-Factor Segments
summary: We consider simultaneous internal stabilization of square proper real-rational plants of arbitrary but fixed finite input-output dimension $n$, arranged as an affine right-coprime factor segment, under explicit nondegeneracy hypotheses. After a classical normalization, the remaining global spectral-cut constraint and the reconstruction constraints at finite poles and at infinity are encoded, without loss, as a finite-dimensional semialgebraic seed, using a function-level double-Cayley factorization. For input coefficients in an effectively presented real closed field, that seed yields an exact existence decision that does not enumerate controller McMillan degree; the decision engine is classical quantifier elimination. The same encoding, now ranging over rational radii, admissible seeds, and residual unimodular and rational Schur parameters, yields a surjective atlas of all proper real-rational common stabilizers of the segment. The results concern this structured class and are compatible with the rational undecidability of simultaneous stabilization of three general plants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究方阵真有理对象在仿射右互质因子段配置下的同时内部镇定问题。通过函数级双Cayley分解，将全局谱割约束、有限极点与无穷远点的重构约束编码为有限维半代数种子；在实闭域上利用经典量词消去实现精确的存在性判定，并构造所有公共镇定期器的满射图册。
AI.motivation: 同时镇定问题（同时稳定多个被控对象）是经典且困难的控制理论问题，尤其当对象个数达到三个及以上时，在一般有理情形下已被证明存在有理不可判定性。本文希望在结构受限的类别（仿射右互质因子段，固定有限输入输出维数）中，绕开不可判定性与McMillan度枚举的障碍，获得精确的、可判定的存在性判定框架。
AI.method: 1) 对被控对象的方块仿射右互质因子段进行经典归一化处理；2) 引入函数级双Cayley分解（double-Cayley factorization），将全局谱割约束和有限极点/无穷远处的重构约束无损地编码为一个有限维半代数种子（semialgebraic seed）；3) 在有效呈现的实闭域上，利用经典量词消去（quantifier elimination）作为判决引擎，直接获得存在性判定而无需枚举镇定期器的McMillan度；4) 进一步让该编码遍历有理半径、容许种子以及残差酉模和有理Schur参数，构造所有真有理公共稳定器的满射图册（surjective atlas）。
AI.result: 对于任意但固定的有限输入输出维数n的方阵真有理对象，在仿射右互质因子段结构及显式非退化假设下，获得了精确的存在性判定（基于经典量词消去，无需枚举控制器McMillan度），并建立了所有真有理公共稳定器的满射参数化图册。
AI.conclusion: 该结果证实，在这一特定结构化类别中，同时镇定问题可以通过实闭域上的量词消去获得精确判定与全参数化；同时该结果与三个一般对象同时镇定的有理不可判定性相容，明确了结构化与非结构化情形之间的判定性边界。

title: Diagnosing and Dynamically Filtering Occupancy World Models for Active Mapping
comment: Accepted by IEEE IROS 2026 Workshop on WORLDS: World Models and Spatial Intelligence for Physical AI
summary: Active mapping requires a robot to select camera viewpoints that efficiently reconstruct an unknown 3D scene. To reason about unobserved regions, recent systems use pretrained occupancy networks as world models that complete missing geometry. The predicted structure contributes to expected coverage gain and constrains feasible robot motion. Consequently, occupancy errors can change both what the robot chooses to explore and where it is able to move. We diagnose these effects by holding the planner fixed and varying only the occupancy representation provided to it. We consider planning without completion, with learned occupancy, with false positives removed by a ground truth oracle, with false negatives restored by an oracle, and with ground truth occupancy. Our experiments show that correcting false positives or false negatives alone does not consistently improve final coverage. This finding reveals a gap between occupancy accuracy and downstream planning performance. Ground truth occupancy provides a much larger improvement in coverage efficiency than in endpoint coverage, suggesting that planning and reachability remain important bottlenecks even when the geometric world model is accurate. Based on these findings, we introduce a dynamic filtering strategy that preserves predictions in unexplored space while suppressing repeatedly unsupported occupancy using online observations. Preliminary examples show that this strategy can redirect viewpoint selection toward reachable surfaces that would otherwise remain unobserved.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制变量法诊断主动地图构建中占据场误差对下游规划的影响。实验发现仅纠正假阳性或假阴性并不能一致提升最终覆盖率，揭示占据精度与规划性能之间存在差距；即使使用真实占据场，覆盖率效率的提升也远大于端点覆盖率，表明规划和可达性仍是瓶颈。据此提出动态过滤策略，保留未探索空间中的预测并抑制在线观测反复不支持的占据，初步实验显示该策略能引导视点选择转向原本无法观测到的可达表面。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图主动建图系统依赖预训练占据网络作为世界模型来补全缺失几何，但占据预测误差会同时影响机器人的探索目标和可行运动范围。作者希望厘清占据表征精度如何影响下游地图规划性能，并检验"更准的占据预测=更好的主动建图"这一隐含假设是否成立。
AI.method: 保持规划器固定，仅改变提供给规划器的占据表征，进行系统的消融诊断：(1)不做补全；(2)使用学习占据网络；(3)用真实值oracle移除假阳性；(4)用oracle恢复假阴性；(5)使用真实占据。在此基础上提出动态过滤策略：保留未探索空间中的占据预测，同时利用在线观测抑制反复得不到观测支持的占据。
AI.result: 单独纠正假阳性或假阴性并不总能一致地提升最终覆盖率；真实占据场对覆盖率效率的提升远大于对最终端点覆盖率的提升；提出的动态过滤策略可重定向视点选择至先前无法观测的可达表面。
AI.conclusion: 占据预测精度与下游规划覆盖性能之间存在显著gap；即便几何世界模型完全准确，规划与可达性推理仍是制约主动建图效率的关键瓶颈。改进规划与可达性推理可能比单纯追求更精确的占据补全带来更大的实际收益。

title: Mapping for Approximation: A Unified View of Rescaled, Variably Scaled and Rational Kernel Methods
summary: Classical approximation methods are usually improved by changing the sampling set, increasing the number of data points, or selecting a different basis. We advocate a complementary viewpoint: keep the sampled values fixed and modify the representation through a suitable mapping. This viewpoint unifies several constructions that were originally introduced for different purposes. Rescaled radial basis function interpolation maps the interpolation operator through a normalization that enforces exact reproduction of constants. Variably scaled kernels map the geometry by lifting the data to a higherdimensional manifold determined by a scale function. Mapped bases and fake nodes map the approximation space without resampling the data, while rational kernel expansions can be interpreted as nonlinear mappings of the trial space. We develop a common notation for these mechanisms, summarize their approximation and stability properties, and explain how discontinuous and rational variants fit the same framework. Reproducible numerical experiments illustrate constant reproduction, error reduction through data-mimicking scale functions, and the suppression of the Runge phenomenon by mapped polynomial bases. The results support a general principle: mappings provide a flexible way to adapt approximation spaces to data geometry and regularity without modifying the original observations

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一的视角来理解近似方法：固定采样值不变，通过合适的映射来修改表示方式，从而统一了缩放径向基函数插值、变尺度核、映射基、伪节点和有理核展开等多种原本为不同目的提出的构造方法。
AI.motivation: 经典近似方法通常通过改变采样集、增加数据点或选择不同基来改进，但这些方法都需要重新采样或改变数据。作者倡导一种补充视角：保持采样值固定，通过映射修改表示方式。这一视角可以统一多种原本为不同目的引入的构造，并建立通用框架。
AI.method: 文章开发了这些机制的通用符号体系，包括：缩放径向基函数插值（通过归一化强制精确复现常数）、变尺度核（通过尺度函数将数据提升到高维流形）、映射基与伪节点（无需重采样数据即映射近似空间）、以及有理核展开（近似空间上的非线性映射）。同时展示了不连续与有理变体如何适应同一框架。
AI.result: 通过可复现的数值实验验证了：常数精确复现、通过数据模仿尺度函数实现误差降低、以及通过映射多项式基抑制龙格现象。结果支持一个通用原则：映射提供了一种灵活的途径，在不修改原始观测的情况下，使近似空间适应数据的几何特征与正则性。
AI.conclusion: 映射是一种灵活且统一的机制，可以在不改变原始数据的情况下调整近似空间以匹配数据几何和正则性，为近似方法的改进提供了与经典重采样范式互补的新方向。

title: Wolf-Rayet stars and black holes: mass distributions and evolutionary connection
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in Astronomy Reports
summary: The form and relationship between the mass distributions of Wolf-Rayet stars and black holes are analyzed using a direct method for estimating the distribution function from a sample of mass values with individual distributions obtained from current observations. It is shown that, taking into account the mass loss of WR stars by the end of this evolutionary stage, the mass distribution of black holes is close to that of the CO-cores of WR stars before gravitational collapse, $M_\mathrm{BH}\simeq M_\mathrm{CO}$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过直接方法从具有个体分布的质量样本中估计分布函数，分析了Wolf-Rayet星与黑洞的质量分布关系，发现考虑WR星质量损失后，黑洞质量分布与引力坍缩前CO核的质量分布相近，即MBH≃MCO。
AI.motivation: 探究Wolf-Rayet恒星与最终形成的黑洞之间质量分布的定量关系，利用更直接的方法从观测样本中估计分布函数，以检验黑洞质量是否直接继承了WR星的CO核质量。
AI.method: 采用直接方法从具有个体分布的质量样本中估计分布函数，结合当前观测数据，比较WR星（考虑演化末期质量损失后）与黑洞的质量分布关系。
AI.result: 在考虑WR星演化阶段末期质量损失的情况下，黑洞的质量分布与WR星引力坍缩前CO核的质量分布高度接近，支持MBH≃MCO的关系。
AI.conclusion: WR星在经历质量损失后的CO核质量可作为预测坍缩形成黑洞质量的良好指标，黑洞与WR星CO核之间存在近乎直接的继承关系。

title: Equidistribution of small points over finitely generated fields
summary: We study the equidistribution of small points over finitely generated fields, in connection with a conjecture of Yuan--Zhang. We first give a counterexample showing that numerical smallness, defined using Moriwaki heights for all polarizations, does not imply equidistribution at every valuation. We then prove that numerically small points do equidistribute at every fully transcendental valuation. In particular, when \(F\) is the function field of a curve \(B/\mathbb{Q}\), these valuations correspond to points of types \(2\), \(3\), and \(4\) in the Berkovich analytification of \(B_{\mathbb{Q}_p}\).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限生成域上小平点的均匀分布问题，与Yuan-Zhang猜想相关。作者首先给出了一个反例，说明所有极化的Moriwaki高度数值上小并不蕴含在每个赋值处的均匀分布；随后证明了数值小平点在每个完全超越赋值处都均匀分布。特别地，当F是曲线B/Q的函数域时，这些赋值对应于B_{Q_p}的Berkovich解析化中的2、3、4型点。
AI.motivation: Yuan-Zhang猜想涉及有限生成域上小平点的均匀分布，这是算术几何中关于高度理论、赋值和Berkovich空间交叉领域的核心问题。理解数值小平性质与不同赋值下均匀分布之间的关系是解决该猜想的关键步骤。
AI.method: 作者通过构造反例来展示数值小并非在所有赋值下都蕴含均匀分布，然后针对完全超越赋值的情形建立了均匀分布定理，利用Moriwaki高度与Berkovich解析化的工具进行论证。
AI.result: (1) 给出了一个反例，证明所有极化的数值小平不蕴含在每个赋值的均匀分布；(2) 证明了数值小平点在每个完全超越赋值处均匀分布；(3) 阐明了函数域情形下这些赋值与Berkovich解析空间中2、3、4型点的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 数值小平点的均匀分布性质依赖于所考虑的赋值类型：在完全超越赋值处成立，但在一般赋值处不成立，这精确刻画了Yuan-Zhang猜想在这方面的边界条件。

title: Submodular Welfare under Routing Coupling: A Hierarchical Decomposition with Perturbation Guarantees
summary: This paper studies joint submodular welfare maximization and routing over graphs, where agents select items under diminishing returns and transport them through a network with congestion-dependent costs. Although welfare maximization admits matroid-based approximations and routing reduces to shortest paths under modular costs, their coupling creates supermodular interactions that break separability. We show that, for fixed routing, the objective remains submodular in the allocation variable, enabling a principled decomposition. Building on this property, we propose the Welfare-based Hierarchical Routing Algorithm (WHIRL), which alternates between tractable routing and allocation updates. Routing is initialized through its modular counterpart, while supermodular effects are modeled as bounded perturbations. The method has finite convergence guarantees and approximation bounds that depend explicitly on the deviation from modular routing. Numerical results illustrate the impact of routing-induced coupling and show that WHIRL achieves a favorable tradeoff between solution quality and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联合子模社会福利最大化与图上的路径规划问题，提出WHIRL算法，该算法交替优化路径与资源分配，在固定路径下目标函数对分配变量保持子模性，从而实现可分解优化，并具有有限收敛保证和解质量与计算成本的权衡。
AI.motivation: 社会福利最大化（通常可借助拟阵近似求解）与路径规划（在模成本下可简化为最短路）各自已被充分研究，但二者耦合后会产生超模交互作用，破坏了原本可分离的结构，使得现有方法无法直接应用。作者旨在解决这种耦合带来的计算挑战。
AI.method: 首先证明在固定路径（routing）时，目标函数在分配变量上仍保持子模性，由此实现原理性的变量分解。在此基础上提出WHIRL（基于福利的层次路径规划算法），在可处理的路径规划和分配更新之间交替迭代。路径规划通过其模版本进行初始化，超模效应被建模为有界扰动。算法采用交替优化的框架分别求解两个子问题。
AI.result: WHIRL具有有限收敛保证，并提供与偏离模路径的偏差显式相关的近似界。数值实验表明，路径规划引入的耦合对解质量有显著影响，WHIRL在解质量与计算成本之间取得了有利的折中。
AI.conclusion: 该文揭示了联合子模福利最大化与路径规划问题中目标函数在固定路径下的子模结构，并通过交替优化的WHIRL算法实现了理论上有界、实践上高效的求解方案，为这类耦合组合优化问题提供了系统性的处理框架。

title: ContextFlow: In-Context Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation
summary: Although highly effective in vision and language domains, applying in-context learning to robotics remains challenging. Existing autoregressive in-context imitation methods discretize continuous actions and exacerbate the accumulation of early prediction errors through next-token prediction, limiting their generalization on unseen task configurations. Meanwhile, flow-matching policies have been explored for continuous robot control and can help mitigate compounding errors; however, in-context imitation learning within a flow-matching framework remains underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce ContextFlow, a conditional flow-matching model that learns continuous action distributions for in-context imitation learning. ContextFlow conditions flow-based action prediction on demonstrations and observations, enabling robust generation from noisy action distributions. To better encode multimodal in-context demonstrations, we adapt perceiver-style multimodal context compressors that distill visual, proprioceptive, and action sequences into compact, task-relevant latent representations. On LIBERO, ContextFlow outperforms ICRT by 35 percentage points in average success rate on unseen task configurations, while matching the performance of the task-specific fine-tuned VLA model $π_0$ without any fine-tuning on unseen tasks. On real robots, it generalizes to unseen configurations of both single-arm and bimanual tasks, achieving 40% success on a new pen-uncapping configuration. Project Page: https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/.

AI.tldr: ContextFlow是一个基于条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）的上下文模仿学习（in-context imitation learning）模型，通过将连续动作分布的学习与演示/观测条件结合，解决了现有自回归方法在机器人控制中离散化动作和误差累积的问题，在LIBERO基准和真实机器人任务中均展现出优越的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉和语言领域的上下文学习（in-context learning）虽已取得成功，但在机器人领域的应用仍面临挑战。现有的自回归式上下文模仿方法存在两个主要缺陷：一是将连续动作离散化，二是通过next-token预测加剧早期预测误差的累积，限制了模型在未见任务配置上的泛化能力。虽然flow-matching策略已被探索用于连续机器人控制并有助于缓解复合误差，但在flow-matching框架下的上下文模仿学习尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: ContextFlow采用条件流匹配模型学习连续动作分布以进行上下文模仿学习。模型将基于流的动作预测条件设定在演示和观测上，从而实现对含噪动作分布的鲁棒生成。为更好地编码多模态的上下文演示，该方法引入了perceiver风格的多模态上下文压缩器，将视觉、本体感觉和动作序列蒸馏为紧凑、任务相关的潜在表征。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，ContextFlow在未见任务配置上的平均成功率比ICRT高出35个百分点，同时在无需任何微调的情况下，追平了针对任务微调的VLA模型π0的性能。在真实机器人上，该模型能够泛化到单臂和双臂任务的未见配置，在全新的开笔帽配置上实现了40%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: ContextFlow证明了将条件流匹配与上下文学习相结合的有效性，为机器人连续动作控制中的上下文模仿学习提供了一种新的、兼具精度与泛化能力的技术路线，无需针对新任务进行微调即可达到甚至超越现有方法的表现。

title: LoCCA: Localized Chebyshev Cross Approximation for Kernel Matrix Factorization via Nodal Perturbation Stability
summary: We propose Local Chebyshev Cross-Approximation (LoCCA), a data-driven framework that bridges smooth polynomial interpolation with flexible matrix factorizations. LoCCA dynamically maps ideal grid nodes to their nearest physical neighbors within unstructured point sets. We support this framework with a new perturbation theory, proving that displacing Chebyshev nodes onto physical data points retains mathematical stability and accuracy without explosive error growth. Numerically, LoCCA provides strict, reliable error control even on irregular geometries where standard grid-based methods fail, achieving substantial speedups and near-optimal matrix compression.

AI.tldr: 提出LoCCA框架，将Chebyshev多项式插值与矩阵分解结合，通过将理想网格节点映射到物理点集最近邻，在无结构化点集上实现稳定、精确且有误差控制的矩阵压缩与加速。
AI.motivation: 标准基于网格的方法在不规则几何（无结构化点集）上表现不佳，需要一种既能保持多项式插值的数学稳定性，又能灵活适用于任意点集分布的矩阵分解方法。
AI.method: 数据驱动的LoCCA框架：动态将理想Chebyshev网格节点映射到非结构化点集的最近物理邻点，并配套提出了新的扰动理论，证明Chebyshev节点移位到物理数据点后数学稳定性与精度仍得以保持，误差不会爆炸增长。
AI.result: 在不规则几何上提供严格可靠的误差控制（标准网格方法在此失效），取得显著加速和接近最优的矩阵压缩效果。
AI.conclusion: LoCCA证明了将光滑多项式插值与灵活矩阵分解相结合的有效性，为无结构点集上的矩阵运算提供了兼具稳定性、精确性与计算效率的解决方案。

title: Hierarchical Inference of the Supermassive Black Hole Binary Merger Rates from Joint Searches using Pulsar Timing Arrays
summary: Gravitational-wave searches do more than identify individual sources - they provide a way to infer the underlying astrophysical populations that produce them. Currently, Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain the supermassive black-hole binary (SMBHB) merger-rate density through both the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) and searches for individual SMBHB signals. The latter implies converting source upper limits into rate upper limits using detection efficiencies estimated empirically. We instead develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework that places the SMBHB merger-rate density model directly inside the PTA likelihood. The unknown catalog of individual SMBHB merger signals is modeled as a Poisson point process on source-parameter space, so that the number of merger signals is inferred from the data rather than imposed by a detection threshold. We describe two computational routes: a catalog-marginal likelihood based on analyses with fixed numbers of candidate sources, and an explicit transdimensional sampling approach that jointly samples population hyperparameters, latent merger signals, and noise. We validate the method with a toy merger-only population model and then apply it to an astrophysical SMBHB merger-rate density model that jointly predicts the SGWB amplitude and the expected merger-catalog size. In simulations, an individual merger signal adds complementary information to the SGWB and can tighten constraints on the merger-rate population.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层贝叶斯框架，将超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）并合率密度模型直接嵌入脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）似然中，通过泊松点过程对未知的单个并合信号目录进行建模，从而从数据中推断并合信号数量而非依赖检测阈值。方法在模拟中验证，单个并合信号可为随机引力波背景（SGWB）提供互补信息并收紧对并合率群体的约束。
AI.motivation: 传统PTA对SMBHB并合率密度的约束分别通过随机引力波背景和单个源搜索实现，后者需通过经验估计的探测效率将源上限转化为率上限，这种两阶段方法无法统一建模，且依赖人为设定的检测阈值，难以充分利用数据的统计信息。
AI.method: 开发一个分层贝叶斯框架，将SMBHB并合率密度模型直接嵌入PTA似然中。未知的单个并合信号目录建模为源参数空间上的泊松点过程，使并合信号数量由数据推断。提供两条计算路线：基于固定数量候选源分析的目录边缘化似然方法，以及显式跨维度采样方法（联合采样群体超参数、潜在并合信号和噪声）。
AI.result: 先用玩具并合-only群体模型验证方法有效性，再应用于同时预测SGWB振幅和预期并合目录大小的天体物理SMBHB并合率密度模型。模拟结果显示，单个并合信号为SGWB提供互补信息，可进一步收紧对并合率群体的约束。
AI.conclusion: 统一的分层贝叶斯框架能够消除传统两阶段分析中探测效率估计带来的信息损失，实现从原始PTA数据到群体参数的端到端推断，并表明单个源信号与随机背景的联合分析可提升对SMBHB并合率群体的约束能力。

title: The Artin-Hasse $p$-section: weighted convolutions and $p$-adic recovery
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, and let $a_n$ be the reduction modulo $p$ of the $n$th coefficient of the Artin-Hasse exponential. We study the weighted $p$-section convolutions $W_k$ formed from the coefficients $a_{kp}$. We prove the conjecture of Avitabile and Mattarei for $1<k<p$ and extend it to a single global power-series identity determining the entire sequence $(W_k)_{k\geq 0}$. This identity yields an explicit base-$p$ digit formula; in particular, $(W_k)$ is $p$-automatic and admits an explicit finite-state evaluator. Independently, the exact conjugated $p$-section equation gives a strict $p$-adic fixed-point iteration for the logarithmic derivative of the $p$-section.
