Since there does not exist a closed-form expression for the marginal likelihood, we present an evaluation method that relies on the Laplace approximation of the marginal likelihood. Finally, some numerical experiments are discussed to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的基于核的方法来辨识前向模型的脉冲响应，导致一个非线性Tikhonov正则化问题，证明了解的存在性，从而证明用高阶MA外生输入(MAX)模型近似前向模型的合理性。文中还利用Laplace近似方法估计边际似然以优化核超参数，并通过数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 前向模型的脉冲响应辨识是系统辨识领域的核心问题。现有的基于核的方法通常假设前向模型的脉冲响应数量有限（即有限阶），或对噪声和模型结构有较强假设。本文旨在提出一种新的核方法，解决脉冲响应辨识问题，并严格证明在高阶MAX模型近似下解的合理性（即引入的偏差可忽略），从而放宽对模型阶数的限制。
AI.method: 该方法的核心是将脉冲响应的辨识转化为一个非线性Tikhonov正则化问题。具体包括：(1) 证明该非线性优化问题解的存在性，为高阶MAX模型逼近前向模型提供理论依据；(2) 提出一种基于Laplace近似的方法来评估边际似然（由于边际似然无闭式表达式），从而实现对核超参数的优化估计；(3) 通过数值实验评估所提辨识方法的性能。
AI.result: 论文从理论上证明了所提出的非线性Tikhonov正则化问题解的存在性，使得采用高阶MAX模型进行前向模型逼近时仅引入可忽略的偏差。同时给出了边际似然的Laplace近似评估方法用于核超参数估计。数值实验展示了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为基于核的前向模型脉冲响应辨识提供了一种新的非线性正则化框架，其理论保证（解的存在性）使得高阶MAX模型近似在理论上变得合理。所提出的Laplace近似方法克服了边际似然无解析表达式的困难，使得核超参数可被有效估计。该方法在数值实验中展现出了良好的性能。

title: Eventually Optimal and Scalable Multi-Agent Planning for Block Cave Mining
summary: Automation in underground mining has the potential to significantly enhance safety, operational efficiency, and sustainability. However, effectively coordinating fleets of autonomous vehicles in dynamic mine environments introduces substantial challenges in both optimization and motion planning. To address these challenges, we introduce and formalize the \emph{Block Cave Mining (BCM)} problem, which focuses on computing a transport plan that maximizes ore throughput while satisfying draw ratio constraints. To solve this problem, we propose SAMM, an eventually optimal anytime solver that jointly integrates task assignment, scheduling, and path planning via a mixed-integer linear programming formulation. To improve scalability, we also introduce SAMMS, a variant of SAMM that trades optimality guarantees for efficiency by decomposing the problem into shorter planning subcycles. Experimental evaluations using realistic industrial mine scenarios demonstrate that SAMMS achieves near-optimal throughput and scales effectively to larger fleets and mine layouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了地下矿山的块段崩落开采（BCM）问题，即在高动态环境中协调自动驾驶车队以最大化矿石吞吐量并满足出矿比约束。作者提出SAMM——一个基于混合整数线性规划的任意时间最优求解器，以及SAMMS——一种牺牲最优性换取效率的变体，通过问题分解为短规划子循环来提升可扩展性。实验表明SAMMS在真实工业矿山场景下能达到近最优吞吐量并有效扩展到更大的车队和矿山布局。
AI.motivation: 地下采矿自动化有望显著提升安全性、运营效率和可持续性，但动态矿山环境中自动驾驶车队的有效协调在优化和运动规划方面都带来巨大挑战，亟需一个能够联合解决任务分配、调度和路径规划问题的框架。
AI.method: 首先形式化BCM问题，通过混合整数线性规划（MILP）构建SAMM求解器，联合集成任务分配、调度和路径规划；随后引入SAMMS变体，将问题分解为较短的规划子循环以牺牲最优性换取计算效率。
AI.result: 在真实工业矿山场景的实验评估中，SAMMS实现了接近最优的吞吐量，并在更大规模的车队配置和矿山布局下展现出良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SAMM/SAMMS方法为地下矿山自动驾驶车队协调提供了有效的求解框架，其中SAMMS在可扩展性与求解质量之间取得了实际可取的良好平衡，能够满足工业应用的实时性需求。

title: Cahn-Hilliard phase-field modeling of tumor growth via locally adaptive isogeometric analysis with THB-splines
summary: Predicting tumor dynamics in biological systems under physiologically relevant conditions using mathematical and computational models remains a challenging problem. Continuum models based on phase-field (diffuse-interface) formulations have proven to be an effective modeling strategy to govern tumor dynamics and interactions of multiple species. Within this framework, the present work investigates a tumor growth model based on the Cahn-Hilliard (CH) equation. The formulation involves a fourth-order differential operator that imposes higher continuity requirement on approximation spaces for a well-defined primal variational formulation. To address this challenge, we use isogeometric analysis (IGA), which inherently satisfies this requirement through spline-based basis functions and eliminates the need for mixed or auxiliary-variable approaches commonly used in standard finite element discretizations. Additionally, a locally adaptive IGA scheme with truncated hierarchical B-splines (THB-splines) is used to reduce computational cost while maintaining accuracy. The model is first evaluated on standard benchmark cases and then applied to an organ-scale, patient-specific geometric model of the breast reconstructed from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data. Our results show that the model reproduces known tumor morphologies, ranging from a spheroidal pattern to fingered growth. A series of numerical experiments further shows the diversity of tumor dynamics produced by different model parameter choices. Our findings demonstrate the predictive potential of the CH-based phase-field tumor growth model integrated with a locally adaptive IGA framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Cahn-Hilliard相场方程与局部自适应等几何分析（IGA）的肿瘤生长模型，通过截断分层B样条（THB-splines）降低计算成本，并在由MRI重建的乳腺器官尺度几何模型上验证了模型的预测能力，成功再现了从球状到指状等多种肿瘤形态。
AI.motivation: 在生理相关条件下利用数学模型预测肿瘤动态仍具挑战性。Cahn-Hilliard相场方程能有效描述肿瘤动力学与多物种相互作用，但其四阶微分算子对逼近空间的光滑性要求极高，传统有限元方法需要借助混合或辅助变量方法，增加复杂度，因此需要寻求更高效的求解框架，并降低计算成本以应对器官尺度问题。
AI.method: 采用基于Cahn-Hilliard方程的相场肿瘤生长模型，利用等几何分析（IGA）中基于样条的基函数天然满足四阶问题的连续性和可微性要求，无需混合或辅助变量方法；进一步采用截断分层B样条（THB-splines）实现局部自适应细化以降低计算成本。模型先在标准基准算例中验证，随后应用于从MRI数据重建的患者特异性乳腺几何模型。
AI.result: 模型成功再现了从球状形态到指状生长的多种已知肿瘤形态；系列数值实验展示了不同模型参数选择下多种肿瘤动态的多样性，验证了模型在器官尺度、患者特异性几何上的适用性及预测潜力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，融合局部自适应IGA框架的CH相场肿瘤生长模型具有可靠的预测能力，能够在患者特异性几何上高效再现多样的肿瘤生长形态，为肿瘤动力学建模提供了有前景的计算工具。

title: Counting Survivor Sets: Exponential Equivalence with Prime-Admissible Sets
summary: For each integer $n\geq 1$, let $N(n)$ denote the number of distinct subsets of $\{2,\ldots,n+1\}$ obtained by choosing one forbidden residue class modulo each integer from $2$ to $n$; this is OEIS sequence A396595 (https://oeis.org/A396595). Equivalently, $N(n)$ is the initial-restriction complexity of the family of global residue-profile survivor sequences. We derive a closed formula, depending on the parity of $n$, for the number of locally distinct residue profiles, and an exact inclusion--exclusion formula for profiles realizing a prescribed survivor set. We prove that $\log N(n)$ has order $n/\log n$, with any possible leading constant between $\log 2$ and $2\log 2$. For prime traces, the logarithm of their number is asymptotic to $(\log 2)n/\log n$. Our main comparison theorem shows that $N(n)$ is exponentially equivalent to the block complexity of prime-admissible subsets of an interval of length $n$. The combinatorial component of the private composite coordinates argument used in the comparison theorem is formalized in Lean 4/Mathlib. We also establish an exact structural recurrence, characterize extendibility by a residue-class covering criterion, and give a dynamic enumeration algorithm. As further illustrations of the model, we exhibit purely periodic global profiles generating prime-valued survivor sequences for which we have not identified corresponding OEIS entries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究序列N(n)（OEIS A396595），即从2到n每个整数各选一个禁止同余类所得到的不同子集数量。作者推导了关于局部不同同余分布的数目的闭式公式，证明了log N(n)的量级为n/log n，并建立了一个比较定理，表明N(n)与区间长度为n的素数容许子集的块复杂度指数等价。
AI.motivation: 旨在深入刻画全局剩余分布幸存者序列族的初始限制复杂度N(n)，理解其增长阶、与素数容许子集复杂度之间的精确关系，并为该模型提供结构性与算法性的完整刻画。
AI.method: 利用包含-排除原理得到精确表达式；依据n的奇偶性导出局部不同分布的闭式公式；通过素数踪迹（prime traces）的渐近分析确立对数阶；借助组合私有复合坐标论证证明比较定理，并使用Lean 4/Mathlib对论证的纯组合部分进行形式化验证；此外给出结构递推和动态枚举算法。
AI.result: 证明了log N(n)的数量级为n/log n，领先常数介于log 2与2log 2之间；素数踪迹数目的对数渐近于(log 2)n/log n；建立了N(n)与素数容许子集块复杂度的指数等价比较定理；得到基于奇偶性区分的闭式公式和精确包含-排除公式；还发现产生素数幸存者序列的纯周期全局分布，但在OEIS中未找到对应条目。
AI.conclusion: 本文对剩余分布幸存者模型给出了完整的理论刻画，包括精确公式、渐近增长、与素数子集复杂度的等价关系以及形式化验证的组合论证，并展现出该模型在素数序列生成方面的额外潜力。

title: Wasserstein Stability and Free Boundaries in Measure-Parameterized Bilevel Obstacle Problems
comment: 35 pages, 1 figure, 1 table; includes ancillary Python code
summary: We study obstacle-constrained variational problems whose reduced energies depend on a probability law through a lower-level optimizer. Uniform strong convexity yields a single-valued Lipschitz follower response, while convexity and a Poincare inequality give a unique upper-level policy. A type-Lipschitz reduced marginal then implies Lipschitz continuity of the policy map from the 1-Wasserstein metric to the energy space. In a one-dimensional linear-obstacle subclass, the policy derivative is the positive part of a cumulative forcing. Single crossing makes the coincidence set an interval. An algebraic crossing of order m gives a $W_1^{1/m}$ modulus for its endpoint; odd-power examples show that this exponent is sharp, while a transversal crossing recovers Lipschitz stability. For empirical laws on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^k$, dimension-dependent Wasserstein bounds yield finite-sample rates for policies and thresholds. At a transversal population root, the empirical threshold is asymptotically linear, with an explicit influence function and central limit theorem. For higher-dimensional regular patches, a conditional level-set argument gives local Hausdorff stability when a nondegenerate switching function is available. An explicit quadratic firm response produces a nonlinear corporate-tax schedule with an endogenous zero-tax region and a Wasserstein-stable threshold. The tax illustration is analytic and uses no empirical calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究依赖下层级最优解的障碍约束变分问题。在均匀强凸、凸性加Poincaré不等式等条件下，建立了从Wasserstein度量空间到能量空间的策略映射的Lipschitz连续性。在一维线性障碍子类中刻画了重合集区间及端点模量（代数穿越给出W_1^{1/m}模量，且证明其最优性）。对经验测度给出了有限样本收敛率与阈值渐近正态性（含显式影响函数），并为高维规则区域建立了局部Hausdorff稳定性。文末以二次企业反应函数构造了非线性公司税模型，展示内生零税率区域及Wasserstein稳定的门限。
AI.motivation: 数学规划与经济学中常见一类"鞍点/双层"结构问题：上层能量依赖某个概率测度，而该测度又通过下层优化问题的解来"响应"策略。已有理论对这类耦合变分问题的正则性与稳定性研究不足，尤其在策略对测度扰动的（Wasserstein度量下）连续性、门限结构的模量估计以及经验过程的有限样本性质方面缺乏系统性刻画。
AI.method: 采用变分分析与最优化理论工具。下层通过均匀强凸性获得单值Lipschitz响应；上层借助凸性与Poincaré不等式构造唯一能量极小元。利用"type-Lipschitz约化边际"推得策略映射的Wasserstein-1连续模。对一维线性障碍情形借助单交叉与代数交叉进行端点模量精细估计，并构造奇数幂反例证明指数sharpness。经验方面利用r维紧集上Wasserstein界推导有限样本率；通过影响函数与CLT刻画门限渐近。高维用非退化开关函数与条件水平集法证Hausdorff稳定。
AI.result: 建立了从1-Wasserstein度量到能量空间的策略映射Lipschitz连续性；一维情形给出重合集为区间、代数交叉阶m对应W_1^{1/m}端点模量（sharp）且横截交叉恢复Lipschitz稳定的精细结果。经验测度下获得依赖维度k的有限样本率；橫截总体根处经验门限渐近线性并满足CLT。高维给出了Hausdorff局部稳定性。公司税示例导出解析式的非线性税负表，含内生零税率区与Wasserstein稳定门限，无需经验校准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为障碍约束的测度依赖变分问题提供了统一的稳定性框架，涵盖连续模、模量sharpness、经验有限样本率与渐近统计性质，并通过公司税实例展示了理论的实际价值，提示这类结构在机制设计与公共政策分析中有广泛适用前景。

title: From LLM-Generated Specifications to Learned Quadruped Locomotion
summary: Quadruped robot locomotion policies are often trained using reinforcement learning, which in turn relies heavily on hand-crafted reward functions. Designing reward functions requires substantial manual engineering, and it is often unclear which local rewards will induce the desired global behavior. Shaped rewards from formal specifications in languages like Signal Temporal Logic (STL) can make rewards more interpretable, but writing STL specifications itself still requires domain expertise. We study whether large language models (LLMs) can fill this gap by generating Parametric Signal Temporal Logic (PSTL) specifications that are subsequently used for policy learning. Given a natural language locomotion objective and a constrained specification grammar, GPT-5.5 and Qwen 3.6 independently propose STL templates for command tracking, safety, and gait structure. We instantiate the parameters of the generated PSTL templates using expert trajectories and retain only specifications that are consistent with demonstrated expert behavior. The resulting specifications are then transformed into smooth, finite-history reward functions and used to train a quadruped locomotion policy with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in MuJoCo XLA (MJX). We evaluate both \emph{gait-aware} and \emph{gait-agnostic} settings. The former specifies walking-trot, trot, and bound regimes, while the latter allows contact patterns to emerge from the task objective. We compare against hand-engineered rewards, Text2Reward-style LLM-generated reward code, and an expert-switching oracle. Gait-aware Qwen 3.6 specifications achieved 100\% survival and command success across all tested speeds (0.3--2.1 m/s) and matched the target gait at high speeds, whereas Text2Reward achieved 0\% for both metrics at $\geq 1.9$ m/s. Videos: https://stl-locomotion.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成参数化信号时序逻辑（PSTL）规范，用于四足机器人步态策略的强化学习训练，以替代繁琐的手工奖励函数设计。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人运动策略常依赖强化学习，而强化学习高度依赖手工设计的奖励函数。手工设计奖励函数需要大量人工工程，且难以预知局部奖励能否诱导出期望的全局行为。虽然基于信号时序逻辑（STL）的成形奖励可提升可解释性，但编写STL规范本身仍需领域专业知识。
AI.method: 给定自然语言运动目标和约束规范语法，使用GPT-5.5和Qwen 3.6独立生成STL模板，覆盖命令跟踪、安全和步态结构三个方面。利用专家轨迹实例化生成的PSTL模板参数，仅保留与示范专家行为一致的规范。将这些规范转换为平滑的有限历史奖励函数，并使用PPO算法在MuJoCo XLA (MJX)中训练四足运动策略。评估步态感知（walking-trot、trot、bound三种模式）和步态不可知两种设置。
AI.result: 步态感知的Qwen 3.6规范在所有测试速度（0.3-2.1 m/s）下实现了100%的存活率和命令成功率，并在高速下匹配目标步态。相比之下，Text2Reward在速度不低于1.9 m/s时两项指标均为0%。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够弥合自然语言运动目标与形式化STL规范之间的鸿沟，自动生成可用于策略学习的可解释奖励规范，其性能可与手工工程奖励相媲美甚至超越，显著优于LLM直接生成奖励代码的方法。与传统STL编写相比，该方法降低了领域专业知识门槛。

title: A Fully Dual Domain Decomposition Method for Extreme Learning Machines Using GenEO Spectral Coarse Spaces
summary: Extreme learning machines (ELMs) are a class of machine learning algorithms that randomly intialize and subsequently fix the hidden layer parameters, and solve for the last layer coefficients using a least squares method. ELMs have been successfully applied to the solution of various partial differential equations, but the cost of solving large least squares problems limits their use in large scale problems or when high accuracy is desired. To address this limitation, domain decomposition methods (DDMs) have been developed for ELMs, reducing training times via parallel computation. Yet these methods, even those incorporating a coarse space, have struggled with scalability. This paper introduces a novel nonoverlapping DDM for ELMs that treats and enforces continuity and flux conditions equally. Additive Schwarz preconditioners and GenEO (Generalized Eigenvalues problems in the Overlaps) coarse spaces are constructed to accelerate the method. Numerical experiments show the new method outperforms previous DDMs for ELMs in both iteration count and accuracy, especially for the Stokes and wave equations. Furthermore, weak scalability has been observed in up to 4,096 subdomains when employing GenEO coarse spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的非重叠区域分解方法用于极限学习机（ELM），通过对称处理连续性和通量条件，并利用加法Schwarz预处理和GenEO粗空间加速，实现了最高4096个子域的弱可扩展性，在迭代次数和精度上均优于已有的ELM区域分解方法。
AI.motivation: ELM在求解偏微分方程时表现良好，但求解大型最小二乘问题的成本限制了其在大规模问题或高精度需求下的应用。已有的针对ELM的区域分解方法（即使包含粗空间）在可扩展性方面存在不足，需要一种更具可扩展性的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的非重叠区域分解方法，对称且均衡地处理子域间的连续性和通量条件；构造加法Schwarz预处理子（Additive Schwarz preconditioners）以及基于重叠区域广义特征值问题（GenEO）的粗空间来加速收敛。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，新方法在迭代次数和精度上均优于已有的ELM区域分解方法，尤其在Stokes方程和波方程的求解中表现突出；当使用GenEO粗空间时，在高达4096个子域下观察到了弱可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了ELM区域分解方法在大规模问题中的可扩展性瓶颈，为将ELM应用于更大规模或更高精度的PDE求解提供了可行的并行化框架。

title: Symmetric power L-functions of a weighted hyper-Kloosterman family
summary: As a natural generalization of the classical hyper-Kloosterman family studied by D. Haessig and S. Sperber, we study the $k$-th symmetric power $L$-functions attached to a weighted hyper-Kloosterman family $$Kl_{n,m}(t;x_{1},\cdot\cdot\cdot,x_{n})=x_{1}^{m}+x_{2}\cdot\cdot\cdot+x_{n}+\frac{t}{x_{1}x_{2}\cdot\cdot\cdot x_{n}}.$$ Under suitable conditions, we determine the bounds of degrees of these $L$-functions and prove that their $q$-adic Newton polygons admit uniform lower bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加权超Kloosterman族第k次对称幂L-函数，在适当条件下确定了这些L-函数的次数上界，并证明其q进Newton多边形具有一致的下界。
AI.motivation: 经典超Kloosterman族是数论中的重要研究对象，D. Haessig和S. Sperber已对其进行了系统研究。将其推广到加权情形并研究其对称幂L-函数，是自然且重要的方向，有助于深入理解此类指数和的算术性质与q进性质。
AI.method: 本文采用q进解析方法，将加权超Kloosterman族的对称幂L-函数与特定的q进解析对象建立联系，通过分析这些对象的刚性（overconvergent）性质来确定L-函数的次数界，并利用Newton多边形的理论建立一致的下界估计。
AI.result: 在合适的条件下，得到了加权超Kloosterman族第k次对称幂L-函数的次数上界，并证明了其q进Newton多边形具有一致下界。
AI.conclusion: 该结果推广了D. Haessig和S. Sperber关于经典超Kloosterman族的结论到加权情形，揭示了加权结构对对称幂L-函数算术性质的影响，为后续进一步研究提供了理论基础。

title: Rank-Adaptive and Linearly Convergent Frank--Wolfe Method over Spectrahedron via Nonconvex Oracle
summary: For Frank--Wolfe (FW) methods for convex optimization over the spectrahedron, it remains open whether a block-update variant can be linearly convergent when the update rank never exceeds the (unknown) optimal rank $r^*$ at each iteration. Existing block and spectral FW methods require an update rank at least $r^*$---and typically prior knowledge of $r^*$---to obtain a linear rate. This paper develops a rank-adaptive FW method whose update ranks satisfy $\widehat{r}_t\le r_t\le r^*$ at every iteration and which converges linearly after a finite burn-in under quadratic growth and strict complementarity, the two conditions commonly used in spectral FW analyses. The method is built on two designs. The first is a nonconvex spectral oracle, motivated by the geometric connection between the simplex and the spectrahedron; it yields a thresholding rank $r_t$ of the current iterate and a closed-form low-rank solution. Computing $r_t$ exactly, however, requires a full eigendecomposition. The second introduces the efficient rank $\widehat{r}_t$ of the current iterate, a cheap surrogate that inherits the optimality properties of the spectral oracle. The algorithm switches between the thresholding rank and the efficient rank so that the actual FW update uses $\widehat{r}_t$, keeps the per-iteration cost comparable to standard FW, and eventually identifies $r^*$. These results close the gap between low-rank efficiency and fast convergence for Frank--Wolfe methods over the spectrahedron. Numerical experiments demonstrate the advantage of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种秩自适应的Frank-Wolfe方法用于谱面体（spectrahedron）上的凸优化。该方法在每次迭代中保证更新秩不超过未知的最优秩r*，且在二次增长和严格互补条件下，经过有限次"burn-in"后实现线性收敛，弥合了低秩效率与快速收敛之间的空白。
AI.motivation: Frank-Wolfe方法的块更新变体在谱面体凸优化中，是否能在每次迭代的更新秩不超过未知最忧秩r*的情况下实现线性收敛，这一问题长期悬而未决。现有的块更新和谱Frank-Wolfe方法要求更新秩至少为r*，且通常需要预先知道r*才能获得线性收敛速率。这限制了方法在实际问题中的适用性。
AI.method: 方法基于两个关键设计：(1) 非凸谱oracle——受单纯形与谱面体之间几何联系的启发，产生当前迭代的阈值秩r_t和闭式低秩解，但精确计算r_t需要完整特征分解；(2) 高效秩（efficient rank）——当前迭代的廉价替身指标，继承谱oracle的最优性性质。算法在阈值秩与高效秩之间切换，使实际FW更新使用高效秩，保持与标准FW相当的每迭代计算成本，并最终识别出r*。
AI.result: 在二次增长和严格互补（谱Frank-Wolfe分析中常用的两个条件）下，算法在有限burn-in后实现线性收敛，且每次迭代更新秩满足r̂_t ≤ r_t ≤ r*。数值实验验证了所提方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过秩自适应设计，成功解决了谱面体上Frank-Wolfe方法中更新秩不超过r*时无法线性收敛的开放性难题，首次同时实现了低秩效率和快速收敛，为谱面体上的大规模凸优化提供了新工具。

title: MAC-I$^2$: Learned Metrics-Aware Covariance for Robust Visual-Inertial Fusion in Initialization and Calibration
summary: Visual-Inertial (VI) fusion is fundamental to accurate and robust state estimation, where camera and IMU measurements are combined according to their respective uncertainties. Existing methods, however, fuse the two modalities with predefined uncertainties, regardless of how reliable each is in the local context, and thus often struggle under challenging environments involving illumination changes, dynamic objects, and textureless regions. In this paper, we present MAC-I$^2$, which achieves robust VI fusion through learned metric-aware covariance for both modalities, so that vision and IMU compete on their own merits rather than relying on predefined uncertainties. Here, metrics-aware means that each predicted covariance faithfully reflects the actual magnitude of the corresponding measurement noise. On the visual side, we propagate learned feature-matching uncertainties into pose covariances for the fusion. On the inertial side, motivated by the observation that integration error accumulates sharply at the early stage and grows slowly afterward, we design a learned IMU model with a learnable initial covariance, and propose a dedicated fine-tuning strategy on a held-out training subset to enable the metrics-aware covariance on unseen sequences. As a showcase, we build a VI initialization and calibration system, since accurate and robust initialization and calibration are the prerequisite for any reliable VI system. Experiments on EuRoC, and VBR show that MAC-I$^2$ substantially outperforms existing methods: it achieves a 99.9% initialization success rate on EuRoC, reducing gravity and velocity errors by about 60% and 42% over the strongest baseline, and maintains 80% success rate on challenging VBR sequences where baseline methods such as VINS-Mono drop below 10%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAC-I²，一种通过学习的度量感知协方差来实现视觉-惯性鲁棒融合的方法。视觉侧传播学习的特征匹配不确定性到位姿协方差，惯性侧设计可学习的IMU模型和初始协方差，并通过专门微调策略使协方差在未见序列上度量感知。在EuRoC和VBR数据集上显著优于现有方法，初始化成功率提升巨大。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-惯性(VI)融合方法预先设定传感器不确定性，缺乏对局部环境中视觉或惯性测量可靠性变化的适应性，在光照变化、动态物体和无纹理区域等挑战性环境下性能退化严重。因此需要让视觉和IMU依据自身实际噪声水平竞争融合，而非依赖预设不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 视觉侧：将学习的特征匹配不确定性传播到位姿协方差用于融合。2) 惯性侧：基于积分误差前期快速累积、后期缓慢增长的特性，设计带可学习初始协方差的IMU模型，并提出在保留训练子集上专门微调的策略，实现未见序列上的度量感知协方差。3) 将该方法应用于VI初始化和标定系统作为展示。
AI.result: 在EuRoC数据集上达到99.9%初始化成功率，相比最强baseline将重力和速度误差分别降低约60%和42%；在挑战性VBR序列上保持80%成功率，而VINS-Mono等baseline方法成功率降至10%以下。
AI.conclusion: 通过度量感知的协方差学习，使两种模态能依据各自实际不确定性进行公平融合，显著提升了视觉-惯性系统在挑战性环境下的初始化和标定鲁棒性，验证了自适应不确定性在VI融合中的关键价值。

title: Off-Grid Point-Scatterer Localization from Sparse Limited-Aperture Data via Hankel Completion
summary:
We study the localization of $s$ distinct planar point scatterers from sparsely sampled single-incidence, single-frequency acoustic far-field data over a limited receiver aperture. Under the first Born approximation, the coherent data form a two-dimensional off-grid exponential sum and admit a low-rank Hankel representation. A limited aperture generally admits multiple aperture-admissible Hankel pencils with different lifted dimensions, sampling multiplicities, and Vandermonde conditioning. Hence, the choice of the Hankel pencil affects both data completion and subsequent localization.
  In this work, we introduce a unified framework for structured completion and off-grid localization based on general aperture admissible Hankel pencils. We establish exact recovery in the noiseless case and stable recovery under bounded noise from a number of random aperture samples that is linear in $s$, up to factors determined by the pencil geometry, source conditioning, and logarithmic terms, together with an explicit localization bound in terms of the completion error. The analysis separates the contribution of the pencil geometry from the conditioning induced by the source configuration and provides verifiable sufficient conditions for stable completion and MUSIC resolution. These results yield quantitative criteria for selecting sample efficient Hankel pencils under a prescribed physical aperture. Numerical experiments on connected and disconnected apertures demonstrate the effects of pencil geometry, sampling, and noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从稀疏采样、单频声学远场数据中定位s个平面点散射体的方法。在第一Born近似下，相干数据构成二维离网格指数和，具有低秩Hankel表示。作者提出了基于一般孔径容许Hankel铅笔的统一框架，用于结构补全和离网格定位，建立了无噪声精确恢复和有界噪声下稳定恢复的理论保证，并提供可验证的充分条件用于稳定补全和MUSIC分辨率，为在给定物理孔径下选择样本高效的Hankel铅笔提供了定量准则。
AI.motivation: 有限孔径下，声学远场稀疏采样数据中定位多个点散射体是一个不适定且困难的问题。由于有限孔径通常允许多种孔径容许的Hankel铅笔存在，不同铅笔具有不同的提升维度、采样多重性和Vandermonde条件数，这导致铅笔选择会同时影响数据补全和后续定位精度。此前缺乏一个统一框架来理解并指导如何选择合适的Hankel铅笔。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个基于一般孔径容许Hankel铅笔的统一框架，用于结构化补全和离网格定位。理论分析包括：无噪声情形下的精确恢复保证；有界噪声下从随机孔径样本中稳定恢复的界（样本数与s线性相关，乘以由铅笔几何、源条件数和对数项决定的因子）；将铅笔几何与源配置引起的条件数贡献分离的分析方法；以及提供可验证的稳定补全和MUSIC分辨率的充分条件。最终得出在给定物理孔径下选择样本高效Hankel铅笔的定量准则。
AI.result: 建立了统一框架下的精确恢复和稳定恢复理论保证，证明了样本复杂度与散射体数量s成线性关系（含铅笔几何、源条件和对数因子），给出了以补全误差表示的显式定位误差界，并提供了可验证的稳定补全与MUSIC分辨率充分条件。数值实验在连通和不连通孔径上验证了铅笔几何、采样和噪声的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离铅笔几何的贡献与源配置引起的条件数影响，获得了可验证的稳定条件和定量准则，为在有限物理孔径下选择样本高效的Hankel铅笔提供了理论指导。该框架统一了结构化补全与离网格定位的分析，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果。

title: A geometric Jacquet--Langlands correspondence for Shimura varieties
summary: We formulate a conjecture predicting the existence of exotic isomorphisms between Igusa stacks associated to different Shimura data whose underlying groups are pure inner forms of each other, and prove it in many cases of interest. In combination with the spectral action of Fargues--Scholze, this allows us to relate the cohomology groups of the two Shimura varieties, giving a geometric incarnation of the Jacquet--Langlands correspondence. An important ingredient in our proofs is the work of Xiao--Zhu on exotic Hecke correspondences between the perfect special fibers of different Shimura varieties, which we reinterpret in terms of exotic isomorphisms of perfect Igusa stacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个猜想，预测与不同Shimura数据相关联的Igusa栈之间存在exotic同构（其底层群是彼此的纯内形式），并在众多感兴趣的情形下证明了该猜想。结合Fargues–Scholze的谱作用，这能关联两个Shimura簇的上同调群，为Jacquet–Langlands对应提供了几何实现。证明的关键工具是Xiao–Zhu关于不同Shimura簇完美特殊纤维之间exotic Hecke对应的成果，本文将其重新诠释为完美Igusa栈之间的exotic同构。
AI.motivation: 作者希望为Jacquet–Langlands对应提供几何层面的解释。传统上Jacquet–Langlands对应建立了不同代数群（互为内形式）的表示之间的对应关系，而本文试图通过Shimura簇和Igusa栈之间的同构关系，将这一表示论中的经典结果在几何上加以实现和验证。
AI.method: 本文的方法包括：(1) 提出关于不同Shimura数据之间Igusa栈的exotic同构猜想；(2) 在多种重要情形下给出该猜想的证明；(3) 将Xiao–Zhu关于exotic Hecke对应的结果重新解释为完美Igusa栈之间的exotic同构；(4) 结合Fargues–Scholze的谱作用，利用这些同构去关联两个Shimura簇的上同调。
AI.result: 作者在众多感兴趣的情形下证明了所提出的exotic同构猜想，并成功将不同Shimura簇的上同调群联系起来，从而以几何方式体现了Jacquet–Langlands对应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了几何与表示论之间的深层次联系，证明了通过Igusa栈的exotic同构可以几何化地实现Jacquet–Langlands对应。这也验证并推广了Xiao–Zhu的工作，为后续在更一般情形下研究内形式之间Shimura簇的关系奠定了基础。

title: The Exact Time-Uniform Rate Frontier for Stochastic Gradient Descent on Smooth Convex Objectives
summary:
We study the time-uniform convergence of the raw iterate of standard stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for unconstrained smooth convex objectives. We prove that, under standard noise assumptions, the time-uniform convergence rate gets arbitrarily close to $\sqrt{\log n / n}$ but never reaches it. More specifically, we prove that for every positive, eventually nondecreasing sequence $h$ satisfying $h(n) = o(\sqrt{n})$, a bound of order $h(n)/\sqrt{n}$, holding simultaneously for all $n$ with probability at least $1-α$ and uniformly over the problem class, is achievable if and only if \[
  \sum_{j = 1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{h(2^j)^2} < \infty. \] The constructive sufficiency result follows from a dyadic horizon-free schedule together with an additive conditional-restart inequality. The necessity counterpart applies to every deterministic nonnegative schedule and holds even for a one-dimensional analytic smooth convex objective with Gaussian noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了标准随机梯度下降（SGD）在无约束光滑凸目标上原始迭代的时间一致收敛性。证明在标准噪声假设下，时间一致收敛率可任意接近√(log n/n)但无法达到。具体地，对于任意满足h(n)=o(√n)的正且最终非递减序列h，形如h(n)/√n的界对所有n同时成立当且仅当∑1/h(2^j)²<∞。
AI.motivation: 标准SGD的收敛性分析通常只关注固定时间步或特定时间节点的误差界，但在线学习和自适应停止场景中需要同时对所有时间步成立的"时间一致"（time-uniform）保证。本文旨在刻画原始SGD迭代能否在时间一致意义下达到接近最优的收敛率，并厘清可达与不可达的精确边界。
AI.method: 作者采用了两种互补的技术路径：(1) 充分性方面，构造了二进（dyadic）无水平线调度（horizon-free schedule），并结合一个加性条件重启不等式（additive conditional-restart inequality）来证明可达性；(2) 必要性方面，对任意确定性非负调度给出了下界论证，并在一维解析光滑凸目标加高斯噪声的设定下证明该下界是最紧的，从而刻画了收敛率的本质极限。
AI.result: 证明了时间一致收敛速率可以任意接近√(log n/n)（对应于h(n)=√(log n)的情形）但永远达不到。给出了一个精确的充要条件：∑_{j=1}^∞ 1/h(2^j)² < ∞。该必要条件对所有确定性非负调度都成立，即使在最简单的一维解析光滑凸目标和高斯噪声下也不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 该研究精确刻画了SGD原始迭代时间一致收敛的理论极限：收敛率界h(n)/√n的可行性完全由h在二进尺度上的平方倒数求和收敛性决定。这一充要条件揭示了时间一致性与经典非一致收敛之间的本质差距，为理解SGD在在线和自适应场景下的行为提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Beyond Task Success: Stage-Wise Reliability of World Model Planning under Sensing Degradation
summary: In world model planning, sensing inputs pass through an encoder and predictor before affecting planner decisions, so final task success alone cannot reveal where sensing disturbances attenuate or persist in the pipeline. We apply 10 visual and temporal sensing degradations to a world model planner and track their effects across representation, future prediction, planner preference, and physical outcome using paired evaluation on the same 50 tasks. The relative impact of degradations was not preserved across stages: large representation shifts could attenuate downstream, while smaller initial shifts could persist to the outcome, and internal-response ordering did not directly match physical-outcome ordering. Temporal degradations also showed distinct patterns: even with similar overall changes in observation history, responses differed substantially with the location of corrupted information and the planner's actual exposure. This non-uniform stage-wise response was also observed in secondary evaluations with another manipulation task and a different world model. Stage-wise diagnosis can therefore identify where sensing disturbances attenuate or persist and help prioritize subsequent model verification and sensing mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究世界模型规划器中感知扰动如何在不同处理阶段（编码、预测、规划偏好、物理结果）衰减或持续，通过对50个任务施加10种视觉与时间退化并逐阶段追踪其影响，发现阶段间退化影响未保持一致，时序退化模式也随信息位置和规划器暴露程度而异。
AI.motivation: 仅关注最终任务成功率不足以揭示感知扰动在规划器流水线中的衰减或持续位置，需要逐阶段诊断来理解世界模型规划器中感知退化对中间表示和最终决策的影响路径。
AI.method: 对同一世界模型规划器施加10种视觉和时间感知退化，在相同的50个任务上进行配对评估，分别追踪退化在（1）表示层、（2）未来预测、（3）规划器偏好、（4）物理结果四个阶段的效应；并在另一操作任务和不同世界模型上进行二次验证。
AI.result: 退化影响的相对大小在各阶段间不一致：大的表示偏移可能在下游衰减，而小的初始偏移可能持续到物理结果；内部响应的排序与物理结果的排序并不匹配。时序退化即使整体观测历史变化相似，其响应也会因损坏信息的位置和规划器实际暴露程度而显著不同。这种非均匀的阶段响应在另一任务和另一世界模型中得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 阶段式诊断能够识别感知扰动在规划器流水线中衰减或持续的位置，有助于优先安排后续的模型验证和感知缓解措施。

title: Strong convergence rates of tamed exponential Euler schemes for superlinear hyperbolic SPDEs
summary:
In this paper, we prove pathwise uniform convergence at rates up to $1/2$ for tamed exponential Euler schemes for semilinear hyperbolic stochastic evolution equations with superlinearly growing nonlinearities and multiplicative noise. We take the term hyperbolic to mean that the leading operator generates a contractive $C_0$-semigroup but no parabolic smoothing occurs. Under local Lipschitz, polynomial growth, coercivity, and monotonicity conditions on the nonlinearities, we establish pathwise uniform strong error estimates of the form \begin{equation*}
  \Big(\mathbb{E}\max_{0\le j \le N} \|U(t_j)-U^j\|_X^p\Big)^{1/p} \lesssim \sqrt{k} \end{equation*} on a Hilbert space $X$ for $p\in [2,\infty)$. Here, $U$ is the mild solution and $U^j$ is the tamed exponential Euler approximation at time $t_j=jk$ with step size $k>0$. This extends previous convergence results for non-parabolic SPDEs from globally to locally Lipschitz nonlinearities, allowing both drift and diffusion to grow polynomially. In a stochastic Kato framework, we further establish local and global well-posedness as well as uniform a priori estimates for the mild solution and its approximation. Applications to nonlinear stochastic transport, Airy, wave-type, and dissipatively damped nonlinear Schrödinger equations are included, covering different nonlinearities-stopped and fractionally tamed schemes. For the Klein-Gordon equation with cubic velocity damping, this complements previous results obtained for additive noise.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了驯化指数欧拉格式在非抛物型半线性双曲随机发展方程中对超线性增长非线性项和乘性噪声的路径一致收敛性，收敛阶可达1/2，将先前全局Lipschitz假设扩展到局部Lipschitz假设。
AI.motivation: 已有关于非抛物型SPDE（超曲型随机发展方程）的数值收敛结果仅限于全局Lipschitz非线性，而实际应用中（如随机输运、Airy、波型方程等）非线性项往往仅满足局部Lipschitz条件且具有超线性增长，需要将收敛性理论推广到更一般的非线性情形。
AI.method: 采用驯化指数欧拉（tamed exponential Euler）格式处理超线性增长的非线性项；在局部Lipschitz、多项式增长、强制性、单调性条件下，利用随机Kato框架建立温和解的局部与全局适定性以及一致先验估计；采用非线性项截断（stopped）和分数阶驯化（fractionally tamed）两种方案处理不同类型的非线性。
AI.result: 在Hilbert空间X上对p∈[2,∞)建立了形如(𝔼 max_{0≤j≤N} ‖U(t_j)−U^j‖_X^p)^{1/p} ≲ √k的路径一致强误差估计，即收敛阶为1/2。该结果将先前的收敛性结论从全局Lipschitz扩展到局部Lipschitz超线性非线性项，并涵盖漂移和扩散均为多项式增长的情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了非抛物型SPDE在超线性增长非线性条件下的驯化指数欧拉格式收敛性理论，并应用于非线性随机输运方程、Airy方程、波型方程及耗散阻尼非线性薛定谔方程等。对具有三次速度阻尼的Klein-Gordon方程，该结果补充了此前仅适用于加性噪声的结论。

title: Four explicit continued fractions for values of the Lerch transcendent and the Hurwitz zeta function
summary: We prove four explicit continued fraction representations for the Lerch transcendent $Φ(z, s, M+1)$, where $\Re M>0$ and $(z,s)\in\{(-1,1),(-1,2),(1,2),(1,3)\}$. All of the continued fractions have unit partial numerators, while partial denominators depend on the parameter $M$. The proofs combine equivalent transformations of continued fractions, generalized hypergeometric functions, three-term recurrences, and asymptotic analysis of minimal solutions. For $z=1$, the corresponding representations give continued fractions for the values of the Hurwitz zeta function $ζ(2, M+1)$ and $ζ(3, M+1)$.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了Lerch超越函数Φ(z,s,M+1)在四组特定参数(z,s)∈{(-1,1),(-1,2),(1,2),(1,3)}下的四个显式连分数表示，其中所有连分数均具有单位部分分子，部分分母依赖于参数M。当z=1时，这些表示分别给出Hurwitz zeta函数ζ(2,M+1)和ζ(3,M+1)的连分数。
AI.motivation: 探索Lerch超越函数（一个涵盖Riemann zeta、Hurwitz zeta、Lerch zeta等多个著名特殊函数的推广）的连分数表示，这类表示对数值计算和理论分析有重要价值。
AI.method: 结合多种技术手段：(1) 连分数的等价变换；(2) 广义超几何函数理论；(3) 三项递推关系；(4) 最小解的渐近分析。
AI.result: 获得了Lerch超越函数在四种特殊参数组合下的四个连分数表示，部分分母依赖于参数M，且对于z=1的情况自然退化为Hurwitz zeta函数ζ(s,M+1)在s=2和s=3时的连分数表示。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果丰富了Lerch超越函数与Hurwitz zeta函数的连分数理论，为相关特殊函数的分析和计算提供了新工具。

title: Structured Positive-Definite Optimal Control Synthesis of Closed-Loop Recommendation Systems over Social Networks
summary: We study the design of feedback recommendation policies for networked multi-topic opinion dynamics. The design of recommendations is formulated as an infinite-horizon linear-quadratic optimal control problem that favors suggestions aligned with each agent's current opinion, thereby using opinion alignment as a proxy for engagement. At the same time, the performance index penalizes polarization, deviation from the uncontrolled equilibrium of the opinion dynamics, and from the current agents' opinion, recommendation effort, and favors coherence among neighbors' recommendations. An agent-wise representation exposes the interconnection structure of the social network and enables structured controller and certificate synthesis. Under the assumption that the stage cost of the performance index is strictly positive definite, the affine optimal control problem separates into a strictly convex steady-state optimization, which determines the optimal equilibrium and the affine controller offset, and an LQR problem, which yields the static state-feedback gain. The resulting centralized Riccati controller provides a performance benchmark, while structured gains are obtained from dissipativity-based and $\mathcal H_2$-based LMI surrogate formulations. Possibly overlapping certificate clusters yield scalable local sufficient conditions for the structured gain design, while a separate steady-state cluster decomposition provides an exact consensus reformulation of the steady-state optimization. Numerical results on a social network illustrate the closed-loop behavior and the trade-off between performance and controller locality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络化多主题观点动态中的反馈推荐策略设计问题，将其建模为无限时域线性二次最优控制问题。该问题通过惩罚极化、偏离非受控均衡等指标，同时偏好与用户当前观点对齐的推荐以模拟参与度。在阶段成本严格正定假设下，该仿射最优控制问题可分解为严格凸的稳态优化（确定最优均衡和仿射控制器偏移量）与LQR问题（求得静态状态反馈增益）。集中的Riccati控制器作为性能基准，结构化增益则由基于耗散性和H₂的LMI替代公式求解。数值结果展示了闭环行为及性能与控制器局部性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台需要设计有效的推荐策略来影响用户观点动态，同时需要在提升用户参与度（通过推荐与用户观点对齐）与降低极化、偏离均衡等负面指标之间取得平衡。现有工作缺乏对网络化多主题观点动态下系统性的推荐反馈控制设计框架。
AI.method: 将推荐策略设计表述为无限时域线性二次最优控制问题：采用agent-wise表示显式揭示社交网络的互连结构，支持结构化控制器和证书综合。在阶段成本严格正定假设下，将仿射最优控制问题分解为：(1) 严格凸的稳态优化问题（确定最优均衡与控制器偏移）；(2) LQR问题（求静态状态反馈增益）。集中式Riccati控制器作为性能基准，结构化增益通过耗散性基和H₂基的LMI替代公式获得；可能重叠的证书簇提供可扩展的局部充分条件，独立的稳态簇分解给出稳态优化的精确共识重构。
AI.result: 在社会网络上的数值实验验证了闭环行为，展示了所提方法在性能与控制器局部性（结构化程度）之间的权衡效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为网络化多主题观点动力学中的推荐反馈策略提供了完整的集中式与分布式（结构化）设计框架，通过将仿射LQ问题分解为稳态优化与LQR问题，平衡了理论最优性（Riccati基准）与可扩展性（LMI与簇分解的局部化方法）。

title: EquiGQNet: Fast Grasp Quality Evaluation via Shared Equivariant Point Cloud Encoding
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Planning six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) grasps for unseen objects in cluttered tabletop scenes from a single-view depth image requires accurate and efficient evaluation of diverse grasp candidates. Existing early-fusion methods capture local object geometry relative to each grasp candidate but repeatedly encode the scene, whereas late-fusion methods reuse a shared scene representation but may lose this grasp-relative local geometry. We propose EquiGQNet, an efficient 6-DoF grasp quality evaluator that combines the strengths of both approaches. For grasp orientation, EquiGQNet replaces the early-fusion operation of rotating and re-encoding the point cloud for each grasp candidate with an SO(3)-equivariant encode-once-then-rotate scheme, yielding grasp-aligned geometric features from a shared scene encoding. For grasp translation, Mid-level Action Fusion (MAF) injects the grasp position into intermediate features before global aggregation, retaining local geometry relative to each candidate. We evaluate EquiGQNet in two grasp planning pipelines: Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based continuous grasp search and candidate ranking with a pretrained generative planner. In simulation, EquiGQNet achieves grasping performance comparable to the early-fusion baseline and substantially outperforms late fusion on objects with complex geometry and limited graspable regions, while reducing CEM planning time from 3.31s to 0.48s, a 6.9x speedup over early fusion. In real-world household-object decluttering, EquiGQNet achieves a 95.2% grasp success rate and 230 picks per hour, versus 153 and 170 for early- and late-fusion baselines. Code is available at https://equigqnet.github.io/.

AI.tldr: EquiGQNet提出一种高效6-DoF抓取质量评估器，通过SO(3)等变"先编码后旋转"机制替代早期融合中的旋转重编码，并结合中层动作融合（MAF）注入抓取平移位置，在保持抓取相对局部几何信息的同时复用共享场景表征。在仿真和真实实验中，其在复杂几何物体上性能优于后期融合并与早期融合相当，同时规划速度提升6.9倍，真实散落清理任务中达到95.2%成功率和每小时230次抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有6-DoF抓取评估方法存在两难：早期融合虽能捕获相对每个抓取候选的局部物体几何，但需对每个候选重复编码场景，效率低下；晚期融合虽复用共享场景表征，但可能丢失抓取相关的局部几何细节。论文旨在同时获得高效的场景复用与精准的抓取相对几何编码。
AI.method: 1) 对抓取方向，采用SO(3)等变的"编码一次后旋转"方案（encode-once-then-rotate），从共享场景编码中获得对齐于抓取姿态的几何特征，避免早期融合中逐候选旋转重编码点云；2) 对抓取平移，提出中层动作融合（MAF），在全局聚合前将抓取位置注入中间特征，保留关于每个候选的局部几何；3) 在CEM连续抓取搜索与预训练生成式规划器的候选排序两种管线中评估。
AI.result: 仿真中，EquiGQNet与早期融合基线性能相当，在复杂几何及有限可抓取区域物体上明显优于后期融合；CEM规划时间从3.31s降至0.48s，较早期融合提速6.9倍。真实家庭物体散落清理中达到95.2%抓取成功率和每小时230次抓取，分别优于早期（153/小时）与后期（170/小时）基线。
AI.conclusion: EquiGQNet通过融合早期融合的局部几何辨识优势与晚期融合的共享表征复用效率，在保持高抓取质量的同时大幅提升规划速度，为单视图深度图像下的6-DoF抓取规划提供了高效可行方案，并在仿真与真实场景中均验证了其性能优势。

title: High-Order Discontinuous Cut Finite Element Methods for Scalar Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
summary: In this paper, we present a family of high-order cut finite element methods based on the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) framework for scalar hyperbolic conservation laws on complex domains. Building on our previous work, we develop a multidimensional formulation that combines macro-element stabilization with flux limiting to obtain a scheme that preserves the maximum principle and remains robust with respect to arbitrary boundary cuts of the background mesh. The physical domain is embedded in a regular background mesh, which may produce arbitrarily small cut cells. To avoid the severe time step restrictions typically associated with such cells, ghost penalty stabilization terms are added on interior facets of macro-elements. The resulting method exhibits stability and accuracy properties similar to those of standard DG methods on fitted meshes. An $L^2$-stability result is derived for the semi-discrete scheme under both periodic and inflow-outflow boundary conditions. To enforce the maximum principle and suppress nonphysical oscillations, we adapt limiter techniques from standard DG methods to the CutFEM setting by defining limiting parameters on macro-elements. In particular, we present a macro-element-based parameterized flux limiter together with adaptations of the Zhang-Shu bound-preserving limiter and the Barth-Jespersen slope limiter. Numerical experiments in two and three spatial dimensions demonstrate optimal convergence orders, preservation of the maximum principle, and accurate shock capturing without spurious oscillations, even for challenging cut configurations involving very small-cut cell intersections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一族基于不连续伽辽金（DG）框架的高阶切割有限元方法，用于复杂域上的标量双曲守恒律。方法结合宏元素稳定化与通量限制器，在背景网格任意切割的情况下保持最大值原理，并通过幽灵惩罚项避免小切割单元带来的时间步长限制。
AI.motivation: 复杂域上的双曲守恒律数值求解面临两个核心挑战：一是嵌入背景网格产生的任意小切割单元会导致严重的时间步长限制；二是需要在不光滑解附近保持最大值原理并抑制非物理振荡。现有方法难以同时兼顾稳定性、精度和无振荡特性。
AI.method: 将物理域嵌入规则背景网格中，在宏元素的内部面上添加幽灵惩罚稳定化项以处理小切割单元；设计宏元素参数化通量限制器，并适配Zhang-Shu保界限制器和Barth-Jespersen斜率限制器以强制执行最大值原理；推导了半离散格式在周期和流入-流出边界条件下的L²稳定性结果。
AI.result: 二维和三维数值实验表明，方法具有最优收敛阶，保持最大值原理，能够在无伪振荡的情况下准确捕捉激波，即使在涉及极小切割单元交叉的挑战性切割构型下也能良好工作。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CutDG方法在复杂切割网格上实现了与适配网格上标准DG方法相当的稳定性与精度，同时具备最大值原理保持和无振荡特性，为复杂域上双曲守恒律的高阶数值求解提供了稳健方案。

title: A Problem on the largest divisor $d$ of $N$ with $d\leq \sqrt{N}$
summary:
For a given number $N$, we consider the problem of
  computing two integers $1\leq r,f < N$ such that
  the set $$\mathcal{X}(N,r,f) = \{(a+b)-(f+\frac{Nr+1}{f}): ab=Nr\}$$
  consists only of positive integers. Computing a solution to the problem is equivalent to finding a
  pair $(r,f)$ satisfying $l(Nr) < f \leq l(Nr+1)$, where $l(x)$ is the largest divisor of $x$ bounded by $\sqrt{x}$. This requires factoring both $Nr$ and $Nr+1$. We present a simple randomized algorithm that - avoiding factoring - computes pairs $(r,f)$.
  We give an exact formula for the total number of possible pairs $(r,f)$, and with the aid of empirical data we estimate that the ratio
  $$\frac{φ(N)-2}{|\mathfrak{F}(N)|}$$ to be roughly about $c*\log \log N$. Here, $\mathfrak{F}(N)$ is the set of unique $r$ appearing among all possible pairs $(r,f)$, $φ(.)$ is the Euler's totient function, and $c$ is a constant equal to 2 for prime $N$ and oscillates much for composite $N$.
  As a separate and independent case, we study the same problem of computing
  $(r,f)$ with $r>N$. We present a procedure to find such an $r$, which requires finding the least prime in an arithmetic progression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一类数论计算问题：给定N，需计算整数对(r,f)使得集合X(N,r,f)仅包含正整数。该问题等价于在l(Nr)<f≤l(Nr+1)范围内寻找f，其中l(x)是x不超过√x的最大因子。传统方法需要对Nr和Nr+1进行因子分解，本文提出一种避免因子分解的简单随机化算法，并给出了可行解对总数的精确公式，同时通过经验数据估计相关比率约为c·log log N。此外还独立研究了r>N的情形，提出一种需要寻找算术级数中最小素数的求解程序。
AI.motivation: 传统求解该问题需要同时分解Nr和Nr+1两个整数，这在计算上代价高昂。作者希望提供一种无需因子分解的随机算法来高效求解此数论问题，并对可行解的结构和数量进行理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出一个简单的随机化算法，通过避免显式因子分解来求解满足条件的(r,f)对；给出了所有可能(r,f)对总数的精确公式；利用经验数据分析比率(φ(N)-2)/|F(N)|的渐近行为；对r>N的独立情形，提出基于算术级数中最少素数查找的求解程序。
AI.result: 给出了可行解对总数的精确计数公式；经验数据显示比率(φ(N)-2)/|F(N)|近似为c·log log N，其中c对素数N取常数2，对合数N则振荡明显；针对r>N的情形给出了相应求解方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过随机算法和理论分析，为这类无因子分解的数论计算问题提供了新的解决途径，揭示了可行解数量与欧拉函数及对数迭代函数之间的关联，并区分了素数N与非素数N在不同行为下的差异。

title: McCormick relaxations for PDE-constrained optimization on multi-dimensional domains
summary:
We are interested in computing approximate dual bounds for nonconvex optimal control problems using McCormick inequalities. To handle the numerical burden concerned with the tightening of these inequalities, we locally average the bilinear term in the PDE constraint. We extend recent theory in this area to elliptic PDEs on multidimensional domains that involve bilinear terms. As an additional result, we also generalize the necessary assumptions to allow for more flexibility in the choice of the discretization for the total variation penalty term from the underlying control problem. Furthermore, we prove the existence of valid bounds on the state variable, which are crucial to enable the optimization-based bound-tightening (OBBT) procedure to tighten the McCormick inequalities.
  Since theoretical bounds on the state variable are rather conservative, OBBT is both crucial and the main computational bottleneck for deriving a sharp approximate dual bound. We show how the sequence of LPs arising during OBBT may sensibly be warmstarted, allowing us to successfully scale the numerical experiments to finer discretizations than what was possible before.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用McCormick不等式计算非凸最优控制问题的近似对偶下界，通过局部平均化PDE约束中的双线性项来降低计算负担，并引入OBBT过程配合热启动技术使数值实验可扩展到更细的离散化。
AI.motivation: 非凸最优控制问题上难以获得紧的近似对偶下界，而使用McCormick不等式加固通常会带来严重的数值负担。现有理论主要针对特定场景，需要扩展到多维域上的椭圆PDE并放宽离散化假设，同时OBBT带来的计算瓶颈制约着数值实验的精度。
AI.method: 将McCormick不等式的局部平均化理论扩展到含双线性项的多维椭圆PDE；推广必要假设以允许TV惩罚项离散化有更多选择；证明状态变量有效界的存在性以支持OBBT；针对OBBT中一系列LP提出热启动策略以加速求解。
AI.result: 建立了多维椭圆PDE双线性项McCormick不等式平均化的理论基础，推广了TV离散化假设，证明了OBBT所需状态界的存在性，并通过热启动LP序列成功将数值实验扩展到比以往更细的离散化尺度。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论推广和热启动技术，实现了对非凸最优控制问题更紧且可扩展的近似对偶下界计算，克服了OBBT这一定义域瓶颈，验证了该方法在更细离散化网格上的有效性。

title: State-of-the-Art in Learning-by-Demonstration with Passive Observation for Industrial Assembly Automation
summary: Learning-by-Demonstration (LbD) enables intuitive robot programming by capturing expert skills, which is crucial for agility in high-mix, low- volume manufacturing. This systematic literature review analyzes passive LbD for industrial assembly processes, focusing on the perception architecture and the generalization of the perceived demonstration. We specifically investigate one-shot approaches where only a single demonstration is required. The review evaluates how systems adapt to new assemblies using this limited data. We identify a shift towards object-centric perception, allowing learned primitives to be transferred to new product variants with minimal training.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇系统文献综述，聚焦于工业装配过程中被动式学习演示（LbD）方法，特别关注单次演示（one-shot）的感知架构和泛化能力，发现该领域正转向以物体为中心的感知方式，使学习到的原始技能能够以最少训练量迁移至新产品变体。
AI.motivation: 高混合、低批量制造环境对敏捷性的需求日益增长，而学习演示（LbD）通过捕捉专家技能实现直观的机器人编程。作者旨在系统梳理被动式LbD在工业装配中的应用现状，探究仅需单次演示即可实现泛化的方法。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，专注于被动式LbD在工业装配流程中的应用，重点分析感知架构设计以及所感知演示的泛化机制，尤其深入调查仅需单次演示的一发式（one-shot）方法。
AI.result: 研究发现该领域呈现向物体中心感知（object-centric perception）转变的趋势，这种架构允许习得的原始技能（primitives）以最小的再训练代价迁移到新的产品变体上。
AI.conclusion: 物体中心感知是实现单次演示LbD泛化的关键方向，能够支持工业装配中快速适应新组装任务的需求。

title: On the well-posedness and efficient approximation for the classical Melan equation in suspension bridges
summary: The classical Melan equation modeling suspension bridges is considered. We first study the explicit expression and global properties of the analytical solution for the simplified ``less stiff'' model, based on which we derive an a priori estimate for the original classical Melan equation and establish, under an explicit load condition, that it has a unique solution with nonnegative integral under downward live loads, thereby showing the uniqueness of the corresponding deflection curve in the engineering setting. We also develop an efficient iterative approximation method by taking the solution of the simplified ``less stiff'' model as the first iterate, and prove its geometric convergence with explicit error estimates. The applicability and computational efficiency of the method are demonstrated through calculations for two actual bridges, which also quantify the influence of the nonlinear nonlocal term on the solution and clarify the relationship between the simplified and original models. Several engineering observations are verified and explained, and some related open problems are suggested.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经典的Melan方程（描述悬索桥的模型）。首先研究了简化"较轻刚度"模型的解析解显式表达和全局性质，并基于此推导原始Melan方程的先验估计，在显式荷载条件下证明了向下活载下存在唯一具有非负积分的解，从而在工程背景下确立了挠度曲线的唯一性。进一步提出了以简化模型解为首步迭代的高效迭代逼近方法，证明了其几何收敛性并给出显式误差估计。通过对两座实际桥梁的计算验证了方法的适用性和计算效率，并量化了非线性非局部项对解的影响。文中验证并解释了几项工程观察，同时提出了相关开放问题。
AI.motivation: Melan方程是描述悬索桥挠度的经典非线性非局部模型，其数学分析（特别是解的存在唯一性与高效数值求解）在工程应用中具有重要价值。此前对原始Melan方程缺乏系统的理论保证和高效的迭代求解工具。
AI.method: 1) 先研究简化"较轻刚度"模型的解析解显式表达式与全局性质；2) 利用简化模型推导原始Melan方程的先验估计，在显式荷载条件下证明解的存在唯一性（非负积分意义下）；3) 以简化模型解为初值构建迭代逼近格式，证明其几何收敛并给出显式误差界。
AI.result: 在显式向下活载条件下证明了原始Melan方程存在唯一非负积分解；所提出的迭代方法具有几何收敛性及显式误差估计；通过对两座真实桥梁的计算验证了方法的实用性和高效性，同时量化了非线性非局部项的影响，澄清了简化模型与原始模型的关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为悬索桥Melan方程的数学理论提供了完备的存在唯一性保证，同时发展了具有理论收敛保证的高效数值方法。研究验证并解释了几项工程观察，指出了若干开放问题，为后续研究提供了方向。

title: Reduction Modulo Binary Polynomials with Logarithmic Feedback Depth
summary: Polynomial modular reduction is central to binary finite-field arithmetic and repeated Frobenius powering. Sparse top-down folding uses few shift/XOR operations, but a tap near the leading term creates a long feedback chain. We formulate this recurrence as inversion of a nilpotent shift operator and factor its inverse by characteristic-two Frobenius powers. The resulting Frobenius-factorized reduction (FFR) applies to every monic binary modulus without materializing a reciprocal or dense reduction matrix, and its shifts can be generated online without a persistent modulus-specific schedule. For degree $m$, nonleading support size $s$, and nearest-tap distance $Δ_{\min}$, FFR has exact feedback depth $\lceil\log_2(m/Δ_{\min})\rceil$ and scheduled work $O(ms(1+\log(m/s)))$. A portable-C evaluation on 1,096 supports through degree $131072$ identifies distinct FFR, López--Dahab, and gf2x-backed Barrett regions. On four certified irreducible moduli, FFR makes complete Rabin irreducibility testing $1.35$--$8.04$ times faster than NTL and $1.60$--$6.81$ times faster than the matched Barrett implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Frobenius幂分解的二元有限域多项式模约简方法（FFR），利用nilpotent移位算子逆的因子分解，避免了求解互逆或稠密约简矩阵的需求，在复杂度、反馈深度和实际性能上均优于López-Dahab和Barrett等方法。
AI.motivation: 多项式模约简是二元有限域算术与重复Frobenius幂运算的核心。传统的稀疏top-down折叠方法虽然使用较少的移位/XOR操作，但当抽头接近首项时会产生长的反馈链，导致性能瓶颈。此外，现有方法要么需要物化modulus-specific的调度表或稠密约简矩阵，要么需要计算reciprocal，这带来了额外的开销和限制。因此需要一种既高效又无需预计算稠密结构的模约简方法。
AI.method: 本文将模约简递推形式化为一个nilpotent移位算子的求逆问题，利用特征2下Frobenius幂对该逆进行因子分解。FFR适用于所有首一二进制模，无需物化reciprocal或稠密约简矩阵，其移位可以在线生成而无需持久化的模特定调度表。对于次数m、非首项支撑大小s和最近抽头距离Δ_min，FFR具有精确的反馈深度⌈log2(m/Δ_min)⌉和调度工作复杂度O(ms(1+log(m/s)))。
AI.result: 在1,096个模上进行可移植C语言评估（次数至131072），识别出FFR、López-Dahab和gf2x支撑的Barrett三种方法的适用区域。在四个经认证的不可约模上，FFR使完整的Rabin不可约性测试比NTL快1.35-8.04倍，比匹配的Barrett实现快1.60-6.81倍。
AI.conclusion: FFR是一种通用的、高效的二元多项式模约简方法，凭借Frobenius因子分解的理论洞见，在理论上实现了对数级的反馈深度，在实践上显著加速了Rabin不可约性测试等关键应用，为不同模特性（稀疏度、抽头距离等）提供了清晰的最优方法选择依据。

title: A Lower Bound for the Heavy-Ball Method on Smooth Convex Functions
summary: Can the classical Heavy-Ball method, with arbitrary horizon-dependent parameters chosen in advance, achieve Nesterov's $O(T^{-2})$ last-iterate rate on every smooth convex objective? We provide a negative answer. For every horizon $T\ge2$ and every predetermined schedule with nonnegative step sizes and momenta in $[0,1)$, there exists a convex $1$-smooth objective, with initialization distance at most one and zero initial velocity, for which the last iterate of the Heavy-Ball method satisfies \[ f(x_T)-f^\star=Ω\!\left(\frac{1}{T^α\log T}\right), \qquad α=\frac{1+\sqrt5}{2}. \] Thus even fully nonstationary, horizon-dependent tuning cannot give the classical Heavy-Ball method a Nesterov-rate guarantee on the smooth convex class.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个负面结果：经典Heavy-Ball方法即使使用任意预先设定的、依赖时间范围的（horizon-dependent）参数调度（步长非负、动量在[0,1)内），也无法在一般光滑凸函数上达到Nesterov的O(T^{-2})最后迭代收敛速率。对任意时间范围T和任意预定量度，都存在一个1-光滑凸目标函数，使得Heavy-Ball的最后迭代收敛下界为Ω(1/(T^α log T))，其中α=(√5+1)/2（黄金比例）。
AI.motivation: 此前的研究一直想确定Heavy-Ball方法在光滑凸优化上能否获得与Nesterov加速法相当的O(T^{-2})最后迭代速率。虽然非平稳、依赖时间范围的参数调度似乎给了Heavy-Ball更大的灵活性，但尚不清楚这种完全非平稳的调参是否能突破已知的局限。作者希望回答一个理论问题：给Heavy-Ball完全自由地预设参数调度，它能否达到Nesterov速率？
AI.method: 作者采用构造性反例方法（lower bound构造）。对于任意时间范围T≥2和任意预先设定的非负步长与动量在[0,1)内的调度，作者构造一个1-光滑凸目标函数，其初始距离不超过1且初始速度为零，使得Heavy-Ball方法的最后迭代满足下界Ω(1/(T^α log T))，其中α=(1+√5)/2为黄金比例。该下界弱于Nesterov的O(T^{-2})速率，从而否定性地回答了问题。
AI.result: 结果表明，即使是完全非平稳、依赖时间范围预选的Heavy-Ball参数，也无法在光滑凸函数类上提供Nesterov速率保证。下界指数α=(1+√5)/2≈1.618介于普通梯度下降的O(T^{-1})与Nesterov加速的O(T^{-2})之间，说明Heavy-Ball在该函数类上存在固有的收敛速度极限。
AI.conclusion: 经典Heavy-Ball方法即使在最优的依赖时间范围的提前调参下，也不能在一般光滑凸优化问题上达到Nesterov的O(T^{-2})最后迭代收敛率。这进一步确认了Heavy-Ball与Nesterov加速法在理论收敛保证上的本质差距，为理解一阶优化方法的能力边界提供了重要的下界结果。

title: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in Surgical Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Project page: https://surgphase.verloge.space
summary: Sparse outcome feedback limits what robots can learn from unsuccessful attempts at complex manipulation. Failed multi-stage surgical attempts can contain grasps, lifts, or transfers worth reusing. In sparse-reward reinforcement learning, terminal rewards collapse such attempts to the same outcome, while scalar vision-language model (VLM) ratings reveal neither what progress merits credit nor when it occurred. We introduce phase-and-first-arrival feedback: one VLM query per recorded episode identifies the furthest visually verified task phase and when that phase is first reached, allowing the learner to reuse partial behavior and localize credit. We instantiate it in SurgPhaseBench, a phase-structured suite spanning rigid and deformable tasks, and evaluate it in simulation and hardware. Across five simulated tasks, our method reaches 75.2% mean success, compared with 52.1% for a reward based on Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) using the same visual input; the advantage persists when only the feedback representation changes. On hardware, the same record supports autonomous block picking and slip recovery. Together, these results show that trajectory-level visual supervision can preserve partial progress while providing the temporal credit needed for sparse-reward control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"阶段与首次到达反馈"（phase-and-first-arrival feedback）方法，通过单次VLM查询记录每集轨迹中视觉可验证的最远任务阶段及其首次到达时间，在稀疏奖励设定下保留部分进度并实现时序信用分配。在SurgPhaseBench基准（5个模拟+硬件任务）上，平均成功率75.2%，优于基于CLIP的奖励（52.1%）。
AI.motivation: 复杂操作任务中，失败的多次手术尝试中常包含可复用的抓取、提升或转移等子行为。然而稀疏奖励强化学习中，终端奖励会将失败的多次尝试坍缩为相同结果；标量VLM评分也无法揭示哪部分进度值得信用以及何时发生。现有反馈机制缺乏对部分进度的识别与时序信用分配能力。
AI.method: 提出阶段与首次到达反馈：对每个记录的回合执行一次VLM查询，识别视觉可验证的最远任务阶段以及该阶段首次被到达的时间点。这种轨迹级视觉监督使学习器既能复用部分行为，又能对时序信用进行定位。在SurgPhaseBench（包含刚体和可变形任务的相位结构基准）中实现，并在仿真和硬件上评估。
AI.result: 在5个模拟任务中，该方法平均成功率达到75.2%，而基于CLIP同视觉输入的奖励方法仅为52.1%；仅改变反馈表示时优势依然存在。硬件上，同一评估记录支持自主取块与滑移恢复。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级视觉监督能够在保留部分进度的同时提供稀疏奖励控制所需的时序信用，表明VLM可作为一种有效的自定义反馈来源用于复杂机器人操作学习。

title: On the sample complexity of the active subspace method
summary: Active subspaces identify low-dimensional linear structure in high-dimensional parameter-to-output maps by estimating the dominant eigenspace of a gradient covariance operator. In practice this covariance is replaced by a Monte Carlo estimator built from a limited number of gradient evaluations. Classical analyses based on controlling the covariance error in operator norm lead to sample-complexity estimates that can be substantially more pessimistic than the sampling rules commonly used in computations. This paper studies the empirical active subspace method directly in the projection-error metric relevant for ridge approximation. We derive non-asymptotic quasi-optimality bounds governed by a regularized inverse Christoffel function associated with the gradient field. Under a bounded-gradient assumption, the resulting estimates already improve the sample-complexity estimates obtained from operator-norm covariance bounds. We then show that additional smoothness of the gradient map, expressed through membership in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, yields sharper coherence estimates and motivates tractable importance sampling from kernel diagonal measures. Furthermore, the same smoothness assumption yields a priori decay bounds for the population active subspace tail energy, which can be combined with our finite-sample estimate to prescribe rank, regularization scale, and sample size, allowing to fully characterize the a priori sample complexity. The abstract assumptions are verified for lognormal Gaussian and affine uniform parametric elliptic PDEs using weighted summability of Hermite and Legendre series expansions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经验活性子空间方法在脊逼近投影误差度量下的样本复杂度。通过引入与梯度场相关的正则化逆Christoffel函数，推导出非渐近拟最优性界，在全局梯度有界假设下改进经典算子范数协方差界的采样复杂度估计；进一步假设梯度映射属于再生核希尔伯特空间，可获得更尖锐的相干性估计并支持从核对角测度进行重要性采样，同时给出总体活性子空间尾部能量的先验衰减界，从而完整刻画先验样本复杂度。理论通过对数正态高斯和仿射一致参数化椭圆PDE验证。
AI.motivation: 经典基于算子范数控制梯度协方差误差的分析方法在高维参数到输出映射中给出的样本复杂度估计往往比实际计算中使用的采样规则悲观得多，因此需要直接在脊逼近相关的投影误差度量下分析经验活性子空间方法。
AI.method: 直接在投影误差度量下研究经验活性子空间方法，推导由梯度场的正则化逆Christoffel函数支配的非渐近拟最优性界；在再生核希尔伯特空间的平滑性假设下获得更尖锐的相干性估计并提出从核对角测度进行重要性采样；利用平滑性假设推导总体活性子空间尾部能量的先验衰减界，结合有限样本估计联合刻画秩、正则化尺度与样本量。
AI.result: 在有界梯度假设下改进了基于算子范数协方差界的样本复杂度估计；在梯度映射属于再生核希尔伯特空间的额外平滑性假设下获得更尖锐的相干性估计；得到总体活性子空间尾部能量的先验衰减界；通过对数正态高斯和仿射一致参数化椭圆PDE的加权可求和性验证了抽象假设的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文从脊逼近的投影误差角度出发，建立了经验活性子空间方法的非渐近拟最优性理论，显著改进了经典分析结果的保守性，并通过函数空间的平滑性假设实现了对样本复杂度的完整先验刻画，为实际计算提供了坚实的理论支撑。

title: On a problem of Erdős and Nathanson related to minimal asymptotic bases of order $h$
summary: Let $h\geq 3$ be an integer and $0<α<1/h$. In this paper, we prove that there exists a minimal asymptotic basis of order $h$ with asymptotic density $α$. This solves an open problem posed by Erdős and Nathanson in 1988.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对任意整数 h≥3 和 0<α<1/h，存在一个渐近密度为 α 的 h 阶最小渐近基，解决了 Erdős 和 Nathanson 于 1988 年提出的公开问题。
AI.motivation: Erdős 和 Nathanson 于 1988 年提出的关于最小渐近基及其渐近密度的存在性问题是数论中的一个长期悬而未决的公开问题，该问题的解决是渐近基理论的重要进展。
AI.method: 本文通过构造性方法证明了对任意整数 h≥3 和参数 0<α<1/h，均能构造出具有指定渐近密度 α 的 h 阶最小渐近基，从而完成对该公开问题的解答。
AI.result: 证明了存在 h 阶最小渐近基（h≥3），其渐近密度恰好为任意给定的 α（0<α<1/h）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果彻底解决了 Erdős 和 Nathanson 在 1988 年提出的公开问题，为最小渐近基理论提供了完整的构造性解答。

title: Optimal input design via Frank-Wolfe
summary: We study optimal input design over a finite horizon for linear dynamical systems. The goal is to minimize a weighted inverse-covariance (information) criterion subject to an energy budget. The set of covariances achievable by causal policies is convex but lacks a tractable explicit description, ruling out projection-based methods. We show that Frank--Wolfe applies naturally: each linear minimization subproblem is a budget-constrained finite-horizon linear quadratic (LQ) problem, solvable by a Riccati recursion and one-dimensional bisection over a Lagrange multiplier. Using smoothness of the objective over the feasible set, we establish an $\mathcal{O}(1/M)$ convergence rate for the objective value, while strong convexity yields an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{M})$ rate for the iterates. We further extend the framework to input design for system identification with unknown dynamics and adaptive online LQR, and illustrate the approach numerically.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限时域下线性动力系统的最优输入设计问题，提出利用Frank-Wolfe算法求解加权逆协方差（信息）准则最小化问题，每个线性最小化子问题可转化为一个带能量预算的有限时域线性二次（LQ）问题，通过Riccati递推和一维二分法求解，并建立了O(1/M)的目标值收敛率和O(1/√M)的迭代收敛率。
AI.motivation: 线性动力系统的输入设计旨在在能量预算约束下最小化加权逆协方差（信息）准则。虽然因果策略可实现协方差的集合是凸的，但缺乏显式的解析描述，使得基于投影的方法不可行，因此需要寻找新的可操作求解途径。
AI.method: 提出Frank-Wolfe算法：利用可行集的凸性但无需显式描述的特点，将每个线性最小化子问题转化为预算约束下的有限时域LQ问题，通过Riccati递推和Lagrange乘子的一维二分法高效求解；利用目标函数在可行集上的光滑性证明目标值O(1/M)收敛率，借助强凸性证明迭代点O(1/√M)收敛率。此外将该框架推广至未知动力学系统辨识的输入设计及自适应在线LQR场景。
AI.result: 建立了Frank-Wolfe算法在目标值上的O(1/M)收敛率与迭代点上的O(1/√M)收敛率；成功将该框架扩展到未知动力学的系统辨识输入设计与自适应在线LQR中，并通过数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Frank-Wolfe方法天然适配于缺乏显式描述的凸可行集上的输入设计问题，其子问题可通过经典LQ技术高效求解，建立了理论收敛保障并验证了在系统辨识与自适应控制等更广泛场景中的适用性。

title: Generalizable 6D Pose Estimation of Textureless Objects with Planar-based Gaussian Splatting
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Estimating the 6D pose of textureless objects without prior CAD models remains a critical challenge due to the lack of appearance features. While recent generalizable approaches alleviate the dependence on object-specific models, their performance on low-texture objects is often limited by insufficient geometric constraints in the underlying representations. In this work, we propose PG-Pose, a geometry-aware framework combining Planar-based Gaussian Splatting (PGS) reconstruction and Geometry-driven pose optimization. In the offline representation extraction stage, three distinct representations of the object are extracted from multi-view reference RGB images with known poses. PG-Pose reconstructs a 3D Gaussian representation and renders high-fidelity depth maps to generate 3D point clouds through back projection. In the online pose inference stage, the initial pose of the input image is estimated by 2D-3D correspondence matching between the input image and the reconstructed 3D point clouds, followed by a PGS-Refiner for iterative pose optimization. Evaluations on the OnePose-LowTexture datasets, PG-Pose achieves an average accuracy of 94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d, with a 2.1% improvement average accuracy compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) GS-based approach. To further demonstrate the effectiveness of PG-Pose for industrial robots in grasping tasks, we deploy it on a dual-arm industrial robot and successfully realize the grasping task on an unseen object.

AI.tldr: PG-Pose是一种面向无CAD模型、低纹理物体的6D位姿估计框架，结合基于平面的高斯泼溅重建与几何驱动的位姿优化，在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上达到94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d精度，较SOTA提升2.1%，并已在双臂工业机器人抓取任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 无CAD模型的低纹理物体6D位姿估计极具挑战性，因为缺乏外观特征。现有通用化方法对低纹理物体的性能常受底层表示中几何约束不足的限制。
AI.method: 提出PG-Pose框架，包含两个阶段：(1) 离线表示提取阶段，从已知位姿的多视角RGB图像中提取三种物体表示，利用基于平面的高斯泼溅(PGS)重建3D高斯表示并渲染高保真深度图，通过反投影生成3D点云；(2) 在线位姿推理阶段，通过输入图像与重建3D点云间的2D-3D对应匹配估计初始位姿，再通过PGS-Refiner进行迭代位姿优化。
AI.result: 在OnePose-LowTexture数据集上，PG-Pose平均精度达到94.2% ADD(S)@0.1d，相比SOTA基于GS的方法平均精度提升2.1%。在双臂工业机器人上部署后成功实现未知物体的抓取任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将平面的几何约束引入高斯泼溅重建及利用几何驱动的位姿优化，PG-Pose有效解决了低纹理物体缺乏外观特征导致的位姿估计难题，证明了其在工业机器人抓取等实际应用中的有效性。

title: Sharp Computational Bounds for Spectral Types of Schrödinger Operators
summary: We prove sharp bounds for determining the spectral-type decomposition of Schrödinger operators in the spirit of Smale's program on the foundations of computation. For explicit one-dimensional self-adjoint Schrödinger operators $H=-{\mathrm d^2}/{\mathrm dx^2}+V$ on $L^2(\mathbb R)$, where $V\in C^\infty(\mathbb R;\mathbb R)$ is given by a finite description of all derivatives and derivative bounds, the pure point and absolutely continuous spectral sets cannot, in general, be recovered by any single limiting procedure. The singular continuous spectral set is strictly harder: it cannot, in general, be recovered by two nested limiting procedures. Analytic constructions of dichotomies realize the lower bounds: Gordon-type repetitions for pure point spectrum, high barriers for absolutely continuous spectrum, and an inverse spectral construction for singular continuous spectrum based on Riesz products, moment-killing perturbations, and a computational Gelfand--Levitan scheme. The finite-description framework also implies corresponding limitations on what can be certified in fixed formal systems (e.g., when used in computer-assisted proofs). Conversely, using wavelet-based certified computation, we prove matching upper bounds for broad classes of self-adjoint differential operators on $\mathbb R^d$ with coefficients of locally bounded variation and quantitative local variation control: two limits suffice for the pure point and absolutely continuous parts, and three for the singular continuous part. This provides a sharp hierarchy for spectral types.

AI.tldr: 本文在Smale计算基础纲领的框架下，证明了确定Schrödinger算子谱型分解的尖锐界：对于显式一维自伴Schrödinger算子，纯点谱和绝对连续谱集一般无法通过任何单一极限过程恢复，奇异连续谱集更严格，无法通过两个嵌套极限过程恢复；反之，对于R^d上满足局部有界变差条件的一类自伴微分算子，两个极限足以恢复纯点谱和绝对连续谱，三个极限足以恢复奇异连续谱，从而建立了谱型的完整层次结构。
AI.motivation: 该研究致力于将Smale关于计算基础的程序精神扩展到谱理论中，即探究从有限的算子描述出发，能否以及需要多少计算资源（以极限过程的嵌套层次衡量）来确定Schrödinger算子的谱型分解（纯点、绝对连续、奇异连续部分）。这一问题具有基础性意义，因为它揭示了谱类型的计算复杂性与可判定性的内在界限，并直接影响计算机辅助证明的适用范围。
AI.method: 证明分为下界与上界两部分。下界通过解析构造二分法实现：利用Gordon型周期重复构造纯点谱的不可恢复性，利用高势垒构造绝对连续谱的不可恢复性，利用基于Riesz乘积、矩消除扰动和计算Gelfand–Levitan方案的逆谱构造实现奇异连续谱不可恢复性。上界则采用基于小波的认证计算方法，对R^d上系数具有局部有界变差和定量局部变差控制的自伴微分算子给出匹配的极限层次。
AI.result: 对于显式描述的一维Schrödinger算子，纯点谱与绝对连续谱集一般不能由任何单一极限过程恢复，奇异连续谱一般不能由两个嵌套极限过程恢复。对于R^d上更广泛的一类自伴微分算子（系数为局部有界变差且具定量变差控制），纯点谱和绝对连续谱恰需两个极限，奇异连续谱恰需三个极限，上下界匹配（sharp），构成完整的谱型尖锐层次。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了谱型分解的计算复杂性的尖锐层级：纯点/绝对连续谱比奇异连续谱"更容易"恢复（前者需要两层极限，后者需要三层）。这一结果不仅是计算复杂性理论意义上的界限，也通过有限描述框架暗示了在固定形式系统中（如用于计算机辅助证明时）相应谱性质不可认证的局限性，揭示了谱型识别固有的不可判定性层次。

title: On the cardinality of the exception set in Littlewood's discrete conjecture
summary:
Let $p$ be a prime, $d\ge 2$, $H\in [1,p)$, and $\ln\ln p = o(\ln H)$. We prove that $$
  \min_{1\le n \le H} n \left\|\frac{a_1 n}{p}\right\|\ldots \left\|\frac{a_d n}{p}\right\| \approx \frac{1}{(\ln p)^{d-1} \ln H} $$ for "almost all" $a \in ({\Bbb Z} / p{\Bbb Z})^d$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究素数p下，d维向量a在模p整数环中，对应于乘积型丢番图逼近的极小值问题。证明在几乎所有a∈(Z/pZ)^d的情形下，min_{1≤n≤H} n·∏‖a_i n/p‖的量级精确为1/((ln p)^{d-1}·ln H)，其中H满足ln ln p = o(ln H)。
AI.motivation: 这是对乘积型丢番图逼近（multiplicative Diophantine approximation）的有限域/算术模拟研究。经典的丢番图逼近研究单个线性形式；而乘积形式涉及多个线性形式的同时逼近，它与Littlewood猜想等相关问题密切相关。在有限域模p框架下研究此类问题，有助于理解其在算术结构中的深层行为，并揭示随机性与均匀分布的精细度量。
AI.method: 作者考虑p为素数，固定维数d≥2，H满足ln ln p = o(ln H)（即H接近p的“超多项式”尺度但仍小于p）。对a=(a_1,...,a_d)∈(Z/pZ)^d，定义乘积范数极小值min_{1≤n≤H} n·∏_{i=1}^d ‖a_i n/p‖，其中‖·‖表示到最近整数的距离。通过概率/计数方法（对“几乎所有”a成立），即证明该极小值的上界和下界均以概率1成立，从而得到精确量级1/((ln p)^{d-1}·ln H)。
AI.result: 证明了对几乎所有a∈(Z/pZ)^d（除测度趋于0的例外集合外），该乘积型极小值满足上界与下界的同时估计，其量级恰好为1/((ln p)^{d-1}·ln H)，给出了精确的渐近常数（≈意味着两边常数倍关系）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果建立了乘积丢番图逼近在模p算术框架下的精确极值行为，揭示了d维情形下极小值以(ln p)^{-(d-1)}衰减的规律，为理解该问题的整体分布结构提供了关键定量结论。

title: On the cost of reaching an attainable state for the boundary-controlled 1-D heat equation
summary: We consider the heat equation in an interval of the real line, with null initial condition, and Dirichlet boundary controls. We study the cost of reaching an attainable state at some time $T>0$. Precisely, given a state in the interval that we know is reachable by suitable boundary controls, we estimate the size of the smallest controls that reach it, in terms of an appropriate norm of this state. Our estimate is optimal in some sense as the time horizon goes to $0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究实数轴上区间内的热方程，具有零初始条件和Dirichlet边界控制。作者考察在固定时间T到达某个可达状态所需的控制代价，给出最小控制大小与目标状态范数之间的估计，并在时间趋于零时证明该估计在某种意义下是最优的。
AI.motivation: 在热方程的边界控制问题中，自然关心的问题是：给定一个可达的目标状态，找到达到它的最小控制需要多大？这关乎控制的"能控性代价"或"最小范数控制"问题，尤其是在短时间区间上的行为，这在实际应用和理论分析中都有重要意义。
AI.method: 论文采用解析方法处理一维区间上的热方程。通过Dirichlet边界控制从零初态出发，形式上系统地刻画可达状态的空间，并计算最小范数控制与相应状态范数之间的关系。估计的最优性通过时间趋于零的极限行为来验证（可能是通过某种缩放参数或谱分解的方法得到精确的渐近常数）。
AI.result: 得到了到达给定可达状态的最小控制大小关于该状态适当范数的显式估计，该估计在时间地平线趋于零时是（某种意义下）最优的，即无法改进。
AI.conclusion: 对于热方程短时间边界控制问题，控制代价的估计可以做到对数量级的精确刻画，在T→0时达到渐近最优。

title: Singularity-Free Guiding Vector Fields on SO(3) with Designer-Specified Progression Behavior
summary: This paper develops a singularity-free guiding vector field (SF-GVF) for path following on the special orthogonal group SO(3). First, we lift the Euclidean SF-GVF construction to SO(3), integrating the augmented-state approach with the intrinsic Lie-group geometry and obtaining a closed-form geometric guidance law whose integral curves converge to a designer-specified attitude path. The field is defined on a dense open subset of SO(3), excluding only the measure-zero antipodal set - a manifestation of the topological obstruction to continuous global stabilization on SO(3). The construction requires no per-step optimization and produces a control input intrinsically in so(3) as body angular rates. Second, we formalize the progression behavior along the path as a designer-supplied function ν(ξ), promoting the parametric speed from an implicitly resolved degree of freedom to a first-class design specification. In contrast to the Euclidean condition v = 0, which excludes vehicles with minimum-speed constraints, the corresponding condition ω= 0 on SO(3) is physically admissible for most platforms with active attitude control, making the progression behavior a design freedom structurally available on SO(3) but absent in the Euclidean setting. The framework's structural results are established under a bi-invariant Riemannian metric and hold uniformly across choices of path, progression, and Lyapunov gain. The framework is illustrated in simulation on self-intersecting paths under both constant and point-convergence progression behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文在特殊正交群SO(3)上提出了一种无奇异的导向向量场(SF-GVF)用于姿态路径跟随，将欧几里得空间的增强状态构造方法推广到李群几何上，获得了闭环形式的几何制导律，并形式化了沿路径的推进行为为设计者指定的函数。
AI.motivation: 现有路径跟随方法在SO(3)上受拓扑障碍限制，难以实现连续全局镇定；同时欧几里得空间中v=0的条件排除了存在最小速度约束的平台，而SO(3)上的对应条件ω=0对多数具备主动姿态控制的平台是物理上可接受的，因此推进行为在SO(3)上可以成为设计自由度。作者希望将欧几里得空间的SF-GVF构造推广至SO(3)，并形式化推进行为。
AI.method: (1) 将欧几里得SF-GVF的增强状态方法与SO(3)的内在李群几何相结合，通过提升构造获得闭环形式的几何制导律，生成so(3)中的体角速度控制输入；(2) 该向量场定义在SO(3)的稠密开子集上，仅排除测度为零的对径集（体现连续全局镇定的拓扑障碍）；(3) 构建无需逐步优化的显式构造；(4) 将推进行为形式化为设计者指定的函数ν(ξ)，使其从隐式自由度提升为一等设计规范；(5) 在双不变黎曼度量下建立结构性质，保证对路径、推进和Lyapunov增益选择的统一有效性。
AI.result: 该框架在双不变黎曼度量下建立了结构性的稳定性与收敛结果，证明积分曲线收敛至设计者指定的姿态路径。通过自相交路径的仿真，分别在恒定推进和点收敛推进两种行为下进行了验证，展示了方法的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将SF-GVF推广至SO(3)并形式化推进行为为设计自由度，且该自由度在欧几里得空间中不存在；其无奇异构造克服了拓扑障碍的限制（仅排除测度零的对径集），为姿态路径跟随提供了理论上完备且计算高效的解决方案。

title: Quadratic Point Estimate Method for Uncertainty Quantification with Dependent Non-Gaussian Inputs
summary: As an extension of the Point Estimate Method (PEM) to evaluate probabilistic moments of quantities of interest (QoI) in general $n$-dimensional spaces, the Quadratic Point Estimate Method (QPEM) has been recently developed. This new method is defined to fully represent up to fifth-order input moments in the Gaussian space, providing general analytical expressions for sample locations and weights, without requiring any numerical optimization. The QPEM can significantly improve the estimation accuracy of the output QoI moments, in relation to PEM-based methods whose numbers of sigma points grow linearly with the problem dimension, while at the same time having an affordable and competitive computational cost up to a considerable number of dimensions. The QPEM is further enhanced in this work by enabling copula integration into the framework, which enables effective modeling of the joint input probability density function by estimating marginals and the dependence structure of the involved random variables. The validity and efficient performance of the copula-based QPEM are showcased against numerous other sampling methods in various examples considering two practical scenarios: (i) when the joint dependence structure can be inferred from data, and (ii) when only marginal distributions and correlation matrices are known.

AI.tldr: 本文在二次点估计法(QPEM)框架中引入copula理论，使其能够有效建模联合输入概率密度函数，通过估计边际分布和随机变量间的依赖结构，提升了高维空间中数量兴趣(QoI)概率矩的估计精度，并在两种实际场景下通过多个示例验证了其有效性和高效性。
AI.motivation: 传统点估计法(PEM)在高维空间中估计概率矩时精度有限，其sigma点数量随维度线性增长。新提出的QPEM能够完全表征高斯空间中高达五阶的输入矩，且无需数值优化，但仍缺乏对输入变量间复杂依赖结构的建模能力，因此需要引入copula来增强对联合概率密度函数的建模。
AI.method: 本文将copula集成到QPEM框架中：(1) QPEM作为PEM的扩展，提供样本位置和权重的通用解析表达式，充分表征高斯空间中直至五阶的输入矩；(2) 通过copula理论建模联合输入PDF，分别估计边际分布和依赖结构；(3) 在两种场景下验证：场景一为可从数据推断联合依赖结构，场景二为仅已知边际分布和相关矩阵。
AI.result: 通过多个示例与多种采样方法对比，copula-based QPEM在两种实际应用场景下均展示了良好的有效性，相比线性增长的PEM方法显著提高了输出QoI矩的估计精度，同时在相当大的维度范围内保持具有竞争力的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于copula的QPEM方法能够在无需数值优化和大量计算开销的前提下，有效处理输入变量间的复杂依赖结构，为高维不确定性量化中概率矩的精确估计提供了一种高效且通用的方法。

title: Generalizing a Pair of Diophantine Equations
summary: For coprime integers $a$ and $b$, it is known that exactly one of the two Diophantine equations $$ ax+by\ =\ \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{2} \qquad\text{and}\qquad 1+ax+by\ =\ \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{2} $$ admits a nonnegative integer solution, and that this solution is unique. We first generalize this result by replacing the right-hand side with an arbitrary integer $m$ and its complement $ab-a-b-m$. This framework enables us to study the existence and uniqueness of nonnegative integer solutions to $$ ax+by\ =\ \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{k} \qquad\text{and}\qquad 1+ax+by\ =\ \frac{(a-1)(b-1)}{k}, $$ where $k$ is a fixed positive integer. We then obtain explicit results when $a$ and $b$ are consecutive Fibonacci numbers. Finally, we examine the original pair of equations in several particular settings, including when $b\equiv \pm1\mod a$, when $b$ is replaced by a higher power, and when the parameters are squared.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两类二元线性丢番图方程的非负整数解的存在性与唯一性。首先将已知的关于 (a-1)(b-1)/2 的结果推广到任意整数 m 及其补数 ab-a-b-m，进而对形如 (a-1)(b-1)/k 的右边部分（k 为固定正整数）进行研究，并获得了 a、b 为连续斐波那契数时的显式结果，最后在多种特殊参数设置下考察了原始方程对。
AI.motivation: 已知对互素整数 a、b，方程 ax+by=(a-1)(b-1)/2 与其带 +1 变体中恰好一个有非负整数解且唯一。作者旨在推广这一经典结果到更一般的右边常数 m 及其补数情形，并系统研究当右边为 (a-1)(b-1)/k（k 为固定正整数）时解的存在性与唯一性，从而深化对这类丢番图方程结构的理解。
AI.method: 论文采用统一的框架，将原始结果中的右侧 (a-1)(b-1)/2 替换为任意整数 m，并同时考察其互补形式 ab-a-b-m。在此框架基础上，将右边进一步替换为 (a-1)(b-1)/k，其中 k 为固定正整数，研究解的存在性与唯一性。对于连续斐波那契数的特殊情况，推导出显式解。最后分别探讨 b≡±1 (mod a)、b 为更高次幂以及参数平方等特定情形下原始方程对的行为。
AI.result: 成功将已知的恰好一个方程有唯一非负整数解的结论推广至任意整数 m 与其补数框架下；对固定正整数 k 的情形建立了类似的存在性与唯一性结论并给出显式结果（当 a、b 为连续斐波那契数时）；在三个特定设置中分别获得了原始方程对的解析结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入 m 及其补数 ab-a-b-m 的推广框架，本文不仅统一了原定理，还将其扩展到除以固定正整数 k 的情形，并在斐波那契数等多类特殊参数配置下获得了显式结论，为该类丢番图方程的研究提供了系统性方法。

title: Equilibria for Time-inconsistent Regular-singular Control Problems
summary: This paper studies a time-inconsistent mixed regular-singular control problem in continuous time with non-exponential discount. We seek time-consistent equilibria in an intrapersonal game framework and propose a novel definition of regular-singular equilibrium where both regular and singular controls are unified via control laws. We establish a verification theorem to provide a sufficient condition of the equilibrium. Furthermore, we propose a novel concept of mild equilibrium for which perturbations are applied separately to the regular and singular control and give the mild verification theorem. We illustrate the applicability of the theory to the effort and dividend problem and obtain an explicit equilibrium depending on the effort and dividend thresholds under a mixture of exponential discount functions and a pseudo-exponential discount function by solving the extended Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) system. The convexity of the value function is rigorously established, and the equilibrium conditions are verified. In addition, we establish the existence of the effort and dividend thresholds under a mixture of exponential discount functions. Numerical results reveal the impacts of exogenous parameters on the effort and dividend thresholds and the equilibrium value function, along with their economic implications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续时间下带非指数贴现的时间不一致混合正则-奇异控制问题。作者在人际博弈框架下提出新定义的正则-奇异均衡（通过控制律统一两类控制）以及温和均衡（分别对正则和奇异控制施加扰动）概念，建立两个对应的验证定理。将该理论应用于努力与分红问题，通过求解扩展HJB系统获得显式均衡（依赖努力阈值与分红阈值），并严格证明值函数凸性及均衡条件的验证。在混合指数贴现下建立了阈值存在性，数值结果揭示了外生参数对阈值和均衡值函数的影响及其经济含义。
AI.motivation: 现实中的决策问题（如努力与分红问题）常涉及时间不一致偏好（非指数贴现），且同时包含正则控制（连续调整）和奇异控制（脉冲式调整）。现有的时间一致均衡理论通常仅针对单一类型控制或离散时间设置，缺乏对混合正则-奇异控制统一处理的时间一致均衡框架。
AI.method: 在人际博弈（intrapersonal game）框架下：1) 提出将正则与奇异控制通过控制律统一的正则-奇异均衡新定义；2) 建立验证定理给出均衡的充分条件；3) 提出温和均衡（mild equilibrium）概念，对两类控制分别施加扰动，并给出温和验证定理；4) 通过求解扩展Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）系统，在混合指数贴现及伪指数贴现下求解努力与分红问题，得到基于努力阈值和分红阈值的显式均衡，并严格证明确立值函数凸性。
AI.result: 在混合指数贴现与伪指数贴现下，获得了努力与分红问题的显式时间一致均衡，均衡由努力控制阈值和分红阈值刻画；严格证明了值函数的凸性及均衡条件的验证；在混合指数贴现下建立了努力与分红阈值的存在性；数值实验揭示了外生参数（如贴现参数等）对努力阈值、分红阈值和均衡值函数的影响及其经济含义。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的时间不一致混合正则-奇异控制均衡理论为含脉冲与连续控制交互的博弈型决策问题提供了统一的解决框架。通过努力与分红问题的显式求解和数值分析，展示了该理论框架的有效性和可操作性，为相关经济模型中时间不一致行为（如有限理性下的盈余管理和分红政策）的分析提供了理论工具。

title: LightSplat: Real-Time High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian SLAM with Loop Closure
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently demonstrated promising reconstruction accuracy for dense 3D scene representations. However, current 3DGS systems struggle to meet the strict demands of real-world deployments due to severe limitations in operational performance and map adaptability. To this end, we propose LightSplat, a hybrid-representation RGB-D SLAM framework. It synergizes local sparse features for robust and fast tracking with a dual-thread backend that progressively constructs dense Gaussian submaps. Crucially, we enable online loop closure through feature-accelerated 3DGS registration, refining overall map consistency through pose graph optimization. Ultimately, LightSplat achieves the online reconstruction of high-fidelity Gaussian map. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and real-world robotic platform demonstrate that our method achieves near state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and the capability to accommodate practical camera motions, maintaining an average framerate of 8 FPS. Overall, LightSplat provides an efficient and robust foundation for deploying high-fidelity 3DGS in real-world environments.

AI.tldr: LightSplat是一个混合表示RGB-D SLAM框架，结合局部稀疏特征用于快速稳健的追踪，以及双线程后端逐步构建密集高斯子地图，通过特征加速的3DGS配准实现在线回环检测与位姿图优化，在多种数据集和真实机器人平台上实现接近最先进的建图质量并保持约8 FPS的平均帧率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)的SLAM系统虽然在密集3D场景重建方面展现出良好的精度，但在真实世界部署中严重受限于运行性能和地图适应性，无法满足实际应用的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出混合表示SLAM框架：1) 局部稀疏特征用于稳健且快速的追踪；2) 双线程后端逐步构建密集高斯子地图；3) 通过特征加速的3DGS配准实现在线回环闭合；4) 通过位姿图优化精化整体地图一致性，最终实现高质量高斯地图的在线重建。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明：该方法实现了接近最先进的(SOTA)重建质量，能够适应实际的相机运动模式，同时维持平均8 FPS的运行帧率。
AI.conclusion: LightSplat为在真实环境中部署高保真3DGS提供了高效且稳健的基础框架，有效弥合了3DGS SLAM从研究到实际部署之间的差距。

title: The modulo 9 Kanade--Russell identities and their Nahm-sum duals
summary: Kanade and Russell initiated a family of conjectural Rogers--Ramanujan type identities of moduli $9$ and $12$, which ultimately comprised five modulo $9$ identities and eleven modulo $12$ identities. The eleven modulo $12$ conjectures were subsequently settled through the work of Bringmann, Jennings-Shaffer, and Mahlburg and of Rosengren. In this paper, we prove all five modulo $9$ Kanade--Russell sum-product identities, four individual generalized Nahm-sum dual identities, and a product formula for the natural dual companion of the fifth Kanade--Russell identity, which is expressed as a linear combination of two negative-mixed-term generalized Nahm sums. The first three individual dual identities settle Conjecture~3.6 of Wang and Wang, while the fourth proves the corresponding conjecture of Li and Wang. Our results also connect directly with the recent Dynkin-diagram framework of Sun and Wang for generalized Nahm sums. They identified the rank-two pairs $(T_1,G_2)$ and $(G_2,T_1)$ as unresolved cases whose modularity would follow, respectively, from the first modulo $9$ Kanade--Russell identity and its Wang-Wang dual. The present results prove precisely these two required identities and hence establish the corresponding modularity statements unconditionally.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Kanade–Russell关于模数9的全部五条sum-product恒等式，以及四条广义Nahm-sum对偶恒等式，并给出了第五条恒等式自然对偶伴侣的乘积公式，从而解决了Wang–Wang猜想3.6和Li–Wang猜想。
AI.motivation: Kanade和Russell提出了关于模数9和12的两族Rogers–Ramanujan型猜想。模数12的十一条猜想已由他人解决，但模数9的五条猜想及相关的Nahm-sum对偶恒等式仍未解决，且这些结果与Sun–Wang的Dynkin图框架中的模性声明直接相关。
AI.method: 作者利用广义Nahm和的技术，证明模数9的全部五条Kanade–Russell sum-product恒等式，并推导出四条单独的对偶恒等式及第五条恒等式的乘积公式（该乘积通过两个负混合项广义Nahm和的线性组合表达）。
AI.result: 三条独立的对偶恒等式解决了Wang–Wang的猜想3.6，第四条证明了Li–Wang的猜想。同时，这些结果精确地证明了Sun–Wang框架中(T1,G2)和(G2,T1)两个秩二情形所需的恒等式，从而无条件确立了相应的模性命题。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整解决了Kanade–Russell模数9的全部猜想及其对偶猜想，并直接建立了与Sun–Wang Dynkin图框架中模性结果之间的桥梁，为该领域的进一步研究提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Distributed Linear Programming on GPU Clusters at Extreme Scale
summary: Large linear programs can exceed the memory of a single compute node. Although first-order methods replace sparse factorizations with GPU-suited matrix-vector products, other solver phases can reintroduce a single-node memory limit. We present SHARDLP, a distributed GPU LP solver that keeps the matrix and primal-dual state partitioned from sharded input through solution output. On the Google PDLP benchmark, SHARDLP reaches the published criterion on nine of eleven instances, compared with eight in the published CPU PDLP study. On the largest benchmark, eight H200 GPUs solve a 1.185-billion-variable, 6.338-billion-nonzero LP in 9.9 minutes; the published CPU experiment reports 21.06 hours on different hardware. Beyond this benchmark, separately checked multi-node solves reach up to 13.604 billion variables and 40.807 billion nonzeros, while validated executions span up to 76 GPUs across 29 compute nodes. For column-partitioned solves, support-aware communication skips GPUs that store no coefficients for a row; on an LP with 2.76 billion nonzeros, it cuts modelled communication by 92.97% and improves solver time by 1.27x-1.52x

AI.tldr: SHARDLP是第一个端到端分片（sharded）的分布式GPU线性规划求解器，从输入存储到输出全过程保持矩阵和原始-对偶状态的分区，无需单节点内存限制。在Google PDLP基准上达到11个实例中9个的发表标准（优于CPU版PDLP的8个）；在最大基准上8块H200 GPU仅用9.9分钟求解含11.85亿变量、63.38亿非零元的LP，而发表的CPU实验需要21.06小时。验证的最大规模可达136.04亿变量、408.07亿非零元，跨29个节点的76块GPU。
AI.motivation: 大规模LP可能超出单节点内存容量。虽然一阶方法用GPU适用的矩阵-向量乘替换了稀疏分解，但求解器的其他阶段（如矩阵加载、状态维护、输出等）仍会重新引入单节点内存瓶颈。现有方案无法在整个求解生命周期中保持数据分布，限制了对超大规模LP的可扩展求解能力。
AI.method: SHARDLP是一个分布式GPU LP求解器，采用全生命周期分片策略：从分片输入、矩阵存储、原始-对偶状态维护到解输出均保持分区。针对按列（column-partitioned）分片的求解，设计了"支持感知通信"（support-aware communication）机制，在行通信时跳过存储该行无系数（零贡献）的GPU节点，从而显著减少通信开销。系统采用一阶方法（基于PDLP算法体系），以GPU矩阵-向量积为核心运算并维持分布式状态。
AI.result: 在Google PDLP基准上达到9/11实例的发表收敛判据（对比CPU PDLP的8/11）。最大基准测试中8块H200 GPU用9.9分钟求解11.85亿变量、63.38亿非零元的LP，而发表论文中的CPU实验需要21.06小时（不同硬件）。独立验证的多节点求解可扩展到136.04亿变量和408.07亿非零元；经验证的运行最多跨29个节点的76块GPU。支持感知通信在27.6亿非零元的LP上减少建模通信量92.97%，求解时间提升1.27x-1.52x。
AI.conclusion: SHARDLP证明通过全生命周期分片设计，可以彻底消除单节点内存限制，使GPU一阶LP求解器扩展到远超单节点容量和单节点GPU数量的规模。其支持感知通信针对稀疏行分布特性进一步优化了分布式效率，在庞大规模LP（数十亿变量/数百亿非零元）上仍然保持实际可用性（分钟级到小时级），为大规模LP求解的可扩展性设定了新基准。

title: How Long Until Your Robot Ignores You? A Safety Benchmark for LLM Orchestrators in Human-Humanoid Collaboration
