The source code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/UNITES-Lab/AID-SR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AID-SR多层级框架，通过将模拟器观测的物理状态转化为结构化反馈，与语义批评、人类反馈和迭代优化结合，形成闭环，使得大语言模型（LLM）能够设计具有物理可行性和功能意义的连续体机器人。在14个任务的基准测试中，模拟可行性检查通过率达96.2%，约26.7%的机器人能成功完成任务，且三个设计出的机器人在真实环境中成功完成对应任务。
AI.motivation: LLM虽可从高层规格自动设计机器人，但在复杂物理交互下效果不佳，原因在于语言推理与实体物理后果之间存在鸿沟，导致设计缺乏物理有效性。现有方法未能弥合这一差距，亟需一个能将物理反馈引入LLM设计循环的机制。
AI.method: 提出AID-SR多层级框架：建立闭环系统，将模拟器中观测到的物理状态翻译为结构化的、可供LLM设计师理解的语言反馈；同时结合语义批评（semantic critique）、人类反馈（human feedback）以及迭代优化（iterative refinement），在多个层级上协同引导生成物理上可行且功能上有意义的机器人设计。
AI.result: 在包含伸展（reaching）、抓取（grasping）、移动（locomotion）和操作（manipulation）四个类别的14个任务组成的腱驱连续体机器人基准测试中，AID-SR实现了96.2%的模拟可行性检查通过率；经通用强化学习训练后，26.7%的机器人能成功完成对应任务；此外，实际制造了三个由AID-SR设计的机器人，并在真实环境中成功完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的仿真与真实环境实验表明，AID-SR打破了利用LLM进行连续体机器人自动设计所面临的"墙壁"——即物理反馈缺失导致的设计有效性瓶颈，证明了将模拟器物理状态结构化反馈纳入LLM迭代设计闭环的可行性。

title: 3DWay: Generalizing Robot Manipulation via 3D Consistent Waypoints
summary: Intermediate representations are key to bridging the modality gap between generalizable manipulation policies and large-scale pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). Among these, trajectory-based representations compactly represent motion-relevant cues, yet most existing approaches predict trajectories in 2D image space, resulting in intrinsic 3D ambiguity. Moreover, using 2D trajectories with depth still leaves the free-space waypoints ambiguous, limiting reliable 3D reasoning. To address this, we propose predicting 3D consistent waypoints (3DWay) from multi-view images. By reformulating 3D waypoints prediction as generating multi-view consistent 2D waypoints followed by geometric triangulation, we enable explicit 3D motion specification while preserving the strong priors of pretrained VLMs. The predicted waypoints can guide existing VLA models for better generalization or be directly executed on simple tasks. Extensive experiments show that 3DWay substantially improves 3D spatial grounding and vision-language reasoning, demonstrating strong potential for generalizable robot manipulation. Codes will be released at https://github.com/ziqin-h/3DWay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3DWay方法，通过从多视角图像预测3D一致性的路径点（waypoints）来弥合通用操作策略与大规模预训练视觉语言模型之间的模态鸿沟。通过将3D路径点预测重构为多视角一致的2D路径点生成加几何三角化，既保留了预训练VLM的强先验，又实现了显式的3D运动规范。
AI.motivation: 现有基于轨迹的中间表示大多在2D图像空间预测轨迹，存在固有的3D歧义；即使结合深度，自由空间路径点仍具歧义，限制了可靠的3D推理。因此需要一种能提供显式3D运动规范且不损失VLM先验的中间表示。
AI.method: 提出3DWay方法：从多视角图像出发，将3D路径点预测问题重构为两步——先预测多视角一致的2D路径点，再通过几何三角化恢复3D一致性路径点。该3D路径点可指导现有VLA模型提升泛化能力，也可直接用于简单任务的执行。
AI.result: 大量实验表明3DWay显著提升了3D空间接地（3D spatial grounding）和视觉语言推理能力，显示出在通用机器人操作中的强大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 3DWay通过多视角一致2D路径点加几何三角化的方式实现了可靠、显式的3D运动表示，验证了其在提升VLA模型泛化与机器人操作方面的有效性，并已开源代码。

title: CALIPER: Clean Scenes Cannot Rank Physical Inference in Pretrained Visual Representations
summary: How far a pushed object slides depends on its mass and friction, which no single image reveals. Pretrained visual encoders are increasingly used as the perception front end of world models for manipulation, and their physical competence is assessed with perturbation benchmarks and linear probes, almost always in a clean, fixed-camera scene. We show that these assessments cannot distinguish an encoder that infers physics from one that does not. CALIPER (calibrate, then predict) is a direct test: an object of unknown mass and friction is struck twice at known speeds, a third strike is shown only up to the moment of contact, and a linear readout on frozen features must predict how far the object slides. Swapping in another object's calibration clips checks that the evidence is actually used. Across 2,000 simulated episodes and eight representations, from V-JEPA 2 to a randomly initialised ViT and raw pixels, calibration adds +0.50 R^2 and the swap removes it. Yet in the clean scene every representation lands within 0.02 R^2 of the ceiling set by true simulator state, because a fixed camera exposes the object's displacement directly in pixel coordinates. Resampling camera, lighting, and clutter for every clip spreads the same representations across 0.50 R^2; when the readout chooses a push speed for a goal distance, V-JEPA 2 misses by 4 mm and the random ViT by 20 mm, no better than ignoring the object. Linear probes track none of this: a change in frame aggregation moves a probe more than pretraining does, and erasing the probed mass direction from the same representation costs nothing in one scene and 0.35 R^2 in the other. Whether a benchmark can rank models is an empirical property, and we give three checks that establish it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CALIPER基准测试,用于评估预训练视觉编码器是否真正从图像中推断物理属性(质量与摩擦系数)。通过两次已知速度击打物体进行校准,再预测第三次击打的滑动距离。结果表明,在固定相机干净场景下所有表示均接近上限,无法区分编码器优劣;而当相机、光照与杂乱环境逐帧重采样时,不同表示的性能差异被放大,V-JEPA 2与随机ViT之间存在显著差距。作者还提供三项检查验证基准能否有效对模型排序。
AI.motivation: 现有对预训练视觉编码器物理能力的评估(扰动基准、线性探针)几乎总是在固定相机的干净场景中进行,作者证明这些评估无法区分真正推断物理的编码器与并未推断物理的编码器,因此需要一种直接且可靠的测试方法。
AI.method: CALIPER方法:对质量与摩擦力未知的物体以已知速度进行两次击打(校准),展示第三次击打直至接触瞬间,用冻结特征的线性读出预测物体滑动距离。通过交换另一物体的校准片段来检验证据是否真正被使用。在约2000个模拟场景和八种表示(从V-JEPA 2到随机初始化的ViT及原始像素)上进行评估,并重采样相机、光照和杂乱环境。
AI.result: 校准将R²提升+0.50,交换另一物体校准后该增益消失。在清洁固定相机场景中,所有表示均落在真实模拟器状态上限0.02 R²内;而重采样场景下表示间R²差异达0.50。目标距离下选择推力速度时,V-JEPA 2误差4mm,随机ViT误差20mm(与忽略物体的基线相当)。线性探针无法反映这些差异:帧聚合方式的改变比预训练影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 基准能否对模型排序是一个经验性质的问题。固定相机场景因像素坐标直接暴露物体位移而无法区分编码器能力;CALIPER在场景重采样条件下能有效区分各表示。作者提供三项检查来确立基准的有效排序能力。

title: Seeing is Not Believing: Breaking the Physical-to-Digital Trust Boundary in Robotics
summary: In multi-robot collaboration, task handovers rely on downstream verifiers performing remote attestation, which inspects sensor telemetry to ensure a robot's physical behavior strictly matches its assigned task. But can this telemetry be trusted? We show that it often cannot. In this paper, we uncover a severe vulnerability in Robot Operating System (ROS) 2: by modifying a single environment variable, an adversary can execute a pre-built hook to covertly intercept and inject both telemetry and control signals before they are published. Consequently, adversaries can hijack a robot to perform dangerous tasks while spoofing downstream verifiers with synthesized fake telemetry. Worse still, by exploiting the widespread reliance on third-party Docker containers and auxiliary tools, attackers can distribute compromised packages embedded with these malicious hooks to launch such attacks easily. On a physical Franka Emika robotic arm running Secure ROS 2, our attack injects fabricated telemetry in real time with only around 3 ms of jitter, preserving temporal synchronization and hardware integrity while achieving an 87% success rate even against an AI-based detector. We have responsibly disclosed these findings to the ROS 2 development team. We prepared a demo video available at https://youtu.be/ExeiGqUrnhQ.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了ROS 2中的一个严重漏洞：攻击者通过修改单个环境变量即可执行预构建的hook，在遥测和控制信号发布前进行隐蔽拦截与注入。该漏洞使攻击者能够劫持机器人执行危险任务，同时通过伪造遥测数据欺骗下游验证器。在物理Franka Emika机械臂上的实验表明，攻击仅需约3ms的抖动即可实时注入伪造遥测数据，对AI检测器的成功率高达87%。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作中的任务交接依赖下游验证器进行远程证明，通过检查传感器遥测数据确保机器人行为与分配任务一致。作者指出这些遥测数据本身可能不可信，需要揭示这一安全假设的根本性缺陷。
AI.method: 作者发现ROS 2中的环境变量漏洞：修改单个环境变量即可触发预构建的恶意hook，在遥测与控制信号发布前进行拦截和注入。利用对第三方Docker容器和辅助工具的依赖，攻击者可以分发含有恶意hook的受损软件包来实施攻击。
AI.result: 在运行Secure ROS 2的物理Franka Emika机械臂上，攻击实现了约3ms抖动的实时伪造遥测注入，保持了时间同步和硬件完整性，并针对AI检测器达到87%的成功率。研究已向ROS 2开发团队负责任地披露。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了即使下游验证器执行了远程证明，机器人的遥测数据仍可能被有效篡改，这对依赖遥测可信性的多机器人任务协作系统构成严重的安全威胁，亟需更底层的信任根解决方案。

title: EvoNav-Bench: Benchmarking Lifelong Navigation in Evolving Environments
summary: Lifelong navigation (LN) requires an embodied agent to solve a sequence of navigation subtasks in the same environment. Since solving each subtask from scratch incurs redundant exploration, an LN agent must consolidate experience from earlier stages and reuse it in later stages, often through persistent scene representations such as scene graphs or visual snapshots. However, existing approaches typically assume a stationary environment, whereas in real-world LN settings, human activities can cause the environment to evolve. With the stationary assumption violated, existing methods may fuse outdated prior observations with new observations, yet current benchmarks cannot reveal this failure mode. In this paper, we present EvoNav-Bench, which extends the GOAT-Bench style LN formulation in the context of evolving environments. Built on the ProcTHOR framework, EvoNav-Bench introduces environment modifications between navigation tasks, making prior experience useful but not fully reliable. This design enables controlled evaluation of how environment evolution affects LN agents that reuse prior scene observations. Using EvoNav-Bench, we benchmark three recent methods that build and reuse scene representations for navigation. We also compare three simple heuristic strategies for handling environment evolution: Frontier-Update, Fail-then-Update, and Stage-Reset. Our results show that existing methods are brittle under environment evolution, while the heuristic strategies enable a controlled analysis of how agents can adapt to scene changes and mitigate their impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoNav-Bench基准，扩展了GOAT-Bench格式的终身导航（LN）任务到动态演化环境场景中。该基准基于ProcTHOR框架，在导航子任务之间引入环境修改，使先验经验仍然有用但不再完全可靠。通过对三种现有场景表示方法和三种启发式策略（Frontier-Update、Fail-then-Update、Stage-Reset）的基准测试，作者发现现有LN方法在环境演化下表现脆弱。
AI.motivation: 现有终身导航方法通常假设环境是静态的，但真实世界中人类活动会导致环境不断变化。这种静态假设使现有方法可能将过时的先验观测与新的观测融合，产生错误导航行为，而当前基准无法揭示这一失败模式。
AI.method: 论文提出了EvoNav-Bench基准：1）在GOAT-Bench任务格式基础上，引入任务之间的环境修改，使先验经验部分可用但不可完全依赖，从而可控地评估环境演化对场景表示复用型LN智能体的影响。2）基准测试三种现有的基于场景表示构建与复用的导航方法。3）对比三种处理环境演化的简单启发式策略：Frontier-Update（前沿更新）、Fail-then-Update（失败后更新）和Stage-Reset（阶段重置）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，现有专注于重用场景表示的LN方法在环境演化条件下表现出脆弱性（brittle），无法有效应对环境变化。相比之下，所提出的三种启发式策略提供了一种可控分析手段，揭示了智能体如何适应场景变化并减轻其负面影响。
AI.conclusion: EvoNav-Bench填补了LN领域在动态/演化环境评估方面的空白。研究结论表明，先前基于场景表示的持久记忆机制需要具备应对环境演化的能力，而启发式策略展示了在场景变化下适应与缓解影响的探索方向，为未来LN智能体在非静态环境中的鲁棒性研究提供了基准与基础。

title: A Multi-Modal Perception Pipeline for Object Detection and Tracking in Autonomous Racing
summary: Object detection and tracking are fundamental components of perception systems for autonomous driving. Achieving robust performance under adverse conditions such as limited visibility, sensor noise, and failures remains an open challenge, particularly in autonomous racing, where vehicles operate at very high speeds, experience strong vibrations, and interact under small safety margins. This paper presents a multi-modal late-fusion perception pipeline for object detection and tracking in the autonomous racing domain. The proposed system extends previous work by exploiting all onboard sensors through a late-fusion approach and a dedicated multi-object tracking framework. Independent detections from cameras, LiDARs, and RADARs are combined to provide timely and robust state estimates of surrounding vehicles. The tracking method explicitly compensates for detection delays and embeds in its model prior knowledge of vehicle dynamics and track layout. Experimental evaluation on real-world data across diverse critical scenarios, representative of challenging edge cases also in urban driving, confirms the effectiveness of the proposed pipeline and its suitability to support safe and adaptive planning decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于自动驾驶赛车领域的多模态晚期融合感知管线，综合利用摄像头、LiDAR和RADAR的独立检测结果，通过专用的多目标跟踪框架提供鲁棒的车辆状态估计，并在真实世界多种关键场景中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知系统在恶劣条件（能见度有限、传感器噪声与故障）下性能鲁棒性不足仍是开放性挑战。尤其在自动驾驶赛车中，车辆高速行驶、振动强烈、安全裕量小，对感知的实时性和可靠性要求极高，亟需能够应对这些极端工况的感知方案。
AI.method: 提出多模态晚期融合感知管线：（1）利用车载全部传感器（摄像头、LiDAR、RADAR），通过晚期融合方式将各模态独立检测结果进行组合，获得及时且鲁棒的状态估计；（2）采用专用多目标跟踪框架，显式补偿检测延迟，并在模型中嵌入车辆动力学先验知识和赛道布局信息。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种关键场景的真实世界数据上进行实验评估，这些场景代表了对城市驾驶同样具有挑战性的边缘情况。实验结果证实了所提管线的有效性，并证明其能够支持安全且自适应的规划决策。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了晚期融合多模态感知结合专用多目标跟踪框架在自动驾驶赛车领域的有效性，不仅适用于赛车场景，其对不利条件鲁棒性的提升也为城市驾驶的极端边缘场景提供了可行的感知方案。

title: RoboCousin: Build Your Own Simulation Playground for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: Bimanual manipulation policies require large and diverse training datasets, yet collecting demonstrations on physical robots is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation can generate data efficiently, but existing pipelines typically operate within closed asset libraries and predefined scenes: adding a newly observed object or environment still requires substantial effort to reconstruct geometry, specify physical and semantic properties, annotate interactions, and integrate the result into executable tasks. We present RoboCousin, an extensible simulation-based data-generation platform that turns user-provided observations into reusable assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for bimanual manipulation. Built on RoboTwin~2.0, RoboCousin converts object images into simulation-ready assets with visual and collision geometry, semantic and physical metadata, and automatically generated grasp-contact candidates. It further constructs digital cousins that vary compatible objects, backgrounds, layouts, and language instructions while preserving task-relevant affordances and spatial relations. The same asset system supports tabletop and room-level scene construction, with collision-aware base control for interaction beyond a fixed workspace. We release RoboCousin-OBD, containing more than 3,000 annotated object instances and 50 background environments, and use RoboCousin to generate over one million expert trajectories across 50 tasks. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that the automatically generated interaction annotations are comparable to curated annotations, generated assets provide effective sim-to-real supervision, and tabletop cousins can improve transfer beyond training on a single reconstructed scene. RoboCousin therefore provides a practical path for expanding both the scale and coverage of synthetic bimanual manipulation data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboCousin，一个可扩展的仿真数据生成平台，能将用户提供的观测数据（如物体图像）自动转化为可复用的资产、场景和专家轨迹，用于双臂操作策略训练。平台基于RoboTwin 2.0构建，支持从图像生成带视觉/碰撞几何、语义/物理元数据和抓取接触候选的仿真资产，并通过"数字孪生cousins"增强场景多样性。作者发布了包含3000+标注物体实例和50个背景环境的RoboCousin-OBD数据集，并生成了覆盖50个任务的超过一百万条专家轨迹，仿真与真实机器人实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 双臂操作策略需要大规模多样化的训练数据，但物理机器人采集演示成本高昂且难以扩展。现有仿真管线局限于封闭资产库和预定义场景，遇到新观察到的物体或环境时，仍需大量人工工作来重建几何、标注物理语义属性、定义交互并集成到可执行任务中，缺乏自动化的数据生成途径。
AI.method: RoboCousin构建于RoboTwin 2.0之上，核心流程包括：(1) 将物体图像自动转换为仿真就绪资产，包含视觉与碰撞几何、语义和物理元数据，并自动生成抓取-接触候选；(2) 构建"数字cousins"——通过改变兼容物体、背景、布局和语言指令来扩展数据多样性，同时保持任务相关的可操作性和空间关系；(3) 统一的资产系统支持桌面级和房间级场景构建，配备碰撞感知的基座控制以支持超出固定工作空间的交互。
AI.result: 发布了RoboCousin-OBD数据集（3000多个标注物体实例、50个背景环境），利用RoboCousin生成了超过一百万条覆盖50个任务的专家轨迹。仿真和真实机器人实验表明：自动生成的交互标注与人工精心标注质量相当；生成的资产能提供有效的sim-to-real监督；桌面级cousins相比在单一重建场景上训练可提升迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: RoboCousin为扩展双臂操作合成数据的规模和覆盖面提供了一条实用的路径，通过自动化的从观测到资产/场景/轨迹的生成管线，显著降低了构建多样化仿真训练数据的门槛。

title: Localized Visual Feature Aggregation via Focus Pooling for Visuomotor Policies
summary: Focusing on spatially localized, control-relevant visual cues has been shown to improve data efficiency in visuomotor policies by reducing the need to model task-irrelevant visual variation. Existing methods often impose this focus through input preprocessing, such as cropping control- or object-centric regions in RGB images or point-clouds. However, it remains underexplored whether such localized features can be exposed directly from commonly used convolutional neural network (CNN) encoded features. In this paper, we show that intermediate CNN features preserve localized visual context for control, but existing pooling methods fail to aggregate it effectively. We introduce FocusPool, an attention pooling module that selectively aggregates intermediate visual features according to their relevance to the robot's current proprioceptive context. The resulting pooled representation captures task-progressive, control-relevant local information and is used directly for policy learning. Across simulation and real-world experiments, FocusPool improves policy success rates over pooling and explicit local focus methods by 36.2% and 41.2%, with training only 5.8% of encoder parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FocusPool，一种注意力池化模块，能够直接从CNN中间特征中提取空间局部化、控制相关的视觉线索用于策略学习，相比现有池化方法和显式局部聚焦方法分别提升成功率36.2%和41.2%，且仅需训练编码器5.8%的参数。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过输入预处理（裁剪RGB图像或点云的控制/物体中心区域）来实现空间局部化聚焦以提高数据效率，但尚未充分探索能否直接从常用的CNN编码特征中暴露局部控制相关特征。现有池化方法无法有效聚合CNN中间特征中保留下来的局部视觉上下文。
AI.method: 引入FocusPool——一种注意力池化模块，根据特征与机器人当前本体感知上下文的相关性，选择性聚合CNN中间视觉特征，生成具备任务渐进性、控制相关的局部信息的池化表示，直接用于策略学习。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，FocusPool相比池化方法提升36.2%成功率，相比显式局部聚焦方法提升41.2%成功率，且仅需训练编码器5.8%的参数。
AI.conclusion: CNN中间特征保留控制相关的局部视觉上下文，FocusPool通过本体感知引导的注意力池化可有效聚合这些特征，以极低的训练成本显著提升视觉运动策略的成功率，无需显式输入预处理即可实现高效局部聚焦。

title: Coverage Path Planning for Redundant Manipulators using Generalized Spanning Trees
summary: Surface coverage with task-redundant manipulators is challenging because each surface point may admit multiple inverse kinematics (IK) solutions, and configuration choices strongly affect motion quality. This paper extends the classical Spanning Tree Coverage (STC) method to redundant manipulators through offline and online Joint Spanning Tree Coverage (JSTC) algorithms. Offline JSTC samples multiple Inverse Kinematics (IK) solutions per grid cell and formulates the problem as a Generalized Minimum Spanning Tree (GMST), selecting one configuration per cell and tracing the resulting tree to obtain a non-revisiting coverage path. Online JSTC incrementally expands and backtracks a spanning tree with feasibility and cost evaluation while handling dynamic grid updates. Simulation results show that offline JSTC reduces computation time, reconfigurations, and joint motion compared to other methods, while online JSTC achieves fast per-step planning in dynamic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对冗余机械臂的表面覆盖规划问题，将经典生成树覆盖（STC）方法扩展为离线与在线联合生成树覆盖（JSTC）算法。离线JSTC对每个网格单元采样多个逆解，构建广义最小生成树问题选择最优构型；在线JSTC则通过增量扩展和回溯生成树实现动态场景下的快速规划。
AI.motivation: 任务冗余机械臂的表面覆盖具有挑战性，因为每个表面点可能存在多个逆运动学（IK）解，而构型选择会显著影响运动质量。现有方法难以在保证非重复覆盖的同时优化构型选择与运动效率。
AI.method: 离线JSTC：对每个网格单元采样多个IK解，将覆盖问题建模为广义最小生成树（GMST），为每格选择一个构型并追踪生成树以获得非重复覆盖路径。在线JSTC：通过增量扩展与回溯生成树，结合可行性和成本评估，并处理动态网格更新。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，离线JSTC相比其他方法减少了计算时间、重构次数和关节运动量；在线JSTC在动态场景中实现了快速的逐步骤规划。
AI.conclusion: 提出的JSTC算法为冗余机械臂的覆盖规划提供了有效的离线与在线解决方案，兼顾了路径质量与计算效率。

title: Safe Task Planning with Long-Term Graph Memory for Embodied Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly advanced zero-shot task planning for embodied agents. However, most LLM- and VLM-driven methods struggle to generate safe high-level actions due to a lack of physical risk awareness, particularly under partial observability, where hazards lie outside the immediate field of view. To address this challenge, we propose a novel safe task-planning framework, SafeMem, which constructs and maintains a long-term semantic graph memory of the open and dynamic environment. Based on egocentric observations, the proposed framework incrementally accumulates knowledge about surrounding objects and their relationships with a graph. Then, an LLM-based risk predictor evaluates candidate actions using the graph memory, triggering a conservatism-modulated replanning loop with explanations for detected hazards. Extensive experiments on the IS-Bench benchmark and a real-world robot platform demonstrate that the SafeMem framework substantially improves safe success rates compared to state-of-the-art VLM-driven task planners. Video results are available on our webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/safemem.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeMem框架，通过构建和维护长期语义图记忆来提高大语言模型/视觉语言模型驱动的具身智能体在部分可观测条件下的安全任务规划能力，在IS-Bench基准和真实机器人平台上显著提升了安全成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM/VLM驱动的零样本任务规划方法缺乏物理风险意识，尤其是在部分可观测环境下，危险往往位于当前视野之外，导致难以生成安全的高层动作。
AI.method: SafeMem框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于自我为中心的观测，以图结构增量累积环境中物体及其关系的长期语义图记忆；(2) 基于LLM的风险预测器利用图记忆评估候选动作，并在检测到危险时触发带有解释的、由保守度调节的重新规划循环。
AI.result: 在IS-Bench基准和真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明，SafeMem在安全成功率上显著优于最先进的VLM驱动的任务规划器。
AI.conclusion: 通过长期语义图记忆与基于LLM的风险预测及保守度可调的重新规划机制，SafeMem有效提升了具身智能体在开放动态、部分可观测环境中的安全任务规划能力。

title: Multi-bounce Drum Roll with Optimized Active Tricks to Leverage Soft Embodiment
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Published in the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM 2026)
summary: This paper presents a soft robotic drummer for accurate and efficient drum rolls. High-frequency drum rolls require the "multi-bounce technique," where a drumstick bounces multiple times with a single stroke. In robotic reproduction of this technique, the body's elasticity is key, while the fine motion during the stroke is also crucial for maximizing the potential of that elasticity. Therefore, we design two tricks: i) Tap-Pull (TP) trick to increase the number of rebounds by adding a pulling motion after impact; and ii) Micro-Pulse (MP) trick to keep the drumming volume by injecting small oscillations during the stroke. Due to the nonlinear complexity of soft embodiment, both tricks are efficiently tuned using Bayesian optimization in a data-driven manner for accomplishing the respective objectives quantified. We evaluated the optimized behaviors with soft and rigid end-effectors. As a result, the soft TP achieved the highest bounce count (12.25 per stroke) with uniform intervals. The soft MP suppressed the volume decay, yielding 6.8-times higher acoustic efficiency compared to the rigid MP. These results indicate that the proposed tricks with the combination of elasticity and optimization can make robots play excellent drum rolls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种软体机器人鼓手，通过Tap-Pull（拉拨）和Micro-Pulse（微脉冲）两种技巧并结合贝叶斯优化，实现了高精度、高效率的鼓滚奏（drum rolls）。软体TP技巧实现了每击12.25次回弹且间隔均匀，软体MP技巧将声学效率提升至刚性端的6.8倍。
AI.motivation: 高频鼓滚奏需要"多次弹跳技术"，即一次挥击使鼓棒多次回弹。机器人复现该技术时，身体弹性是关键，但击打过程中的精细运动同样重要，以最大化弹性潜能。现有方法缺乏对软体本体弹性与精细动作协同设计的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出两种运动技巧：1）Tap-Pull（TP）技巧——在撞击后增加回拉动作以提高回弹次数；2）Micro-Pulse（MP）技巧——在挥击过程中注入微小振荡以维持鼓击音量。由于软体本体的非线性复杂性，两种技巧均采用基于数据驱动的方式，通过贝叶斯优化高效调参以分别实现各自量化的目标。
AI.result: 在软体和刚性末端执行器上评估了优化行为。软体TP实现了最高的回弹次数（每次击打12.25次）且间隔均匀；软体MP抑制了音量衰减，相比刚性MP实现了6.8倍的声学效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的技巧结合弹性与优化的协同，能使机器人演奏出优秀的鼓滚奏效果，验证了软体本体设计配合数据驱动运动优化在该任务中的有效性。

title: AURORA: Active Uncertainty-Driven Re-Orientation for In-Hand Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Observing objects grasped by a robot hand is challenging due to severe visual occlusions. Although in-hand manipulation can expose hidden surfaces, existing approaches often rely on predefined or open-loop reorientation strategies that do not explicitly target under-observed regions. We propose AURORA, an active 3D reconstruction framework that closes the loop between online object-centric reconstruction and in-hand reorientation. At its core, Ray-GPIS estimates direction-wise reconstruction uncertainty along candidate viewing rays and selects next-best-view targets using an uncertainty--novelty objective, which are realized through an axis-conditioned in-hand rotation policy. The resulting RGB-D observations are fused incrementally using CAD-free 6D pose tracking and lightweight geometric reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that AURORA improves reconstruction quality and information-acquisition efficiency over non-active rotation strategies, while Ray-GPIS also outperforms active view-planning baselines in reconstruction performance, action-ranking quality, and planning efficiency. Targeted ablations further validate its robustness to hand occlusion and pose errors. The project webpage is available at https://aurorahand.github.io/

AI.tldr: AURORA是一个主动3D重建框架，通过Ray-GPIS估计方向性重建不确定性并选择最优视角，利用轴向条件在手旋转策略闭环循环，实现遮挡物体逐步重建，实验证明其重建质量与信息获取效率优于非主动旋转策略和视角规划基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人手抓取物体会导致严重的视觉遮挡，难以完整重建物体。现有在手操作重定向方法多采用预定义或开环策略，未显式针对欠观测区域进行优化，导致重建效率和质量受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出AURORA框架，在线物体中心重建与在手重定向之间形成闭环；2) 核心模块Ray-GPIS沿候选观测射线估计方向性重建不确定性；3) 采用不确定性-新颖性目标函数选择下一最优视角；4) 通过轴向条件在手旋转策略实现最优视角的物理执行；5) 使用无需CAD模型的6D位姿跟踪和轻量级几何重建融合RGB-D观测。
AI.result: 实验表明AURORA在重建质量和信息获取效率上优于非主动旋转策略；Ray-GPIS在重建性能、动作排序质量和规划效率上超越主动视角规划基线；消融实验验证了其在手遮挡和位姿误差下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将主动视角选择与在手重定向闭环结合，能有效解决抓取遮挡下的3D重建问题，Ray-GPIS为不确定性驱动的观测规划提供了高效可靠的方案。

title: PGMT: Perceptive General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid motion trackers can reproduce diverse whole-body motions, but their performance degrades on complex terrain where terrain-agnostic references become physically infeasible. We present PGMT, a Perceptive General Motion Tracking pipeline for humanoid robots that learns terrain adaptation from independently selected motion references and terrains. PGMT first learns a general tracking and recovery prior, then incorporates terrain perception through motion-conditioned terrain glimpses that selectively encode regions relevant to the current motion. Terrain-aware tracking relaxation allows necessary deviations from the reference while preserving its motion intent. Zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates robust terrain-adaptive locomotion and whole-body motion execution over real-world terrain with obstacles up to 37 cm high, while supporting teleoperation, dynamic motion tracking, and fall recovery. PGMT extends general humanoid motion tracking beyond flat ground, providing a unified policy for terrain-adaptive locomotion, diverse whole-body behaviors, and teleoperation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: PGMT是一个感知型通用运动跟踪管线，通过两个阶段（通用跟踪与恢复先验学习 + 地形感知适应）使类人形机器人在复杂地形上实现全身运动的一体化策略，支持遥操作、动态运动跟踪和跌倒恢复，零样本部署在Unitree G1上可跨越高达37cm的障碍。
AI.motivation: 现有类人形运动跟踪器在平坦地面上表现良好，但在复杂地形上性能退化，因为与地形无关的参考动作在物理上变得不可行。需要一种能将地形感知整合进运动跟踪的方法。
AI.method: PGMT分为两个阶段：(1) 学习通用跟踪与恢复先验；(2) 通过运动条件化地形快照（motion-conditioned terrain glimpses）整合地形感知，选择性编码与当前运动相关的区域。采用地形感知的跟踪松弛（terrain-aware tracking relaxation）机制，允许相对参考的必要的偏差同时保持运动意图。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1上零样本部署展示了鲁棒的地形自适应运动和全身运动执行，可跨越高达37cm的真实地形障碍，同时支持遥操作、动态运动跟踪和跌倒恢复。
AI.conclusion: PGMT将通用类人形运动跟踪从平坦地面扩展到复杂地形，提供了一个统一策略，涵盖地形自适应运动、多样化全身行为和复杂环境中的遥操作。

title: TASG-Explore: Traversability-Aware Sector-Guided Exploration for Ground Robot on Uneven Terrain
summary: Autonomous exploration on uneven terrain requires ground robots to balance exploration efficiency, coverage completeness, and terrain safety. Detailed tsrrain reasoning improves local reliability but can slow large-scale exploration, whereas coarse region guidance expands quickly in open areas but can miss narrow passages and irregular traversable boundaries. To address this challenge, this paper presents TASG-Explore, a traversability-aware sector-guided exploration framework for ground robots. The framework first performs hierarchical traversability analysis using variable-voxel ground fitting and adaptive 8-bit obstacle encoding. It then splitting cost map into sectors, incrementally updates sector clusters, extracts terrain-coupled frontier viewpoints, and maintains a dynamic topological roadmap with unknown topological hypotheses. Finally, a sector-guided planner selects region targets and inserts local viewpoints to generate efficient exploration routes. Benchmark experiments in diverse challenging environments, including caves, forests, and rugged hills, show that TASG-Explore achieves the best overall performance among six representative state-of-the-art planners. The proposed traversability analysis improves processing efficiency by 6.3 times while maintaining high accuracy, and the exploration planner improves exploration efficiency by 51% and increases coverage by up to 2.95 times in rugged hill scene. Large-scale real-world experiments further demonstrate the practical value of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出TASG-Explore框架，通过分层可通行性分析、扇区引导规划及拓扑路线图，在崎岖地形上平衡探索效率、覆盖完整性和地形安全。
AI.motivation: 崎岖地形上的自主探索面临挑战：精细地形推理虽可提高局部可靠性但会拖慢大规模探索速度；而粗糙的区域引导虽在开阔地带扩展快，却容易遗漏狭窄通道和不规则的可通行边界。现有方法难以兼顾探索效率、覆盖完整性和地形安全三者平衡。
AI.method: TASG-Explore框架包括：(1)分层可通行性分析——使用可变体素地面拟合和自适应8位障碍编码；(2)将代价地图按扇区划分，增量更新扇区簇，提取与地形耦合的边界视点，并维护带有未知拓扑假设的动态拓扑路线图；(3)扇区引导规划器选择区域目标并插入局部视点，生成高效探索路径。
AI.result: 在洞穴、森林和崎岖山地等多种挑战性环境的基准实验中，TASG-Explore在六种代表性SOTA规划器中取得最佳综合性能。可通行性分析处理效率提升6.3倍且保持高精度；探索规划器探索效率提升51%，在崎岖山地场景覆盖率最高提升2.95倍。大规模真实世界实验验证了实用性。
AI.conclusion: TASG-Explore通过扇区引导与分层地形感知相结合，有效解决了崎岖地形探索中效率与安全、粗粒度引导与细粒度推理之间的权衡问题，在地面机器人自主探索领域具有实际应用价值。

title: Estimating Semantic Ambiguity via Gaussian Context Distributions for VLM-Driven Traversability Analysis
summary: Autonomous navigation in unstructured environments requires robust scene understanding, yet Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often suffer from semantic ambiguity, where conflicting predictions can lead to dangerous failures. To address this, we present a novel pipeline for vision-based traversability estimation that explicitly models contextual uncertainty. Our approach utilizes Conceptual Anchoring to ground open-vocabulary VLM predictions onto a continuous physical traversability scale. By formulating the model's responses as a Gaussian Context Distribution (GCD), we derive both a dense traversability map and a dense uncertainty map based on the statistical properties of the distribution. Experimental validation on the real-world GOOSE dataset demonstrates that our proposed uncertainty metric effectively correlates with sources of ambiguity, such as visual artifacts and mixed terrain overlap. The method exhibits competitive performance while offering the distinct advantage of providing statistical uncertainty estimates to address semantic ambiguity, enabling safer and more reliable autonomous behavior in complex outdoor settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于视觉的自主导航可通行性估计管线，通过"概念锚定"将开放词汇VLM预测映射到连续物理可通行性尺度，并将模型响应建模为高斯上下文分布（GCD），同时生成稠密可通行性地图和稠密不确定性地图，以明确建模语义模糊性。在GOOSE真实数据集上验证了不确定性指标与实际模糊源的关联，实现了更安全的户外自主导航。
AI.motivation: 在非结构化环境中进行自主导航需要强健的场景理解，然而视觉-语言模型常常面临语义模糊性问题——相互矛盾的预测可能导致危险的导航失败。现有方法未显式建模这种上下文不确定性，因此需要一种能够量化语义模糊性并将其转化为可用导航信号的方案。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段管线：（1）概念锚定（Conceptual Anchoring），将开放词汇VLM的预测锚定到连续的物理可通行性尺度上，以消除语义术语与物理可行性之间的鸿沟；（2）将模型响应建模为高斯上下文分布（Gaussian Context Distribution, GCD），利用该分布的统计特性同时导出稠密可通行性地图和稠密不确定性地图。
AI.result: 在真实世界的GOOSE数据集上进行实验验证，结果表明所提出的不确定性度量能有效关联语义模糊性的来源（如视觉伪影和混合地形重叠），且方法整体性能具有竞争力，同时额外提供了统计不确定性估计的优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模语义模糊性并提供统计不确定性估计，该方法能够在复杂户外环境中实现更安全和更可靠的自主导航行为，较传统可通行性估计方法具有独特优势。

title: MFVINS: Multiple Fisheye Camera-Based Visual Inertial System
summary: A simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) method using a monocular camera and a low-cost inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor is an effective way to fulfill a low-cost sensor configuration. Using this sensor configuration, visual-inertial system (VINS) focuses on fusing data from a camera and an IMU sensor to estimate the six degrees-of-freedom (DOF) of the sensor pose. Typically, VINS uses only a single camera as visual input, which lead to problems such as error accumulation due to occlusion, various illumination, and textureless environments. In this paper, we propose a new multiple fisheye camera-based visual-inertial system called MFVINS. We present an IMU-aided FAST feature tracker for multiple cameras that enables efficient extraction and robust matching of local features. Then, the proposed method filters out outliers caused by fisheye distortion on the normalized image plane. Subsequently, a new reprojection error with physical validity constraints is proposed for bundle adjustment using learning-based depth estimation. The proposed method is applied to various scenarios, and its effectiveness is demonstrated by comparing previous VINS methods. In particular, MFVINS is implemented in real-time process to leverage the advantages of using multiple cameras -- robustness against occlusion and textureless regions -- while reducing the computational burden.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多鱼眼相机与低成本IMU融合的视觉惯性系统MFVINS，通过IMU辅助的FAST特征跟踪器、归一化图像平面上的畸变离群点过滤以及结合学习式深度估计和物理有效性约束的束调整方法，在实时处理中实现对遮挡和无纹理环境的鲁棒性，并降低计算负担。
AI.motivation: 传统的单目相机视觉惯性系统（VINS）仅使用单个相机作为视觉输入，在遮挡、光照变化和无纹理环境下容易出现误差累积问题。低成本传感器配置下，需要一种更鲁棒的SLAM方法来解决上述挑战。
AI.method: 提出多鱼眼相机视觉惯性系统MFVINS，包含三个核心模块：(1) IMU辅助的FAST特征跟踪器，用于多相机的高效特征提取与鲁棒匹配；(2) 在归一化图像平面上过滤由鱼眼畸变引起的离群点；(3) 提出带物理有效性约束的重投影误差用于基于学习深度估计的束调整（bundle adjustment）。系统在实时进程中实现。
AI.result: 将MFVINS应用于多种场景，并与先前的VINS方法进行比较，实验验证了其有效性。特别地，MFVINS实现了实时处理，利用多相机在遮挡和无纹理环境下的鲁棒性优势，同时降低了计算负担。
AI.conclusion: 多鱼眼相机配置加上IMU辅助的特征跟踪和学习式深度估计，能够有效克服传统单目VINS在复杂环境下的局限性，在保持实时性能的同时提升鲁棒性和精度。

title: CASD: Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation for Multi-StageRobot Manipulation
summary: An action chunk can span several stages of a manipulation task, yet a label for its first step describes only the current stage. We introduce Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation (CASD), which derives semantic targets for entire action chunks. An offline vision--language model segments demonstrations into described stages. Their occupancy within each action chunk determines a weighted semantic target, including transitions between stages. A CASD generator learns to predict this target from the current observation, robot state, and task instruction. We then freeze the generator and train a policy conditioned on its predictions. The semantic branch runs once per policy query, without online VLM calls or reasoning-trace decoding. Teacher matching on annotated LIBERO training episodes is above chance for both single-stage and boundary-crossing chunks. We evaluate three Fast-WAM variants and a DreamZero integration across four benchmarks, including distribution shifts on LIBERO-Plus. Compared with published references, IDM+CASD reaches 98.9\% versus 98.0\% average success on LIBERO, while Uncond falls below its reference. Joint+CASD reaches 93.0\% versus 90.6\% on RoboTwin 2.0, and DreamZero+CASD reaches a 47.9\% four-category MolmoSpaces manipulation average versus 40.7\%. Performance varies across backbone integrations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出块对齐语义蒸馏（CASD），利用离线视觉-语言模型将演示分割为带描述的阶段，并根据每个动作块内阶段的占用情况（含阶段过渡）生成加权语义目标。生成器从当前观察、机器人状态和任务指令预测该目标，冻结生成器后训练以其预测为条件的策略。语义分支仅在每次策略查询时运行一次，无需在线VLM调用或推理链解码。
AI.motivation: 动作块（action chunk）可跨越操作任务的多个阶段，然而现有方法仅用其第一步的标签来描述动作块，无法反映动作块覆盖的完整语义内容，导致策略学习缺乏更丰富的语义指导信号。
AI.method: 离线VLM将演示分割为带文字描述的阶段；计算各阶段在每个动作块内的占用比例，构建包含阶段间过渡信息的加权语义目标；CASD生成器从当前观测、机器人状态与任务指令预测该目标；冻结生成器后，训练以该预测为条件的策略，语义分支每次策略查询仅运行一次。
AI.result: 在标注的LIBERO训练片段上，教师匹配对单阶段和跨边界块均高于偶然水平。评估了三种Fast-WAM变体及DreamZero集成，覆盖四个基准（含LIBERO-Plus分布偏移）。IDM+CASD在LIBERO上达到98.9%对98.0%的平均成功率；Joint+CASD在RoboTwin 2.0上达93.0%对90.6%；DreamZero+CASD在MolmoSpaces四类操作上平均达47.9%对40.7%。性能在不同骨干集成间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: CASD通过为整个动作块推导对齐的语义目标，一致提升了多种策略骨干的成功率，验证了离线语义蒸馏作为带阶段过渡信息的动作块学习信号的有效性；但效果因骨干集成方式而异，且无条件的Uncond基线相对于参考性能下降，说明方法对训练方案的敏感性仍需进一步讨论。

title: Learning to build covering structures with continuous adjustments
summary: Robotic construction offers the potential to use materials more efficiently and create complex geometries, but current methods rely on rigid, high-precision plans that cannot accommodate the tolerances, inaccuracies, and unexpected changes inherent in physical fabrication. In this work, we introduce a reinforcement learning approach that forgoes predefined plans entirely, instead generating construction sequences adaptively as the structure is built. Our method operates on graph-structured state representations and a mixed (parameterized) action space, requiring both discrete block selection and continuous placement parameters. Because the stability simulation of a structure is computationally heavy, we develop an efficient exploration strategy by incorporating unilateral edges into graph neural networks, extending soft actor-critic (SAC) to this hybrid setting. We evaluate our algorithm, HSAC, against the prior method hybrid-PPO (HPPO), demonstrating significantly higher asymptotic performance and good sample efficiency. We also demonstrate HSAC's robustness to hyperparameter choices and its exploration capability, handling up to 10 discrete actions without performance degradation. Finally, we validate our approach on a physical two-robot setup, successfully building a spanning arch with 3D-printed blocks in closed-loop execution, confirming that policies trained in simulation transfer to real hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSAC算法，一种无需预定义计划的强化学习机器人建造方法。它利用图神经网络处理结构状态表示，并通过扩展SAC算法适应混合（参数化）动作空间（离散块选择+连续放置参数），在实际搭建中自适应生成建造序列。实验表明HSAC显著优于先前的hybrid-PPO方法，在物理双机器人系统上成功闭环建造了一座拱桥，验证了仿真到实物的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人建造方法依赖刚性、高精度的预定义计划，无法适应物理制造中固有的公差、误差和意外变化。因此需要一种能够随着结构实际搭建过程自适应生成建造序列的方法，彻底摒弃预定义计划。
AI.method: 提出混合软演员-评论家（HSAC）算法，核心包括：(1) 使用图结构状态表示建模结构；(2) 通过图神经网络中的单边边（unilateral edges）实现高效探索策略，缓解结构稳定性仿真计算开销大的问题；(3) 将SAC扩展到混合（参数化）动作空间，同时处理离散块选择和连续放置参数。
AI.result: HSAC相较于先前方法hybrid-PPO（HPPO）在渐近性能上显著更高，且具有良好的样本效率；算法对超参数选择具有鲁棒性，支持多达10个离散动作而无性能退化；在物理双机器人平台上成功闭环执行了用3D打印块搭建跨越拱桥的任务。
AI.conclusion: 仿真中训练的策略可以成功迁移到真实硬件上，验证了该自适应强化学习方案在物理机器人建造中的可行性和实际应用潜力。

title: BIFTA: Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation for Unknown Sensors
summary: Advances in tactile sensing have made contact-rich perception possible, accelerating progress in robotic manipulation, material understanding, and embodied interaction. However, because optical design, elastomer mechanics, and imaging geometry differ substantially across tactile sensors, models trained on known sensor types can suffer an abrupt performance collapse on unknown sensors. To address this problem, we propose the Brain-Inspired Few-Shot Tactile Adaptation (BIFTA) framework; it draws on the brain's rapid sensory adaptation mechanism to adapt a frozen encoder to an unknown tactile sensor from a small labeled support set. BIFTA preserves pretrained representations through dual-view statistical memory, constructs support-conditioned spectral graphs to repair sensor-dependent feature neighborhoods, and applies uncertainty-gated recurrent propagation to strengthen reliable cross-query evidence. Extensive benchmarks across three tactile datasets show that BIFTA substantially improves adaptation to unknown sensors: with only 10\% labeled target data on SITR, it raises mean Sparsh accuracy from 6.86\% for the frozen source classifier to 87.09\%, exceeding the strongest implemented prior comparison by 47.22 percentage points, and these gains generalize across datasets, pretrained backbones, and tactile tasks. These results validate BIFTA for data-efficient adaptation to unknown tactile sensors and offer a promising route toward tactile models that transfer across heterogeneous hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIFTA（脑启发的少样本触觉适应框架），用于解决触觉传感器因光学设计、弹性体力学和成像几何差异导致的跨传感器性能崩溃问题。BIFTA通过冻结编码器加少样本支持集的适配策略，在仅10%标注数据下将Sparsh准确率从6.86%提升至87.09%，超越最强基线47.22个百分点。
AI.motivation: 不同触觉传感器在光学设计、弹性体力学和成像几何上差异显著，导致在已知传感器上训练良好的模型遇到未知传感器时性能急剧崩塌。这种跨硬件泛化能力缺失严重阻碍了触觉感知在机器人操作、材料理解等领域的实际部署。
AI.method: BIFTA借鉴大脑快速感官适应机制，包含三个核心模块：（1）双视图统计记忆用于保持预训练表征；（2）支持集条件谱图用于修复传感器相关的特征邻域结构；（3）不确定门控循环传播用于强化可靠的跨查询证据。整个框架采用冻结编码器加少样本适配范式。
AI.result: 在三个触觉数据集上的广泛基准测试表明，BIFTA显著提升了未知传感器的适应能力。在SITR数据集上仅用10%标注目标数据，就将平均Sparsh准确率从6.86%提升至87.09%，比最强基线高出47.22个百分点，且增益在多个数据集、预训练骨干和触觉任务上均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了BIFTA在数据高效适应未知触觉传感器方面的有效性，为跨异构硬件迁移的触觉模型提供了有前景的技术路径。

title: HiBRIDGE: A Hierarchical Bayesian Neural Network Framework for Interpretable Dialogue Management in Group-Robot Interaction
summary: In multi-party human-robot interaction, a robot must continuously decide whom to address and what to say to participate effectively in the conversation. In real-world interactions, this is challenging because several behaviours may be plausible at the same time: a robot might continue a topic with one participant, involve another through a question, or address the whole group, with the appropriate choice depending on both whom it addresses and the interaction context. Current approaches remain limited in representing uncertainty when several behaviours are plausible and in structuring decisions into semantically meaningful intermediate steps that make robot decisions easier to interpret. Addressing these, we present HiBRIDGE, a hierarchical Bayesian neural network framework for group-robot dialogue management. Its Bayesian formulation enables uncertainty-aware prediction and robust learning from limited interaction data, while the hierarchical approach formulates behaviour selection as a structured, multi-stage decision process. We further use decision-tree surrogates to investigate whether this structure can support more interpretable explanations. Across three offline group-HRI datasets, our findings show that Bayesian formulations outperform their deterministic counterparts and several state-of-the-art baselines. Next, through an online study (N=20), we show that explanations derived from the hierarchical model are rated as more helpful for understanding robot behaviour and are preferred over those derived from the flat model. Finally, through our in-person study (N=12), we demonstrate the feasibility of HiBRIDGE for autonomous real-time group interaction, with both hierarchical and flat Bayesian variants positively perceived. Overall, HiBRIDGE combines strong predictive performance with a structured decision process that supports more interpretable explanations of robot behaviour.

AI.tldr: HiBRIDGE是一个用于多人群组人机交互对话管理的分层贝叶斯神经网络框架，通过贝叶斯公式实现不确定性感知预测和有限数据学习，分层结构化决策过程提升可解释性。在离线数据集上优于确定性模型和SOTA基线，在线与真人交互研究中证实其解释更具帮助性且被用户偏好。
AI.motivation: 在多人群组人机交互中，机器人需要持续决定对谁说话以及说什么。现有方法在两方面存在局限：(1) 当多种行为同时合理时，难以表示不确定性；(2) 缺少将决策结构化为语义上有意义的中间步骤的机制，导致机器人决策难以解释。
AI.method: 提出HiBRIDGE，一种分层贝叶斯神经网络框架，用于群组机器人对话管理。贝叶斯公式支持不确定性感知预测和从有限交互数据中稳健学习；分层结构将行为选择建模为结构化的多阶段决策过程。此外，使用决策树替代模型来探索该结构是否支持更可解释的解释。
AI.result: (1) 在三个离线群组HRI数据集上，贝叶斯公式优于确定性对应模型和多个SOTA基线；(2) 在线研究(N=20)显示分层模型派生的解释比扁平模型派生的被评价为更有助于理解机器人行为且更受偏好；(3) 真人实时交互研究(N=12)验证了HiBRIDGE用于自主实时群组交互的可行性，分层和扁平贝叶斯变体均获积极评价。
AI.conclusion: HiBRIDGE将强大的预测性能与结构化决策过程相结合，支持对机器人行为更可解释的解释，为群组人机交互中的对话管理提供了一种兼顾性能与可解释性的有效方案。

title: DCLP++: Learning to Navigate with Footprint Clearance and Relative Motion
summary: We present DCLP++, a local navigation frameworkthat uses footprint clearance as the geometric basis for studying relative motion features in dynamic environments. Each valid LiDAR return is mapped to its shortest Euclidean distance from the filled robot footprint before reciprocal encoding, replacing distance from the sensor with distance to the occupied body. Radial measurementsor simulated planar relative velocities provide short-horizon features without static-dynamic labels in the policy input. A preliminary study uses a rectangular robot with a speed limit of 1 m/s among 20 moving obstacles. On 100 fixed validation tasks, two selected training seeds yield mean success rates of 42% with sensor rangeand 70% with footprint clearance after 200,000 environment steps.Motion variants show mixed additional gains. These results supportthe clearance-based observation in the evaluated setting; reliable motion benefits and transfer across robots require further evaluation.

AI.tldr: DCLP++是一个本地导航框架，使用足迹间距作为动态环境中相对运动特征的几何基础，用传感器与被填充机器人足迹的最短欧氏距离替代传感器距离进行倒易编码。实验表明足迹间距优于传感器范围（70% vs 42%成功率），但运动变体增益不一，跨机器人泛化仍需验证。
AI.motivation: 传统导航策略以传感器距离作为观测基础，忽视了机器人本体占地对其在拥挤动态环境中安全导航的影响，且需要静态/动态标签等额外信息，增加了策略学习的复杂性。
AI.method: 将每个有效的LiDAR返回映射到其距被填充机器人足迹的最短欧氏距离，再进行倒易编码；采用径向测量或模拟平面相对速度提供短时域特征，无需将静态/动态类别标签输入策略。在矩形机器人、1m/s限速、20个移动障碍物的场景中进行初步验证。
AI.result: 在100个固定验证任务上，两个选定训练种子的200,000环境步后平均成功率：使用传感器范围为42%，使用足迹间距为70%。运动变体表现出混合的额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 在该评测环境中支持基于足迹间距的观测方式；运动特征带来的可靠收益以及跨机器人的迁移能力仍需进一步评估。

title: FOCI Policy: Focus on Object-Centric Interactions for Relational Manipulation Policies
summary: Object-centric manipulation policies improve generalization by modeling object motion instead of directly predicting robot actions. However, existing methods are often limited by representations which are either too simplistic to capture interaction dynamics or too dense to learn efficiently. We observe that many rigid relational manipulation tasks are governed by short interaction phases where the relative motion between task-relevant objects is tightly constrained. Based on this observation, we propose \textsc{Foci Policy}, an interaction-centric framework that achieves a two-fold abstraction: (1) temporally, by automatically extracting compact interaction segments from demonstrations;(2) spatially, by representing skills as relative $SE(3)$ motion between task-relevant objects, yielding invariance to scene configurations and robot embodiment. Experiments on RLBench, COLOSSEUM, and real-world tasks show that \textsc{Foci Policy} achieves strong performance with substantially less training data than prior object-centric and action-centric policies. These results suggest that modeling object-object interactions provides a simple and efficient inductive bias for rigid relational manipulation. Project page: \href{https://fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}{fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Foci Policy，一个交互中心框架，通过时间和空间双重抽象（自动提取紧凑交互片段，将技能表示为任务相关物体间的相对SE(3)运动）来学习刚性关系操作策略，在RLBench、COLOSSEUM和真实世界任务中相比以往物体中心和动作中心策略用更少训练数据取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 物体中心操作策略通过建模物体运动而非直接预测机器人动作来提升泛化性，但现有方法要么表示过于简单无法捕捉交互动力学，要么过于稠密导致学习效率低。作者观察到许多刚性关系操作任务由短交互阶段主导，其中相关物体间的相对运动受到紧密约束，这为设计高效、可泛化的策略表示提供了启示。
AI.method: 提出交互中心框架Foci Policy，实现双重抽象：(1) 时间上，从演示中自动提取紧凑的交互片段；(2) 空间上，将技能表示为任务相关物体间的相对SE(3)运动，从而对场景配置和机器人本体具有不变性。策略在交互片段内学习物体对之间的相对运动关系，以此驱动操作。
AI.result: 在RLBench、COLOSSEUM以及真实世界任务上，Foci Policy相比先前的物体中心和动作中心策略，用显著更少的训练数据即可取得强性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，建模物体-物体交互为刚性关系操作提供了一种简单而高效的归纳偏置，兼顾了数据效率与泛化能力。

title: A Controlled Comparison of Manual and Teleoperated Intraocular Instrument Motion for an Input Device
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE Access for possible publication
summary: Input devices for robotic microsurgery are frequently described as preserving the surgeon's trained technique, but the claim is rarely measured. We compared manual and teleoperated intraocular instrument motion with the trocar constraint, the instrument, the eye model and the tracking source common to both conditions, so that the control interface was the only factor varied. Prior comparisons cannot hold the instrument fixed, because a robotic instrument is not the tool used manually. Sixteen participants performed a navigation task on a commercial ophthalmic simulator by hand and through a three-degree-of-freedom input device commanding a five-joint robot. Task outcome was equal but at ceiling: every participant acquired all five targets under both interfaces with no retinal or lens injury. Execution differed on every measure. Teleoperated trials took three times as long at a quarter of the median speed, covered less than half the angular working range, and were broken into 3.5 times as many separate movements. Completion time and movement fragmentation improved substantially across four trials of practice and had not plateaued; the measures set by the configured rate ceiling and joint limit changed the least. Finger activity doubled and pinch variability tripled, so reducing instrument degrees of freedom redistributed manual effort rather than reducing it. The interface preserves the outcome and reshapes the execution.

AI.tldr: 该研究在保持套管约束、器械、眼球模型和追踪源相同的条件下，对比了徒手与通过三自由度输入设备遥操作五关节机器人进行眼科显微手术导航任务的表现。结果发现两类接口的任务结果相同但执行方式截然不同：遥操作耗时3倍、速度仅1/4、活动范围减半、动作碎片化程度高3.5倍，且手指活动翻倍、捏合力变异性增至3倍。研究表明该界面"保留了结果却重塑了执行方式"。
AI.motivation: 显微手术机器人输入设备常被声称"保留外科医生训练的技术"，但该主张很少被测量验证。先前比较无法在器械固定的条件下进行对照，因为机器人的器械与手动工具不同。本研究旨在隔离控制界面这一唯一变量，客观测量不同控制条件对手术执行的影响。
AI.method: 16名受试者在商用眼科模拟器上分别通过手动操作和3自由度输入设备控制五关节机器人执行导航任务。两种条件下共用相同的套管约束、器械、眼球模型和追踪源，使控制界面成为唯一变化因素。任务结果以目标获取成功率及视网膜/晶状体损伤情况评估，执行过程通过时间、速度、工作范围、动作片段数等运动学指标及手指活动、捏合力变异度进行量化分析。
AI.result: 两组任务结果均达到天花板效果（16名受试者全部通过两种界面完成5个目标获取，无视网膜或晶状体损伤）。但所有执行指标均存在显著差异：遥操作耗时3倍、中位速度仅1/4、角工作范围不足一半、动作片段数为3.5倍。练习4次后完成时间和动作碎片化显著改善且未平台化，而受速率上限和关节极限约束的指标变化最小。手指活动翻倍，捏合力变异度增至3倍。
AI.conclusion: 该三自由度遥操作接口在临床结局层面与手动操作等效，但在执行方式上产生了根本性重构：它使运动变慢、范围变小、过程更碎片化，并将操作负担从器械移动重新分配到手指活动上，而非真正减少操作努力。该界面"保留了结果、重塑了执行"，表明器械自由度减少并未降低而是重新分配了手动努力。

title: Ostrich: Taking Large Strides Through Stiff Contact in Differentiable Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. Code: https://github.com/aleskucera/ostrich
summary: Three properties determine whether a differentiable simulator can drive gradient-based optimization through contact: simulation accuracy, gradient reliability, and per-iteration cost. Tape-based engines such as MJX and Newton Semi-Implicit require timesteps small enough to keep contacts numerically tractable, and their backpropagation memory grows linearly with the number of timesteps T. Surrogate models bound memory by approximating contact away, but the resulting gradients lose the geometry the optimization depends on. We present Ostrich, a GPU-accelerated rigid-body simulator that resolves hard contacts and friction with non-smooth Newton iteration at large timesteps (h ~ 0.1 s), and differentiates the converged residual via the implicit function theorem, reusing the forward Schur complement to compute the adjoint at O(1) memory per timestep. On real-robot trajectories over a pallet obstacle, Ostrich holds MuJoCo's sim-to-real accuracy up to a 50x larger timestep. Its gradients converge from random initializations where MJX descends slowly and Newton Semi-Implicit stalls; a warm iteration runs 211x faster than MJX's and 4.7x faster than Semi-Implicit's. On the same scene Ostrich differentiates 8,192 parallel worlds on a single 24 GB GPU, sustaining 29x checkpointed MJX's optimization throughput; without checkpointing both baselines exhaust memory at far fewer worlds. We close with a gradient-based trajectory optimization demonstration over triangle-mesh terrain across a 10 s horizon, a setting where prior engines either restrict to primitive geometry or face the convergence and memory limits shown above.

AI.tldr: Ostrich是一种GPU加速刚体仿真器，通过非光滑牛顿迭代在大步长（h≈0.1s）下求解硬接触和摩擦力，并利用隐函数定理对收敛残差进行微分，每时间步仅需O(1)内存计算伴随梯度。在真实机器人托盘障碍轨迹上，Ostrich在比MuJoCo大50倍的时间步长下保持sim-to-real精度；梯度优化从随机初始化收敛，热迭代比MJX快211倍；可在单张24GB GPU上并行微分8192个世界，优化吞吐量是带checkpoint的MJX的29倍。
AI.motivation: 可微分仿真器的三个关键属性——仿真精度、梯度可靠性和单步成本——之间相互制约。基于tape的引擎（如MJX和Newton Semi-Implicit）需要极小时间步以保持接触数值可解，且反向传播内存随时间步数T线性增长；替代模型虽然限制了内存但近似掉了接触，丢失了优化所依赖的几何信息。亟需一种既能在大时间步下保持硬接触精度、又具有恒定内存代价的梯度传播方案。
AI.method: 论文提出Ostrich：1) 在GPU上使用非光滑牛顿迭代在大时间步长（h≈0.1s）下求解硬接触与摩擦力；2) 通过隐函数定理（implicit function theorem）对收敛残差求微分，复用前向Schur补来计算伴随，实现每时间步O(1)的内存开销；3) 支持大规模并行（8192个世界）GPU优化。
AI.result: Ostrich在真实机器人托盘障碍轨迹上，以比MuJoCo大50倍的时间步长保持sim-to-real精度；其梯度从随机初始化即可收敛，而MJX下降缓慢、Newton Semi-Implicit停滞；热迭代速度快于MJX（211倍）和Semi-Implicit（4.7倍）。在单张24GB GPU上可对8192个并行世界求微分，保持29倍于带checkpoint的MJX的优化吞吐量；对比之下两种基线在不带checkpoint时远较少的world数即耗尽显存。此外，在10秒时域、三角形网格地形上的基于梯度的轨迹优化演示中展现了对复杂几何的支持。
AI.conclusion: Ostrich有效打破了可微分仿真中精度、梯度质量与内存/计算成本之间的权衡：通过隐函数定理结合非光滑牛顿迭代，能够在O(1)内存下获得大步长下可靠且准确的梯度，显著超越MJX和Newton Semi-Implicit的收敛性与吞吐量，并将可微优化扩展到复杂三角网格地形等此前受限的场景。

title: Graph-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Systems with Time-Varying Topology
summary: This paper presents a graph-based safe multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for cooperative navigation with time-varying topology. To address the critical challenge of ensuring safety in environments with sensing constraints, a safety-decoupled mechanism is introduced through a Control Barrier-Like Function (CBLF) action screening layer. This mechanism bridges the gap between discrete LiDAR perception and continuous safety constraints, ensuring that physical safety constraints are strictly satisfied regardless of the learning progress. Building upon this safety foundation, a unified structural architecture is proposed, integrating a attention-based actor and a Graph Attention Network (GAT) centralized critic. The actor utilizes a value vector reconstruction mechanism that explicitly encodes relative geometric relations through a collaborative tracking error matrix, enabling scale-insensitive policy learning under time-varying communication topologies. Meanwhile, the GAT-based critic models evolving interaction structures for accurate global value estimation. The proposed framework is validated on real differential-drive robot platforms, and experimental results demonstrate superior stability and safety in dynamic scenarios with limited fields-of-view.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于图的安全多智能体强化学习框架，通过CBLF动作筛选层解耦安全与学习，结合注意力actor和GAT集中critic，在时变拓扑下实现协作导航，并在真实差速驱动机器人平台上验证了优越的稳定性与安全性。
AI.motivation: 在具有感知约束（如有限视场）的环境中，多智能体安全导航面临两大挑战：离散LiDAR感知与连续安全约束之间存在鸿沟，以及时变通信拓扑下如何保证策略学习的规模不变性与全局价值估计的准确性。
AI.method: 提出安全解耦机制：通过类控制屏障函数（CBLF）动作筛选层严格保证物理安全约束；构建统一结构架构，包含基于注意力的actor与基于图注意力网络（GAT）的集中式critic；actor采用值向量重构机制，通过协作跟踪误差矩阵编码相对几何关系，实现时变拓扑下规模不变策略学习；GAT critic建模动态交互结构以进行全局价值估计。
AI.result: 在真实差速驱动机器人平台上进行验证，实验结果表明所提框架在有限视场动态场景中表现出优越的稳定性和安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效弥合了离散感知与连续安全约束间的鸿沟，使得安全保证不依赖于学习进度，同时通过图注意机制适应时变拓扑，为受限感知下的多智能体安全协作导航提供了可靠方案。

title: Real-time Puncture Detection and Recovery for Pneumatic Soft Actuators
summary: Soft robots offer safe and adaptive interaction with humans and unstructured environments through their inherent ability to deform and comply. Pneumatic actuators are one way to build soft robots. They are typically made from soft silicone materials and are especially effective for driving such systems, enabling smooth and adaptable motion. However, their compliant nature also makes them vulnerable to mechanical failures like punctures and tears, limiting practical deployment. To address this, we propose a puncture detection system for soft actuators using motion data from a single inertial measurement unit. Extracted features are used to train anomaly detectors for puncture detection and non-linear models to estimate severity. We also introduce a multi-chamber pneumatic soft bending actuator capable of diverse configurations via selective chamber inflation. Our algorithm identifies the punctured chamber and provides a severity score using a chamber perturbation scheme. Anomaly detectors are trained on normal operation data and detect damage through reconstruction errors, while severity is estimated by a separate model trained under slightly modified conditions. Finally, we demonstrate a failure recovery strategy to maintain actuation force post-failure. This approach enhances the reliability and safety of soft robotic systems through real-time, data-driven damage detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单个惯性测量单元（IMU）运动数据的软体气动执行器穿刺检测系统，可用于识别被刺穿的腔室并评估损伤严重程度，同时提出一种故障恢复策略以维持失效后的驱动力。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人的柔顺特性使其容易遭受穿刺、撕裂等机械损伤，限制了实际部署。现有系统缺乏实时、数据驱动的损伤检测手段来提升其可靠性和安全性。
AI.method: 利用单个IMU采集运动数据，提取特征训练异常检测器用于穿刺检测；通过腔室扰动方案识别被穿刺的腔室并提供严重程度评分；异常检测器基于正常操作数据训练，通过重建误差检测损伤，严重程度则由独立模型在修改条件下训练估计；另提出多腔室气动软体弯曲执行器，支持选择性腔室充气实现多样构型，并开发故障恢复策略维持驱动力。
AI.result: 该方法能够识别被穿刺的特定腔室，输出严重程度评分，并在执行器发生故障后通过恢复策略维持驱动力，从而增强软体机器人系统的可靠性和安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了通过数据驱动的实时损伤检测可有效提升软体气动执行器的鲁棒性，为软体机器人的实际部署提供了一种可行的可靠性保障方案。

title: CAST: Alternating State-Value Targets and Expanded Policy Gradients for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is a family of RL methods that learn a model of the environment and use it for action selection, making it well suited to robotics due to its sample efficiency. Combining learned models with online planning can further improve action selection, as the planner can exploit the model to find better actions than the learned policy alone. Recent methods combining learned policies with online planning typically learn the value of the policy rather than the stronger planner-guided behavior. We present CAST (Critic with Alternating State-value Target), which uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning while regularizing the value estimate with the current policy. CAST replaces the action-value critic with a state-value critic, trained using a target that combines a real planner-guided transition and an imagined transition under the current policy. The resulting value function corresponds to an alternating process between planner-guided behavior and the current policy, allowing it to benefit from the stronger planner behavior while being regularised by the policy being learned. We evaluate CAST on the DeepMind Control and HumanoidBench Suites against several state-of-the-art methods, and demonstrate successful transfer to a physical Unitree Go2 quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.

AI.tldr: CAST是一种模型-based强化学习方法，通过交替使用规划器引导行为和当前策略的状态值目标来改进价值学习，在DeepMind Control和HumanoidBench基准上超越多种SOTA方法，并成功迁移到物理Unitree Go2四足机器人完成动态倒立。
AI.motivation: 现有的结合学习策略与在线规划的MBRL方法通常学习策略本身的值函数，而不是更强的规划器引导行为的价值，从而未能充分利用规划器发现的更优动作来改进价值学习。
AI.method: CAST将行动值评论家替换为状态值评论家，训练目标结合了一个真实的规划器引导转换和一个当前策略下的想象转换，使价值函数对应于规划器引导行为与当前策略之间的交替过程，既利用更强的规划器行为又受当前学习策略的正则化约束。
AI.result: 在DeepMind Control和HumanoidBench基准套件上评估，CAST优于多种SOTA方法，并成功迁移到真实Unitree Go2四足机器人上执行动态倒立动作。
AI.conclusion: 通过交替规划器引导与当前策略的价值训练目标，CAST能够有效结合在线规划的优势与学习策略的稳定性，证明了该方法在仿真和真实机器人上的适用性。

title: Visible-Reachable Workspace for Perception-Aware Humanoid Design
summary: Workspace analysis measures where a robot can place its end effector. For visually guided manipulation, reachability alone is insufficient: a kinematically reachable target may not be visible in the specific pose required to reach it. The robot must then redirect its sensing or move its body to acquire a view, turning a perception limitation into additional motion. Existing humanoids largely inherit this limitation when copying human form factors. We introduce the visible-reachable workspace (VRW), a design-stage measure that conditions visibility on feasible reaching configurations and extends it to concurrent visibility of spatially separated work regions. We apply VRW by building a 31-DoF humanoid with independently actuated RGB-D cameras. On the same robot, camera articulation increases visible-reachable coverage from 38% to 97%. With actuated camera layouts, a second camera raises pairwise coverage from 0.45 to 0.95, while a third changes it only to 0.97. In a controlled two-target reach-and-grasp benchmark, our dual-actuated design reduces mean completion time by 17% and mechanical energy by 19% relative to the same robot with its cameras fixed. Hardware experiments demonstrate simultaneous observation and manipulation of front/back and left/right target pairs without torso reorientation. The results suggest that reachability becomes a more informative design quantity for perception-driven humanoid manipulation when it is evaluated together with the sensing configurations that make the reachable space observable. We will open-source all software and the humanoid hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/DukeHumanoidv2

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可见-可达工作空间"(VRW)这一设计阶段度量指标，将可达性与感知可见性联合建模，并据此设计了一款31自由度、带独立驱动RGB-D相机的人形机器人。相机驱动使可见可达覆盖率从38%提升至97%，双相机将成对覆盖率从0.45提升至0.95；在双目标抓取基准测试中，双驱动设计相比固定相机方案减少了17%的平均完成时间与19%的机械能耗，并通过硬件实验验证了无需躯干转身即可同时观察与操作前后、左右目标对。
AI.motivation: 传统工作空间分析仅衡量机器人末端执行器的几何可达性，但在视觉引导的操控任务中，一个运动学可达的目标可能在所需抓取姿态下并不可见，导致机器人被迫增加额外运动来调整感知。现有类人机器人在复制人体形态时同样继承了这一局限。因此需要一种在设计阶段就将可达性与感知可见性联合评估的度量工具。
AI.method: 提出可见-可达工作空间(VRW)概念，将可见性条件约束于可行达的构型集合之上，并扩展至多个空间分离工作区域的并发可见性度量。基于该度量构建了一款31自由度人形机器人，其RGB-D相机采用独立驱动（可旋转）机构，用于最大化可见-可达覆盖率。
AI.result: 在同一机器人平台上，相机关节化将可见-可达覆盖率从38%提升至97%；在驱动相机布局下，双相机将成对覆盖率从0.45提升至0.95，第三台相机仅提高至0.97（边际收益递减）。双驱动设计在受控双目标抓取基准中较固定相机方案减少17%平均完成时间与19%机械能耗；硬件实验证明可同时观察并操作前后、左右目标对而无需躯干重定向。
AI.conclusion: 将可达性与感知配置联合评估，可使可达性成为感知驱动的人形操控中更具信息量的设计指标。软件与人形硬件设计将开源。

title: Remotely Detectable Keyed Communication through Motion
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, Project website and code: https://sites.google.com/view/motionbasedmessaging/home
summary: Messages from electronic devices are conventionally received as text, audio, or radio signals. But robots move with rich, articulate motion in the real world, opening up the possibility of transmitting messages through motion itself. In this paper, we consider the problem of motion-based communication, where we seek to modify a robot's movements so as to transmit messages detectable from remote sensing (e.g., video or motion capture), without degrading policy performance. We introduce a method for messaging through motion capable of encoding arbitrary message content over short payloads - such as an agent's current intent - as noise in any pre-trained policy's actions. This brings a new kind of robustness to robot communication: this 'physical' channel complements standard wireless communications channels but does not depend on them, requiring no extra hardware nor the establishment of a direct link to the robot. We systematically characterize the space of encoding schemes and derive design heuristics, then validate them across simulated environments and real-robot deployment; on real robots running at 50 Hz, four robots jointly recover an 8-bit message at an aggregate 0.67 bits/s.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于运动的通信方法，通过在机器人动作中嵌入噪声来编码消息（如智能体意图），使消息可从远程传感（视频或动作捕捉）检测，且不影响策略性能，并通过模拟和真实机器人实验验证。
AI.motivation: 电子设备的通信通常依赖文本、音频或无线电信号，这些方式需要额外硬件或直接链路。机器人在真实世界中以丰富、流畅的动作运动，这为通过动作本身传输消息提供了可能，但现有方法忽略了这一物理通信渠道。
AI.method: 提出通过在任意预训练策略的动作中添加噪声来编码任意短载荷消息（如智能体的当前意图）。系统地表征编码方案空间并推导设计启发式，在模拟环境和真实机器人上验证。真实机器人以50Hz运行，四台机器人联合恢复8位消息。
AI.result: 在模拟环境和真实机器人部署中验证了该方法；真实机器人以50Hz运行时，四台机器人联合恢复8位消息，聚合吞吐率达0.67 bits/s。
AI.conclusion: 这种"物理"信道补充了标准无线通信信道但不依赖它们，无需额外硬件或建立直接链路，为机器人通信带来了一种新的鲁棒性。编码的消息不影响策略性能。

title: Model Predictive Control of Tensegrity Robots via Contact-Aware Graph Neural Dynamics Model
summary: Tensegrity robots offer lightweight, compliant mobility over challenging terrain but remain difficult to model and control due to complex contact-rich dynamics and partial observability. This work presents a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller for a three-bar tensegrity robot driven by a learned graph neural network (GNN) dynamics model. This work first extends prior GNN-based models with a differentiable contact detection module. The extension allows the dynamics model to reason over non-horizontal planar terrains, obstacles, as well as self-collisions. Then, the learned dynamics model and the MPPI controller operate in a closed data-collection loop, iteratively improving model accuracy and control performance. This work further introduces a hybrid MPPI strategy that combines MPPI with turning motion primitives to improve maneuverability. Experiments are performed in MuJoCo across five navigation tasks, which include, wall obstacles, inclines, narrow corridors, low-clearance structures, and a composite 3D obstacle course. The experiments demonstrate that the hybrid MPPI controller operating over the learned GNN dynamics model improves predictive accuracy over a flat-ground baseline model and achieves superior navigation performance compared to $A^*$-based re-planning and MPPI-only variants. Results show that the contact-aware learned dynamics combined with the sampling-based model predictive control enable robust tensegrity navigation in complex, contact-rich environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于学习型图神经网络（GNN）动力学模型与模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器的混合控制框架，用于三杆张拉整体（tensegrity）机器人在复杂接触丰富环境中的导航。通过引入可微分接触检测模块扩展GNN模型，并采用闭环数据采集迭代提升模型与控制性能，最终在MuJoCo中的五项导航任务上验证了其相比A*重规划和纯MPPI变体的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 张拉整体机器人虽然具有轻量化和柔顺运动能力，适合在复杂地形上移动，但其接触丰富的动力学和非完全可观测性使得建模和控制极为困难。现有方法难以应对非水平地形、障碍物和自碰撞等多样的接触场景，需要一种能够学习接触动力学并将其有效用于模型预测控制的方案。
AI.method: 该方法包括三部分：(1) 在先前基于GNN的动力学模型基础上扩展了一个可微分的接触检测模块，使模型能够推理非水平平面地形、障碍物和自碰撞；(2) 将学习到的GNN动力学模型与MPPI控制器闭环连接，形成数据采集与训练交替进行的学习循环，迭代提升模型精度和控制表现；(3) 提出一种混合MPPI策略，将标准MPPI与转向运动原语相结合以改善机动性。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中涉及五项导航任务（墙体障碍、斜坡、狭窄通道、低净空结构和复合3D障碍赛道）的实验表明，混合MPPI控制器在学习到的GNN动力学模型上比平面地面基线模型具有更高的预测精度，并且导航性能优于基于A*的重新规划方案和仅使用MPPI的变体。结果证实了接触感知的学习动力学结合基于采样的模型预测控制能够实现鲁棒的张拉整体导航。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了将接触感知的GNN学习动力学模型与采样型模型预测控制相结合，可以有效地解决张拉整体机器人在复杂接触丰富环境中的鲁棒导航问题，为柔性机器人在非结构化环境中的控制提供了一条可行路径。

title: DYAD: A Multimodal Dataset of Co-Located Human Assistance
summary: An embodied assistant working beside a person must track task state, recognize help seeking, choose how to intervene, and produce an appropriate response. Existing procedural datasets richly describe individual execution, while interactive datasets capture remote verbal instruction or undifferentiated co-working. They do not jointly link a co-located helper's verbal and physical interventions to performer requests, task state, assistance triggers, and outcomes. We introduce DYAD (DYadic Assistance Dataset), a synchronized multimodal record of human-human assistance during gearbox assembly. Across 20 sessions, one trained helper follows a guidance-first policy while assisting HoloLens 2 wearers. DYAD links 528 task-step intervals and 611 performer requests with 851 valid assistance records spanning verbal and physical help. DYAD's annotations span the assistance process; three reference tasks evaluate selected components rather than an end-to-end system: causal step understanding, pre-onset mode anticipation, and instructor response generation. On 829 eligible mode events, the strongest four-seed RGB mean is 0.548 +/- 0.007 macro-F1; causal metadata reaches 0.624 and a privileged trigger mapping 0.915, revealing information not recovered from pre-onset RGB. DYAD's contribution is not scale, but a linked interaction structure spanning help seeking, intervention choice, execution, and outcome under egocentric and workspace sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文引入DYAD（双人援助数据集），一个同步多模态的人类-人类辅助装配数据集，包含20次齿轮箱装配会话、528个任务步间隔、611个表演者请求及851条有效帮助记录，将表演者的请求、任务状态、辅助触发与共处辅助者的言语和物理干预建立关联。
AI.motivation: 现有程序性数据集仅描述单独执行过程，交互式数据集仅覆盖远程言语指令或未区分的协作，缺少将现场共处辅助者的言语和物理干预与表演者请求、任务状态、触发条件及结果联合建模的数据资源。这种数据缺口阻碍了具身辅助智能体在真实协作场景中的研究与评估。
AI.method: 通过HoloLens 2穿戴者在20次会话中进行齿轮箱装配，一个训练有素的辅助者遵循引导优先策略进行协助。数据同步记录多模态信号，标注涵盖整个辅助过程：关联528个任务步间隔、611个表演者请求与851条有效帮助记录（含言语和物理两种帮助形式）。提供三项参考任务：因果步骤理解、症状前模式预测和指导者响应生成。
AI.result: 在829个符合条件的模式事件中，最强的四种子RGB平均macro-F1为0.548±0.007；因果元数据达到0.624，特权触发映射达到0.915，表明仅靠症状前RGB无法恢复的信息可从此类结构化标注中获取。
AI.conclusion: DYAD的贡献不在于规模，而在于其关联式的交互结构，横跨求助、干预选择、执行和结果，在自我中心视角与工作空间感知下提供了全新的数据集范式。

title: A Distributed Consensus Particle Filter for Target Tracking using Autonomous Surface Vessels
comment: This is a preprint copy of a paper that has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the OCEANS 2026 Conference, Monterey, USA, September 21-24, 2026
summary: Maritime target tracking over large distances often requires multi-agent teams without centralized coordination, and intermittent communication. Each agent must maintain an independent estimate that can take advantage of opportunistic communications availability when possible. This can lead to overly confident local estimates in the absence of external data. In this work, we propose an augmentation to a classical particle filter implementation that accounts for this potential source of error by forcing particles to spread strategically in the absence of informative updates from other sensor nodes. We demonstrate our method using Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) on a lake, and show that our augmentations do not deteriorate nominal performance, and provide an advantage in some specific edge cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对经典粒子滤波器的增强方法，用于多智能体海事目标跟踪场景，在缺乏来自其他传感器节点的通信更新时，策略性地迫使粒子分散，以补偿因间歇性通信导致的过度自信问题。该方法在湖上无人水面艇（USVs）上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 大规模海域中的目标跟踪往往需要多个无人平台协同工作，但这些平台之间缺乏集中式协调且通信是间歇性的。每个智能体需要独立维护自己的目标状态估计，并在通信可用时利用机会性通信来提升精度。然而，在没有外部数据更新的情况下，局部估计会变得过度自信，导致估计误差被低估，从而影响跟踪性能。
AI.method: 提出一种对经典粒子滤波器实现的增强方案，核心思想是在没有其他传感器节点的信息更新时，策略性地强制粒子分布扩展开来，以反映由于间歇性通信带来的不确定性增长，从而避免过度自信的估计。
AI.result: 在湖面环境下使用无人水面艇（USVs）进行了实验验证，结果表明该增强方法不会降低标称性能，并且在某些特定的边缘情况下能提供明显的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的粒子滤波器增强方法能够有效应对多智能体海事跟踪中因间歇性通信导致的过度自信问题，在不损害正常性能的前提下提升特定场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。

title: Rethinking Learned Occupancy in Autonomous Active Mapping with Observation-Gated Filtering
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Space Robotics Workshop (oral)
summary: Autonomous 3D active mapping requires a space robot to choose where to sense while building the geometry needed for navigation. Learned occupancy completion extends spatial context beyond the current field of view, but one predicted map often serves two planning roles: it scores expected surface gain and constrains collision-free motion. Unsupported occupancy can therefore distort both where the robot looks and where it believes it can travel. We study this coupled interface in a controlled closed-loop benchmark by holding the active-mapping system fixed and varying only its planner-facing occupancy across observation-only, learned, oracle-corrected, and ground-truth conditions. Improving occupancy accuracy does not monotonically improve closed-loop coverage: across 25 starts, planning with ground-truth occupancy reaches 70% of the learned baseline's final coverage 12.7 steps earlier on average, while increasing final coverage by only 0.031. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce an observation-gated filter that retains completion in insufficiently observed regions and suppresses predictions only after repeated frustum exposure without nearby RGB-D support. The filter improves both targeted failure-prone starts without retraining or ground truth. These results motivate online revision of planner-facing geometry during autonomous intervals between communication windows. The current study assumes benchmark RGB-D observations and sufficiently accurate pose estimates; planetary sensing conditions and accumulated localization drift remain to be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究空间机器人在3D主动建图中，学习的占用补全预测如何同时服务于"表面增益评分"和"碰撞约束"两个规划角色，发现预测不准确性会扭曲观测目标与可行运动范围。通过受控闭环基准实验发现，提高占用精度并不单调改善闭环覆盖率（地面真值占用虽比学习基线提前12.7步达到70%覆盖，但最终覆盖率仅提升0.031）。为此提出一种观测门控滤波器，在未充分观测区域保留补全结果，仅在多次视锥暴露且缺乏RGB-D支撑时抑制预测，无需重新训练即可改善失败场景。
AI.motivation: 自主3D主动建图中，机器人需要在构建导航所需几何结构的同时决定下一步观测位置。学习式占用补全虽然能将空间上下文扩展到当前视野之外，但单一预测地图同时扮演两个角色——评估期望表面增益和约束无碰撞运动——导致不支持的占用预测会同时扭曲机器人的观测方向和可行路径，这是此前未被系统研究的问题。
AI.method: 搭建受控闭环基准：保持主动建图系统固定，仅改变面向规划器的占用条件（仅观测、学习预测、预言机修正、地面真值四种）。在此基础上提出观测门控滤波器，该滤波器在观测不足的区域保留学习补全，仅当某区域经历多次视锥暴露但仍无附近RGB-D支撑时抑制预测输出。
AI.result: 实验表明：占用精度提升并不会单调改善闭环覆盖率。在25个初始位置中，使用地面真值占用规划的方案比学习基线平均提前12.7步达到70%最终覆盖率（但最终覆盖率仅高0.031）。所提出的观测门控滤波器在不重新训练、不依赖地面真值的条件下，针对性的改善了易失败初始位置的建图性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果激励在通信间隙的自主运行期间对面向规划器的几何占用进行在线修正。当前研究假设基准RGB-D观测和足够精确的位姿估计，行星感知条件和累积定位漂移的影响尚待后续评估。

title: Online, Reachability-Aware, Sampling-Based Motion Planning
summary: Sampling-Based Model-Predictive Control (MPC) algorithms are a flexible class of controllers used for navigation on a wide range of robotic systems. Historically, such approaches have lacked hard safety guarantees, a shortcoming which we remedy in this work by computing guaranteed reachable-set overapproximations online with a fast, interval-based pipeline. We show that our method achieves similar performance to a state-of-the-art reachability-based planner without the need for the expensive pre-computation step, and can be scaled to systems that are infeasible using existing approaches. Finally, we demonstrate that our technique reduces safety violations by over 99% in a racing simulation and successfully controls a model racecar on real hardware experiments without crashes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于区间运算的在线可达集过度逼近方法，为采样型模型预测控制（MPC）提供硬安全保证，无需昂贵的离线预计算，并在仿真与真实硬件上验证了超过99%的安全违规率降低。
AI.motivation: 采样型MPC算法广泛应用于各类机器人系统的导航控制，但传统上缺乏硬安全保证（hard safety guarantees），这一短板限制了其在安全关键场景中的应用。
AI.method: 在线利用快速、基于区间运算（interval-based）的流程计算可达集过度逼近（reachable-set overapproximations），为采样型MPC提供形式化安全保证。
AI.result: 与最先进的基于可达性的规划器相比，该方法在无需昂贵预计算的条件下实现了相当的导航性能，并可扩展到现有方法无法处理的系统；在赛车仿真中安全违规减少超过99%，并在真实模型赛车的硬件实验中无碰撞地成功控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明通过高效在线可达集计算，可以在不依赖预计算的前提下为采样型MPC赋予硬安全保证，兼顾性能与可扩展性，并在仿真与实机中均验证了其有效性。

title: DeCAL: Towards Physically-Grounded Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Models via Contact-Aware Latent Co-Imagination
summary: Dexterous manipulation involves contact-rich and fine-grained interactions with the physical world, posing significant challenges for existing vision-language-action (VLA) models due to severe visual occlusions and complex contact dynamics. While recent works have incorporated tactile sensing into robotic manipulation, most approaches still rely on homogeneous multimodal fusion, lacking adaptive tactile integration and explicit modeling of physical dynamics. In this work, we present DeCAL, a physically-grounded dexterous vision-language-action model that unifies understanding, imagination and action generation for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, DeCAL leverages specialized experts for each capability while enabling efficient information flow among them. To effectively leverage tactile information, we introduce Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion that dynamically regulates tactile interactions via a contact-aware gating strategy. Furthermore, we propose Visuo-Tactile Latent Co-Imagination to jointly model visual and tactile dynamics, equipping the policy with implicit physical world knowledge. Experimental results show that DeCAL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks, attaining a 71% average success rate and an 83.4% progress success rate, while also demonstrating strong generalization to unseen scenarios. The website is available at https://aureleopku.github.io/DeCAL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeCAL，一个基于物理启发的灵巧视觉-语言-动作模型，通过Mixture-of-Transformers架构、自适应视觉-触觉融合和视觉-触觉潜在协同想象，在接触丰富的灵巧操作任务上实现71%平均成功率和83.4%进展成功率，并展现出对未见场景的强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作涉及接触丰富且细粒度的物理世界交互，现有VLA模型因严重的视觉遮挡和复杂的接触动力学面临巨大挑战。虽然已有工作将触觉感知引入机器人操作，但多数方法依赖同质多模态融合，缺乏自适应的触觉集成和物理动力学的显式建模。
AI.method: DeCAL采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构，为每种能力配备专门专家并实现高效的信息流动；提出自适应视觉-触觉融合（Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion）机制，通过接触感知的门控策略动态调节触觉交互；提出视觉-触觉潜在协同想象（Visuo-Tactile Latent Co-Imagination）方法，联合建模视觉和触觉动力学，赋予策略隐式的物理世界知识。
AI.result: DeCAL在所有任务上一致达到最先进性能，取得71%的平均成功率和83.4%的进展成功率，同时展现出对未见场景的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DeCAL通过统一理解、想象和动作生成三种能力，以物理感知的方式结合视觉与触觉信息，有效解决了接触丰富灵巧操作中的视觉遮挡和接触动力学复杂等问题，验证了自适应触觉融合与物理动力学显式建模的有效性。

title: Proxy Policy Steering
summary: Generalist robot policies carry broad manipulation priors from large-scale data, but specializing them to a new task remains the deployment bottleneck. This requires eliciting task-specific behavior from limited demonstrations without degrading their broad capabilities. We introduce Proxy Policy Steering (PPS), an inference-time adaptation method that resolves this challenge by training two lightweight proxy policies whose calibrated velocity-space difference steers the frozen base sampler. A reference proxy models the frozen base's behavior on target-task observations, and a task proxy, initialized from the reference, captures how this behavior changes under task supervision. Their difference forms a calibrated velocity-space residual that steers the frozen base sampler at every denoising step. We identify the conditions under which this residual isolates the change induced by task supervision, and validate them empirically. Because the base is never directly modified, its broad capabilities remain available at inference, including behaviors such as recovery from failure that the demonstrations themselves do not exercise. Adaptation requires only forward velocity predictions from the base, making PPS lightweight to train and applicable even without access to the base's parameters. On 8 real-world and 4 simulation manipulation tasks, PPS lifts the state-of-the-art pi 0.5 base policy by 53% absolute success rate on average, with zero-to-one gains on tasks the base never solves, while preserving the base's broad capabilities. PPS outperforms LoRA fine-tuning, from-scratch specialists, residual policies, and prior inference-time steering methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Proxy Policy Steering (PPS)，一种推理时自适应方法，通过训练两个轻量代理策略的校准速度空间差来引导冻结的通用基础策略，在不修改基础策略的前提下实现任务特化，在8个真实世界和4个仿真操纵任务上平均提升53%的绝对成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略虽携带大规模数据的广泛操纵先验，但如何将其专门化为新任务仍是部署瓶颈——需要从有限演示中引出任务特定行为而又不损害其广泛能力。
AI.method: 训练两个轻量代理策略：参考代理建模冻结基础策略在目标任务观测上的行为，任务代理（从参考代理初始化）捕捉任务监督下的行为变化。两者之差构成校准的速度空间残差，在每一步去噪时引导冻结的基础采样器。仅需基础策略的前向速度预测即可，无需修改基础参数。
AI.result: 在8个真实世界和4个仿真操纵任务上，PPS将SOTA pi 0.5基础策略的平均绝对成功率提升53%，在基础策略从未解决的任务上实现从零到一的增益，同时保持基础策略的广泛能力。优于LoRA微调、从零训练的专用策略、残差策略及先前的推理时引导方法。
AI.conclusion: PPS通过不直接修改基础策略的方式实现高效任务特化，保留了基础策略的广泛能力（包括演示中未涉及的失败恢复行为），是一种轻量且可广泛适用的推理时自适应方法。

title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.

AI.tldr: TANGO是首个用于语言条件人形机器人穿越杂乱环境的全身视觉-语言导航框架。它直接预测29自由度关节空间动作，完全在仿真中训练，通过全局路径规划、运动学全身运动生成、障碍感知运动编辑和RL跟踪等流程合成多样化穿越行为，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现了零样本真实场景部署。
AI.motivation: 传统导航方法将人形机器人在杂乱环境中的运动建模为2D路径规划问题，忽视了穿越复杂3D空间所需的全身几何感知自适应能力（如手臂放置、躯干调整和步态调节）。需要一个能够同时理解语言指令、感知环境几何并输出全身动作的统一框架。
AI.method: TANGO采用端到端的全身视觉-语言导航框架，以自然语言指令和第一人称RGB观测为输入，直接预测29自由度关节空间动作。训练完全在仿真中完成，流程包括：(1)全局路径规划生成导航路径；(2)运动学全身运动生成；(3)障碍感知运动编辑确保碰撞自由；(4)基于RL的跟踪为策略学习提供动态可行的动作监督。
AI.result: 在广泛仿真实验中，TANGO在视觉-语言导航任务上达到最先进性能，并且相比强模块化基线方法在需要障碍协商的挑战性场景中表现更优。此外，在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现了零样本部署，在杂乱真实场景中展示出稳健的语言引导穿越能力。
AI.conclusion: TANGO证明了通过纯仿真训练可以有效学习语言条件下的全身导航策略，并可直接零样本迁移到真实人形机器人上，无需任何真实世界导航数据，为解决杂乱环境中的全身人形导航提供了新的范式。
